glossary.κέλεται: κέλομαι — bid, command, urge; pres. 3 sg.
glossary.κέρδεά: κέρδος — gain, profit; (pl.) cunning, shrewd ways; neut. acc. pl., accented before enclitic θ’
glossary.καταπαύσομεν: καταπαύω — stop, put an end to; fut. 1 pl., with κε(ν) in a purpose clause
glossary.καταφθίσθαι: καταφθίνω — perish utterly, be destroyed; aor. inf. mid.-pass.: ’to have perished’
glossary.κείνη: κεῖνος — that, that one; demonstrative pron., epic (= Attic ἐκεῖνος); fem. nom. sg.
glossary.κεχολωμένον: χολόω — make angry; pass. be angry, enraged; perf. pass. part. masc. acc. sg.: ’in a state of anger’
glossary.κορυφῆς: κορυφή — peak, summit; fem. gen. sg.
glossary.κυλίνδεται: κυλίνδω — roll; pres. 3 sg. mid.-pass.: ’rolls, comes rolling on’
glossary.κῆρα: κήρ — doom, fate of death; fem. acc. sg.
glossary.λώιόν: λωίων — better, more advantageous; comparative (of ἀγαθός), neut. nom. sg.
glossary.μέσσην: μέσος — middle; fem. acc. sg., epic μέσσος (doubled σ) = Attic μέσην
glossary.μαντεύεο: μαντεύομαι — prophesy, divine; pres. imper. 2 sg. mid.
glossary.μαντεύεσθαι: μαντεύομαι — prophesy, divine; pres. inf. mid.
glossary.μαντεύομαι: μαντεύομαι — prophesy, divine; pres. 1 sg. mid.
glossary.μαστορίδης: Μαστορίδης — son of Mastor, patronymic of Halitherses; masc. nom. sg.
glossary.μετ: μετά (elided μετ’) — among, after, in quest of; prep. + acc. · also as preverb in tmesis, standing apart from its verb (μετ’ … βαῖνε = μετέβαινε ’followed’) · also + dat., ’among, between’ (μετ’ ἀμφοτέροισιν ’between the two of them’)
glossary.μνηστύος: μνηστύς — wooing, courtship; fem. gen. sg.
glossary.μυθέαι: μυθέομαι — speak, tell, utter; pres. 2 sg. mid., epic uncontracted (= Attic μυθῇ)
glossary.μυθήσασθαι: μυθέομαι — speak, tell, declare; aor. inf. mid.
glossary.μυκήνη: Μυκήνη — Mycene, eponymous heroine of the city; nom. sg.
glossary.νεμεσίζεται: νεμεσίζομαι — feel indignation, be ashamed; pres. 3 sg.
glossary.νεμόμεσθ: νέμομαι — dwell in, occupy, inhabit; pres. 1 pl. mid., epic, elided (νεμόμεσθ’ = Attic νεμόμεθα)
glossary.νεώτερον: νέος — young; comparative νεώτερος, masc. acc. sg.
glossary.νοήματα: νόημα — thought, design, purpose; neut. acc. pl.
glossary.νύκτας: νύξ — night; fem. acc. pl., acc. of time: ’by nights’
glossary.οἰκία: οἰκίον — house, home (Homer only in neut. pl. οἰκία, collective, = Attic οἰκία fem. sg.); neut. acc. pl.
glossary.οἴκαδ: οἴκαδε (elided οἴκαδ’) — homeward, to home; adv., -δε suffix of direction
glossary.οἷ: οἷος — of what kind, such as; relative/exclamatory adj., neut. nom./acc. pl. οἷα, elided (οἷ’) · also orthotone dat. sg. of the 3rd-person pronoun (= οἱ): ’to him, to her’
glossary.οὐδὲ: οὐδέ — and not, nor, not even; neg. conj. (grave, mid-clause form)
glossary.πάντεσσιν: πᾶς — all, every; masc./neut. dat. pl., epic -εσσι(ν) (= Attic πᾶσι)
glossary.πάσχωσιν: πάσχω — suffer, experience; pres. subj. 3 pl.
glossary.παθόντ: πάσχω — suffer, experience; aor. part. masc. acc. sg., elided (παθόντ’ = παθόντα)
glossary.παλαιά: παλαιός — old, of old; neut. acc. pl.: ’things of old’
glossary.παλαιῶν: παλαιός — old; fem. gen. pl. (substantival, ’the women of old’), partitive/comparison
glossary.παραθεῖτο: παρατίθημι — set beside, place before; aor. opt. mid. 3 sg., in a clause of repeated circumstance
glossary.παρφάμενος: παράφημι — talk over, beguile with words; part. mid., masc. nom. sg.
glossary.παυέσθων: παύω — stop, cease; pres. imper. mid. 3 pl.: ’let them stop’
glossary.παύσεσθαι: παύω — stop, cease; fut. inf. mid.
glossary.πείσομαι: πάσχω — suffer, experience; fut. 1 sg. (not of πείθω)
glossary.πηνελοπείῃ: Πηνελόπεια — Penelope; dat. sg., dat. of comparison
glossary.πιφαυσκόμενος: πιφαύσκω — declare, make known, make plain; pres. part. mid., masc. nom. sg., reduplicated
glossary.πλησίω: πλησίος — near; masc. nom. dual, used predicatively/adverbially: ’close (to one another)’
glossary.ποθὴν: ποθή — a missing, a longing, a want of; fem. acc. sg., + gen. of the thing lacked
glossary.ποιεῖτ: ποιέω — make, do, win, cause; pres. mid. 3 sg., elided (ποιεῖτ’ = ποιεῖται): ’wins (for herself)’
glossary.πολέος: πολύς — much, many; masc./neut. gen. sg., epic (= Attic πολλοῦ)
glossary.πολέσιν: πολύς — much, many; masc./neut. dat. pl., epic (= Attic πολλοῖς)
glossary.πολύμητις: πολύμητις — of many wiles, epithet of Odysseus (built on μῆτις ’cunning intelligence’); masc. nom. sg.
glossary.πολύμυθον: πολύμυθος — full of words, talkative; masc. acc. sg. (a one-off jibe, not a fixed epithet)
glossary.πολὺν: πολύς — much, many; masc. acc. sg., acc. of duration: ’for a long time’ · also adjectival, agreeing with a direct object noun: ‘much’ (πολὺν βίοτον ‘much livelihood’)
glossary.ποτιδέγμενοι: προσδέχομαι (epic ποτιδέγμαι) — wait for, await, expect; pres. part. mid. masc. nom. pl.
glossary.ποτιδέγμενος: προσδέχομαι (epic ποτιδέγμαι) — wait for, await, expect; pres. part. mid. masc. nom. sg.
glossary.πρὶν: πρίν — before, until; adv./conj., + inf. (grave, mid-clause form) · also τὸ πρίν, substantivized with the article: ‘formerly, at first’, no infinitive · also bare adv. ’formerly’, no art./inf.
glossary.πρῆξαι: πρήσσω (Attic πράσσω) — accomplish, achieve, effect; aor. inf. act.
glossary.πτερύγεσσιν: πτέρυξ — wing; fem. dat. pl., epic -εσσι(ν)
glossary.πτερὰ: πτερόν — feather, wing; neut. acc. pl.
glossary.πυκνά: πυκνός — thick, close-set, dense; neut. acc. pl.
glossary.πως: πώς — somehow, in any way; enclitic adv. (οὔ πως ’in no way’)
glossary.πόρῃσιν: πόρω (defective) — give, grant, furnish; aor. subj. 3 sg., epic -ῃσιν
glossary.πῃ: πῃ — in some way, anywhere; enclitic adv.
glossary.πῆμα: πῆμα — woe, calamity, disaster; neut. nom. sg. · also neut. acc. sg., direct object: ’woe’
glossary.σέο: σύ — you (sg.); gen. sg., epic uncontracted (= Attic σοῦ), gen. of comparison
glossary.σοῖσι: σός — your, yours; masc./neut. dat. pl., epic -οισι
glossary.στυγερὰς: στυγερός — hateful, dreaded, loathsome; fem. acc. pl.
glossary.σὴν: σός — your, yours; fem. acc. sg.
glossary.σὺ: σύ — you (sg.); nom. sg. (grave, mid-clause form)
glossary.σῷ: σός — your, yours; masc./neut. dat. sg.
glossary.τάων: ὁ, ἡ, τό — he, she, it; that (in Homer a pronoun); fem. gen. pl., epic (= Attic τῶν): ’of these/those women’
glossary.τέθνηκε: θνῄσκω — die; perf. 3 sg. with pres. sense: ’is dead’
glossary.τέκεσσιν: τέκος — child; neut. dat. pl., epic -εσσι(ν)
glossary.τέτρατον: τέταρτος — fourth; epic by-form τέτρατος, neut. nom. sg. (agreeing with ἔτος)
glossary.τίνων: τίνω — pay, pay a penalty; pres. part. masc. nom. sg.
glossary.τελευτηθῆναι: τελευτάω — bring to fulfilment, accomplish; aor. inf. pass., in indirect statement after φημί
glossary.τελεῖται: τελέω — bring to pass, fulfil, accomplish; pres. pass. 3 sg.
glossary.τετελεσμένον: τελέω — bring to pass, fulfil; perf. pass. part. neut. nom. sg., periphrastic with ἔσται: ’shall stand fulfilled’ · also periphrastic with the pres. ἐστίν rather than fut. ἔσται, of a thing already fixed by fate: ’it is a thing ordained, it is decreed’
glossary.τεὸν: τεός (epic possessive = σός) — your, yours; masc./neut. acc. sg.
glossary.τηλεμάχῳ: Τηλέμαχος — Telemachus, son of Odysseus; masc. dat. sg.
glossary.τινά: τις, τι — someone, something; masc. acc. sg., indefinite, accented before enclitic οἱ (with ὅν: ὅν τινα ’whatever’) · also neut. acc. pl., ’any’, with an understood noun (εἴ τινά που δεδάηκας ’if you have learned any’)
glossary.τιταινομένω: τιταίνω — stretch, strain; pres. part. mid., nom. dual
glossary.τοῖσδεσσι: ὅδε — this, this here; demonstrative pron., masc. dat. pl., epic -εσσι
glossary.τοῦτον: οὗτος, αὕτη, τοῦτο — this; masc. acc. sg.
glossary.τοῦτό: οὗτος, αὕτη, τοῦτο — this; neut. nom./acc. sg., accented before enclitic γ’ · also accented before enclitic τί (τοῦτό τί μοι ’this, I think’)
glossary.τρίετες: τρίετες — for three years; neut. acc. sg. used adverbially (acc. of duration), from τρίετης
glossary.τυρώ: Τυρώ — Tyro, a heroine of the past, mother of Pelias and Neleus; nom. sg.
glossary.τόσσα: τόσος — so much, so many; epic τόσσος (doubled σ), neut. acc. pl.
glossary.τὼ: ὁ, ἡ, τό — he, she, it; that (in Homer a pronoun); masc. nom. dual: ’the two of them’  ·  also acc. dual, object of a verb of address: τὼ … προσέφη ’spoke to the two of them’ · also relative, nom. dual, ’who (the two)’: τοκῆε δύω, τὼ μὴ γείνασθαι ὄφελλον
glossary.τῆλ: τῆλε (elided/apocopated τῆλ’) — far, far away; adv.
glossary.τῆς: ὁ, ἡ, τό — he, she, it; that (in Homer a pronoun); fem. gen. sg. · also fem. gen. sg. with the force of a relative: ’of which’ (τῆς ἕτερον μὲν θειλόπεδον ’of which one part is a drying-ground’)
glossary.τῶνδε: ὅδε — this, this here; demonstrative pron., masc./neut. gen. pl.
glossary.υἷας: υἱός — son; masc. acc. pl., epic υἷας (= Attic υἱούς)
glossary.φημὶ: φημί — say, assert, declare; pres. 1 sg.
glossary.φοιτῶσ: φοιτάω — go to and fro, roam; pres. 3 pl., elided (φοιτῶσ’ = φοιτῶσι)
glossary.φραζώμεσθ: φράζομαι — consider, take thought, devise; pres. subj. 1 pl. mid., hortatory, elided (φραζώμεσθ’ = φραζώμεθα)
glossary.φρονέουσ: φρονέω — think, be minded, ponder; pres. part. fem. nom. sg., elided, uncontracted (φρονέουσ’ = φρονέουσα)
glossary.φυτεύει: φυτεύω — plant, beget; pres. 3 sg., fig. ’set in motion (a disaster)’
glossary.φόνον: φόνος — murder, slaughter, bloodshed; masc. acc. sg.
glossary.φῆν: φημί — say, assert; impf. 1 sg., uncontracted (= ἔφην)
glossary.χαλεπαίνειν: χαλεπαίνω — be harsh, be angry; pres. inf.
glossary.χαλεπὸν: χαλεπός — harsh, grievous, painful; neut. nom. sg.
glossary.χρήματα: χρῆμα — thing, possession; (pl.) property, goods; neut. nom./acc. pl.
glossary.χρόνον: χρόνος — time; masc. acc. sg., acc. of duration
glossary.ἀέκουσαν: ἄκων (epic ἀέκων) — unwilling; fem. acc. sg. (= Attic ἄκουσαν)
glossary.ἀγήνωρ: ἀγήνωρ — lordly, manly, proud; adj. (2-termination), masc./fem. nom. sg.
glossary.ἀγλαὸν: ἀγλαός — splendid, radiant, bright; masc./neut. acc. sg.
glossary.ἀγόρευες: ἀγορεύω — speak, declare, say; impf. 2 sg., in an unreal apodosis with ἄν
glossary.ἀκράαντον: ἀκράαντος — unaccomplished, unfulfilled, vain; fem. acc. sg. (2-termination adj., predicative): ’in vain’
glossary.ἀλκμήνη: Ἀλκμήνη — Alcmene, mother of Heracles; nom. sg.
glossary.ἀλλήλοισι: ἀλλήλων — one another; masc./neut. dat. pl., epic -οισι
glossary.ἀλλύεσκεν: ἀναλύω — unravel, undo, unloose again; impf. 3 sg. iterative in -σκον, epic assimilated (ἀλλύεσκεν = ἀναλύεσκεν)
glossary.ἀλλύουσαν: ἀναλύω — unravel, undo; pres. part. fem. acc. sg., epic assimilated (ἀλλύουσαν = ἀναλύουσαν)
glossary.ἀμείνων: ἀγαθός — good; comparative ἀμείνων, masc. nom. sg.: ’better’
glossary.ἀμφί: ἀμφί — around, about, on both sides of; prep. + acc. · also preverb in tmesis, standing apart from its verb (ἀμφί … ἕπον = ἀμφέπον ’busied themselves about, dressed’)
glossary.ἀνάγκης: ἀνάγκη — necessity, compulsion; fem. gen. sg.: ’under compulsion’
glossary.ἀνιήσει: ἀνιάω — distress, vex, grieve; fut. 3 sg.
glossary.ἀνιείης: ἀνίημι — let go, incite, urge on; pres. opt. 2 sg., in an unreal apodosis with κε
glossary.ἀνιηρέστερον: ἀνιηρός — distressing, grievous; comparative, neut. nom./acc. sg.
glossary.ἀνωγέτω: ἄνωγα — bid, command; perf. imper. 3 sg. with pres. force: ’let him bid’
glossary.ἀπάνευθε: ἀπάνευθε — far away, apart, at a distance; adv., + gen.
glossary.ἀπείρητος: ἀπείρητος — untried, without experience; masc. nom. sg.
glossary.ἀπερχομένη: ἀπέρχομαι — go away, depart; pres. part. fem. nom. sg.
glossary.ἀπεχθάνεαι: ἀπεχθάνομαι — become hateful, incur hatred; pres. 2 sg., epic uncontracted (= Attic ἀπεχθάνῃ)
glossary.ἀπονέεσθαι: ἀπονέομαι — go back, return; pres. inf.
glossary.ἀποτίνειν: ἀποτίνω — pay back, repay; pres. inf.
glossary.ἀπόπεμψον: ἀποπέμπω — send away, send off; aor. imper. 2 sg.
glossary.ἀπῶσαι: ἀπωθέω — push away, thrust away, drive out; aor. inf. act.
glossary.ἀρήσετ: ἀράομαι — pray, pray for, call down (a curse); fut. 3 sg. mid., elided (ἀρήσετ’ = ἀρήσεται)
glossary.ἀργαλέης: ἀργαλέος — grievous, painful, hard; fem. gen. sg.
glossary.ἀργεῖοι: Ἀργεῖοι — the Argives, i.e. the Greeks; masc. nom. pl.
glossary.ἀρετῆς: ἀρετή — excellence, worth (of a person); fem. gen. sg.
glossary.ἀσχάλλῃς: ἀσχάλλω — be vexed, chafe, be distressed; pres. subj. 2 sg.
glossary.ἀχαιαί: Ἀχαιαί (fem. of Ἀχαιός) — the Achaean women; fem. nom. pl.
glossary.ἀχαιοί: Ἀχαιοί — the Achaeans, the Greeks; masc. nom. pl.
glossary.ἁλιθέρσης: Ἁλιθέρσης — Halitherses, an old seer of Ithaca, son of Mastor; masc. nom. sg.
glossary.ἁνδάνει: ἁνδάνω — please, be pleasing to; pres. 3 sg., + dat.
glossary.ἃς: ὅς, ἥ, ὅ — who, which; relative pron., fem. acc. pl.
glossary.ἄγνωστον: ἄγνωστος — unknown, unrecognized; masc. acc. sg.
glossary.ἄλλοισιν: ἄλλος — other, another; masc./neut. dat. pl.
glossary.ἄλλῃ: ἄλλος — other, another; fem. dat. sg. used adverbially: ’elsewhere’ · also fem. dat. sg. adjective, ’(at) another (woman)’ (ἄλλῃ νεμεσῶ)
glossary.ἅ: ὅς, ἥ, ὅ — who, which; relative pron., neut. nom./acc. pl.: ’what things’
glossary.ἐεικοστῷ: εἰκοστός — twentieth; epic ἐεικοστός (prothetic ε-), masc./neut. dat. sg.
glossary.ἐθέλουσ: ἐθέλω — wish, be willing; pres. part. fem. nom. sg., elided, concessive (ἐθέλουσ’ = ἐθέλουσα): ’though unwilling’
glossary.ἐθέλῃσι: ἐθέλω — wish, be willing; pres. subj. 3 sg.
glossary.ἐκέκαστο: καίνυμαι — excel, surpass; plpf. 3 sg. with impf. sense: ’excelled’
glossary.ἐκείνῳ: κεῖνος (Attic ἐκεῖνος) — that, that one; demonstrative pron., masc. dat. sg.
glossary.ἐμπαζόμεθ: ἐμπάζομαι — care for, heed, regard; pres. 1 pl. mid., + gen., elided (ἐμπαζόμεθ’ = ἐμπαζόμεθα)
glossary.ἐμυθεόμην: μυθέομαι — tell, relate, speak; impf. 1 sg. mid., iterative sense: ’I used to tell’
glossary.ἐνίψω: ἐνέπω (also ἐννέπω) — say, tell, utter; fut. 1 sg.
glossary.ἐναίσιμα: ἐναίσιμος — fitting, in due measure, true (of an omen); neut. acc. pl.
glossary.ἐναίσιμοι: ἐναίσιμος — fitting, in due measure, true (of an omen); masc. nom. pl.
glossary.ἐναίσιμον: ἐναίσιμος — fitting, in due measure; neut. acc. sg.
glossary.ἐνιαυτῷ: ἐνιαυτός — year; masc. dat. sg., dat. of time when
glossary.ἐνόησε: νοέω — perceive, think, devise; aor. 3 sg.
glossary.ἐξετέλεσσε: ἐκτελέω — bring to completion, finish; aor. 3 sg.
glossary.ἐπέεσσιν: ἔπος — word; neut. dat. pl., epic -εσσι(ν)
glossary.ἐπέτοντο: πέτομαι — fly; impf. 3 dual · also impf. 3 pl.: ’they flew, sped’
glossary.ἐπήλυθον: ἐπέρχομαι — come upon, come on, pass by; aor. 3 pl., unaugmented (= Attic ἐπῆλθον)
glossary.ἐπίστασθαι: ἐπίσταμαι — know, understand, be skilled in; pres. inf.
glossary.ἐπεπείθετο: πείθω — persuade; plpf. 3 sg. with impf. sense: ’was won over’
glossary.ἐπιδινηθέντε: ἐπιδινέω — whirl about, wheel about; aor. pass. part., nom. dual
glossary.ἐπιεικὲς: ἐπιεικής — fitting, suitable, proper; neut. nom. sg., used impersonally with ἐστί
glossary.ἐπιθήσομεν: ἐπιτίθημι — impose, lay upon; fut. 1 pl.
glossary.ἐποτρύνῃς: ἐποτρύνω — urge on, incite; pres. subj. 2 sg.
glossary.ἐρέω: ἐρέω — say, tell, declare; fut. 1 sg. (epic fut. of εἶπον, = Attic ἐρῶ); in tmesis with ἐκ, ἐξερέω ’speak out plainly’
glossary.ἐριδαίνομεν: ἐριδαίνω — strive, vie, contend; pres. 1 pl.
glossary.ἐρινῦς: Ἐρινύς — a Fury, avenging spirit that answers a parent’s curse; fem. acc. pl.
glossary.ἐρχόμεθ: ἔρχομαι — go, come; pres. 1 pl., elided (ἐρχόμεθ’ = ἐρχόμεθα)
glossary.ἐσθλὰς: ἐσθλός — good, noble; fem. acc. pl.
glossary.ἐυδείελον: ἐυδείελος — stock epithet of Ithaca, exact sense disputed (perhaps ’clear-seen’); fem. acc. sg.
glossary.ἐυπλοκαμῖδες: ἐυπλοκαμίς — a woman of the fine locks, fair-tressed woman; fem. nom. pl. (a nominal formation, distinct from the adj. ἐυπλόκαμος)
glossary.ἐυστέφανός: ἐυστέφανος — fair-crowned, well-garlanded; fem. nom. sg.
glossary.ἐφεύρομεν: ἐφευρίσκω — find, discover, catch (in the act); aor. 1 pl.
glossary.ἑκὼν: ἑκών — willing, of one’s own accord; masc. nom. sg.
glossary.ἑταίρους: ἑταῖρος — companion, comrade; masc. acc. pl.
glossary.ἔδονται: ἐσθίω — eat; fut. 3 pl., mid. in form (epic future)
glossary.ἔειπε: εἶπον — say, speak, tell; aor. 3 sg., epic uncontracted, augment ἐ- kept before the root’s own ει- (= Attic εἶπε)
glossary.ἔθρεψε: τρέφω — rear, nurture, bring up; aor. 3 sg.
glossary.ἔληθε: λήθω (poetic by-form of λανθάνω) — escape notice, elude; impf. 3 sg., augmented, + dat. of means: ’escaped notice by’
glossary.ἔμελλον: μέλλω — be about to, be destined to; impf. 3 pl. · also impf. 1 sg. (same form): ’I was destined, was about to’ + fut. inf.
glossary.ἔμπης: ἔμπης — nevertheless, in any case, for all that; adv.
glossary.ἔξιτέ: ἔξειμι (ἐξ + εἶμι) — go out, get out; pres. imper. 2 pl.
glossary.ἔπειθεν: πείθω — persuade, deceive; impf. 3 sg., augmented
glossary.ἔστι: εἰμί — be; pres. 3 sg. impersonal: ’it is possible’ · also existential, ‘there is’ (ἔστι δέ τις πέτρη ‘there is a rock’)
glossary.ἔτεχ: τίκτω — bear, beget; aor. 3 sg., elided and aspirated (ἔτεχ’ = ἔτεκε)
glossary.ἔχῃ: ἔχω — hold, have, keep to; pres. subj. 3 sg.
glossary.ἠματίη: ἠμάτιος — by day, in the daytime; fem. nom. sg. used adverbially
glossary.ἣ: ὅς, ἥ, ὅ — who, which; relative pron., fem. nom. sg. (grave, mid-clause form)
glossary.ἤιξαν: ἀΐσσω — dart, rush, dash; aor. 3 pl., augmented
glossary.ἰδέτην: ὁράω (aor. root εἶδον) — see, look, glance; aor. 3 dual, in tmesis with ἐς: ἐς ... ἰδέτην = ἐσιδέτην
glossary.ἰκαρίῳ: Ἰκάριος — Icarius, father of Penelope; masc. dat. sg.
glossary.ἰών: εἶμι — go; pres. part. masc. nom. sg.
glossary.ἱκέσθην: ἱκνέομαι — come to, arrive at, reach; aor. 3 dual
glossary.ὀλέσαντ: ὄλλυμι — destroy, lose; aor. part. masc. acc. sg., elided, in tmesis with ἄπο (ὀλέσαντ’ ἄπο = ἀπολέσαντα)
glossary.ὀνύχεσσι: ὄνυξ — claw, talon; masc. dat. pl., epic -εσσι
glossary.ὀπυιέμεν: ὀπυίω — take to wife, marry (of the man); pres. inf., epic -έμεν (= Attic ὀπυίειν)
glossary.ὀφθαλμοῖσιν: ὀφθαλμός — eye; masc. dat. pl., epic -οισι(ν)
glossary.ὁμηλικίην: ὁμηλικίη — age-group, those of the same age, contemporaries; fem. acc. sg., acc. of respect
glossary.ὁμοῖα: ὅμοιος — like, similar; neut. acc. pl.: ’similar to’
glossary.ὄσσοντο: ὄσσομαι — forebode, have a premonition of; impf. 3 dual
glossary.ὅν: ὅς, ἥ, ὅ — who, which; relative pron. (indefinite with τε/τις: ὅν τινα = ὅστις, ’whatever’); masc. acc. sg., accented before enclitic τινά · also plain relative pron., masc. acc. sg., not accented for a following enclitic: ’whom’ (ὅν ῥα καθεῖσεν ’whom he had stationed’)
glossary.ὅτεῴ: ὅστις — whoever; epic dat. sg. ὅτεῳ (= Attic ὅτῳ), masc.
glossary.ὑμέτερος: ὑμέτερος — your (pl.), yours; masc. nom. sg.
glossary.ὑπ: ὑπό (elided ὑπ’) — under, beneath; prep. + gen.; also + acc., ’under, up under’ · also of agent with a verb of dying, ‘by, at the hands of’ + gen. (ὤλεθ’ ὑπ’ Αἰγίσθοιο ‘perished by Aegisthus’) · also + dat., ’under, beneath’ · also as preverb in tmesis, standing apart from its verb, no case governed: οὓς ὑπ’ Ὀδυσσεὺς δύσετ’ = ὑπεδύσετο ’underneath which Odysseus sank down’
glossary.ὑποκρίνονται: ὑποκρίνομαι — answer, reply, interpret; pres. 3 pl.
glossary.ὑφαίνεσκεν: ὑφαίνω — weave; impf. 3 sg. iterative in -σκον
glossary.ὑψόθεν: ὑψόθεν — from on high, from above; adv., -θεν suffix
glossary.ὤφελες: ὀφείλω — owe; aor. 2 sg., in an unfulfilled wish + inf.: ’you ought to have, I wish you had’
glossary.ὥρμηναν: ὁρμαίνω — ponder, turn over in mind, weigh; aor. 3 pl.
glossary.ὧν: ὅς, ἥ, ὅν (possessive) — his own, her own; masc./neut. gen. pl. · also relative ὅς, ἥ, ὅν: of whom, whose; gen. pl., partitive (τοὺς δ’ ὧν ἐθέλει ’whomever he wishes’), not the possessive
glossary.ὧραι: ὥρα — season, time of year; fem. nom. pl.
glossary.αἰψηρήν: αἰψηρός — hasty, swift; fem. acc. sg., agreeing with ἀγορήν
glossary.αἴσιμα: αἴσιμος — fitting, right, according to what is destined; neut. acc. pl., object of εἰδώς: ’what is fitting’ · also object of τίσειν: ’everything that is fitting, what is due’
glossary.αἴσυλα: αἴσυλος — presumptuous, reckless, wicked (paired with look-alike αἴσιμος); neut. acc. pl., object of ῥέζοι: ’wicked things’
glossary.αἶψ: αἶψα — quickly, swiftly; adv., elided (αἶψ’ = αἶψα)
glossary.αὐλῇ: αὐλή — courtyard, farmyard; fem. dat. sg.
glossary.βίαια: βίαιος — violent, forcible; neut. acc. pl., agreeing with ἔργα
glossary.γέροντι: γέρων — old man; masc. dat. sg.
glossary.γίγνομαι: γίγνομαι — become, be; pres. 1 sg., near-copulative: ’I am, I become’
glossary.γελάσας: γελάω — laugh; aor. part. masc. nom. sg.: ’having laughed’
glossary.γυνή: γυνή — woman, wife; fem. nom. sg.
glossary.γόνος: γόνος — offspring, child; masc. nom. sg.
glossary.δέμας: δέμας — bodily form, frame; neut. acc. sg., accusative of respect: ’in body’
glossary.δέρμασιν: δέρμα — skin, hide; neut. dat. pl.
glossary.δίκαιοι: δίκαιος — just, righteous; masc. nom. pl.
glossary.δαίνυσθαί: δαίνυμι — give a feast; mid. δαίνυμαι, feast, banquet; pres. inf. mid.
glossary.δαινυμένους: δαίνυμι — give a feast; mid. δαίνυμαι, feast, banquet; pres. part. mid. masc. acc. pl.: ’feasting’
glossary.δαιτί: δαίς — feast, banquet; fem. dat. sg.
glossary.δηρὸν: δηρόν — for a long time, long; neut. acc. sg. used as adv. (accusative of duration)
glossary.διαπρήσσωσι: διαπρήσσω — accomplish, carry through; pres. subj. 3 pl.
glossary.διατρίβουσιν: διατρίβω — wear away time over, delay, obstruct; pres. 3 pl.
glossary.δώμαθ: δῶμα — house, home; neut. acc. pl., elided (δώμαθ’ = δώματα before a rough breathing)
glossary.δώματ: δῶμα — house, home; neut. acc. pl., elided (δώματ’ = δώματα) · also neut. nom. pl., subject: κλυτὰ δώματ’ ἔασιν ’his famous halls are’
glossary.εἰμι: εἰμί — be; pres. 1 sg., enclitic form (unaccented after an accented word): ’I am’
glossary.εἰμὶ: εἰμί — be; pres. 1 sg. (grave, mid-clause form): ’I am’
glossary.εἴκοσ: εἴκοσι — twenty; indeclinable numeral, elided (εἴκοσ’ = εἴκοσι)
glossary.εἶμι: εἶμι — go, will go; pres. 1 sg. with future sense (= Attic fut. of ἔρχομαι): ’I am going, I will go’
glossary.εὐηνορίδης: Εὐηνορίδης — son of Evenor (patronymic); masc. nom. sg.
glossary.εὐφραίνεσθαι: εὐφραίνομαι — enjoy oneself, make merry; pres. inf. mid.
glossary.εὐχόμενος: εὔχομαι — pray, vow, boast; pres. part. masc. nom. sg.: ’praying’
glossary.εὔχετ: εὔχομαι — pray, vow; impf. 3 sg., elided (εὔχετ’ = εὔχετο), + dat.: ’prayed to’
glossary.εὕοντας: εὕω — singe, singe off the bristles; pres. part. masc. acc. pl.: ’being singed’
glossary.θείου: θεῖος — divine, godlike; masc. gen. sg.
glossary.θεοῦ: θεός — god; masc. gen. sg., genitive with a verb of hearing · also genitive governed by a preposition (ἄνευ θεοῦ ’without a god’) · also possessive genitive with a noun: ’of the god’ (θεοῦ δαῖτα) · also gen. with ἄρχομαι, ’from the god’ (the point of departure)
glossary.θεὸς: θεός — god; masc. nom. sg., predicate: ’as a god’ · also plain nom. sg. subject, an unspecified deity left unnamed: ’a god’ (θεὸς δ’ ἐκέδασσεν Ἀχαιούς ’a god scattered the Achaeans’) · also of a goddess (θεός is common gender)
glossary.θυμός: θυμός — heart, spirit; masc. nom. sg.
glossary.θᾶσσον: ταχύς — swift; comparative adv. θᾶσσον ’more swiftly, the sooner’
glossary.θῖνα: θίς — shore, beach; fem. acc. sg.
glossary.κέλευθον: κέλευθος — way, path, journey; fem. acc. sg.
glossary.κέλευσας: κελεύω — bid, command, urge; aor. 2 sg.
glossary.κίε: κίω — go, go one’s way; aor. 3 sg. (root aorist, unaugmented): ’went’ (the gen. Τηλεμάχοιο is governed by ἰθύς ’straight toward’, not by this verb) · also imper. 2 sg.: ’go!’
glossary.καθήμενος: κάθημαι — sit; pres. part. masc. nom. sg.: ’sitting’
glossary.καθαπτόμενοι: καθάπτομαι — accost, address, lay hold of with words; pres. part. mid. masc. nom. pl., + dat.: ’accosting with words’
glossary.κακίους: κακός — bad, evil; comparative κακίων, masc. nom. pl.: ’worse’
glossary.κακορραφίῃσι: κακορραφίη — evil devising, evil scheming; fem. dat. pl., epic -ῃσι, instrumental
glossary.κακὰς: κακός — bad, evil; fem. acc. pl., agreeing with κῆρας
glossary.κακὸς: κακός — bad, base, cowardly; masc. nom. sg., predicate: ’base’
glossary.κατέδουσι: κατέδω — eat up, devour; pres. 3 pl.
glossary.καταπαυέμεν: καταπαύω — stop, put an end to; pres. inf., epic -έμεν (= Attic καταπαύειν)
glossary.καταπαύετε: καταπαύω — stop, restrain, check; pres. 2 pl.
glossary.κείνου: κεῖνος — that, that one; demonstrative pron., epic (= Attic ἐκεῖνος); masc. gen. sg.
glossary.κεχάροιτο: χαίρω — rejoice; perf. opt. 3 sg., reduplicated (κεχάροιτο), potential: ’would rejoice’ · also in a purpose clause after a past tense, ’might rejoice’ (ἵνα … κεχάροιτο); the form is usu. classed as a reduplicated aor. mid. opt.
glossary.κιὼν: κίω — go; aor. part. masc. nom. sg.: ’going’
glossary.κλῦθί: κλύω — hear, listen; aor. imper. 2 sg., + gen.: ’hear me!’
glossary.κτερεΐξω: κτερεΐζω — pay funeral honours to; fut. 1 sg.
glossary.κῆρας: κήρ — doom, fate of death, death-spirit; fem. acc. pl.
glossary.λαῶν: λαός — people, host; masc. gen. pl., governed by ἄνασσε ’was lord over’ · also gen. with a noun: ’of the people’ (ποιμένα λαῶν ’shepherd of the people’) · also governed by ἐκ: ἔκ ... λαῶν ’from the people’ · also partitive gen. after a relative: οἵ ... λαῶν ἡμετέρων ’those of our people who’ · also partitive gen. after an adjective of rank: πάντων ἀριδείκετε λαῶν ’most distinguished of all the people’ · also gen. governed by πρόσθεν: ’before (the city and) the people’
glossary.λειώκριτος: Λειώκριτος — Leiocritus, a suitor, son of Evenor; masc. nom. sg.
glossary.λῦσεν: λύω — loose, dissolve, break up; aor. 3 sg.
glossary.μάχοιτο: μάχομαι — fight; pres. opt. 3 sg., + dat.: ’should fight against’
glossary.μέγας: μέγας — great, big, grown; masc. nom. sg., predicate: ’grown’ · also plain attributive adj., masc. nom. sg., ’great, huge’ (μέγας σῦς ’a great boar’), not predicate
glossary.μέλαιναν: μέλας — black, dark; fem. acc. sg., agreeing with κῆρα · also agreeing with νῆα (θοὴν ἀνὰ νῆα μέλαιναν ’the swift black ship’)
glossary.μέμνηται: μιμνήσκομαι — remember, be mindful of; perf. 3 sg. (pres. force), + gen.: ’remembers’
glossary.μέντορ: Μέντωρ — Mentor, an Ithacan elder, companion of Odysseus; masc. voc. sg.
glossary.μαχήσασθαι: μάχομαι — fight; aor. inf., + dat.: ’to fight against’
glossary.μεγαίρω: μεγαίρω — grudge, begrudge, be unwilling to allow; pres. 1 sg., + inf.: ’I do not grudge [them] to’ · also with no complement, οὔ τι μεγαίρω: ’I grudge [it] not at all’
glossary.μεθ: μετά (elided μεθ’ before a rough breathing) — among, with; prep. + dat. · also + acc., ’after, behind’ (μεθ’ ἡμιόνους ’behind the mules’)
glossary.μενοινήσει: μενοινάω — set one’s heart on, purpose eagerly; aor. opt. 3 sg., elided (μενοινήσει’ = μενοινήσειε)
glossary.μενοινᾷς: μενοινάω — desire eagerly, set one’s heart on; pres. 2 sg.
glossary.μετέειπεν: μετεῖπον — speak among, address a group (poetic aor., defective); aor. 3 sg.: ’spoke among them’
glossary.μοῖραν: μοῖρα — due share, what is fitting, portion, fate; fem. acc. sg. (κατὰ μοῖραν ’according to what is fitting’)
glossary.μῆτις: μῆτις — cunning intelligence, craft, counsel; fem. nom. sg.
glossary.νέαι: νέος — new, young; fem. nom. pl.
glossary.νήπιος: νήπιος — infant, still a child, witless; masc. nom. sg.
glossary.νεμεσίζομαι: νεμεσίζομαι — feel righteous indignation, resent; pres. 1 sg., + dat.: ’resent’
glossary.νηυσὶν: ναῦς — ship; fem. dat. pl., epic νηυσί(ν)
glossary.νιψάμενος: νίζω — wash; aor. part. mid. masc. nom. sg.: ’having washed’
glossary.νοήμονες: νοήμων — sensible, thoughtful; masc. nom. pl.
glossary.νόοιο: νόος — mind, thought, purpose; masc. gen. sg., epic -οιο (= Attic -ου)
glossary.νῆες: ναῦς — ship; fem. nom. pl., epic νῆες
glossary.πέλονται: πέλομαι — be, become, prove to be; pres. 3 pl.
glossary.παλαιαί: παλαιός — old, ancient; fem. nom. pl.
glossary.παρέμιμνεν: παραμίμνω — stay beside, linger, tarry; impf. 3 sg.
glossary.παρθέμενοι: παρατίθημι — set beside, put at risk, stake; aor. part. mid. masc. nom. pl.: ’having staked’
glossary.πατρώιοί: πατρώιος — inherited from one’s father, ancestral; masc. nom. pl.
glossary.πατρὶ: πατήρ — father; masc. dat. sg., governed by ὁμοῖοι ’like’ · also masc. dat. sg. of the person told: ’to (her) father’ (ἀγγείλειε ... πατρὶ φίλῳ ’report to her dear father’) · also masc. dat. sg. in apposition to Zeus: Διὶ πατρὶ ’to father Zeus’
glossary.παύρους: παῦρος — few, little; masc. acc. pl.
glossary.παῖδες: παῖς — child, son; masc. nom. pl.
glossary.παῦροι: παῦρος — few, little; masc. nom. pl.
glossary.πείθεσθαί: πείθομαι — obey, be persuaded by; pres. inf., + dat.: ’to obey’
glossary.πειρήσω: πειράω — try, make an attempt; fut. 1 sg. act.: ’I will make trial, I will attempt’
glossary.πεύσεται: πυνθάνομαι — learn, inquire by asking; fut. 3 sg., + gen.: ’he will learn (of)’
glossary.πηνελοπείης: Πηνελόπεια — Penelope; fem. gen. sg., epic Πηνελοπείης (= Attic Πηνελόπης)
glossary.πινέμεν: πίνω — drink; pres. inf., epic -έμεν (= Attic πίνειν), used as an imperative: ’drink!’ · also complementary inf. after κέλεται: ’to drink’
glossary.πλέονες: πολύς — much, many; comparative πλέων/πλείων, masc. nom. pl. πλέονες: ’the greater number, most’
glossary.πλεόνεσσι: πολύς — much, many; comparative πλέων/πλείων, masc. dat. pl. πλεόνεσσι, epic -εσσι (= Attic πλείοσι)
glossary.πολιῆς: πολιός — grey; fem. gen. sg., agreeing with ἁλός
glossary.πολλαὶ: πολύς — much, many; fem. nom. pl.
glossary.προλέλοιπεν: προλείπω — abandon, forsake in advance, leave behind; perf. 3 sg.
glossary.πρόφρων: πρόφρων — willing, eager-minded, well-disposed; masc. nom. sg.
glossary.πυκινοῖσιν: πυκινός — close-packed, tightly-stitched, close; neut. dat. pl., epic -οισι(ν) (= Attic -οῖς) · also masc. dat. pl.; of words and thoughts, ’shrewd, well-knit’
glossary.πυνθάνομαι: πυνθάνομαι — learn by inquiry, come to understand; pres. 1 sg.
glossary.πότμον: πότμος — fate, doom, death; masc. acc. sg.
glossary.πύλονδ: Πύλος — Pylos; acc. sg. with the directional suffix -δε, elided (Πύλονδ’ = Πύλονδε ’to Pylos’)
glossary.σιάλους: σίαλος — fat hog, fattened pig; masc. acc. pl.
glossary.σκίδνασθ: σκεδάννυμι (epic pres. σκίδνημι) — scatter, disperse; pres. imper. 2 pl. mid., elided (σκίδνασθ’ = σκίδνασθε)
glossary.σκηπτοῦχος: σκηπτοῦχος — sceptre-holding, sceptred; masc. nom. sg.
glossary.σοῦ: σύ — you (sg.); gen. sg.: ’of you, your’
glossary.στελέω: στέλλω — fit out, equip, make ready; fut. 1 sg.
glossary.συλλέξομαι: συλλέγω — gather together, collect; fut. 1 sg. mid.
glossary.σφὰς: σφεῖς — they, themselves; reflexive poss. acc. pl. σφάς: ’their own’ (agreeing with κεφαλάς)
glossary.σχεδόθεν: σχεδόθεν — from near, close at hand; adv., with the directional suffix -θεν
glossary.σχεδόν: σχεδόν — near, close at hand; adv.
glossary.ταύτην: οὗτος, αὕτη, τοῦτο — this; fem. acc. sg.
glossary.τελέει: τελέω — accomplish, complete, fulfill; fut. 3 sg., epic uncontracted (= Attic τελεῖ)
glossary.τελέσαι: τελέω — accomplish, bring to pass, fulfill; aor. inf.: ’to bring to pass’
glossary.τελευτήσειν: τελευτάω — bring to an end, accomplish, fulfill; fut. inf.: ’to accomplish’
glossary.τελευτήσουσιν: τελευτάω — bring to an end, accomplish, fulfill; fut. 3 pl.
glossary.τελευτῆσαι: τελευτάω — bring to an end, accomplish, fulfill; aor. inf.: ’to accomplish’
glossary.τηλεμάχοιο: Τηλέμαχος — Telemachus, son of Odysseus; masc. gen. sg., epic -οιο, governed by ἰθύς ’straight toward’ (not by κίε) · also plain possessive gen. with a periphrasis (ἱερὴ ἲς Τηλεμάχοιο ’the might of Telemachus’, i.e. Telemachus himself)
glossary.τλαίην: τλάω — endure, bear, have the heart to; aor. opt. 1 sg., potential: ’I would endure’
glossary.τῶ: ὁ, ἡ, τό — he, she, it; that (in Homer a pronoun); masc./neut. dat. sg. used adverbially, epic τῶ (= Attic τῷ): ’therefore’
glossary.τῷδ: ὅδε — this, this here; demonstrative pron., masc./neut. dat. sg., elided (τῷδ’ = τῷδε)
glossary.φάτ: φημί — say, speak; impf. 3 sg. mid., unaugmented, elided (φάτ’ = φάτο)
glossary.φυλάσσειν: φυλάσσω — guard, keep, watch over; pres. inf.: ’to keep’
glossary.φωνήσασ: φωνέω — utter, speak aloud, raise one’s voice; aor. part. fem. nom. sg., elided (φωνήσασ’ = φωνήσασα)
glossary.φῦ: φύω — grow, put forth; mid. sense ’took firm hold of, clasped’; aor. 3 sg. (root aorist), tmesis with ἐν (ἔν … φῦ = ἐνέφυ)
glossary.χαλεπός: χαλεπός — harsh, difficult, severe; masc. nom. sg.
glossary.χατέουσα: χατέω — lack, need, long for; pres. part. fem. nom. sg.: ’longing (for it)’
glossary.χεύω: χέω — pour, heap up; fut. 1 sg., epic χεύω: ’I will heap up’
glossary.χθιζὸς: χθιζός — of yesterday, yesterday’s; masc. nom. sg., used adverbially: ’yesterday’
glossary.ἀέξεται: ἀέξω — increase, cause to grow; mid.-pass. ἀέξομαι, pres. 3 sg.: ’grows’
glossary.ἀγανὸς: ἀγανός — gentle, mild; masc. nom. sg.
glossary.ἀγαυοί: ἀγαυός — noble, illustrious; masc. nom. pl.
glossary.ἀγαυοὺς: ἀγαυός — noble, illustrious; masc. acc. pl.
glossary.ἀγαυοῦ: ἀγαυός — noble, illustrious; masc. gen. sg.
glossary.ἀγγελιάων: ἀγγελίη — message, tidings, news; fem. gen. pl., epic -άων (= Attic ἀγγελιῶν)
glossary.ἀεικέα: ἀεικής — unseemly, shameful, unfitting; masc. acc. sg. · also neut. acc. pl., used substantivally: ’unseemly things’ (ἀεικέα μερμηρίζων ’pondering unseemly things’)
glossary.ἀθηναίη: Ἀθηναίη — Athena; fem. nom. sg., epic full form (= Ἀθήνη)
glossary.ἀκέοντα: ἀκέων — silent, without a word; masc. acc. sg.
glossary.ἀκουήν: ἀκουή — hearing, report, tidings; fem. acc. sg.
glossary.ἀκούων: ἀκούω — hear; pres. part. masc. nom. sg.: ’hearing’
glossary.ἀμφιφορεῦσι: ἀμφιφορεύς — two-handled jar, amphora; masc. dat. pl.
glossary.ἀνέστη: ἀνίστημι — stand up, rise; aor. 3 sg. intrans.: ’stood up’
glossary.ἀνδράσι: ἀνήρ — man; masc. dat. pl., epic ἀνδράσι
glossary.ἀνιεμένους: ἀνίημι — send up, let go, release; pres. part. mid./pass. masc. acc. pl.: ’being let loose, driven in’
glossary.ἀνοήμων: ἀνοήμων — witless, senseless; masc. nom. sg.
glossary.ἀπέσσεται: ἄπειμι — be away, be absent, be far off; fut. 3 sg., epic ἀπέσσεται (= Attic ἀπέσται): ’will be far off’
glossary.ἀργαλέον: ἀργαλέος — hard, difficult, troublesome; neut. nom. sg., impersonal predicate governing an inf. · also neut. acc. sg. agreeing with a noun: ’grievous, hard’ (δεινόν τ’ ἀργαλέον τε, of λαῖτμα)
glossary.ἀρείους: ἀγαθός — good; irregular comparative ἀρείων, masc. nom. pl. ἀρείους, + gen. of comparison: ’better than’
glossary.ἀτέλεστος: ἀτέλεστος — unaccomplished, unfulfilled; fem. nom. sg.
glossary.ἀταρτηρέ: ἀταρτηρός — reckless, mischievous, hurtful; masc. voc. sg.
glossary.ἀφραδέων: ἀφραδής — senseless, foolish, thoughtless; masc. gen. pl., agreeing with μνηστήρων
glossary.ἁλίη: ἅλιος — fruitless, vain, in vain (unrelated to ἅλς ’sea’); fem. nom. sg. ἁλίη
glossary.ἃ: ὅς, ἥ, ὅ (relative) — who, which; neut. acc. pl.: ’what things’ (ἃ μενοινᾷς ’what you desire’)
glossary.ἄγγεσιν: ἄγγος — vessel, jar, container; neut. dat. pl., epic -εσσι
glossary.ἄλλῳ: ἄλλος — other, another; masc./neut. dat. sg.
glossary.ἄλφιτα: ἄλφιτον — barley-groats, barley-meal (usu. pl.); neut. acc. pl.
glossary.ἄνασσε: ἀνάσσω — be lord over, rule; impf. 3 sg., unaugmented, + gen.: ’was lord over’
glossary.ἄνεῳ: ἄνεως — silent, speechless; masc. nom. pl.
glossary.ἄρσον: ἀραρίσκω — fit, join, arrange; aor. imper. 2 sg. ἄρσον: ’fit, arrange!’
glossary.ἐείσατο: εἴδομαι — seem, appear; aor. 3 sg. ἐείσατο, unaugmented: ’seemed’
glossary.ἐθελοντῆρας: ἐθελοντήρ — volunteer, willing man; masc. acc. pl.
glossary.ἐκείρετε: κείρω — shear, cut down, waste, consume; impf. 2 pl., unaugmented: ’you stripped away’
glossary.ἐλθόντ: ἔρχομαι — come, go; aor. part. masc. acc. sg., elided (ἐλθόντ’ = ἐλθόντα): ’at his coming’
glossary.ἐλθών: ἔρχομαι — come, go; aor. part. masc. nom. sg.: ’going’
glossary.ἐλπωρή: ἐλπωρή — hope, expectation; fem. nom. sg.
glossary.ἐμά: ἐμός — my, mine; neut. acc. pl.
glossary.ἐνέστακται: ἐνστάζω — instill, drip into; perf. pass. 3 sg.: ’has been instilled’
glossary.ἐνήσομεν: ἐνίημι — send into, launch into; fut. 1 pl., + dat.: ’we will launch (her) on’
glossary.ἐξαίτους: ἔξαιτος — chosen, picked out, select; masc. acc. pl.
glossary.ἐξελάσαι: ἐξελαύνω — drive out; aor. inf., + gen. of separation: ’to drive out (of)’
glossary.ἐπέεσσι: ἔπος — word, speech; neut. dat. pl., epic -εσσι (= Attic ἔπεσι)
glossary.ἐπέτρεπεν: ἐπιτρέπω — entrust, commit to the charge of; impf. 3 sg.
glossary.ἐπήβολος: ἐπήβολος — having a share of, master of; masc. nom. sg., + gen.
glossary.ἐπίσποι: ἐφέπω (aor. ἐπισπεῖν) — follow upon, meet with; aor. opt. 3 sg. ἐπίσποι: ’would meet with’
glossary.ἐπιόψομαι: ἐφοράω — look over, inspect, single out; fut. 1 sg. ἐπιόψομαι: ’I will single out’
glossary.ἐρέτας: ἐρέτης — rower, oarsman; masc. acc. pl.
glossary.ἐρετάων: ἐρέτης — rower, oarsman; masc. gen. pl., epic -άων (= Attic -ῶν)
glossary.ἐσθιέμεν: ἐσθίω — eat; pres. inf., epic -έμεν (= Attic ἐσθίειν), used as an imperative: ’eat!’
glossary.ἐσθλὰ: ἐσθλός — good, noble, staunch; neut. acc. pl.
glossary.ἐσκίδναντο: σκεδάννυμι (epic pres. σκίδνημι) — scatter, disperse; impf. 3 pl. mid., augmented: ’scattered’
glossary.ἐσσὶ: εἰμί — be; pres. 2 sg., epic ἐσσί (= Attic εἶ)
glossary.ἐφοπλίσσαντες: ἐφοπλίζω — fit out fully, equip; aor. part. masc. nom. pl.: ’having equipped’
glossary.ἐφώνησεν: φωνέω — utter, speak, give voice to; aor. 3 sg.
glossary.ἐόντες: εἰμί — be; pres. part. masc. nom. pl., epic (= Attic ὄντες): ’being’
glossary.ἑταῖροι: ἑταῖρος — companion, comrade; masc. nom. pl.
glossary.ἑταῖρος: ἑταῖρος — companion, comrade; masc. nom. sg.
glossary.ἑὰ: ἑός — his own, her own (possessive, by-form of ὅς); neut. acc. pl.
glossary.ἔα: ἐάω — let be, allow, leave alone; pres. imper. 2 sg.: ’leave alone!’
glossary.ἔμπεδα: ἔμπεδος — steadfast, secure, firm; neut. acc. pl.
glossary.ἔμπορος: ἔμπορος — passenger, one who travels by ship as a fare-paying passenger; masc. nom. sg.
glossary.ἔν: ἐν — in, on; preverb in tmesis, standing apart from its verb (ἔν … φῦ = ἐνέφυ ’took firm hold’)
glossary.ἔνδοθι: ἔνδοθι — within, inside; adv., with the locative suffix -θι
glossary.ἔολπα: ἔλπω — cause to hope; perf. ἔολπα, reduplicated, pres. force, 1 sg.: ’I expect, hope’
glossary.ἔρδειν: ἔρδω — do, act, perform; pres. inf.: ’to do’
glossary.ἔρχεσθαι: ἔρχομαι — go, come; pres. inf.: ’to go’
glossary.ἔσσεαι: εἰμί — be; fut. 2 sg., epic ἔσσεαι (= Attic ἔσῃ): ’you will be’
glossary.ἔστιν: εἰμί — be; pres. 3 sg., impersonal: ’it is possible’ · also plain copula, personal: ’is’ (ἀργύρεος ... ἔστιν ἅπας ’it is entirely silver’)
glossary.ἔφατ: φημί — say, speak; impf. 3 sg. mid., augmented, elided (ἔφατ’ = ἔφατο)
glossary.ἕκηλον: ἕκηλος — at ease, undisturbed, in peace; masc. acc. sg.
glossary.ἠγαθέην: ἠγάθεος — very sacred, holy; fem. acc. sg. ἠγαθέην, agreeing with Πύλον (here treated as fem., as often in this formula)
glossary.ἠεροειδέα: ἠεροειδής — misty-looking, dark like mist; masc. acc. sg.
glossary.ἠλεέ: ἠλεός — crazed, distraught, out of one’s wits; masc. voc. sg.
glossary.ἠύ: ἠύς — good, noble, brave; neut. nom. sg. ἠύ, agreeing with μένος
glossary.ἤια: ἤια — provisions for a journey; neut. acc. pl. · also neut. nom. pl. (subject): ’our stores’ · also a different word, impf. 1 sg. of εἶμι ’go’: ’I was going’, unrelated to this noun
glossary.ἤλυθες: ἔρχομαι — come, go; aor. 2 sg., epic ἤλυθες (= Attic ἦλθες): ’you came’
glossary.ἤματι: ἦμαρ — day; neut. dat. sg., epic ἤματι
glossary.ἦα: εἰμί — be; impf. 1 sg., epic ἦα (= Attic ἦν)
glossary.ἧσθ: ἧμαι — sit; pres. 2 pl., elided (ἧσθ’ = ἧσθε): ’you sit’
glossary.ἰήλω: ἰάλλω — send, let fly, dispatch; aor. subj. 1 sg.: ’I may send’
glossary.ἰθακήσιος: Ἰθακήσιος — of Ithaca, Ithacan; masc. nom. sg.
glossary.ἰὼν: εἶμι — go; pres. part. masc. nom. sg.: ’going’
glossary.ἴσασιν: οἶδα — know; perf. 3 pl. (pres. force), ν-movable: ’they know’
glossary.ἵκηαι: ἱκνέομαι — come, arrive, reach; aor. subj. 2 sg. mid.: ’you may reach’
glossary.ὀδυσεὺς: Ὀδυσσεύς — Odysseus; masc. nom. sg., single-σ metrical variant Ὀδυσεύς
glossary.ὀνόμαζε: ἐξονομάζω — call by name, address directly; impf. 3 sg., unaugmented, tmesis (ἔκ … ὀνόμαζε = ἐξωνόμαζε) · also ὀνομάζω (simple, no preverb) — name, call by name, tell the name of; pres. imper. 2 sg.: ’name (him)!’ (τρίτον ἄνδρ’ ὀνόμαζε)
glossary.ὀτρυνέει: ὀτρύνω — urge on, speed, set in motion; fut. 3 sg., epic uncontracted -έει (= Attic ὀτρυνεῖ)
glossary.ὀτρύνων: ὀτρύνω — urge on, incite; pres. part. masc. nom. sg.: ’urging’
glossary.ὁδὸς: ὁδός — way, journey; fem. nom. sg.
glossary.ὁμοῖοι: ὅμοιος — like, similar; masc. nom. pl., + dat.: ’like (their father)’
glossary.ὄπιθεν: ὄπιθεν — from behind, hereafter, in time to come; adv., with the directional suffix -θεν
glossary.ὅπλισσόν: ὁπλίζω — make ready, prepare, equip; aor. imper. 2 sg.: ’prepare!’
glossary.ὑπερηνορέοντες: ὑπερηνορέω — be overbearing, presumptuous (built on ἀγήνωρ); pres. part. masc. nom. pl.: ’being overbearing’
glossary.ὔμμι: σύ (pl. ὑμεῖς) — you; epic encl. dat. pl. ὔμμι (= Attic ὑμῖν): ’to/for you’
glossary.ὔμμιν: σύ (pl. ὑμεῖς) — you; epic dat. pl. ὔμμιν (= Attic ὑμῖν): ’to you’
glossary.αἰειγενέτῃσιν: αἰειγενέτης — everlasting, ever-born (αἰεί + γίγνομαι); masc. dat. pl., epic -ῃσι(ν) (= Attic -αις); epithet of the gods, distinct from θεοὶ αἰὲν ἐόντες
glossary.αἱρήσομαι: αἱρέω — take, seize; here mid. ’take for myself, fetch’; fut. 1 sg.
glossary.αὐτίκ: αὐτίκα (elided αὐτίκ’) — at once, immediately, forthwith; adv.
glossary.αὐτὴ: αὐτός — self; intensive pron., fem. nom. sg.: ’she herself’, ’you yourself’
glossary.αὖθ: αὖθι (elided αὖθ’) — here, on the spot, right here; adv. (distinct from αὖτε/αὖ ’again, in turn’)
glossary.βάλῃ: βάλλω — throw, cast; aor. subj. 3 sg., tmesis ἐν … βάλῃ = ἐμβάλῃ ’cast in’, in a purpose clause · also plain (no tmesis), ’strike, hit’ + acc., in a clause of fearing with μή: μή πώς μ’ ... βάλῃ ’lest it strike me’
glossary.βάντες: βαίνω — go, step; aor. part. masc. nom. pl., root aorist, tmesis ἀνά … βάντες = ἀναβάντες ’having embarked’  ·  also plain, + ἐς and acc. of place entered: ’having stepped into (the tubs)’
glossary.βαῖν: βαίνω — go, walk, step; impf. 3 sg., unaugmented, elided (βαῖν’ = βαῖνε), tmesis ἀνέβαινε ’was going aboard’ · also in tmesis with ἐκ, ἐκβαίνω ’was stepping out’
glossary.βαῖνε: βαίνω — go, walk, step; impf. 3 sg., unaugmented (= ἔβαινε); here tmesis μετέβαινε ’was following’ · also without tmesis: ’went’ (ἀμφ’ ἑνὶ δούρατι βαῖνε ’went astride one timber’)
glossary.βλεφάροισιν: βλέφαρον — eyelid; neut. dat. pl., epic -οισι(ν) (= Attic -οις)
glossary.βοεῦσιν: βοεύς — thong or rope of ox-hide (from βοῦς); masc. dat. pl.
glossary.βουλή: βουλή — plan, counsel, will; nom. sg.
glossary.γένηται: γίγνομαι — come to be, happen; aor. subj. 3 sg., in a temporal clause with ἄν/κε: ’shall come’ · also aor. subj. 3 sg. in a direct question of doubt/deliberation, no ἄν/κε: τί … γένηται; ’what is to happen?’ · also aor. subj. 3 sg., prospective in a negative statement with a relative clause: οὐδὲ γένηται ’nor ever shall there be’
glossary.γλαυκώπιδι: γλαυκῶπις — epithet of Athena, ’gleaming-eyed’ (sense uncertain); fem. dat. sg.
glossary.γρῆυς: γραῦς (epic γρῆυς) — old woman; nom. sg.
glossary.δάσονται: δατέομαι — divide, share out; fut. 3 pl.
glossary.δασαίμεθα: δατέομαι — divide, share out; aor. opt. 1 pl., potential with κε: ’we would divide’
glossary.δεῦτε: δεῦτε — come! (pl. imper.-like interjection of an old verb of motion; sg. δεῦρο)
glossary.δησάμενοι: δέω — bind, make fast; aor. part. mid. masc. nom. pl.: ’having made fast (for themselves)’
glossary.διαπρήσσουσα: διαπράσσω — accomplish, make one’s way through; pres. part. fem. nom. sg., with κέλευθον: ’covering her course’
glossary.διατρίβωμεν: διατρίβω — wear away time, linger, delay; pres. subj. 1 pl. (hortatory, with μή): ’let us not delay’
glossary.δικλίδες: δικλίς — double, folding (of a door); fem. nom. pl.
glossary.διογενὴς: διογενής — sprung from Zeus, Zeus-born; masc. nom. sg., epithet of Odysseus
glossary.δμωαί: δμωή — female slave, bondwoman; nom. pl.
glossary.δοροῖσι: δορός — skin, hide, leather sack (Attic δορά); masc. dat. pl., epic -οισι
glossary.δοροῖσιν: δορός — skin, hide, leather sack (Attic δορά); masc. dat. pl., epic -οισιν (ν-movable)
glossary.δοῖμεν: δίδωμι — give; aor. opt. 1 pl., potential with κε: ’we would give’
glossary.δυωδεκάτη: δυωδέκατος (Attic δωδέκατος) — twelfth; fem. nom. sg. (understanding ἡμέρα ’day’)
glossary.δύσετό: δύω/δύνω — sink, set (of the sun); aor. mid. 3 sg., unaugmented
glossary.εἰλάτινον: εἰλάτινος — of fir, of pine; masc./neut. acc. sg.
glossary.εἴπεσκε: εἶπον (aor. of λέγω/φημί) — say, speak; iterative impf. 3 sg. with suffix -σκε, epic (= ἔλεγεν ἄν): ’would say, used to say’
glossary.εἴρυσε: ἐρύω — draw, drag, haul; aor. 3 sg., epic lengthened form (= εἴρυσσε, ἔρυσε)
glossary.εὐρύκλεια: Εὐρύκλεια — Eurycleia, Odysseus’s old nurse; nom. sg.
glossary.εὐρύν: εὐρύς — wide, broad; masc. acc. sg., agreeing with θάλαμον, held apart from its noun by hyperbaton
glossary.εὕδειν: εὕδω — sleep; pres. inf.: ’to sleep’ (with ὤρνυντο, ’bestirred themselves to sleep’)
glossary.εὗρον: εὑρίσκω — find; aor. 3 pl., unaugmented (= ηὗρον)
glossary.ζέφυρον: Ζέφυρος — the West Wind, personified; masc. acc. sg.
glossary.θάρσει: θαρσέω — be of good courage, take heart; pres. imper. 2 sg.
glossary.θαλαμόνδε: θάλαμος — chamber, room; acc. sg. + directional suffix -δε: ’to the chamber’
glossary.θεοῖο: θεός — god; masc. gen. sg., epic -οιο (= Attic -οῦ) · also of a goddess, θεός being common in gender
glossary.θινὶ: θίς (θίν-) — shore, beach, strand; dat. sg.
glossary.θοήν: θοός — swift, quick; fem. acc. sg.
glossary.θυμοφθόρα: θυμοφθόρος — heart-destroying, deadly (of drugs); neut. acc. pl.
glossary.κάμμορον: κάμμορος — ill-fated, wretched (κατά + μόρος); masc. acc. sg.
glossary.κάτθεσαν: κατατίθημι — set down, stow; aor. 3 pl., syncopated and unaugmented (= κατέθηκαν)
glossary.καθῖζον: καθίζω — sit down, take one’s seat; impf. 3 pl.
glossary.καλέσσας: καλέω — call; aor. part. masc. nom. sg., epic -εσσ- (= Attic καλέσας)
glossary.καρπαλίμως: καρπάλιμος — swift, nimble; adv. καρπαλίμως: ’swiftly, nimbly’
glossary.κελάδοντ: κελάδω — resound, roar, sound loudly; pres. part. masc. acc. sg., elided (κελάδοντ’ = κελάδοντα), agreeing with Ζέφυρον
glossary.κλαίουσα: κλαίω — weep, cry; pres. part. fem. nom. sg.: ’weeping’
glossary.κληισταὶ: κληιστός — that can be shut, close-fitting (of a door); fem. nom. pl.
glossary.κληῖσι: κληΐς — thole-pin, oarlock (also ’key, bolt’ elsewhere); fem. dat. pl., epic -ισι · also ’rowing-bench, thwart’ (ἐπὶ κληῖσι καθῖζον ’sat down on the rowing-benches’)
glossary.κοίτου: κοίτη — bed, going to bed, rest; gen. sg., governed by μέδηται ’takes thought of’ · also gen. governed by μιμνήσκομαι ’think of’ (μνησαίατο κοίτου ’had bed in mind’)
glossary.κούρῃ: κούρη — girl, maiden, daughter (Attic κόρη); dat. sg.
glossary.κώκυσεν: κωκύω — cry out, wail; aor. 3 sg.
glossary.λαρώτατος: λαρός — pleasant, sweet to the taste; superl. λαρώτατος, masc. nom. sg.: ’most delicious’
glossary.λευκὰ: λευκός — white, bright; neut. acc. pl.
glossary.λεῖβον: λείβω — pour, pour a libation; impf. 3 pl., unaugmented
glossary.μέδηται: μέδομαι — be mindful of, take thought for, plan (+ gen.); pres. subj. 3 sg., in a general temporal clause with ὁππότε κε
glossary.μία: εἷς, μία, ἕν — one; fem. nom. sg.
glossary.μαῖ: μαῖα — nurse, mother (affectionate address to an old woman); fem. voc. sg., elided (μαῖ’ = μαῖα)
glossary.μεγάλ: μέγας — great, loud; neut. acc. pl. used adverbially, elided (μεγάλ’ = μεγάλα): ’loudly’
glossary.μεγάρῳ: μέγαρον — hall, great room; neut. dat. sg.
glossary.μερμηρίζει: μερμηρίζω — ponder anxiously, devise, plot; pres. 3 sg.
glossary.μεσόδμης: μεσόδμη — crossbeam amidships holding the mast’s foot; gen. sg.
glossary.μετέειφ: μετεῖπον (μετά + εἶπον) — speak among, address; aor. 3 sg., elided and aspirated (μετέειφ’ = μετέειπε)
glossary.μογήσας: μογέω — toil, suffer hardship; aor. part. masc. nom. sg.: ’having suffered’
glossary.μοῦνος: μόνος (epic/Ionic μοῦνος) — alone, only; masc. nom. sg.
glossary.μυληφάτου: μυληφάτος — ground at the mill (μύλη ’mill’ + a verbal element ’struck, ground’); neut. gen. sg.
glossary.ναιεταόντων: ναιετάω — dwell, be situated, be inhabited; pres. part. gen. pl., epic uncontracted (= Attic ναιετώντων)
glossary.νητὸς: νητός — heaped up, piled (verbal adj. of νέω ’heap up’); masc. nom. sg.
glossary.νοήμονα: Νοήμων — Noemon, an Ithacan who lends Telemachus a ship; masc. acc. sg.
glossary.νοστήσειε: νοστέω — return home; aor. opt. 3 sg., optative of hope/expectation: ’should he return’
glossary.νόημα: νόημα — thought, notion, idea; neut. nom. sg.
glossary.νόου: νόος — mind (Attic contracted νοῦ); gen. sg., uncontracted
glossary.οἴκαδε: οἶκος — house, home; + directional suffix -δε: ’homeward, to one’s home’
glossary.οἴνοιο: οἶνος — wine; gen. sg., epic -οιο (= Attic -ου)
glossary.οὕτω: οὕτω(ς) — thus, so, in this way; adv.
glossary.οὖρον: οὖρος — fair wind, following wind; masc. acc. sg. · also a different word, neut. ’furrow-stretch’, the length a pair of mules ploughs in one go (οὖρον … ἡμιόνοιιν); exact measure unknown
glossary.πάντῃ: πάντῃ — everywhere, in every direction; adv.
glossary.πάτρης: πάτρη (Attic πάτρα) — fatherland, native land; gen. sg., Ionic η for Attic ᾱ
glossary.πένοντο: πένομαι — labor at, be busy with, toil; impf. 3 pl.
glossary.πέπυσται: πυνθάνομαι — learn, inquire, get word of; perf. 3 sg. mid., with present force: ’has learned’
glossary.πίειραν: πίων (fem. πίειρα) — fat, rich, fertile; fem. acc. sg.
glossary.πίθοι: πίθος — large storage jar; masc. nom. pl.
glossary.πίνοντας: πίνω — drink; pres. part. masc. acc. pl.: ’as they were drinking’
glossary.παλαιοῦ: παλαιός — old, ancient; masc./neut. gen. sg.
glossary.παννυχίη: παννύχιος (Ionic fem. παννυχίη) — all through the night; fem. nom. sg. used adverbially, agreeing with the ship
glossary.παρισταμένη: παρίσταμαι — stand beside, come to one’s side; pres. part. fem. nom. sg.
glossary.πεῖρε: πείρω — pierce, drive through; impf. 3 sg., unaugmented, with κέλευθον: ’was cutting her way’
glossary.πλάζε: πλάζω — make to wander, drive astray, confound; impf. 3 sg., unaugmented: ’made them stagger, reel’
glossary.ποθέσαι: ποθέω — long for, miss; aor. inf.: ’to miss (him)’
glossary.πολλὴν: πολύς — much, many; fem. acc. sg.
glossary.πολυϊδρείῃσιν: πολυϊδρείη — much cunning, shrewdness; fem. dat. pl., epic -ῃσι(ν) (= Attic -αις), instrumental: ’with the shrewdness of’
glossary.πορφύρεον: πορφύρεος — dark-gleaming, surging, seething (of water, not a colour term here); neut. nom./acc. sg., agreeing with κῦμα · also of a cloak, a colour term: ’purple, dark red’; neut. acc. sg., agreeing with φᾶρος (πορφύρεον … φᾶρος ’a purple cloak’)
glossary.ποτὸν: ποτόν — drink, that which is drunk; neut. acc. sg.
glossary.προτόνοισιν: πρότονος — forestay (rope bracing the mast forward); masc. dat. pl., epic -οισιν
glossary.πρυμνήσι: πρυμνήσιον — stern-cable (mooring rope); neut. acc. pl., elided (πρυμνήσι’ = πρυμνήσια)
glossary.πρυμνῇ: πρύμνη — stern (of a ship); dat. sg.
glossary.πτόλιν: πτόλις (epic by-form of πόλις) — city; acc. sg.
glossary.πόνον: πόνος — toil, labor, trouble; acc. sg.
glossary.πύλου: Πύλος — Pylos, city in the Peloponnese, home of Nestor; gen. sg.
glossary.πώμασιν: πῶμα — lid, cover; neut. dat. pl.
glossary.πᾶσαι: πᾶς — all, every; fem. nom. pl.
glossary.πῇ: πῇ — where?, to what place?; interrog. adv.
glossary.σανίδες: σανίς — board, plank, door-leaf; fem. nom. pl.
glossary.σκιόωντό: σκιάω (also σκιόω) — cast a shadow, grow dark; impf. mid. 3 pl., epic diectasis (= Attic ἐσκιοῦντο)
glossary.σπάσατ: σπάω — draw, pull; aor. mid. 3 sg., unaugmented, elided (σπάσατ’ = σπάσατο): ’drew (his hand) away’
glossary.στήσαντο: ἵστημι — set up, make to stand; aor. mid. 3 pl.: ’they set up (for themselves)’
glossary.στείρῃ: στεῖρα — the ship’s stem, cutwater; dat. sg.
glossary.στῆσαν: ἵστημι — set up, make to stand, raise; aor. act. 3 pl., transitive
glossary.στῆσε: ἵστημι — set up, station, moor; aor. act. 3 sg., transitive (contrast intransitive ἕστασαν)
glossary.σφισιν: σφεῖς — they; epic dat. pl. pron. (= Attic αὐτοῖς): ’to/for them’
glossary.τελεύτησέν: τελευτάω — bring to an end, complete, fulfil; aor. 3 sg.
glossary.τετύχθω: τεύχω — make, prepare, bring about; perf. pass. imper. 3 sg.: ’let it stand accomplished, let it be ready’
glossary.τηλόθι: τηλόθι — far off, far away; epic adv. with suffix -θι, + gen.: ’far from’
glossary.τινας: τις, τι — someone, something; indefinite pron., masc./fem. acc. pl.: ’some, certain’ · also with a relative, οὕς τινας ’whichever, whoever’
glossary.τούτου: οὗτος, αὕτη, τοῦτο — this; demonstrative pron., masc./neut. gen. sg.
glossary.τοῖχον: τοῖχος — wall (of a room or house); acc. sg.
glossary.τῆλε: τῆλε — far, far away; adv., + gen.: ’far from’
glossary.φάν: φημί — say, speak; aor. 3 pl., unaugmented, contracted (φάν = φάσαν/ἔφασαν): ’they said’
glossary.φάρμακ: φάρμακον — drug, potion, medicine; neut. acc. pl., elided (φάρμακ’ = φάρμακα)
glossary.φέροντες: φέρω — carry, bear; pres. part. masc. nom. pl.
glossary.φίλε: φίλος — dear, one’s own; masc. voc. sg.
glossary.φίλῃ: φίλος — dear, one’s own; fem. dat. sg.
glossary.φαίδιμον: φαίδιμος — shining, glorious, illustrious; masc. acc. sg.
glossary.φερώμεθα: φέρω — carry, bear, bring; pres. subj. mid. 1 pl. (hortatory): ’let us carry, fetch’
glossary.φθίῃς: φθίνω — perish, waste away, die; aor. subj. 2 sg., in a purpose clause with ὥς κε: ’lest you perish’
glossary.φορέουσι: φορέω — carry, bear (habitually); pres. 3 pl., epic uncontracted (= Attic φοροῦσι)
glossary.φράσσονται: φράζομαι — devise, plot, consider (mid.; distinct from act. φράζω ’point out, tell’); fut. 3 pl.
glossary.φρονίοιο: Φρόνιος — Phronius, father of Noemon; masc. gen. sg., epic -οιο (= Attic -ου)
glossary.φυλάσσεις: φυλάσσω — guard, keep watch over; pres. 2 sg.
glossary.φωτὶ: φώς — man, mortal; masc. dat. sg.
glossary.χειρῶν: χείρ — hand; gen. pl., genitive of separation: ’from their hands’
glossary.χεῦεν: χέω — pour; aor. 3 sg., unaugmented (contrast augmented ἔχευε)
glossary.χεῦον: χέω — pour; aor. imper. 2 sg., unaugmented
glossary.χηλοῖσιν: χηλός — chest, coffer; fem. dat. pl., epic -οισιν
glossary.χρόα: χρώς — skin, flesh, complexion; acc. sg. χρόα
glossary.ἀγέρεσθαι: ἀγείρω — gather, assemble; aor. inf. mid., intransitive: ’to gather, assemble (themselves)’
glossary.ἀγαπητός: ἀγαπητός — beloved, cherished (esp. an only child); masc. nom. sg.
glossary.ἀγυιαί: ἀγυιά — street, road (in a city); fem. nom. pl.
glossary.ἀείραντες: ἀείρω (Attic αἴρω) — raise, lift; aor. part. masc. nom. pl.
glossary.ἀκραῆ: ἀκραής — blowing keen and fresh (of wind); masc. acc. sg.
glossary.ἀκτῆς: ἀκτή — grain, meal (a distinct epic word, homonym of ἀκτή ’shore’); gen. sg. · also ἀκτή ’shore, headland’, fem. gen. sg. (ἐπ’ ἀκτῆς ’on the shore’)
glossary.ἀλάλησθαι: ἀλάομαι — wander; perf. inf., with perfect force shading to present: ’to be a wanderer, to go wandering’
glossary.ἀλλογνώτῳ: ἀλλόγνωτος — of another, unrecognized kind, strange (ἄλλος + γιγνώσκω); masc. dat. sg.
glossary.ἀλφίτου: ἄλφιτον — barley-groats, barley-meal; neut. gen. sg.
glossary.ἀλύξας: ἀλύσκω — escape, avoid; aor. part. masc. nom. sg.
glossary.ἀλώμενος: ἀλάομαι — wander; pres. part. masc. nom. sg.
glossary.ἀμφιφορεῦσιν: ἀμφιφορεύς — two-handled jar (amphora); masc. dat. pl.
glossary.ἀμφὶ: ἀμφί — on both sides, around, about; prep./adv. · also as preverb in tmesis, standing apart from its verb (ἀμφὶ ... βάλλομεν = ἀμφιβάλλομεν ’we threw around, embraced’)
glossary.ἀμύντορας: ἀμύντωρ — defender, helper (from ἀμύνω ’ward off’); masc. acc. pl.
glossary.ἀναβῇ: ἀναβαίνω — go up, ascend; aor. subj. 3 sg., in a general temporal clause
glossary.ἀντινόοιο: Ἀντίνοος — Antinous, a leading suitor; masc. gen. sg., epic -οιο (= Attic -ου)
glossary.ἀνώγει: ἄνωγα (defective, perf. with pres. force) — command, bid, order; impf. 3 sg., + inf.: ’was bidding’ · also pres. 3 sg., a present formed on the perf. stem: ’bids’ (ἐποτρύνει καὶ ἀνώγει ’urges and bids’)
glossary.ἀπόληται: ἀπόλλυμι — destroy; mid. perish, be lost; aor. subj. 3 sg. mid., in a conditional clause: ’should he perish’
glossary.ἀπώμνυ: ἀπόμνυμι — swear solemnly; impf. 3 sg., augment fused into the compound (ἀπ-ώμνυ = ἀπώμνυε)
glossary.ἀραρυῖαι: ἀραρίσκω — fit together, join; perf. part. fem. nom. pl., intransitive: ’closely fitted’
glossary.ἀρηρότες: ἀραρίσκω — fit together, join; perf. part. masc. nom. pl., intransitive: ’ranged closely, fitted’
glossary.ἀτρύγετον: ἀτρύγετος — unharvested (epithet of the sea; sense disputed); masc. acc. sg., agreeing with πόντον
glossary.ἀφορμηθέντος: ἀφορμάομαι — set out, depart; aor. part. masc. gen. sg., genitive participle governed by ἀκοῦσαι (verb of perception + gen. participle), unexpressed subject ’I’: ’that I have set out’
glossary.ἁθρό: ἁθρόος — all together, in a mass/heap; neut. nom. pl., elided (ἁθρό’ = ἁθρόα)
glossary.ἄκουσαν: ἀκούω — hear, heed; aor. 3 pl., + gen. of the person heard: ’heeded him’
glossary.ἄκουσεν: ἀκούω — hear; aor. 3 sg., + acc. of the thing heard
glossary.ἄκρητον: ἄκρητος — unmixed, undiluted (of wine); neut. acc. sg.
glossary.ἄλλ: ἄλλος — other, another; neut. acc. sg., elided (ἄλλ’ = ἄλλο): ’another thing’ · also neut. nom./acc. pl. ἄλλα, elided, genuinely ambiguous with the sg. reading: ἄλλ’ ἐνόησεν ’devised other things’ or ’another thing’ · also the conjunction ἀλλά ’but’, elided, as printed before ἄγε: ἄλλ’ ἄγε δή ’but come now’
glossary.ἄλλαι: ἄλλος — other, another; fem. nom. pl.
glossary.ἄμμιν: ἐγώ (pl. ἡμεῖς) — I, we; epic dat. pl. ἄμμι(ν) (= Attic ἡμῖν)
glossary.ἄρουραν: ἄρουρα — tilled land, plowland, earth; acc. sg.
glossary.ἄφυσσεν: ἀφύσσω — draw off, ladle out (wine); aor. 3 sg., unaugmented
glossary.ἄφυσσον: ἀφύσσω — draw off, ladle out; pres. imper. 2 sg.
glossary.ἅλαδ: ἅλς — sea, salt water; acc. sg. + directional suffix -δε, elided (ἅλαδ’ = ἅλαδε): ’seaward’
glossary.ἅπαντας: ἅπας — all, the whole, every; masc. acc. pl.
glossary.ἅπτεσθαι: ἅπτομαι — take hold of, lay hold of (+ gen.); pres. inf. mid.
glossary.ἐθέλει: ἐθέλω — wish, be willing, intend; pres. 3 sg.
glossary.ἐθέλεις: ἐθέλω — wish, be willing, intend; pres. 2 sg.
glossary.ἐικυῖα: ἔοικα — be like, resemble; perf. part. fem. nom. sg., + dat.: ’likened to, having the appearance of’
glossary.ἐκέλευσεν: κελεύω — command, order, bid; aor. 3 sg.
glossary.ἐκερτόμεον: κερτομέω — taunt, jeer at, mock; impf. 3 pl.
glossary.ἐκπροκαλεσσαμένη: ἐκπροκαλέομαι (ἐκ + προ + καλέομαι) — call forth, summon out; aor. part. mid. fem. nom. sg., epic -εσσ-
glossary.ἐμὴ: ἐμός — my, mine; fem. nom. sg.
glossary.ἐνείκῃ: ἐνείκω (epic aor. stem serving φέρω ’carry, bring’) — bring, carry; aor. subj. 3 sg., in a purpose clause
glossary.ἐπήρετμοι: ἐπήρετμος — at the oar, seated ready to row; masc. nom. pl. · also of ships, ’fitted/equipped with oars’: νῆες ἐπήρετμοι ’oared ships’ (masc. nom. pl.)
glossary.ἐπελώβευον: ἐπιλωβεύομαι — heap outrage upon, mock (from λώβη ’outrage, insult’); impf. 3 pl.
glossary.ἐπιστεφέας: ἐπιστεφής — crowned, heaped to the brim (of a bowl filled for libation); masc. acc. pl., epic uncontracted
glossary.ἐποτρύνας: ἐποτρύνω (also ὀτρύνω) — urge on, spur; aor. part. masc. nom. sg., + dat.: ’having roused (his comrades)’
glossary.ἐσθλοὶ: ἐσθλός — good, noble, brave; masc. nom. pl.
glossary.ἐσχατιῇ: ἐσχατιή — the furthest point, edge, border; dat. sg.
glossary.ἐυκνήμιδες: ἐυκνήμις — well-greaved (wearing greaves on the shins); masc. nom. pl., epithet applied here to Telemachus’s own crew · also of Odysseus’ companions (ἐυκνήμιδες ἑταῖροι ’well-greaved companions’)
glossary.ἐυσσέλμῳ: ἐύσσελμος — well-benched (of a ship, having good rowing-benches); fem. dat. sg.
glossary.ἐυστρέπτοισι: ἐύστρεπτος — well-twisted; masc. dat. pl., epic -οισι
glossary.ἐυῶδες: ἐυώδης — sweet-smelling, fragrant; neut. nom./acc. sg.
glossary.ἐφύλασσε: φυλάσσω — guard, watch over, keep; impf. 3 sg.
glossary.ἐφύρην: Ἐφύρη — Ephyra, a place famed for deadly drugs; acc. sg.
glossary.ἐϋρραφέεσσι: ἐϋρραφής — well-stitched, well-sewn (ἐϋ- + ῥάπτω ’sew’); masc. dat. pl., epic uncontracted -έεσσι
glossary.ἐύσσελμοι: ἐύσσελμος — well-benched (of ships); fem. nom. pl.
glossary.ἑνδεκάτη: ἑνδέκατος — eleventh; fem. nom. sg. (understanding ἡμέρα ’day’)
glossary.ἑσπέριος: ἑσπέριος — of evening, at evening; masc. nom. sg. used adverbially: ’in the evening’
glossary.ἑσπερίους: ἑσπέριος — of evening, at evening; masc. acc. pl. used adverbially agreeing with an implied ’them’: ’at evening’
glossary.ἔδησαν: δέω — bind, make fast; aor. 3 pl.
glossary.ἔθεεν: θέω — run; impf. 3 sg.: ’was running, sped on’
glossary.ἔκβαλλε: ἐκβάλλω — throw out, knock out; impf. 3 sg., + gen. of separation: ’cast down out of’
glossary.ἔκειτο: κεῖμαι — lie, be laid up, be stored; impf. 3 sg.
glossary.ἔλαιον: ἔλαιον — olive oil; neut. acc. sg.
glossary.ἔλυσαν: λύω — loose, untie, cast off; aor. 3 pl.
glossary.ἔμπλησον: ἐμπίμπλημι — fill up, fill full; aor. imper. 2 sg.
glossary.ἔνθεν: ἔνθεν — from there, thence; adv. of place, with suffix -θεν
glossary.ἔπειτά: ἔπειτα — then, next, after that; adv., accented ἔπειτά before an enclitic (οἱ)
glossary.ἔπεσαν: πίπτω — fall; aor. 3 pl.; here idiomatic of a door swinging shut: ’fell to, closed’
glossary.ἔπρησεν: πίμπρημι (also πρήθω) — blow into, cause to swell; aor. 3 sg., of wind filling a sail
glossary.ἔσχ: ἔχω — have, hold; aor. 3 sg., elided (ἔσχ’ = ἔσχε): ’had charge of, kept’
glossary.ἔχειν: ἔχω — have, hold, keep; pres. inf. · also used as an imperative, a regular Homeric idiom for commands: ’hold (him) fast!’ (αὖθι δ’ ἔχειν μεμαῶτα)
glossary.ἔχευε: χέω — pour; impf. 3 sg., augmented (contrast unaugmented χεῦεν/χεῦον of the same verb)
glossary.ἕκαστον: ἕκαστος — each, every; masc. acc. sg.
glossary.ἕλκον: ἕλκω — drag, haul, draw; impf. 3 pl.
glossary.ἕστασαν: ἵστημι — stand; pluperf. 3 pl., intransitive, with simple past force: ’were standing’ (reduplicated ἑ-στα-σαν)
glossary.ἠγερέθοντο: ἀγείρω — gather, assemble; impf. pass. 3 pl., epic -εθ- formation (= Attic ἠγείροντο)
glossary.ἠμαθόεντος: ἠμαθόεις — sandy (epithet of Pylos); masc. gen. sg.
glossary.ἠῶ: ἠώς (Attic ἕως) — dawn; acc. sg., accusative of extent: ’on into the dawn’ · also acc. after πρός: ’towards the dawn, the east’ (πρὸς ἠῶ)
glossary.ἡγήσατο: ἡγέομαι — lead the way, go before; aor. 3 sg.
glossary.ἡδυπότοιο: ἡδύποτος — sweet to drink, pleasant-tasting (of wine); masc. gen. sg., epic -οιο (= Attic -ου)
glossary.ἡδύν: ἡδύς — sweet, pleasant; masc. acc. sg.
glossary.ἥδε: ὅδε, ἥδε, τόδε — this, this here; demonstrative pron., fem. nom. sg.
glossary.ἰάπτῃ: ἰάπτω — assail, hurt, mar; pres. subj. 3 sg., in a purpose/result clause with ὡς ἄν
glossary.ἰούσης: εἶμι — go; pres. part. fem. gen. sg., genitive absolute: ’as the ship went’
glossary.ἰόντι: εἶμι — go; pres. part. masc. dat. sg.: ’for you, going’ · also agreeing with μοι: ’for me, as I went’
glossary.ἱερὴ: ἱερός — sacred, holy; fem. nom. sg.
glossary.ἲς: ἴς (gen. ἰνός) — force, strength, might; fem. nom. sg., in the periphrasis ἱερὴ ἲς + gen. ’the sacred strength of ...’, i.e. the hero himself · also plain ’force, might’ of a thing: ἲς ἀνέμοιο ’the force of the wind’
glossary.ἴαχε: ἰάχω — cry out, resound, roar; aor. 3 sg., unaugmented, of a loud natural noise
glossary.ἴκμενον: ἴκμενος — favorable, following (of a wind); masc. acc. sg., in the formula ἴκμενον οὖρον
glossary.ἴομεν: εἶμι — go; pres. subj. 1 pl. (hortatory): ’let us go’ · also subj. in a temporal clause with ἄν/κε: ’we go, are going’ (ὄφρ’ ἂν … ἀγροὺς ἴομεν ’while we go through the fields’)
glossary.ἴσθι: οἶδα — know; perf. imper. 2 sg.: ’know (it)!’ · also εἰμί — be; pres. imper. 2 sg.: ’be!’ (the two forms are identical; context here favors οἶδα)
glossary.ἴχνια: ἴχνιον — footprint, track; neut. acc. pl.
glossary.ἵει: ἵημι — send, let go, throw; impf. 3 sg., unaugmented
glossary.ἵεται: ἵημι — send; mid. hasten, be eager, press on; pres. 3 sg.
glossary.ὀιομένη: ὀίομαι — suppose, think, expect; pres. part. fem. nom. sg.
glossary.ὀλέσσῃ: ὄλλυμι — destroy, kill; aor. subj. 3 sg., epic -εσσ-, in a purpose clause
glossary.ὀλοφυρομένη: ὀλοφύρομαι — lament, wail, mourn; pres. part. fem. nom. sg.
glossary.ὀπυίοι: ὀπυίω — marry, take to wife (of a man); pres. opt. 3 sg., potential in a relative clause: ’whoever might marry (her)’
glossary.ὀτρύνοντος: ὀτρύνω — urge on, spur; pres. part. masc. gen. sg., genitive with ἄκουσαν: ’heeded him urging’
glossary.ὀφέλλειεν: ὀφέλλω — increase, augment (not to be confused with ὀφείλω ’owe’); opt. 3 sg., potential with κε: ’would increase’
glossary.ὁππότε: ὁππότε (Attic ὁπότε) — whenever, when; conj., + subj. and κε in a general temporal clause · also introducing an indirect question, + pres. indic.: ’when’ (ὁππότε Τηλέμαχος νεῖτ(αι) ’when Telemachus is to return’)
glossary.ὁρμήν: ὁρμή — onset, impulse, start; acc. sg., here ’the start, the setting-out’
glossary.ὅπλ: ὅπλον — tool, gear; pl. ship’s tackle and rigging (not weapons here); neut. acc. pl., elided (ὅπλ’ = ὅπλα) · also tools, implements of any craft (ὅπλα χαλκήια ’bronze tools’, of a smith)
glossary.ὅπλα: ὅπλον — tool, gear; pl. ship’s tackle and rigging (not weapons here); neut. acc. pl.
glossary.ὅπλων: ὅπλον — tool, gear; pl. ship’s tackle and rigging; neut. gen. pl.
glossary.ὅτ: ὅτε (elided ὅτ’) — when; temporal conj., here + ἄν and subj. in a general/future clause · also + indic., of a single definite past event: ’when’ (ὅτ’ ἐν Ἄργεϊ ... ἵστασαν ’when they were mooring in Argos’) · also + opt., in a repeated past clause: ’whenever’ (ὅτ’ ἂψ ἄρχοιτο ’whenever he began again’) · also + subj. without ἄν, in a general clause: ὅτ’ … ἔχῃ ’whenever … holds’
glossary.ὑπέδεκτο: ὑποδέχομαι — undertake, promise, agree to; aor. mid. 3 sg., unaugmented
glossary.ὑπερηνορεόντων: ὑπερηνορέω — play the overbearing man, be overweening (ὑπέρ + ἀνήρ); pres. part. gen. pl., epic uncontracted, partitive with τις
glossary.ὤρνυντο: ὄρνυμι — stir, rouse; mid. bestir oneself, rise; impf. 3 pl., + inf.: ’rose (to sleep)’
glossary.ὤτρυνεν: ὀτρύνω — urge on, spur; impf. 3 sg.
glossary.ᾔτεε: αἰτέω — ask, ask for, request; impf. 3 sg., uncontracted
glossary.αἰγιόχοιο: αἰγίοχος — aegis-bearing (of Zeus); epic gen. sg. -οιο (= Attic -ου); meaning disputed: usually ’holding the αἰγίς (goatskin shield)’, other derivations were proposed in antiquity
glossary.αἰδοῦς: αἰδώς — shame, a sense of respect or reserve that restrains one before others; fem. gen. sg.
glossary.αἰδόμενος: αἴδομαι — feel shame, show regard, respect; pres. part. masc. nom. sg.: ’out of respect, from delicacy’
glossary.αἰδὼς: αἰδώς — shame, a sense of respect or reserve; fem. nom. sg.
glossary.αὔτως: αὔτως — just so, in this very way; adv. (ὣς δ’ αὔτως ’and in just the same way’) · also ’simply, without more’, of words alone (ἦ αὔτως ἐπέεσσιν ’or simply with words’)
glossary.βροτοῖσιν: βροτός — mortal, mortal man; masc. dat. pl., epic -οισι(ν) (= Attic -οῖς)
glossary.γαιήοχε: γαιήοχος — earth-holder, earth-carrier (epithet of Poseidon); masc. voc. sg.; the verb behind -οχος (ἔχω ’hold’ or ὀχέω ’bear, carry’) is debated
glossary.γαῖα: γαῖα — earth, land; fem. nom. sg. (epic = Attic γῆ)
glossary.γερήνιος: Γερήνιος — Gerenian (standing epithet of Nestor); masc. nom. sg.; meaning uncertain — perhaps from Gerenia/Gerenon in Messenia, or linked to γέρων ’old man’ or γέρας ’honour’
glossary.γεραίτερον: γεραιός — old; comparative γεραίτερος ’older’; masc. acc. sg.
glossary.γούναθ: γόνυ (pl. γούνατα) — knee; neut. acc. pl., elided and aspirated (γούναθ’ = γούνατα); clasping the knees is the suppliant’s gesture
glossary.δέπας: δέπας — cup, drinking-cup; neut. nom./acc. sg.
glossary.δέπαϊ: δέπας — cup; neut. dat. sg., epic uncontracted δέπαϊ, its ending sounded as a separate syllable (= Attic δέπᾳ)
glossary.δήμιος: δήμιος — of the people, public; nom. sg., two-termination (the -ος form serving for the fem. too); opp. ἴδιος ’private, one’s own’
glossary.δίδου: δίδωμι — give; pres. imper. 2 sg.: ’give!’ · also impf. 3 sg., epic (= ἐδίδου): ’she gave’ (of the Muse)
glossary.δίου: δῖος — heavenly, divine, illustrious; standing epithet; masc. gen. sg.
glossary.δαίνυντ: δαίνυμι — feast, give a feast; mid. feast, partake; impf. 3 pl. mid., unaugmented, elided (δαίνυντ’ = δαίνυντο)
glossary.δαίτης: δαίτη (epic by-form of δαίς) — feast, banquet; fem. gen. sg. (1st decl.; δαίς itself has gen. δαιτός)
glossary.δασσάμενοι: δατέομαι — divide, share out; aor. part. mid. masc. nom. pl., epic doubled σ (= Attic δασάμενοι)
glossary.δαῖτ: δαίς — feast, meal; acc. sg., elided (δαῖτ’ = δαῖτα)
glossary.δειδισκόμενος: δειδίσκομαι — greet, welcome, pledge (by holding out the cup); pres. part. masc. nom. sg.
glossary.δεῦρ: δεῦρο — hither, here; adv., elided (δεῦρ’ = δεῦρο)
glossary.δικαίῳ: δίκαιος — just, righteous (one who gives what is due); masc. dat. sg.
glossary.δυσμενέεσσιν: δυσμενής — hostile, ill-disposed; masc. dat. pl., epic -εσσι (= Attic -έσι)
glossary.δὸς: δίδωμι — give, grant; aor. imper. 2 sg.
glossary.δῶκε: δίδωμι — give; aor. 3 sg., unaugmented (= ἔδωκε)
glossary.εἰλήλουθμεν: ἔρχομαι — go, come; perf. 1 pl., epic εἰλήλουθμεν with lengthened reduplication (= Attic ἐληλύθαμεν): ’we have come’
glossary.εἰμέν: εἰμί — to be; pres. 1 pl., epic εἰμέν (= Attic ἐσμέν)
glossary.εἰπέμεν: εἶπον — say, tell; aor. inf., epic -έμεν (= Attic εἰπεῖν)
glossary.εἴδομεν: οἶδα — know; perf. subj. 1 pl., short-vowel (= Attic εἰδῶμεν), hortatory: ’let us know, let us find out’
glossary.εἴθ: εἴτε — whether, or; correlative conj., elided and aspirated (εἴθ’ = εἴτε)
glossary.εἴρεαι: εἴρομαι — ask; pres. 2 sg., epic by-form of ἔρομαι, uncontracted ending (= Attic ἔρῃ)
glossary.εἴτε: εἴτε — whether, or; correlative conj. (εἴτε ... εἴτε ’whether ... or’)
glossary.εὐχομένοισι: εὔχομαι — pray, vow; pres. part. masc. dat. pl., epic -οισι (= Attic -οις)
glossary.εὔξεαι: εὔχομαι — pray, vow; aor. subj. 2 sg., short-vowel, uncontracted ending (= Attic εὔξῃ)
glossary.εὔχεο: εὔχομαι — pray; pres. imper. 2 sg., uncontracted (= Attic εὔχου)
glossary.εὔχετο: εὔχομαι — pray; impf. 3 sg. (no augment written; εὐ- not lengthened to ηὐ-)
glossary.εὖθ: εὖτε — when; conj., elided and aspirated (εὖθ’ = εὖτε)
glossary.ζείδωρον: ζείδωρος — grain-giving (of ploughland); fem. acc. sg.; meaning disputed: usually ’giving ζειά (a kind of grain)’, an ancient alternative reads ’life-giving’ (from ζάω)
glossary.θέμις: θέμις — custom, what is right, established usage; fem. nom. sg.
glossary.θαρσήσας: θαρσέω — take courage, be bold; aor. part. masc. nom. sg.: ’having taken courage’
glossary.θνητοῖσι: θνητός — mortal; masc. dat. pl., epic -οισι (= Attic -οῖς)
glossary.θοῇ: θοός — swift, quick (standing epithet of ships); fem. dat. sg.
glossary.θρασυμήδεϊ: Θρασυμήδης — Thrasymedes, son of Nestor; masc. dat. sg., epic uncontracted -εϊ (= Attic -ει)
glossary.θῆχ: τίθημι — put, place; aor. 3 sg., unaugmented, elided and aspirated (θῆχ’ = θῆκε)
glossary.κάλλιόν: καλός — beautiful, fine; comparative κάλλιον, neut. nom./acc. sg. used predicatively: ’more fitting’
glossary.κέκευθε: κεύθω — cover, hide, conceal; perf. 3 sg. with pres. sense: ’holds hidden’
glossary.κέλευθα: κέλευθος — path, way, course; neut. nom./acc. pl. κέλευθα, epic by-form beside fem. sg. κέλευθος
glossary.κατάγοντο: κατάγω — bring down, bring to land; mid. put in to shore; impf. 3 pl. mid., unaugmented (= κατήγοντο)
glossary.καταλέξω: καταλέγω — recount in full and in order; fut. 1 sg. or aor. subj. 1 sg. (the epic forms coincide): ’I will tell in full’
glossary.κλῦθι: κλύω — hear, listen; aor. imper. 2 sg.: ’hear!’ (regular opening of a prayer)
glossary.κούρην: κούρη — girl, daughter (epic = Attic κόρη); fem. acc. sg.
glossary.κρέ: κρέας — meat, flesh; neut. acc. pl., elided (κρέ’ = κρέα)
glossary.κυανοχαίτῃ: κυανοχαίτης — dark-haired (epithet of Poseidon, from κύανος ’dark blue-black’ + χαίτη ’flowing hair’); masc. dat. sg.
glossary.κύθε: κεύθω — cover, hide; aor. 3 sg., unaugmented (= ἔκυθε)
glossary.κύμασιν: κῦμα — wave, billow; neut. dat. pl.
glossary.κώεσιν: κῶας — fleece, sheepskin; neut. dat. pl.
glossary.κῦδος: κῦδος — glory, the lustre of success granted by a god; neut. nom./acc. sg.
glossary.λίμνην: λίμνη — mere, standing water, lake; fem. acc. sg.
glossary.λίσσεσθαι: λίσσομαι — beseech, entreat; pres. inf. used imperativally: ’beseech (him)!’ · also pres. inf. as a complement in apposition after δοάσσατο κέρδιον εἶναι: ’to beseech’
glossary.ληιστῆρες: ληιστήρ — plunderer, pirate, freebooter; masc. nom. pl.
glossary.λιπὼν: λείπω — leave, leave behind; aor. part. masc. nom. sg.: ’having left’
glossary.λυγρὸν: λυγρός — baneful, bitter, grievous; masc. acc. sg.
glossary.μαλακοῖσιν: μαλακός — soft; neut. dat. pl., epic -οισι (= Attic -οῖς)
glossary.μαρνάμενον: μάρναμαι — fight, do battle; pres. part. masc. acc. sg.
glossary.μεγήρῃς: μεγαίρω — grudge, begrudge; aor. subj. 2 sg., in a prohibition with μηδέ: ’do not begrudge’
glossary.μειλίσσεο: μειλίσσω — soothe, make mild, soften; pres. imper. mid. 2 sg., uncontracted (= Attic μειλίσσου)
glossary.μελαίνῃ: μέλας — black; standing epithet of ships; fem. dat. sg. μέλαινα · also modifying a different noun, not a ship (μελαίνῃ φρικί ’with a dark ripple’, of the sea’s surface)
glossary.μελιηδέος: μελιηδής — honey-sweet; masc./neut. gen. sg., epic uncontracted (= Attic μελιηδοῦς)
glossary.μετέρχομαι: μετέρχομαι — go after, seek, pursue; pres. 1 sg.
glossary.μεταλλῆσαι: μεταλλάω — inquire, ask about; aor. inf.
glossary.μηδέ: μηδέ — and not, nor, do not; neg. conj., used to forbid before an imperative · also continuing a purpose clause with the subjunctive: ’and not’ (μηδέ … πάθῃσι ’and may he not suffer’) · also in a wish with the optative, ’and not, nor’: μηδέ … γένοιτο ’and may there not be’
glossary.μηρί: μηρίον — thigh-piece, burned as an offering; neut. acc. pl., elided (μηρί’ = μηρία)
glossary.μνῆσαι: μιμνήσκω — remind; mid. remember, be mindful; aor. imper. mid. 2 sg.: ’remember!’
glossary.μοίρας: μοῖρα — share, portion; fem. acc. pl.
glossary.μολόντες: βλώσκω (aor. ἔμολον) — come, go; aor. part. masc. nom. pl.: ’having come’
glossary.μύθοισι: μῦθος — word, speech, thing said; masc. dat. pl., epic -οισι (= Attic -οις)
glossary.μῆτιν: μῆτις — cunning intelligence, craft, counsel; fem. acc. sg.
glossary.νέστορ: Νέστωρ — Nestor, king of Pylos; masc. voc. sg.
glossary.νέστωρ: Νέστωρ — Nestor, king of Pylos; masc. nom. sg.
glossary.νεστορίδης: Νεστορίδης — son of Nestor (patronymic); masc. nom. sg.
glossary.νεώτερός: νέος — young; comparative νεώτερος ’younger’; masc. nom. sg.
glossary.νηληϊάδη: Νηληϊάδης — son of Neleus (patronymic of Nestor); masc. voc. sg.
glossary.νηλῆος: Νηλεύς — Neleus, father of Nestor; masc. gen. sg., epic -ῆος (= Attic -έως)
glossary.νημερτὲς: νημερτής — unerring, infallible; neut. acc. sg. used as a noun, direct object: ’the unerring truth’
glossary.νοήσεις: νοέω — perceive, think of, devise; fut. 2 sg.: ’you will think of’
glossary.ξείνους: ξεῖνος — stranger, guest-friend (epic = Attic ξένος); masc. acc. pl.
glossary.οἷά: οἷος — of what kind, such as; relative/exclamatory adj., neut. nom./acc. pl., with τε in a comparison: ’just as, like’
glossary.οὕνεκα: οὕνεκα (crasis of οὗ ἕνεκα) — because; also relative: for the sake of which, for which reason; conj.
glossary.πάρ: παρά — beside, along; prep. + dat., epic apocope πάρ (= παρά)
glossary.πάσαντο: πατέομαι — taste, partake of; aor. mid. 3 pl., unaugmented: ’they tasted’
glossary.πάσχετε: πάσχω — suffer, experience; impf. 2 pl., unaugmented (= ἐπάσχετε)
glossary.πήματ: πῆμα — woe, suffering, calamity; neut. acc. pl., elided (πήματ’ = πήματα)
glossary.παλλάδ: Παλλάς — Pallas, title of Athena; fem. acc. sg., elided (Παλλάδ’ = Παλλάδα)
glossary.πεισίστρατος: Πεισίστρατος — Peisistratus, son of Nestor; masc. nom. sg.
glossary.πελάγει: πέλαγος — the open sea; neut. dat. sg.
glossary.πεντακόσιοι: πεντακόσιοι — five hundred; numeral adj., masc. nom. pl.
glossary.πεπείρημαι: πειράομαι — try, test, make trial of; perf. 1 sg., Ionic η for Attic long α: ’I have had experience (of)’
glossary.πεπνυμένῳ: πέπνυμαι — have one’s wits about one, be prudent; perf. part. masc. dat. sg., stock epithet: ’prudent’
glossary.πευθόμεθ: πεύθομαι (epic by-form of πυνθάνομαι) — learn, hear of, inquire; pres. 1 pl. mid., elided (πευθόμεθ’ = πευθόμεθα)
glossary.πλαζομένου: πλάζω — drive off course; pass. wander, be driven astray; pres. part. gen. sg.; reference disputed: usually taken with ἄλλου, ’(from) another, a wanderer’, some take it of Odysseus, ’(the tale) of him wandering’
glossary.πλεῖθ: πλέω — sail; pres. 2 pl., elided and aspirated (πλεῖθ’ = πλεῖτε): ’do you sail?’
glossary.πολέμιζον: πολεμίζω — fight, wage war; impf. 3 pl., unaugmented (= ἐπολέμιζον), + dat.: ’fought against’
glossary.πολύχαλκον: πολύχαλκος — rich in bronze, of much bronze (epithet of the sky); masc. acc. sg.
glossary.ποσείδαον: Ποσειδῶν (epic Ποσειδάων) — Poseidon; masc. voc. sg., accent thrown back
glossary.ποτέ: ποτέ — once, at some time, ever; encl. adv.
glossary.πρήξαντα: πρήσσω (Attic πράσσω) — do, accomplish, achieve; aor. part. masc. acc. sg., Ionic η (= Attic πράξαντα): ’having accomplished (it)’
glossary.προσπτύξομαι: προσπτύσσομαι — greet warmly, embrace, address; fut. 1 sg. or aor. subj. 1 sg., short-vowel (= προσπτύξωμαι): ’shall I greet?’
glossary.προτέρη: πρότερος — before, first, earlier; fem. nom. sg., predicative: ’first, before (him)’, Ionic η (= Attic προτέρα)
glossary.προτέρῃ: πρότερος — before, first, earlier; fem. dat. sg., agreeing with a fem. pronoun: ’to her first’
glossary.προτέρῳ: πρότερος — before, first, earlier; masc. dat. sg., agreeing with a masc. pronoun: ’to you first’
glossary.προύχοντο: προέχω — hold before oneself, have ready; mid. impf. 3 pl., contracted (προύχοντο = προέχοντο)
glossary.πρώτιστα: πρώτιστος — first of all (epic double superlative of πρῶτος); neut. acc. pl. used adverbially: ’first of all’
glossary.πρῆξιν: πρῆξις (Attic πρᾶξις) — business, undertaking, transaction; fem. acc. sg., Ionic η
glossary.πρῆξις: πρῆξις (Attic πρᾶξις) — business, errand, undertaking; fem. nom. sg., Ionic η
glossary.πυλίοισιν: Πύλιος — Pylian, of Pylos; masc. dat. pl., epic -οισι (= Attic -οις)
glossary.πυλίων: Πύλιος — Pylian, of Pylos; masc. gen. pl.
glossary.πύθηαι: πυνθάνομαι — learn, inquire, find out; aor. subj. 2 sg., uncontracted ending (= Attic πύθῃ)
glossary.σπείσῃς: σπένδω — pour a libation; aor. subj. 2 sg.
glossary.σπεῖσαι: σπένδω — pour a libation; aor. inf.: ’to pour a libation’
glossary.σπλάγχνα: σπλάγχνον — mostly pl. σπλάγχνα, the inner organs (heart, liver, etc.), entrails, tasted first at a sacrifice; neut. nom./acc. pl.
glossary.σπλάγχνων: σπλάγχνον — mostly pl., the inner organs, entrails; neut. gen. pl.
glossary.στεῖλαν: στέλλω — equip, make ready; of sails, furl, take in; aor. 3 pl., unaugmented (= ἔστειλαν)
glossary.σύμπασιν: σύμπας — all together, all in a body; masc. dat. pl.
glossary.σὰ: σός — your (sg.); neut. acc. pl., agreeing with a neut. pl. noun: ’your (knees)’
glossary.σῇσι: σός — your (sg.); fem. dat. pl., epic -ῃσι (= Attic -αῖς)
glossary.τάρπησαν: τέρπω — delight, satisfy; aor. pass. 3 pl., unaugmented (= ἐτάρπησαν), + gen.: ’had their fill of’
glossary.τελεύτα: τελευτάω — bring to an end, accomplish, fulfil; impf. 3 sg., unaugmented (= ἐτελεύτα)
glossary.τεοῖσιν: τεός (epic possessive = σός) — your, yours; masc. dat. pl., epic -οισι (= Attic σοῖς)
glossary.τινές: τις, τι — someone, something; masc./fem. nom. pl. (accented before an enclitic) · after a relative, οἵ τινες (= οἵτινες) is the pl. of ὅστις: ’who, whoever’
glossary.τοί: ὁ, ἡ, τό — he, she, it; that (in Homer a pronoun; later the article); masc. nom. pl. ’they’ · also relative: ’who’ · also encl. dat. sg. pron. σύ ’to you’ (= τοι, accented before a following enclitic, e.g. τοί τι)
glossary.τοὔνεκα: τοὔνεκα (crasis of τοῦ ἕνεκα) — for this reason, therefore; adv.
glossary.τοῖς: ὁ, ἡ, τό — he, she, it; that (in Homer a pronoun; later the article); masc. dat. pl. ’to/among them’
glossary.τραφέμεν: τρέφω — rear, nourish; intr. aor. inf. τραφέμεν, epic -έμεν (= Attic τραφῆναι): ’to grow up, be reared’
glossary.τρωσὶν: Τρῶες — the Trojans; masc. dat. pl.
glossary.υἱάσι: υἱός — son; masc. dat. pl., epic stem υἱ- (= Attic υἱοῖς/υἱέσι)
