glossary.υἱάσιν: υἱός — son; masc. dat. pl., epic stem υἱ-, ν-movable (= Attic υἱοῖς/υἱέσι)
glossary.φαείνοι: φαείνω — shine, give light; pres. opt. 3 sg., purpose after a past tense: ’so that he might shine’
glossary.χαρίεσσαν: χαρίεις — graceful, pleasing, gracious; fem. acc. sg. χαρίεσσαν
glossary.χατέουσ: χατέω — need, lack, stand in want of; pres. 3 pl., uncontracted, elided (χατέουσ’ = χατέουσι), + gen.
glossary.χρυσείῳ: χρύσεος (Attic χρυσοῦς) — golden; masc./neut. dat. sg., epic uncontracted -είῳ (= Attic -ῷ)
glossary.χρύσειον: χρύσεος (Attic χρυσοῦς) — golden; masc./neut. acc. sg., epic uncontracted -ειον (= Attic -οῦν)
glossary.ψεῦδος: ψεῦδος — falsehood, lie; neut. acc. sg.
glossary.ψυχὰς: ψυχή — life, spirit, soul; fem. acc. pl.
glossary.ἀγακλειτῆς: ἀγακλειτός — very glorious, famed; fem. gen. sg.
glossary.ἀθηναίην: Ἀθηναίη — Athena; fem. acc. sg., epic full form (= Ἀθήνη)
glossary.ἀλάλησθε: ἀλάομαι — wander, roam; perf. 2 pl. with pres. sense: ’you wander’
glossary.ἀλλοδαποῖσι: ἀλλοδαπός — of another land, foreign; masc. dat. pl., epic -οισι (= Attic -οις), used substantively: ’to men of other lands’
glossary.ἀλόωνται: ἀλάομαι — wander, roam; pres. 3 pl. mid., diectasis, vowels stretched back out (= Attic ἀλῶνται)
glossary.ἀμοιβὴν: ἀμοιβή — return, exchange, recompense; fem. acc. sg.
glossary.ἀμφικύπελλον: ἀμφικύπελλος — meaning disputed: usually taken as ’double’ (a cup with a bowl at each end), also explained as ’two-handled’; neut. acc. sg., agreeing with δέπας
glossary.ἀμφιτρίτης: Ἀμφιτρίτη — Amphitrite, a sea-goddess, sometimes standing for the sea itself; fem. gen. sg.
glossary.ἀνόρουσε: ἀνορούω — spring up, leap up; aor. 3 sg., unaugmented (= ἀνώρουσε)
glossary.ἀπευθέα: ἀπευθής — unlearned, not found out, unascertained; masc. acc. sg.
glossary.ἁλίῃσιν: ἅλιος — of the sea; fem. dat. pl., epic -ῃσι (= Attic -αις), agreeing with ψαμάθοις: ’sands of the sea’
glossary.ἄγυρίν: ἄγυρις — gathering, assembly (old form of ἀγορά); fem. acc. sg.
glossary.ἄκουσας: ἀκούω — hear; aor. 2 sg., unaugmented (= ἤκουσας), + gen. of source
glossary.ἄλεισον: ἄλεισον — goblet, cup; neut. acc. sg.
glossary.ἄλλοισι: ἄλλος — other; masc. dat. pl., epic -οισι (= Attic -οις)
glossary.ἄνακτι: ἄναξ — lord, king, master; masc. dat. sg.
glossary.ἄνωγον: ἄνωγα — bid, command (perf. with pres. sense); past (impf. or plpf.) 3 pl. or 1 sg., unaugmented (augmented ἤνωγον): ’they bade, I bade’
glossary.ἅλα: ἅλς — sea, salt sea; fem. acc. sg.
glossary.ἐίσης: ἴσος (epic ἐίσος, fem. ἐίση) — equal; of a ship, well-balanced; fem. gen. sg.; exact sense uncertain (’equal on both sides’, or other proposals)
glossary.ἐδωδῆς: ἐδωδή — food, eating; fem. gen. sg.
glossary.ἐθέλῃσθα: ἐθέλω — be willing, wish; pres. subj. 2 sg., epic ending -ῃσθα (= Attic ἐθέλῃς)
glossary.ἐλεαίρων: ἐλεαίρω (epic by-form of ἐλεέω) — pity, have compassion on; pres. part. masc. nom. sg.
glossary.ἐμοῦ: ἐμός — my, mine; masc./neut. gen. sg.: ’my’ · also ἐγώ — I; gen. sg.: ’of me’
glossary.ἐνίσπες: ἐνέπω/ἐνίσπω — tell, relate, declare; aor. imper. 2 sg.: ’tell!’
glossary.ἐνισπεῖν: ἐνέπω/ἐνίσπω — tell, relate, declare; aor. inf.: ’to tell’
glossary.ἐνοσίχθονι: ἐνοσίχθων — earth-shaker (epithet of Poseidon); masc. dat. sg.
glossary.ἐντυνόμενοι: ἐντύνω — make ready, prepare; pres. part. mid. masc. nom. pl.
glossary.ἐξαλαπάξαι: ἐξαλαπάζω — sack utterly, raze; aor. inf.
glossary.ἐξερέεσθαι: ἐξερέομαι (epic by-form of ἐξέρομαι) — question, inquire of; pres. inf., uncontracted (= ἐξερεῖσθαι)
glossary.ἐπέπλως: ἐπιπλέω — sail over, sail across; aor. 2 sg., old root aorist (= Attic ἐπέπλευσας)
glossary.ἐπέσπεν: ἐφέπω — follow after, meet with; aor. 3 sg. ἐπέσπεν, of fate: ’met (his fate)’
glossary.ἐρέει: ἐρέω (epic fut. of εἶπον, = Attic ἐρῶ) — say, tell; fut. 3 sg., uncontracted (= Attic ἐρεῖ)
glossary.ἐρικυδέα: ἐρικυδής — very glorious, splendid; fem. acc. sg., epic uncontracted
glossary.ἐρύσαντο: ἐρύω — draw, pull; aor. mid. 3 pl.: ’they drew (the meat) off (the spits)’
glossary.ἐστέ: εἰμί — to be; pres. 2 pl.: ’you are’
glossary.ἐυκτίμενον: ἐυκτίμενος — well-built, well-founded; neut. acc. sg.
glossary.ἑδριάασθαι: ἑδριάομαι — seat oneself, sit down; pres. inf. mid., diectasis (= Attic ἑδριᾶσθαι)
glossary.ἑκάστοθι: ἑκάστοθι — in each place; adv., with the locative suffix -θι
glossary.ἑκάστῃ: ἕκαστος — each, every; fem. dat. sg.
glossary.ἔκαιον: καίω — burn; impf. 3 pl.: ’they were burning’
glossary.ἔνι: ἐν — in; prep. + dat., postpositive with anastrophe, accent thrown back after its noun (δήμῳ ἔνι = ἐν δήμῳ)
glossary.ἔπειρον: πείρω — pierce, spit meat on a spit; impf. 3 pl.: ’they were piercing, spitting’
glossary.ἔχευεν: χέω — pour; aor. 3 sg., in tmesis with ἐν (ἐν … ἔχευεν = ἐνέχευεν): ’poured in’
glossary.ἕδραι: ἕδρα — seat, row of seats, and so a company seated together; fem. nom. pl.
glossary.ἕδρας: ἕδρα — seat, session, company seated together; fem. acc. pl.
glossary.ἠβαιόν: ἠβαιός — little, small; neut. acc. sg. used adverbially, almost always with a negative: ’not even a little’
glossary.ἠντήσατε: ἀντάω — meet with, encounter; aor. 2 pl., + gen.: ’you have met with’
glossary.ἠρᾶτο: ἀράομαι — pray, vow; impf. 3 sg., augmented (ἀ- → ἠ-)
glossary.ἠσπάζοντο: ἀσπάζομαι — greet, welcome; impf. 3 pl., augmented
glossary.ἡδέος: ἡδύς — sweet, pleasant; masc./neut. gen. sg.
glossary.ἤντησας: ἀντάω — meet with, encounter; aor. 2 sg., augmented, + gen.: ’you came upon’
glossary.ἥατο: ἧμαι — sit, be seated; impf. 3 pl., epic -ατο (= Attic ἧντο): ’were sitting’
glossary.ἧχι: ἧχι — where; epic relative adv. (= Attic οὗ)
glossary.ἰδ: ἰδέ — and; epic conj., elided (ἰδ’ = ἰδέ)
glossary.ἰδίη: ἴδιος — one’s own, private; fem. nom. sg., Ionic η (= Attic ἰδία)
glossary.ἱκάνομαι: ἱκάνω — come to, reach, arrive at; pres. 1 sg. mid. (deponent form ἱκάνομαι): ’I come to (your knees)’
glossary.ἱκόμεσθα: ἱκνέομαι — come, arrive; aor. 1 pl. mid., epic -μεσθα (= Attic -μεθα): ’we came’
glossary.ἱπποδάμοιο: ἱππόδαμος — horse-taming (standing epithet); masc. gen. sg., epic -οιο (= Attic -ου)
glossary.ἱππότα: ἱππότης — horseman, charioteer (epithet of Nestor); masc. nom. sg., old form in short -α
glossary.ἴω: εἶμι — go; pres. subj. 1 sg., deliberative: ’am I to go?’
glossary.ἵδρυσεν: ἱδρύω — seat, set, establish; aor. 3 sg.: ’seated (them)’
glossary.ἷξον: ἵκω — come, arrive, reach; aor. 3 pl.: ’they came’ (+ acc. of place reached, with or without a preposition)
glossary.ὀιζυρὸν: ὀιζυρός — wretched, full of misery; masc. acc. sg., predicative: ’(bore him) to be wretched’
glossary.ὀπωπῆς: ὀπωπή — sight, act of seeing; fem. gen. sg.
glossary.ὀφθαλμοῖσι: ὀφθαλμός — eye; masc. dat. pl., epic -οισι (= Attic -οῖς)
glossary.ὁμηλικίη: ὁμηλικίη — those of the same age, age-mates; fem. nom. sg., used predicatively of one person: ’he is my age-mate’ · also predicated of a plural subject: πάντες ὁμηλικίη ’all of them of the same age’
glossary.ὁππόθ: ὁππόθι — where; epic indirect interrog. adv., elided (ὁππόθ’ = ὁππόθι before a smooth breathing; before a rough breathing ὁππόθ’ could also be ὁππότε ’when’, aspirated)
glossary.ὄλωλεν: ὄλλυμι — destroy; perf. 3 sg. intr.: ’has perished, is lost’
glossary.ὄπαζε: ὀπάζω — grant, bestow, give as a companion; pres. imper. 2 sg.: ’grant!’
glossary.ὄπωπας: ὁράω — see; perf. 2 sg.: ’you have seen’
glossary.ὑγρὰ: ὑγρός — wet, fluid, liquid; neut. acc. pl.
glossary.ὑπέρτερα: ὑπέρτερος — higher, upper; neut. acc. pl., of meat: ’the upper (outer) flesh’
glossary.ὑπεὶρ: ὑπέρ — over, above; prep. + acc., epic lengthened by-form ὑπείρ
glossary.ὑποθήσεται: ὑποτίθημι — put under; mid. suggest, advise, prompt; fut. mid. 3 sg.
glossary.ὑπονηίου: ὑπονήιος — under (Mount) Neion; masc./fem. gen. sg.; which height the name belongs to, and whether it is Ithaca’s own, is uncertain
glossary.ὑποστὰς: ὑφίστημι — place under; intr. (aor. 2 act. and mid.) undertake, promise; aor. 2 part. act. masc. nom. sg., intr.: ’having promised’
glossary.ὤπτων: ὀπτάω — roast; impf. 3 pl.: ’they were roasting’
glossary.ὥρμισαν: ὁρμίζω — moor, bring to anchor; aor. 3 pl.: ’they moored (her)’
glossary.ῥέζον: ῥέζω — do, perform; of sacrifice, ἱερὰ ῥέζειν ’offer sacrifice’; impf. 3 pl., unaugmented (= ἔρρεζον)
glossary.αἰπήν: αἰπύς — steep, sheer; fem. acc. sg. (agreeing with πόλιν ’steep city’), distinct from the fixed phrase αἰπὺς ὄλεθρος
glossary.αἱ: ὁ, ἡ, τό — he, she, it; that (in Homer a pronoun; later the article); fem. nom. pl. ’they’, referring to the ships (αἱ δ’ ... ἔπλεον) · also fem. nom. pl. ’they’, of women (αἱ δ’ ὅτε ... ἵκοντο ’and when they came’) · also fem. nom. pl. ’they’, of the mules (αἱ δ’ ὦκα λίπον ’and they quickly left’) · also fem. nom. pl. ’they’, of the islands (αἱ δέ τ’ ἄνευθε ’and they lie apart’)
glossary.αἲ: αἴ (epic = εἰ) — if, would that; particle introducing a wish + opt. (αἲ γάρ ’would that’)
glossary.αἴας: Αἴας — Ajax, son of Telamon, Greek hero at Troy; masc. nom. sg.
glossary.αἵ: ὅς, ἥ, ὅ — who, which; relative pron., fem. nom. pl. (αἵ μοι ἕποντο ’which followed me’) · also ὁ, ἡ, τό: fem. nom. pl. demonstrative ’they’ (ἔνθ’ αἵ γ’ ’there they’)
glossary.αὖθι: αὖθι — there, on the spot, right there; adv.
glossary.βαθυζώνους: βαθύζωνος — deep-girdled (wearing a long, girdled robe); stock epithet of women; fem. acc. pl.
glossary.βεβαρηότες: βαρέω — weigh down, burden; perf. part. masc. nom. pl., intransitive: ’weighed down, heavy’ (οἴνῳ βεβαρηότες ’heavy with wine’)
glossary.βουλῇ: βουλή — plan, counsel, council; fem. dat. sg. (ἐνὶ βουλῇ ’in council’)
glossary.βούλετο: βούλομαι — wish, want, prefer; impf. 3 sg. mid., unaugmented: ’he wished’
glossary.βῆμεν: βαίνω — go, walk, step; aor. 1 pl., unaugmented (= ἔβημεν): ’we went, we embarked’
glossary.γένοιτο: γίγνομαι — become, happen, turn out; aor. opt. 3 sg. (ὅπως ἄριστα γένοιτο ’how it might turn out best’) · also aor. opt. 3 sg. in a wish with μή: μὴ ... φίλον γένοιτο ’may it not prove pleasing’ · also aor. opt. 3 sg. in a wish after αἲ γάρ: αἲ γὰρ τοῦτο γένοιτο ’would that this might happen’
glossary.γίγνωσκον: γιγνώσκω — perceive, recognize, come to know; impf. 1 sg., unaugmented (= ἐγίγνωσκον): ’I perceived, I could tell’ · also impf. 3 pl. (same form), unaugmented: ’they recognised, they came to know’
glossary.γεραιστὸν: Γεραιστός — Geraestus, a headland at the south of Euboea; masc. acc. sg. (place to which)
glossary.γλαυκώπιδος: γλαυκῶπις — gleaming-eyed (standing epithet of Athena); fem. gen. sg.
glossary.γυναῖκας: γυνή — woman, wife; fem. acc. pl.
glossary.δίχ: δίχα (elided δίχ’) — apart, in two, at odds; adv. (δίχ’ ἐβάζομεν ’we spoke at odds’)
glossary.δίχα: δίχα — apart, in two, asunder; adv. (δίχα ... ἥνδανε βουλή, lit. ’counsel pleased split in two’, i.e. was divided)
glossary.δαΐφρονα: δαΐφρων — wise-minded, war-minded (root disputed: linked either to δαῆναι ’learn’ or δάϊς ’battle’); masc. acc. sg., epithet of Odysseus
glossary.δαήσεαι: δαῆναι (root δα-) — learn, come to know; fut. mid. 2 sg. δαήσεαι: ’you shall learn’
glossary.δεινὸν: δεινός — dread, terrible, awesome; masc. acc. sg. (δεινὸν χόλον ’dread anger’) · also neut. nom./acc. sg., agreeing with a neuter noun (κῦμα): ’dread’; can also be taken adverbially
glossary.δεύτερον: δεύτερος — second; neut. acc. sg. used adverbially: ’a second time’
glossary.δεῖξε: δείκνυμι — show, point out; aor. 3 sg., unaugmented (= ἔδειξε): ’he showed’
glossary.διέδραμον: διατρέχω — run through, run across (δια- + τρέχω); aor. 3 pl.: ’they ran through, sped over’ (ἰχθυόεντα κέλευθα διέδραμον)
glossary.διεπέρσαμεν: διαπέρθω — sack utterly, destroy utterly (δια- intensive + πέρθω ’sack’); aor. 1 pl.: ’we utterly sacked’
glossary.διομήδεος: Διομήδης — Diomedes, son of Tydeus, Greek hero at Troy; masc. gen. sg.
glossary.δολιχὸν: δολιχός — long; masc. acc. sg. (δολιχὸν πλόον ’a long voyage’)
glossary.δόλοισι: δόλος — trick, stratagem, cunning device; masc. dat. pl., epic -οισι (= Attic -οις)
glossary.δύναμιν: δύναμις — power, might, ability; fem. acc. sg.
glossary.δῖαν: δῖος — heavenly, divine, illustrious; fem. acc. sg. δῖαν, here extended to the sea (ἅλα δῖαν ’the heavenly brine’) rather than a hero · also of a place-name: Λακεδαίμονα δῖαν ’heavenly Lacedaemon’
glossary.δῖοι: δῖος — heavenly, divine, illustrious; masc. nom. pl. δῖοι, here extended to the Achaeans generally (δῖοι Ἀχαιοί) rather than a single hero
glossary.εἰνάετες: εἰνάετες — for nine years; adv. (εἰνά- epic by-form of ἐννέα ’nine’ + -ετες ’years’), cf. ἑξάετες, πεντάετές in this same part
glossary.εἰσήγαγ: εἰσάγω — lead in, bring in; aor. 3 sg., elided (εἰσήγαγ’ = εἰσήγαγε): ’he led in, brought home’
glossary.εἰσορόωντα: εἰσοράω — look upon, gaze at; pres. part. masc. acc. sg., epic uncontracted (= Attic εἰσορῶντα): ’as I gaze’, agreeing with an implied ’me’
glossary.εὐρέα: εὐρύς — wide, broad; neut. acc. pl., agreeing with νῶτα ’broad backs’ (ἐπ’ εὐρέα νῶτα θαλάσσης ’over the broad back of the sea’) · also masc. acc. sg., epic by-form of εὐρύν, agreeing with a masc. noun (θαλάσσης εὐρέα κόλπον ’the sea’s broad bosom’)
glossary.θείειν: θέω — run; pres. inf., epic θείειν (= Attic θεῖν): ’to run’ (πέρι θείειν ταχύς ’exceedingly swift to run’)
glossary.θεσπεσίῃ: θεσπέσιος — wondrous, prodigious, superhuman in scale; fem. dat. sg. (ἠχῇ θεσπεσίῃ ’with a wondrous outcry’)
glossary.θεόφιν: θεός — god; dat./instr. pl., epic suffix -φι(ν) (θεόφιν = θεοῖς): ’to/by the gods’ (θεόφιν μήστωρ ἀτάλαντος ’a counselor the equal of the gods’)
glossary.καθύπερθε: καθύπερθε(ν) — above, from above; adv., + gen.: ’above’ (καθύπερθε Χίοιο ’above Chios’) · also plain adv., no case: ’overhead, above’
glossary.κακά: κακός — bad, evil; neut. acc. pl., substantive: ’evils, troubles’ (πάθομεν κακά ’we suffered troubles’)
glossary.κακοῖο: κακός — bad, evil; neut. gen. sg., epic -οιο (= Attic -οῦ) (πῆμα κακοῖο ’woe of evil, i.e. woe upon woe’, an intensifying genitive)
glossary.κακότητα: κακότης — badness, misery, trouble; fem. acc. sg.
glossary.κακὴν: κακός — bad, evil; fem. acc. sg. (ἔριν ... κακήν ’evil strife’)
glossary.καλεσσαμένω: καλέω — call, summon; aor. mid. part., dual nom.: ’the two having called’ (τὼ καλεσσαμένω ἀγορήν ’the two having called an assembly’)
glossary.κατέκταθεν: κατακτείνω — kill, slay; aor. pass. 3 pl., root aorist in -θεν, augmented (κατ’ + ἔκταθεν; unaugmented κτάθεν elsewhere in Homer): ’were slain’
glossary.καταδύντα: καταδύω — go down, set; aor. part. masc. acc. sg. (ἐς ἠέλιον καταδύντα ’at the sun’s going down, at sunset’)
glossary.καταθνητῶν: καταθνητός — mortal, subject to death; masc. gen. pl. (καταθνητῶν ἀνθρώπων ’of mortal men’), epic by-form of θνητός
glossary.καταφθιμένοιο: καταφθίνω — perish, die, waste away; aor. mid. part. masc. gen. sg., epic -οιο (= Attic -ου): ’having perished, dead’
glossary.κείνων: κεῖνος — that, that one; demonstrative pron., epic (= Attic ἐκεῖνος); masc./fem. gen. pl.: ’of those’
glossary.κεύσω: κεύθω — hide, conceal; fut. 1 sg.: ’I will hide’
glossary.κεῖθι: κεῖθι — there; adv., epic (= Attic ἐκεῖ)
glossary.κρήτην: Κρήτη — Crete; fem. acc. sg. (place to which, εἰσήγαγε ... Κρήτην)
glossary.κρατερὸς: κρατερός — mighty, strong, powerful; masc. nom. sg.
glossary.κτήματά: κτῆμα — possession, piece of property; neut. acc. pl.
glossary.κόσμον: κόσμος — order, arrangement, due order; masc. acc. sg. (οὐ κατὰ κόσμον ’not in due order’)
glossary.λέσβῳ: Λέσβος — Lesbos, an Aegean island; fem. dat. sg. (place where, ἐν Λέσβῳ)
glossary.ληίδ: ληΐς — booty, plunder, spoil; fem. acc. sg., elided (ληίδ’ = ληίδα) (κατὰ ληίδα ’after plunder’)
glossary.λιγὺς: λιγύς — clear-sounding, shrill, whistling; masc. nom. sg., usually of voices/instruments but here of wind (λιγὺς οὖρος ’a clear, keen wind’)
glossary.λιπέσθαι: λείπω — leave; aor. mid. inf. λιπέσθαι: ’to be left behind’ (παῖδα λιπέσθαι ’that a son be left behind’)
glossary.μάψ: μάψ — rashly, in vain, without due cause; adv.
glossary.μήδετο: μήδομαι — devise, plan, contrive; impf. 3 sg.: ’was devising, planned’
glossary.μήνιος: μῆνις — wrath, anger (esp. a god’s lasting anger); fem. gen. sg.
glossary.μήστωρ: μήστωρ — counselor, adviser, one who devises; masc. nom. sg. (θεόφιν μήστωρ ἀτάλαντος ’a counselor the equal of the gods’)
glossary.μίμαντα: Μίμας — Mimas, a windy headland on the Asia Minor coast opposite Chios; masc. acc. sg.
glossary.μαρνάμεθ: μάρναμαι — fight, do battle; 1 pl., pres.-stem form with past (impf.) force, elided (μαρνάμεθ’): ’we fought’
glossary.μαχητής: μαχητής — fighter, warrior; masc. nom. sg.
glossary.μεγαθύμου: μεγάθυμος — great-hearted, high-spirited; masc. gen. sg.
glossary.μεγακήτεα: μεγακήτης — vast, teeming with great creatures (μέγας + κῆτος ’sea-monster’); masc. acc. sg.
glossary.μενέλαος: Μενέλαος — Menelaus, king of Sparta, brother of Agamemnon; masc. nom. sg.
glossary.μετρήσαντες: μετρέω — measure; aor. part. masc. nom. pl.: ’having measured’, of crossing a sea as if pacing it out (πέλαγος μετρήσαντες)
glossary.μηχανόωνται: μηχανάομαι — contrive, devise, scheme; pres. 3 pl., epic uncontracted -όωνται (= Attic -ῶνται): ’they contrive’
glossary.μιμνήσκεσθαι: μιμνήσκω — remind; mid. remember, think of; pres. inf. + gen.: ’to take thought of’ (νόστου μιμνήσκεσθαι ’to think of their return’)
glossary.μυθήσαιτο: μυθέομαι — speak, tell, relate; aor. opt. 3 sg. mid.: ’could tell’ (τίς κεν ... μυθήσαιτο ’who could tell’)
glossary.μυθείσθην: μυθέομαι — speak, tell, declare; impf. 3 dual: ’the two told’ (μῦθον μυθείσθην ’they told the matter’)
glossary.μυρμιδόνας: Μυρμιδόνες — the Myrmidons, Achilles’ own troops from Phthia; masc. acc. pl.
glossary.μῆρ: μηρός (pl. μῆρα) — thigh; sacrificial thigh-piece wrapped in fat and burned to a god; neut. acc. pl., elided (μῆρ’ = μῆρα) · also neut. nom. pl., subject, same form: ’the thigh-pieces’ (κατὰ μῆρ’ ἐκάη ’were burned’)
glossary.μῦθοί: μῦθος — word, speech, thing said; masc. nom. pl.
glossary.νέας: ναῦς — ship; fem. acc. pl., epic νέας (= Attic ναῦς)
glossary.νήεσσι: ναῦς — ship; fem. dat. pl., epic νήεσσι (= Attic ναυσί)
glossary.νεοίμεθα: νέομαι — go, return, come; pres. opt. 1 pl., in an indirect deliberative question: ’whether we should go’
glossary.νόσφιν: νόσφιν — apart, far off, away; adv.
glossary.νόῳ: νόος — mind, thought; masc. dat. sg., instrumental: ’in mind, in thought’
glossary.νύκτα: νύξ — night; fem. acc. sg., accusative of duration: ’(through) the night’
glossary.νῆας: ναῦς — ship; fem. acc. pl., epic νῆας (= Attic ναῦς)
glossary.νῶι: ἐγώ (dual νῶι) — we two; acc. dual: ’the two of us’ (μετὰ νῶι ’after the two of us’)  ·  also used as nom. dual: νῶι … ἱκόμεθ’ ’we two have come’
glossary.νῶτα: νῶτον — back; neut. acc. pl. νῶτα, poetic image ’the broad back(s) of the sea’ · also ’back’ of a person: ’his back’ (ἥ οἱ νῶτα … ἄμπεχεν)
glossary.ξανθὸς: ξανθός — fair-haired, yellow, tawny; masc. nom. sg., standing epithet of Menelaus · also applied to Rhadamanthus: ξανθὸς Ῥαδάμανθυς ’fair-haired Rhadamanthus’ (the same epithet extended to a new figure)
glossary.οἴνῳ: οἶνος — wine; masc. dat. sg., instrumental: ’with wine’ (οἴνῳ βεβαρηότες ’heavy with wine’)
glossary.οἴσουσι: φέρω (fut. stem οἰσ-) — carry, bear; fut. 3 pl.: ’they will carry’ (οἴσουσι κλέος ’they will carry fame’)
glossary.οἶδα: οἶδα — know; perf. with pres. sense, 1 sg.: ’I know’
glossary.οὖρος: οὖρος — a fair wind, favorable wind; masc. nom. sg. · also a different word, related to ὁράω ’see, watch’ — warden, guardian; masc. nom. sg. (οὖρος Ἀχαιῶν ’warden of the Achaeans’)
glossary.πάθομεν: πάσχω — suffer, experience; aor. 1 pl., unaugmented (= ἐπάθομεν): ’we suffered’
glossary.πάθον: πάσχω — suffer, experience; aor. 3 pl., unaugmented (= ἔπαθον): ’they suffered’ · also aor. 1 sg. (same -ον ending): ’I suffered’
glossary.πάτροκλος: Πάτροκλος — Patroclus, companion of Achilles, killed by Hector; masc. nom. sg.
glossary.πέλαγος: πέλαγος — the open sea, high sea; neut. acc. sg.
glossary.παιπαλοέσσης: παιπαλόεις — rugged, craggy; fem. gen. sg. παιπαλοέσσης, agreeing with Χίοιο (the island-name Chios treated as feminine)
glossary.παντοίοισι: παντοῖος — of every kind, all manner of; masc. dat. pl., epic -οισι (= Attic -οις)
glossary.παραμίμνων: παραμίμνω — remain beside, stay on; pres. part. masc. nom. sg.: ’remaining’
glossary.παῖδα: παῖς — child, son, daughter; masc./fem. acc. sg.
glossary.πείσεσθαι: πείθω — persuade; mid./pass. fut. inf. πείσεσθαι: ’to be persuaded, to be won over’ (οὐ πείσεσθαι ἔμελλεν ’he was not to win her over’)
glossary.πεντάετές: πεντάετες — for five years; adv., cf. ἑξάετες, εἰνάετες in this same part
glossary.περιθεῖεν: περιτίθημι — place around, bestow, confer; aor. opt. 3 pl.: ’might bestow’ (δύναμιν περιθεῖεν ’might grant such power’)
glossary.πεύθομαι: πεύθομαι — learn by inquiry, hear tell, get news of; pres. 1 sg. mid., epic (= Attic πυνθάνομαι)
glossary.πλαζόμενοι: πλάζω — drive astray; mid./pass. wander, roam; pres. part. masc. nom. pl.: ’roaming’
glossary.πλόον: πλόος — voyage, sailing, course; masc. acc. sg., epic πλόον (= Attic πλοῦν)
glossary.ποιάντιον: Ποιάντιος — son of Poias (patronymic adj., of Philoctetes); masc. acc. sg.
glossary.ποικιλομήτην: ποικιλομήτης — of shifting, many-colored cunning (ποικίλος + μῆτις); masc. acc. sg., epithet of Odysseus
glossary.ποιμένι: ποιμήν — shepherd; masc. dat. sg., in the standing royal title ποιμὴν λαῶν ’shepherd of the people’
glossary.πολέες: πολύς — much, many; masc. nom. pl., epic πολέες (= Attic πολλοί)
glossary.πολέμου: πόλεμος — war, battle; masc. gen. sg.
glossary.πριάμοιο: Πρίαμος — Priam, king of Troy; masc. gen. sg., epic -οιο (= Attic -ου)
glossary.προέηκεν: προΐημι — send forth, let go; aor. 3 sg., epic προέηκεν (= Attic προῆκε): ’he sent forth’ (of the wind, θεὸς προέηκεν ἀῆναι)
glossary.πυθέσθαι: πυνθάνομαι — inquire, learn, hear of; aor. inf. mid. πυθέσθαι, epexegetic: ’to hear of’ (κλέος ... πυθέσθαι ’fame ... to hear of’)
glossary.πόντος: πόντος — sea, open sea; masc. nom. sg.
glossary.σέβας: σέβας — awe, reverent wonder; neut. nom. sg. (σέβας μ’ ἔχει ’awe holds me’)
glossary.σφεων: σφεῖς — they; epic gen. pl. pron. σφέων/σφεων: ’of them’
glossary.σχέτλιος: σχέτλιος — cruel, merciless, hard-hearted; masc. nom. sg. (applied here to Zeus, an unusually harsh judgment of a god)
glossary.τέμνειν: τέμνω — cut; pres. inf., used of a sea-crossing: ’to cut across’ (πέλαγος τέμνειν ’to cut across the open sea’)
glossary.τένεδον: Τένεδος — Tenedos, a small island off the Troad; fem. acc. sg. (place to which, ἐς Τένεδον)
glossary.τέρας: τέρας — sign, portent, marvel; neut. acc. sg.
glossary.τίσασθαι: τίνω (mid. τίνυμαι) — pay, requite; mid. exact vengeance, punish; aor. inf. mid. τίσασθαι: ’to take vengeance on’, same root as ἐτίσατο in this part
glossary.ταχὺς: ταχύς — quick, swift; masc. nom. sg. (θείειν ταχύς ’swift to run’)
glossary.τετλάμεν: τλῆναι (perf. stem τετλα-) — endure, bear, have the heart to; perf. inf. τετλάμεν, epic (= Attic τετληκέναι): ’to endure’
glossary.τεός: τεός — your, yours (2nd person possessive adj., epic = σός); masc. nom. sg.
glossary.τοιοῦτον: τοιοῦτος — such, of this kind; masc. acc. sg.
glossary.τοσσήνδε: τοσόσδε — so great, so much; fem. acc. sg., epic τοσσήνδε (double σ)
glossary.τρέπεται: τρέπω — turn; pass. be turned, changed; pres. 3 sg.: ’is changed’ (νόος τρέπεται ’the mind is changed’)
glossary.τυδέος: Τυδεύς — Tydeus, father of Diomedes; masc. gen. sg. (Τυδέος υἱός ’son of Tydeus’, periphrasis for Diomedes)
glossary.τυδεΐδεω: Τυδεΐδης — son of Tydeus (patronymic of Diomedes); masc. gen. sg., epic -εω (= Attic -ου)
glossary.φάσ: φημί — say, assert; pres. 3 pl., elided (φάσ’ = φασί): ’they say’
glossary.φαίδιμος: φαίδιμος — shining, glorious, illustrious; masc. nom. sg. · also as a proper name, Φαίδιμος — Phaedimus, king of the Sidonians who gave Menelaus the silver bowl; masc. nom. sg.
glossary.φαίης: φημί — say, assert; pres. opt. 2 sg., potential with κε: ’you would say’
glossary.φεῦγε: φεύγω — flee, escape; impf. 3 sg., unaugmented (= ἔφευγε): ’he fled’
glossary.φεῦγον: φεύγω — flee, escape; impf. 1 sg., unaugmented (= ἔφευγον): ’I fled’
glossary.φιλοκτήτην: Φιλοκτήτης — Philoctetes, son of Poias, archer left on Lemnos and later brought to Troy; masc. acc. sg.
glossary.φραζόμεθ: φράζομαι — consider, devise, plan; impf. 1 pl. mid., elided (φραζόμεθ’ = φραζόμεθα): ’we devised’
glossary.φύγοιμεν: φεύγω — flee, escape; aor. opt. 1 pl., in a purpose clause: ’that we might escape’
glossary.φῆναι: φαίνω — show, reveal, bring to light; aor. inf. φῆναι: ’to show’
glossary.χίοιο: Χίος — Chios, an Aegean island; fem. gen. sg., epic -οιο (= Attic -ου)
glossary.χαλεπὰ: χαλεπός — harsh, difficult, severe; neut. acc. pl., substantive: ’harsh things’ (χαλεπὰ ... ὁρμαίνοντες ’pondering harsh thoughts’)
glossary.ψυρίης: Ψυρίη — Psyria, a small island near Chios; fem. gen. sg.
glossary.ἀέσαμεν: ἀέσαι (root ἀϝεσ-, distinct from ἄημι ’blow’) — pass the night; aor. 1 pl.: ’we passed the night’
glossary.ἀήμεναι: ἄημι — blow (of wind); pres. inf., epic ἀήμεναι (= Attic ἀῆναι): ’to blow’
glossary.ἀγαμέμνονι: Ἀγαμέμνων — Agamemnon, king of Mycenae, leader of the Achaeans at Troy; masc. dat. sg.
glossary.ἀθηναίης: Ἀθηναίη — Athena; fem. gen. sg., Ionic-epic form (= Attic Ἀθηνᾶς)
glossary.ἀκούετε: ἀκούω — hear; pres. 2 pl., used with perfect force: ’you have heard’
glossary.ἀλεγεινῆς: ἀλεγεινός — painful, grievous; fem. gen. sg.
glossary.ἀλλήλοις: ἀλλήλων — one another, each other; reciprocal pron., masc. dat. pl.: ’against one another’
glossary.ἀμειβομένω: ἀμείβω — exchange; mid. answer, reply; pres. part. dual nom.: ’the two exchanging words, answering one another’ · also of dancers, no words spoken: ’taking turns, changing places with each other’ (ταρφέ’ ἀμειβομένω); sense inferred from the scene
glossary.ἀμφιέποντες: ἀμφιέπω — be busy about, attend to, ply; pres. part. masc. nom. pl.: ’busying ourselves (with)’
glossary.ἀμφιελίσσας: ἀμφιέλισσα — curved at both ends (standing epithet of ships); fem. acc. pl.
glossary.ἀμφοτέροισιν: ἀμφότερος — both; masc. dat. pl., epic -οισιν (= Attic -οις)
glossary.ἀνέτλημεν: ἀνατλῆναι (root τλα-) — endure, bear up under; aor. 1 pl.: ’we endured’
glossary.ἀναβάντες: ἀναβαίνω — go up, go aboard, embark; aor. part. masc. nom. pl.: ’having embarked’
glossary.ἀντίλοχος: Ἀντίλοχος — Antilochus, son of Nestor, killed at Troy; masc. nom. sg.
glossary.ἀνόρουσαν: ἀνορούω — spring up, leap up; aor. 3 pl.: ’they sprang up’
glossary.ἀολλέσιν: ἀολλής — gathered, all together, in a body; fem. dat. pl., epic -εσιν (= Attic -εσι)
glossary.ἀπευθής: ἀπευθής — without tidings, uninformed, ignorant of news; masc. nom. sg.
glossary.ἀπηύρα: ἀπαυράω — take away, rob, deprive of; aor. 3 sg., unaugmented, with an impf.-looking ending: ’took away’
glossary.ἀποστρέψαντες: ἀποστρέφω — turn back, turn away; aor. part. masc. nom. pl.: ’having turned back’
glossary.ἀπόλοντο: ἀπόλλυμι — destroy; mid. ἀπόλλυμαι, perish, be lost, die; aor. 3 pl.: ’perished’
glossary.ἀρήιος: ἀρήιος — warlike, of Ares; masc. nom. sg.
glossary.ἀργείοις: Ἀργεῖοι — the Argives, i.e. the Achaeans/Greeks; masc. dat. pl.
glossary.ἀργείοισιν: Ἀργεῖοι — the Argives, i.e. the Achaeans/Greeks; masc. dat. pl., epic -οισιν (= Attic -οις)
glossary.ἀριστέρ: ἀριστερός — left, on the left; neut. acc. sg., elided (ἀριστέρ’ = ἀριστερά), used adverbially: ’on the left’
glossary.ἀτάλαντος: ἀτάλαντος — equal (in weight), a match for; masc. nom. sg., + dat.: ’equal to’ (θεόφιν ... ἀτάλαντος ’equal to the gods’)
glossary.ἀτάσθαλα: ἀτάσθαλος — wanton, reckless; neut. acc. pl., substantive: ’wanton, reckless deeds’, the adjective behind the fixed noun ἀτασθαλίαι ’wanton-follies’
glossary.ἀτρεΐδην: Ἀτρεΐδης — son of Atreus (patronymic, here of Agamemnon); masc. acc. sg.  ·  also used of Menelaus: Ἀτρεΐδην Μενέλαον ’Menelaus, son of Atreus’
glossary.ἀτρεΐδῃ: Ἀτρεΐδης — son of Atreus (patronymic, of Agamemnon); masc. dat. sg.
glossary.ἀτρεΐδῃσι: Ἀτρεΐδης — son of Atreus (patronymic); masc. dat. pl. -ῃσι, of both sons of Atreus together, Agamemnon and Menelaus
glossary.ἀχαιοὶ: Ἀχαιοί — the Achaeans, the Greeks; masc. nom. pl.
glossary.ἀχιλλεύς: Ἀχιλλεύς — Achilles, son of Peleus, chief Greek hero at Troy; masc. nom. sg.
glossary.ἀχιλλῆος: Ἀχιλλεύς — Achilles, son of Peleus, chief Greek hero at Troy; masc. gen. sg., epic -ῆος (= Attic -έως)
glossary.ἀῆναι: ἄημι — blow (of wind); aor. inf. ἀῆναι: ’to blow’ (contrast the pres. inf. ἀήμεναι elsewhere in this part)
glossary.ἄγ: ἄγω — lead; impf. 3 sg., unaugmented, elided (ἄγ’ = ἄγε): ’he led’ · also ἄγε (elided ἄγ’), the interjection ’come!’, 2 sg. imper., used even to a group: ’come, come now’
glossary.ἄγειραν: ἀγείρω — gather, assemble, muster; aor. 3 pl.: ’they gathered’
glossary.ἄνακτα: ἄναξ — lord, king, master; masc. acc. sg.
glossary.ἄνακτος: ἄναξ — lord, king, master; masc. gen. sg.
glossary.ἄργεϊ: Ἄργος — Argos; neut. dat. sg., epic uncontracted -εϊ (= Attic -ει)
glossary.ἄριστα: ἀγαθός (superl. ἄριστος) — best; neut. acc. pl. used adverbially: ’best’ (ὄχ’ ἄριστα ’far the best’)
glossary.ἄρξειεν: ἄρχω — lead, begin, rule; aor. opt. 3 sg., of a repeated/general past action: ’might lead, happened to lead’
glossary.ἄσχετοι: ἄσχετος — unrestrainable, unrestrained (ἀ- + σχετός, from ἔχω); masc. nom. pl. (μένος ἄσχετοι ’unrestrained in fury’)
glossary.ἐίσας: ἐΐσος — well-balanced, even (sense disputed, perhaps ’equal on both sides’); fem. acc. pl. ἐίσας, agreeing with νῆας
glossary.ἐβάζομεν: βάζω — speak, say; impf. 1 pl.: ’we spoke’ (δίχ’ ἐβάζομεν ’we spoke at odds, disagreed’)
glossary.ἐγχεσιμώρους: ἐγχεσίμωρος — spear-wielding, spear-fierce (second element disputed: linked to μῶρος ’eager, mad’ or to μέμονα ’be eager’); masc. acc. pl., stock epithet of the Myrmidons
glossary.ἐκεῖνα: ἐκεῖνος — that, that one; demonstrative pron., neut. acc. pl.: ’those things’
glossary.ἐλαύνομεν: ἐλαύνω — drive, row, march; pres.-stem form with past narrative force, 1 pl.: ’we rowed on’
glossary.ἐλθέμεν: ἔρχομαι — go, come; aor. inf., epic ἐλθέμεν (= Attic ἐλθεῖν): ’to come’
glossary.ἐλθόντες: ἔρχομαι — go, come; aor. part. masc. nom. pl.: ’having come’
glossary.ἐμήσατο: μήδομαι — devise, plan, contrive; aor. 3 sg.: ’contrived’
glossary.ἐμῷ: ἐμός — my, mine; masc. dat. sg.
glossary.ἐνίκα: νικάω — conquer, surpass, excel; impf. 3 sg., augmented (ἐ- + νίκα; unaugmented would be νίκα): ’surpassed’ (πολλὸν ἐνίκα ’surpassed by far’)
glossary.ἐννύχιαι: ἐννύχιος — by night, nocturnal; fem. nom. pl., used adverbially: ’by night’
glossary.ἐντιθέμεσθα: ἐντίθημι — put in, place in; mid. put aboard for oneself; impf. 1 pl. mid.: ’we loaded aboard’
glossary.ἐξακέσαιτο: ἐξακέομαι — heal completely, appease, cure; aor. opt. 3 sg. mid., in a purpose clause: ’so that he might appease’
glossary.ἐξερέοις: ἐξερέω — inquire closely, ask out, question thoroughly; opt. 2 sg., future-toned: ’you should ask about’
glossary.ἐοικότα: ἔοικα — be like, be fitting; perf. part. masc. acc. sg.: ’fitting’ (ἐοικότα μυθήσασθαι ’to speak fittingly’) · also neut. nom./acc. pl., substantival: ’fitting things’ (ἐοικότα γὰρ καταλέξω ’for I will tell fitting things’) · also neut. nom. pl., predicative: ’like, comparable’ (ἐοικότα τοῖσι ’like those’)
glossary.ἐοικότες: ἔοικα — be like, be fitting, resemble; perf. part. masc. nom. pl.: ’fitting’ (μῦθοι ἐοικότες ’fitting words’)
glossary.ἐπέκλωσαν: ἐπικλώθω — spin, allot by spinning (of Fate/the gods); aor. 3 pl.: ’spun out, allotted’
glossary.ἐπέσπον: ἐφέπω — follow upon, pursue, meet with; aor. 3 pl. ἐπέσπον: ’met with, incurred’ (κακὸν οἶτον ἐπέσπον ’met an evil doom’)
glossary.ἐπίφρονι: ἐπίφρων — sound of mind, prudent, sensible; fem. dat. sg.
glossary.ἐπισμυγερῶς: ἐπισμυγερῶς — most grievously, to one’s sorrow (ἐπι- intensive + σμυγερός ’woeful’); adv.
glossary.ἐρέξαμεν: ῥέζω — do, perform, esp. offer sacrifice; aor. 1 pl.: ’we offered’ (ἐρέξαμεν ἱρά ’we offered sacrifices’)
glossary.ἐρητύοντο: ἐρητύω — hold back, check, restrain; pass. be held back; impf. 3 pl., unaugmented: ’were held back’
glossary.ἐρυκακέειν: ἐρύκω — hold back, restrain, detain; aor. inf., reduplicated epic -κακέειν (= Attic ἐρῦξαι): ’to hold back’
glossary.ἐσάωθεν: σῴζω — save, keep safe; aor. pass. 3 pl., epic ἐσάωθεν (= Attic ἐσώθησαν): ’were saved’
glossary.ἐσσομένοισι: εἰμί — be; fut. part. masc. dat. pl., epic ἐσσομένοισι (= Attic ἐσομένοις): ’to those who are to be, future generations’
glossary.ἐστόρεσεν: στόρνυμι — spread, spread smooth; aor. 3 sg.: ’spread smooth, calmed’ (of the sea)
glossary.ἐτέλεσσε: τελέω — complete, accomplish, bring to pass; aor. 3 sg., epic -εσσε (= Attic ἐτέλεσε)
glossary.ἐτίσατο: τίνω (mid. τίνυμαι) — pay, requite; mid. exact vengeance, take vengeance on; aor. 3 sg. mid.: ’took vengeance (on)’
glossary.ἐτεόν: ἐτεός — true, real; neut. acc. sg. used adverbially: ’truly, really’ (εἰ ἐτεόν γε ’if indeed truly’)
glossary.ἐόντων: εἰμί — be; pres. part. masc./neut. gen. pl., epic (= Attic ὄντων): ’of (those) being’ (θεῶν αἰὲν ἐόντων ’of the gods who are forever’)
glossary.ἐύβοιαν: Εὔβοια — Euboea, the large island off the coast of Boeotia; fem. acc. sg., printed without diaeresis (Ἐύβοιαν)
glossary.ἑήνδανε: ἁνδάνω — please, be pleasing to; impf. 3 sg., augmented ἑ- from the root’s original digamma (cf. the also-augmented, contracted ἥνδανε elsewhere in this part; unaugmented ἄνδανε); + dat.: ’was pleasing to’
glossary.ἑκατόμβας: ἑκατόμβη — hecatomb, a great sacrifice (orig. of a hundred oxen); fem. acc. pl.
glossary.ἑξάετες: ἑξάετες — for six years; adv., cf. πεντάετές, εἰνάετες in this same part
glossary.ἔθεμεν: τίθημι — put, place, lay; aor. 1 pl., augmented (the aorist stem θε- is consonant-initial, so the ἐ- shown is the augment; unaugmented θέμεν): ’we laid’ (μῆρα ἔθεμεν ’we laid the thigh-pieces on the altar’)
glossary.ἔθηκε: τίθημι — put, place, cause, bring about; aor. 3 sg., augmented (root θη-/θε-, consonant-initial; unaugmented θῆκε): ’set, caused’ (ἔριν ἔθηκε ’set strife’)
glossary.ἔκγονός: ἔκγονος — offspring, descendant; masc. nom. sg.
glossary.ἔκιχεν: κιχάνω — come upon, overtake, reach; aor. 3 sg., augmented (root κιχ-, consonant-initial; unaugmented κίχεν); the -ν is the movable ν, unrelated to the augment: ’he overtook’
glossary.ἔμελλεν: μέλλω — be about to, be destined to; impf. 3 sg., augmented (root μελλ-, consonant-initial; unaugmented μέλλε(ν)): ’was going to, was destined’
glossary.ἔμνησας: μιμνήσκω — remind; aor. 2 sg., + gen. of the thing: ’you reminded (me) of’ (ἔμνησας ὀιζύος ’you reminded me of the woe’)
glossary.ἔπλεον: πλέω — sail; impf. 3 pl.: ’they were sailing, they sailed’
glossary.ἔριν: ἔρις — strife, quarrel, contention; fem. acc. sg.
glossary.ἔσβη: σβέννυμι — quench, extinguish; pass./intr. aor. 3 sg. ἔσβη, root aorist: ’died out, was quenched’ (of the wind, not fire)
glossary.ἔχοντε: ἔχω — have, hold; pres. part. masc. nom. dual: ’the two having’ (ἕνα θυμὸν ἔχοντε ’the two of them sharing one mind’)
glossary.ἕλκομεν: ἕλκω — draw, drag, haul; pres.-stem form with past narrative force, 1 pl.: ’we drew’ (νέας ἕλκομεν ’we drew our ships down’)
glossary.ἕνα: εἷς, μία, ἕν — one; masc. acc. sg. (ἕνα θυμόν ’one mind’)
glossary.ἕταροι: ἑταῖρος — companion, comrade; masc. nom. pl., epic by-form ἕταροι (= ἑταῖροι)
glossary.ἠέλιον: ἥλιος — sun; masc. acc. sg., epic uncontracted ἠέλιον (= Attic ἥλιον)
glossary.ἠνεμόεντα: ἠνεμόεις — windy, wind-swept; masc. acc. sg.
glossary.ἠνώγει: ἄνωγα (defective, perf. with pres. force) — command, bid, order; impf. 3 sg., augmented (ἠνώγει, beside unaugmented ἀνώγει elsewhere in this part), + inf.: ’was bidding’
glossary.ἠχῇ: ἠχή — sound, outcry, din; fem. dat. sg.
glossary.ἡμίσεες: ἥμισυς — half; masc. nom. pl., epic ἡμίσεες, substantive: ’half (of them)’
glossary.ἡμετέροισι: ἡμέτερος — our, ours; masc./neut. dat. pl., epic -οισι (= Attic -οις)
glossary.ἤθελ: ἐθέλω — wish, be willing; impf. 3 sg., elided (ἤθελ’ = ἤθελε): ’he wished’
glossary.ἤρτυε: ἀρτύω — fit together, prepare, contrive; impf. 3 sg.: ’was preparing’ (ἐπὶ ... ἤρτυε, tmesis, ’was preparing upon (us)’)
glossary.ἥνδανε: ἁνδάνω — please, be pleasing to; impf. 3 sg., augmented (η- from the root’s original digamma, contracted; the same augment as the uncontracted ἑήνδανε in this part; unaugmented ἄνδανε); + dat.: ’was pleasing to’
glossary.ἦλθ: ἔρχομαι — go, come; aor. 3 sg., elided (ἦλθ’ = ἦλθε): ’he came, he returned’
glossary.ἦρα: ἦρα — favor, service (only in the idiom ἦρα φέρειν ’bring favor, curry favor’); neut./fem. acc. sg.
glossary.ἧος: ἧος — as long as, while; temporal conj., epic (= Attic ἕως) · also ’until’, and by extension ’so that’, introducing a purpose clause with the optative after a past main verb (ἧος … παύσειε ’so that it might stop her weeping’) · also plain temporal ’until’, with the indicative marking a definite past terminus: ἧος ... κατέπεφνεν ’until Artemis slew him’
glossary.ἰδομενεὺς: Ἰδομενεύς — Idomeneus, king of Crete, leader of the Cretan contingent at Troy; masc. nom. sg.
glossary.ἰχθυόεντα: ἰχθυόεις — fish-filled, teeming with fish; neut. acc. pl. (ἰχθυόεντα κέλευθα ’fish-filled paths’, of the sea) · also masc. acc. sg. w/ πόντον: ’upon the fish-teeming sea’, not only neut. acc. pl. of κέλευθα
glossary.ἱέμενοι: ἵεμαι — long for, strain toward, be eager; pres. part. masc. nom. pl.: ’longing’ (οἴκαδε ἱέμενοι ’longing for home’)
glossary.ἱερὰς: ἱερός — sacred, holy; fem. acc. pl.
glossary.ἵκοιο: ἱκνέομαι — come, arrive at, reach; aor. opt. 2 sg.: ’you would arrive at’
glossary.ἵστασαν: ἵστημι — set, station; here transitive, moor (a ship); impf. 3 pl., unaugmented: ’were mooring’ · also transitive, of setting up a vessel: ’they set up (a tripod)’
glossary.ὀβριμοπάτρης: ὀβριμοπάτρη — she of the mighty father (ὄβριμος + πατήρ); fem. gen. sg., epithet of Athena
glossary.ὀιζύος: ὀιζύς — woe, misery, hardship; fem. gen. sg., governed by ἔμνησας ’you reminded (me) of’
glossary.ὀλοῆς: ὀλοός — deadly, destructive, baneful; fem. gen. sg.
glossary.ὁμοιωθήμεναι: ὁμοιόω — make like, make equal; aor. pass. inf., epic -ήμεναι (= Attic ὁμοιωθῆναι): ’to be made equal’ (μῆτιν ὁμοιωθήμεναι ’to be matched in cunning’)
glossary.ὁρμαίνοντας: ὁρμαίνω — ponder, turn over in the mind, debate; pres. part. masc. acc. pl.: ’pondering’
glossary.ὁρμαίνοντες: ὁρμαίνω — ponder, turn over in the mind, debate; pres. part. masc. nom. pl.: ’pondering’
glossary.ὄλβον: ὄλβος — prosperity, good fortune, happiness; masc. acc. sg.
glossary.ὄχ: ὄχα — by far, exceedingly; adv., elided (ὄχ’ = ὄχα), intensifying a superlative (ὄχ’ ἄριστα ’far the best’)
glossary.ὅπῃ: ὅπῃ — where, wherever, in whatever way; relative adv.
glossary.ὅσα: ὅσος — as much/many as; neut. acc. pl.: ’all that, as much as’ · also neut. nom. pl., subject: ὅσα φύλλα … γίγνεται ’as many leaves as come’
glossary.ὑπένερθε: ὑπένερθε(ν) — below, underneath, beneath; adv., + gen.: ’below’ (ὑπένερθε Χίοιο ’below Chios’)
glossary.ὑπερβασίης: ὑπερβασίη — transgression, outrage, overstepping of bounds; fem. gen. sg., genitive of the charge with τίνομαι: ’for their transgression’
glossary.ὑπὲκ: ὑπέκ — out from under, forth from beneath; prep. + acc.; here in tmesis with φύγοιμεν: ’flee out from under’ (ὑπὲκ κακότητα φύγοιμεν)
glossary.ὦρσε: ὄρνυμι — stir up, rouse, set in motion; aor. 3 sg.: ’stirred up, roused’
glossary.ὦρτο: ὄρνυμι — stir up, rouse; mid./intr. aor. 3 sg. ὦρτο, root aorist: ’arose’ (of a wind springing up) · also of a person: ’set out, started’ (ὦρτο πόλινδ’ ἴμεν ’set out to go to the city’)
glossary.ᾐτέομεν: αἰτέω — ask, request; impf. 1 pl., augmented (αι- → ᾐ-), uncontracted ending -εομεν (= Attic ᾐτοῦμεν): ’we asked’
glossary.ῥάπτομεν: ῥάπτω — stitch, sew; fig. weave, contrive (evils); pres.-stem form with past narrative force, 1 pl.: ’we wove, we contrived’ (κακὰ ῥάπτομεν)
glossary.ῥέξαι: ῥέζω — do, perform, esp. offer sacrifice; aor. inf.: ’to offer’ (ῥέξαι ἑκατόμβας ’to offer hecatombs’)
glossary.αἰγύπτῳ: Αἴγυπτος — Egypt; fem. dat. sg., poetic dat. of direction: ‘to Egypt’ · also a plain dative of place where, ’in Egypt’ (Αἰγύπτῳ ... ἔσχον ’the gods held me back in Egypt’)
glossary.αἰπεῖά: αἰπύς — steep, sheer; adj., fem. nom. sg., agreeing with πέτρη
glossary.αἰπὺ: αἰπύς — steep, sheer; adj., neut. acc. sg., agreeing with ὄρος · also with other neut. nouns (αἰπὺ πτολίεθρον ’steep citadel’)
glossary.αὐτῆμαρ: αὐτῆμαρ — on that very day; adv. (αὐτός + ἦμαρ)
glossary.βίας: βία — force, violence; fem. acc. pl.: ‘acts of violence’
glossary.βελέεσσιν: βέλος — shot, arrow, dart; neut. dat. pl., epic -εσσι(ν)
glossary.βουλοίμην: βούλομαι — wish, prefer; pres. opt. 1 sg.: ‘I would wish’
glossary.βοὴν: βοή — shout, war-cry; fem. acc. sg. of respect: ‘good at the war-cry’ (βοὴν ἀγαθός)
glossary.γάμοιο: γάμος — marriage, wedding; masc. gen. sg., epic -οιο (= Attic -ου)
glossary.γένε: γένος — race, stock, generation; neut. acc. pl., elided (γένε’ = γένεα): ‘generations’
glossary.γένοιτ: γίγνομαι — become, happen, come to pass; aor. opt. 3 sg., elided (γένοιτ’ = γένοιτο): ‘would happen’
glossary.γλαφυρῇσι: γλαφυρός — hollow; adj., fem. dat. pl., epic -ῃσι (= Attic -αις)
glossary.γόρτυνος: Γόρτυν — Gortyn, a city of Crete; fem. gen. sg.
glossary.δίκας: δίκη — custom, right, judgment; fem. acc. pl.: ‘judgments’, not yet the abstract ‘justice’
glossary.δαίνυ: δαίνυμι — give a feast; impf. 3 sg., unaugmented, athematic ending (δαίνυ = ἐδαίνυ): ‘gave a feast’
glossary.δαμῆναι: δαμάζω — subdue, overpower; aor. pass. inf.: ‘to be overcome’ (of death or fate) · also used of overpowering a god by main force (θεὸς ... δαμῆναι ’a god is hard to subdue’), not only of death or fate
glossary.διατμήξας: διατμήγω — cut apart, split; aor. part. masc. nom. sg.: ‘having split apart’
glossary.δολόμητις: δολόμητις — guileful, crafty-minded (δόλος + μῆτις); adj., masc./fem. nom. sg.
glossary.δύνανται: δύναμαι — be able, can; pres. 3 pl.
glossary.εἰδότες: οἶδα — know; perf. part. masc. nom. pl.: ‘knowing’
glossary.εἰπέ: εἶπον (aor. of λέγω/φημί) — say, tell; aor. imper. 2 sg.: ‘tell!’
glossary.εἰσοράασθαι: εἰσοράω — look upon, behold; pres. inf. mid., uncontracted, diectasis (= Attic εἰσορᾶσθαι)
glossary.εἴρυσθαι: εἴρυμαι (= ἐρύομαι) — guard, protect, watch over; pres. inf.
glossary.εἶπες: εἶπον (aor. of λέγω/φημί) — say, speak; aor. 2 sg.: ‘you said’ (augment fused into the diphthong, unlike unfused ἔειπες)
glossary.εὔκηλος: εὔκηλος — at ease, undisturbed; adj., masc. nom. sg.
glossary.ζωόν: ζωός — alive, living; adj., masc. acc. sg.
glossary.θάπτοι: θάπτω — bury; pres. opt. 3 sg.: ‘he might bury’ (purpose clause after ὄφρα)
glossary.θέλγεσκ: θέλγω — beguile, charm, enchant; impf. 3 sg. iterative in -σκε: ‘kept beguiling’ (iteratives never take the augment)
glossary.θέων: θέω — run, speed; pres. part. masc. nom. sg.: ‘speeding’
glossary.θεούσης: θέω — run, speed; pres. part. fem. gen. sg., agreeing with νηός: ‘running’
glossary.θεός: θεός — god; masc. nom. sg. · also fem. nom. sg. ’goddess’ (δεινὴ θεός; θεός is common gender)
glossary.κέχρητ: χράομαι — use, be furnished with; perf. mid. 3 sg., elided (κέχρητ’ = κέχρητο) + dat.: ‘was possessed of’
glossary.κήδοιτό: κήδομαι — care for, be concerned; pres. opt. 3 sg.: ‘might care’ (θυμῷ ‘in her heart’)
glossary.κατέδαψαν: δάπτω — tear, devour; aor. 3 pl.: ‘would tear apart’ (κατά intensive prefix)
glossary.κατέπεφνε: πέφνω (defective verb) — slay, kill; aor. 3 sg., augmented and reduplicated (κατ-έ-πεφν-ε): ‘killed’
glossary.κατέσχετ: κατέχω — hold back, detain; aor. mid. 3 sg., elided (κατέσχετ’ = κατέσχετο): ‘was held back’
glossary.καὐτὸς: καὶ αὐτός (crasis καὐτός) — and...yourself, even yourself; masc. nom. sg.: ‘you yourself too’
glossary.κείμενον: κεῖμαι — lie, be laid; pres. part. masc. acc. sg.: ‘lying’
glossary.κηδόμενοί: κήδομαι — grieve, be troubled, care; pres. part. masc. nom. pl.: ‘grieving’
glossary.κλαῦσεν: κλαίω — weep, mourn; aor. 3 sg.: ‘would have wept’ (+ κέ, potential)
glossary.κλυταιμνήστρη: Κλυταιμνήστρη — Clytemnestra, wife of Agamemnon; nom. sg.
glossary.κρήτῃ: Κρήτη — Crete; fem. dat. sg., poetic dat. of direction: ‘to Crete’
glossary.κρείων: κρείων — ruling, lord, sovereign; masc. nom. sg., epithet of kings (εὐρὺ κρείων ‘wide-ruling’)  ·  also honorific of a chief steward, not a king: κρείων Ἐτεωνεύς ’the lord Eteoneus’
glossary.κτάνε: κτείνω — kill, slay; aor. 3 sg., unaugmented (= ἔκτανε)
glossary.κτείνας: κτείνω — kill, slay; aor. part. masc. nom. sg.: ‘having killed’
glossary.κτερίσειεν: κτερίζω — render funeral honours to; aor. opt. 3 sg.
glossary.κυανοπρῳρείους: κυανοπρῳρεύς — dark-prowed; adj., acc. pl., agreeing with νέας ‘ships’ (built on κύανος)
glossary.κυβερνήτην: κυβερνήτης — helmsman, steersman; masc. acc. sg.
glossary.κυβερνῆσαι: κυβερνάω — steer, pilot; aor. inf., epexegetic: ‘at piloting’
glossary.κυδαλίμοιο: κυδάλιμος — glorious, famous; adj., masc. gen. sg., epic -οιο (= Attic -ου)
glossary.κύδωνες: Κύδωνες — the Cydonians, a people of western Crete; masc. nom. pl.
glossary.κύματ: κῦμα — wave; neut. nom. pl., elided (κύματ’ = κύματα): ‘waves’ · also neut. acc. pl., direct object: πρὸ δὲ κύματ’ ἔαξεν ’broke the waves ahead of him’
glossary.κύματά: κῦμα — wave; neut. nom. pl. (κύματα), accented before enclitic τε: ‘waves’
glossary.κύρμα: κύρμα — prey, spoil, booty; neut. nom. sg., predicate with γενέσθαι: ‘to become spoil’
glossary.κῦμ: κῦμα — wave; neut. acc. sg., elided (κῦμ’ = κῦμα), object of ἀποέργει: ‘the wave’ · also neut. nom. sg., subject: κῦμ’ ἐφόρει ’a wave bore (me)’
glossary.λίθος: λίθος — stone, rock; masc. nom. sg.
glossary.λαὸς: λαός — people, host, community; masc. nom. sg.
glossary.λεγώμεθα: λέγω — speak, say, tell (of); pres. subj. 1 pl., hortatory: ‘let us speak’
glossary.λιγέων: λιγύς — shrill, clear-sounding, whistling; adj., masc. gen. pl., agreeing with ἀνέμων
glossary.λισσὴ: λισσός — smooth, sheer; adj., fem. nom. sg.
glossary.λυγρά: λυγρός — grievous, baneful, miserable; adj., neut. acc. pl.: ‘grievous things’
glossary.μήσατ: μήδομαι — devise, contrive, plan; aor. mid. 3 sg., unaugmented, elided (μήσατ’ = μήσατο) (= Attic ἐμήσατο)
glossary.μήσατο: μήδομαι — devise, contrive, plan; aor. mid. 3 sg., unaugmented (= Attic ἐμήσατο)
glossary.μίν: μιν — him; epic encl. acc. pron. (= Attic αὐτόν), accented μίν, subject of the inf. ἀνάξασθαι in indirect statement · also fem. ’her’, object of a verb or participle: καί μιν ἔτισ’ ’and honoured her’; μίν ... εἰσορόωντες ’looking on her’
glossary.μαλειάων: Μαλέαι (Μαλειαί) — Malea, the promontory of the Peloponnese; gen. pl.: ‘of Malea’ (Μαλειάων ὄρος)
glossary.μεγάροις: μέγαρον — hall, great room; neut. dat. pl.: ‘in the halls’
glossary.μενελάου: Μενέλαος — Menelaus, king of Sparta, brother of Agamemnon; masc. gen. sg.
glossary.μηκέτι: μηκέτι — no longer, not any more; neg. adv., used with subj./imper. in prohibitions
glossary.μηχανάασθαι: μηχανάομαι — contrive, devise; pres. inf. mid., uncontracted, diectasis (= Attic μηχανᾶσθαι)
glossary.μικρὸς: μικρός — small, little; adj., masc. nom. sg.
glossary.μοῖρα: μοῖρα — fate, portion, lot; fem. nom. sg.
glossary.μυκήνης: Μυκήνη — Mycenae, Agamemnon’s city; fem. gen. sg.
glossary.μυχῷ: μυχός — innermost part, corner, recess; masc. dat. sg.
glossary.νέες: ναῦς — ship; fem. nom. pl., epic νέες (= Attic νῆες)
glossary.νότος: Νότος — the South Wind, personified; masc. nom. sg.
glossary.νῆάς: ναῦς — ship; fem. acc. pl., epic νῆας (= Attic ναῦς)
glossary.οἰωνοὶ: οἰωνός — bird of prey, bird of omen; masc. nom. pl.
glossary.οἰωνοῖσιν: οἰωνός — bird of prey, bird of omen; masc. dat. pl., epic -οισι(ν)
glossary.οἴκαδέ: οἴκαδε — homeward, to one’s home; adv. (οἶκος + -δε)
glossary.οἴκοθι: οἴκοθι — at home; adv., locative suffix -θι (= Attic οἴκοι)
glossary.οὕτως: οὕτω(ς) — so, thus, in this way; adv.
glossary.πάσχομεν: πάσχω — suffer, experience; pres. 1 pl., vivid/generalizing present for a past situation: ‘we suffered’
glossary.πέντε: πέντε — five; numeral adj., indeclinable, agreeing with νέας · also agreeing with υἷες: ’five (sons)’
glossary.πέτρη: πέτρη — rock, crag; fem. nom. sg.
glossary.παρίστατο: παρίσταμαι — stand beside, stand by; impf. 3 sg.: ‘stood by’
glossary.πεδίῳ: πεδίον — plain, flat land; neut. dat. sg.
glossary.πελώρια: πελώριος — monstrous, huge, prodigious; adj., neut. nom. pl., agreeing with κύματα
glossary.περικήδετο: περικήδομαι — care deeply for, be much concerned about; impf. 3 sg., unaugmented (= Attic περιεκήδετο) + gen.
glossary.πηδάλιον: πηδάλιον — steering-oar, rudder; neut. acc. sg.
glossary.πλάζετ: πλάζω (pass. πλάζομαι) — drive astray, wander; impf. pass. 3 sg., unaugmented, elided (πλάζετ’ = ἐπλάζετο)
glossary.πλέομεν: πλέω — sail; pres. 1 pl., vivid narrative present for a past situation: ‘we were sailing’
glossary.πολέας: πολύς — much, many; masc./fem. acc. pl., epic πολέας (= Attic πολλούς)
glossary.πολλοὺς: πολύς — much, many; masc. acc. pl.
glossary.πολυχρύσοιο: πολύχρυσος — rich in gold; adj., fem. gen. sg., epic -οιο (= Attic -ου)
glossary.σέθεν: σύ — you (sg.); gen. sg., epic σέθεν (= Attic σοῦ)
glossary.σαώσαι: σαόω (= σῴζω) — save, keep safe; aor. opt. 3 sg., potential without κε/ἄν: ‘could save’
glossary.σκαιὸν: σκαιός — on the left, left-hand; adj., masc. acc. sg., agreeing with ῥίον
glossary.σούνιον: Σούνιον — Sounion, headland of Attica; neut. acc. sg.
glossary.σπέρχοιεν: σπέρχω — press hard, drive on, hasten; pres. opt. 3 pl., general/iterative: ‘drove on’
glossary.σπιλάδεσσιν: σπιλάς — reef, rocky ledge; fem. dat. pl., epic -εσσι(ν)
glossary.σπουδῇ: σπουδή — haste, effort, zeal; fem. dat. sg. used adverbially: ‘with effort, barely’
glossary.στυγερὴν: στυγερός — hateful, loathsome; adj., fem. acc. sg.
glossary.στυγερῆς: στυγερός — hateful, loathsome; adj., fem. gen. sg.
glossary.σύμπαντες: σύμπας — all together, all in a body; adj., masc. nom. pl.
glossary.σῆς: σός — your, yours (sg.); possessive adj., fem. gen. sg.
glossary.τάφον: τάφος — funeral rite, funeral feast; masc. acc. sg.
glossary.ταῦτ: οὗτος, αὕτη, τοῦτο — this; neut. nom./acc. pl., elided (ταῦτ’ = ταῦτα): ‘these things’
glossary.τελέοντες: τελέω — accomplish, fulfil, undergo; pres. part. masc. nom. pl., uncontracted (= Attic τελοῦντες): ‘accomplishing’
glossary.τηλέμαχε: Τηλέμαχος — Telemachus, son of Odysseus; masc. voc. sg.
glossary.τηλόθεν: τηλόθεν — from afar, from a distance; adv., ablatival suffix -θεν
glossary.τροίηθεν: Τροίη — Troy; adv. form with ablatival suffix -θεν: ‘from Troy’
glossary.τροίηνδε: Τροίη — Troy; adv. form with directional suffix -δε: ‘to Troy’
glossary.τροφέοντο: τρέφω — thicken, swell (rare sense, of waves); impf. pass. 3 pl., uncontracted: ‘were reared up’
glossary.τρὶς: τρίς — three times, thrice; numeral adv.
glossary.τότ: τότε — then, at that time; adv., elided (τότ’ = τότε)
glossary.τὰς: ὁ, ἡ, τό — he, she, it; that (in Homer a pronoun; later the article); fem. acc. pl.: ‘them, those’ (referring to ships) · also fem. acc. pl. ’them’, of the mules
glossary.φίλῳ: φίλος — dear, beloved, one’s own; adj., masc. dat. sg.
glossary.φαιστόν: Φαιστός — Phaestus, a city of Crete; fem. acc. sg.
glossary.φασιν: φημί — say, assert; pres. 3 pl.: ‘they say’
glossary.φιλέειν: φιλέω — love, be fond of; pres. inf., uncontracted (= Attic φιλεῖν)
glossary.φιλεῦντας: φιλέω — love, be fond of; pres. part. masc. acc. pl., uncontracted (= Attic φιλοῦντας)
glossary.φοῖβος: Φοῖβος — Phoebus, epithet of Apollo (‘bright, radiant’); masc. nom. sg.
glossary.φράσσαντ: φράζω (mid. φράζομαι) — devise, contrive, plan; aor. mid. 3 pl., unaugmented, elided (φράσσαντ’ = φράσσαντο)
glossary.φρόνιν: φρόνις — wisdom, prudence, understanding; fem. acc. sg. (rare poetic noun)
glossary.φρόντιν: Φρόντις — Phrontis, son of Onetor, Menelaus’s helmsman; masc. acc. sg.
glossary.φῦλ: φῦλον — tribe, race, class; neut. acc. pl., elided (φῦλ’ = φῦλα): ‘tribes’
glossary.χερσὶ: χείρ — hand; fem. dat. pl., epic -σί (= Attic χερσίν)
glossary.χεῦε: χέω — pour; aor. 3 sg., here in tmesis (ἐπὶ … χεῦε = ἐπέχευε): ‘poured upon’
glossary.χυτὴν: χυτός — poured, heaped; adj., fem. acc. sg., agreeing with γαῖαν: ‘a heaped (mound of) earth’
glossary.ἀέθλους: ἄθλος — trial, contest, ordeal; masc. acc. pl., uncontracted epic ἄεθλος (= Attic ἄθλους)
glossary.ἀγάλματ: ἄγαλμα — votive offering, delight-object; neut. acc. pl., elided (ἀγάλματ’ = ἀγάλματα): ‘offerings’
glossary.ἀγαθὸς: ἀγαθός — good, brave, noble; adj., masc. nom. sg.
glossary.ἀγαθῇσι: ἀγαθός — good; adj., fem. dat. pl., epic -ῃσι (= Attic -αις)
glossary.ἀγαμέμνων: Ἀγαμέμνων — Agamemnon, king of Mycenae, leader of the Achaeans at Troy; masc. nom. sg.
glossary.ἀγαμεμνονέην: Ἀγαμεμνόνεος — of Agamemnon, Agamemnon’s; adj., fem. acc. sg., agreeing with ἄλοχον
glossary.ἀγανοῖς: ἀγανός — gentle, mild; adj., neut. dat. pl., agreeing with βελέεσσιν
glossary.ἀγείρων: ἀγείρω — gather, collect; pres. part. masc. nom. sg.: ‘gathering’
glossary.ἀεικὲς: ἀεικής — unseemly, shameful, unfitting; adj., neut. acc. sg.
glossary.ἀθάνατος: ἀθάνατος — immortal, deathless; adj., masc. nom. sg.
glossary.ἀθηνάων: Ἀθῆναι — Athens; fem. gen. pl.: ‘from Athens’
glossary.ἀθηνέων: Ἀθῆναι — Athens; fem. gen. pl., epic Ἀθηνέων (= Ἀθηνῶν): ‘of Athens’
glossary.ἀλαλκέμεν: ἀλέξω (aor. ἤλαλκον) — ward off, defend against; aor. inf. in -έμεν (reduplicated): ‘to ward off’
glossary.ἀληθέα: ἀληθής — true; adj., neut. acc. pl.: ‘the truth, true things’
glossary.ἀληθὲς: ἀληθής — true; adj., neut. acc. sg. used adverbially: ‘truly’
glossary.ἀλόχοιο: ἄλοχος — wife, bedfellow; fem. gen. sg., epic -οιο (= Attic -ου)
glossary.ἀνάλκιδος: ἄναλκις — without strength, cowardly, feeble; adj., masc. gen. sg.
glossary.ἀνάξασθαι: ἀνάσσω — rule, be lord of; aor. mid. inf.: ‘to have ruled’ (+ acc. here, unusually, instead of the usual dat.)
glossary.ἀνήγαγεν: ἀνάγω — lead up, bring up; aor. 3 sg.: ‘he led up’
glossary.ἀναίνετο: ἀναίνομαι — refuse, reject, disdain; impf. 3 sg., unaugmented (= Attic ἠναίνετο): ‘refused’
glossary.ἀνῆψεν: ἀνάπτω — hang up, fasten on; aor. 3 sg.: ‘he hung up’
glossary.ἀπ: ἀπό (elided ἀπ’) — from, away from; prep. + gen.
glossary.ἀποέργει: ἀπείργω — ward off, keep off; pres. 3 sg., uncontracted: ‘wards off’
glossary.ἀπολέσθαι: ἀπόλλυμι (mid. ἀπόλλυμαι) — perish, be destroyed; aor. mid. inf.: ‘to perish’
glossary.ἀρείω: ἀρείων — better, more valiant; comparative adj. (of ἀγαθός), masc. acc. sg.
glossary.ἀτρεΐδης: Ἀτρεΐδης — son of Atreus (patronymic); masc. nom. sg.
glossary.ἀυτμένα: ἀϋτμή — breath, blast; fem. acc. sg.
glossary.ἀφικόμεθ: ἀφικνέομαι — arrive, reach; aor. mid. 1 pl., elided (ἀφικόμεθ’ = ἀφικόμεθα): ‘we reached’
glossary.ἀχαιιάδων: Ἀχαιϊάς (pl. Ἀχαιϊάδες) — Achaean woman; fem. gen. pl.: ‘of the Achaean women’
glossary.ἀχαιικοῦ: Ἀχαιικός — Achaean; adj., neut. gen. sg., agreeing with Ἄργεος
glossary.ἄγη: ἄγη — amazement, wonder (rare noun, cf. ἄγαμαι); fem. nom. sg.
glossary.ἄειραν: ἀείρω — lift, raise, bear; aor. 3 pl.: ‘bore’
glossary.ἄελλαι: ἄελλα — storm, squall, gust; fem. nom. pl.
glossary.ἄκρον: ἄκρος — topmost, outermost; adj., neut. acc. sg. used substantively: ‘the headland’
glossary.ἄστεος: ἄστυ — city, town; neut. gen. sg.
glossary.ἄχθος: ἄχθος — burden, load, weight; neut. acc. sg.
glossary.ἐθέλοιεν: ἐθέλω — wish, be willing; pres. opt. 3 pl.: ‘they willed’
glossary.ἐθέλουσαν: ἐθέλω — wish, be willing; pres. part. fem. acc. sg.: ‘willing’
glossary.ἐθέλων: ἐθέλω — wish, be willing; pres. part. masc. nom. sg.: ‘willing’
glossary.ἐκαίνυτο: καίνυμαι — surpass, excel; impf. 3 sg. + gen.: ‘surpassed’
glossary.ἐκλελάθοιτο: ἐκλανθάνομαι — forget utterly; aor. opt. 3 sg., reduplicated: ‘would forget’
glossary.ἐκτελέσας: ἐκτελέω — accomplish fully, bring to completion; aor. part. masc. nom. sg.: ‘having accomplished’
glossary.ἐλθέμεναι: ἔρχομαι — come, go; aor. inf. in -έμεναι (= Attic ἐλθεῖν): ‘to come’
glossary.ἐλπομένῳ: ἔλπομαι — hope, expect; pres. part. dat. sg., agreeing with ἐμοί: ‘hoping’
glossary.ἐπέδησε: ἐπιδέω — bind fast, fetter; aor. 3 sg. + inf.: ‘bound (him to be overcome)’
glossary.ἐπέλασσε: πελάζω — bring near, drive to; aor. 3 sg.: ‘drove’
glossary.ἐπέλασσεν: πελάζω — bring near, drive to; aor. 3 sg.: ‘drove’
glossary.ἐπέτελλεν: ἐπιτέλλω — command, charge, enjoin; impf. 3 sg.: ‘gave command’
glossary.ἐπισπόμενοι: ἕπομαι — follow; aor. part. masc. nom. pl.: ‘following’
glossary.ἐποιχόμενος: ἐποίχομαι — go against, assail, come upon; pres. part. masc. nom. sg.: ‘assailing’
glossary.ἐρήμην: ἐρῆμος — deserted, desert, lonely; adj., fem. acc. sg., agreeing with νῆσον
glossary.ἐτήτυμος: ἐτήτυμος — true, real, genuine; adj., masc. nom. sg.
glossary.ἐτύχθη: τεύχω — make, bring about; aor. pass. 3 sg.: ‘came to pass’
glossary.ἐφέστιος: ἐφέστιος — at one’s own hearth; adj., masc. nom. sg.
glossary.ἐφράσατο: φράζω (mid. φράζομαι) — devise, plan, contrive; aor. mid. 3 sg., augmented: ‘devised’
glossary.ἐχθαίρουσ: ἐχθαίρω — hate, detest; pres. 3 pl., elided (ἐχθαίρουσ’ = ἐχθαίρουσι): ‘they hate’
glossary.ἑπτάετες: ἑπτάετες — for seven years; adv. (acc. of duration, ἑπτά + ἔτος)
glossary.ἔθαν: θνῄσκω — die; aor. 3 sg., elided (ἔθαν’ = ἔθανε)
glossary.ἔκηε: καίω — burn; aor. 3 sg., Homeric lengthened-vowel form (beside Attic ἔκαυσα): ‘he burned’
glossary.ἔλπετο: ἔλπομαι — hope, expect; impf. 3 sg.: ‘he had hoped’
glossary.ἔναιον: ναίω — dwell, inhabit; impf. 3 pl.: ‘they dwelt’
glossary.ἔτετμεν: τέτμον (defective aor., ‘find, come upon’) — find; aor. 3 sg.: ‘he had found’
glossary.ἔχοντα: ἔχω — have, hold; pres. part. masc. acc. sg.: ‘holding’
glossary.ἕλωρ: ἕλωρ — prey, spoil, plunder; neut. nom. sg., predicate with γενέσθαι: ‘to become prey’
glossary.ἕταρον: ἑταῖρος (epic ἕταρος) — companion, comrade; masc. acc. sg.
glossary.ἠεροειδέι: ἠεροειδής — misty-looking, dusky; adj., masc. dat. sg., agreeing with πόντῳ
glossary.ἠλᾶτο: ἀλάομαι — wander, roam; impf. mid. 3 sg., augmented and contracted (ἀ- → ἠ-): ‘he wandered’
glossary.ἤλυθε: ἔρχομαι — come, go; aor. 3 sg., epic by-form (= ἦλθε): ‘he came’
glossary.ἤλυξαν: ἀλύσκω — escape, avoid, flee from; aor. 3 pl.: ‘they escaped’
glossary.ἤνασσε: ἀνάσσω — rule, be lord of; aor. 3 sg. + gen.: ‘he ruled’
glossary.ἥμεθ: ἧμαι — sit, remain; impf. mid. 1 pl., elided (ἥμεθ’ = ἥμεθα): ‘we were staying’
glossary.ἰαρδάνου: Ἰάρδανος — the Iardanus, a river of Crete; masc. gen. sg.
glossary.ἰδέσθαι: ὁράω — see; aor. mid. inf.: ‘to see’
glossary.ἰνδάλλεται: ἰνδάλλομαι — appear, seem, resemble; pres. 3 sg.: ‘seems’
glossary.ἰόντες: εἶμι — go, come; pres. part. masc. nom. pl.: ‘coming’ · also ’going’ rather than ’coming’, the precise direction supplied by context: Τροίηθεν ἰόντες ’setting out from Troy, departing’
glossary.ἱεροῖς: ἱερός — sacred, holy; adj., masc. dat. pl., agreeing with βωμοῖς
glossary.ἱπποβότοιο: ἱππόβοτος — horse-pasturing, grazed by horses; adj., neut. gen. sg., epic -οιο (= Attic -ου) · also gen. of comparison after ἐπήρατος, of an implied land (fem.): μᾶλλον ἐπήρατος ἱπποβότοιο ’lovelier than a horse-pastured land’
glossary.ἱρὸν: ἱερός (epic ἱρός) — sacred, holy; adj., neut. acc. sg.
glossary.ἷξε: ἵκω (root aor. ἷξον) — come, arrive at, reach; aor. 3 sg.: ‘he reached’
glossary.ὀίεαι: ὀΐομαι — think, suppose, imagine; pres. 2 sg.: ‘you imagine’
glossary.ὀγδοάτῳ: ὄγδοος (epic ὀγδόατος) — eighth; ordinal numeral, neut. dat. sg.: ‘in the eighth (year)’
glossary.ὀμφῇ: ὀμφή — divine voice, oracular utterance; fem. dat. sg.
glossary.ὀνητορίδην: Ὀνητορίδης — son of Onetor (patronymic of Phrontis); masc. acc. sg.
glossary.ὁμοίιον: ὁμοίιος — common to all alike; adj., masc. acc. sg., agreeing with θάνατον
glossary.ὁπότε: ὁπότε — whenever, when; temporal conj., + opt. in a general/iterative clause
glossary.ὄρεσσιν: ὄρος — mountain; neut. dat. pl., epic -εσσι(ν)
glossary.ὄρος: ὄρος — mountain; neut. acc. sg., object of ἷξε: ‘the mountain’ · also neut. nom. sg., ’a mountain’, subject of a verbless clause naming it: ἐν δ’ ὄρος αὐτῇ ’and on it a mountain’
glossary.ὑποδάμνασαι: ὑποδάμνημι (pass. -αμαι) — subdue, subject; pres. pass. 2 sg., athematic ending -ασαι: ‘you submit’
glossary.ὑφάσματά: ὕφασμα — woven cloth, web; neut. acc. pl.: ‘woven cloths’
glossary.ὠθεῖ: ὠθέω — push, thrust, drive; pres. 3 sg.: ‘drives’
glossary.ὤλεθ: ὄλλυμι (mid. ὄλλυμαι) — perish, be destroyed, die; aor. mid. 3 sg., elided (ὤλεθ’ = ὤλετο): ‘he perished’
glossary.ῥέεθρα: ῥέεθρον — stream, running water, current; neut. acc. pl.
glossary.ῥίον: ῥίον — headland, promontory; neut. acc. sg.
glossary.αἰδοίῃ: αἰδοῖος — revered, august; fem. dat. sg. (Ionic η = Attic -ᾳ)
glossary.αἰθούσῃ: αἴθουσα — portico, colonnaded hall; fem. dat. sg.
glossary.αὐδησάσης: αὐδάω — speak, utter one’s voice; aor. part. fem. gen. sg.: ’(of her) speaking’
glossary.αὐτόετες: αὐτόετες — within the same year; adv. (αὐτός + ἔτος)
glossary.βάλλον: βάλλω — throw, cast; impf. 3 pl., unaugmented (= Attic ἔβαλλον): ’were casting, threw’
glossary.βοῦν: βοῦς — ox, cow; acc. sg. (masc. ’ox’, fem. ’cow’)
glossary.γαμβροῖσιν: γαμβρός — son-in-law, kinsman by marriage; masc. dat. pl., epic -οισιν (= Attic -οῖς)
glossary.γεραίτερος: γεραιός — old; comparative γεραίτερος, masc. nom. sg.: ’older, an elder’
glossary.γεραιός: γεραιός — old; masc. nom. sg., often substantival: ’old man’
glossary.δέσποινα: δέσποινα — mistress, lady of the house; fem. nom. sg.
glossary.δίδωθι: δίδωμι — give, grant; pres. imper. 2 sg., epic δίδωθι (= Attic δίδου)
glossary.δίφρος: δίφρος — chariot-board, chariot; masc. nom. sg.
glossary.δίφρῳ: δίφρος — chariot-board, chariot; masc. dat. sg.
glossary.δεινόν: δεινός — terrible, dread, awesome; masc. acc. sg. or neut. nom./acc. sg.
glossary.δεπάεσσι: δέπας — cup, goblet; neut. dat. pl., epic -εσσι (= Attic δέπασι)
glossary.δόμοισιν: δόμος — house, home; masc. dat. pl., epic -οισιν (= Attic -οις), plural for a single dwelling
glossary.εἰλήλουθεν: ἔρχομαι — come, go; perf. 3 sg., epic εἰλήλουθεν (= Attic ἐλήλυθε): ’has come’
glossary.εἶμ: εἶμι — go, shall go; pres. 1 sg. with future sense, elided (εἶμ’ = εἶμι)
glossary.εὐνήν: εὐνή — bed, bedding, marriage-bed; fem. acc. sg. · also of an animal’s lair, den (ἑὴν εἰσήλυθεν εὐνήν ’came into his own lair’, of the lion in the simile)
glossary.εὐρυμέτωπον: εὐρυμέτωπος — broad-browed (of cattle); masc./fem. acc. sg. or neut. nom./acc. sg.
glossary.ζόφον: ζόφος — gloom, darkness (esp. of the west, where the sun sets); masc. acc. sg.
glossary.ζώω: ζώω (Attic ζάω) — live, be alive; pres. indic. or subj. 1 sg. (= Attic ζῶ)
glossary.θάμβος: θάμβος — amazement, astonishment; neut. nom./acc. sg.
glossary.θαασσέμεν: θάσσω (epic θαάσσω) — sit; pres. inf., epic -έμεν (= Attic θάσσειν): ’to sit’
glossary.θαρσύνω: θαρσύνω — encourage, cheer, embolden; pres. indic. or subj. 1 sg.
glossary.θαύμαζεν: θαυμάζω — marvel, wonder; impf. 3 sg., unaugmented (= Attic ἐθαύμαζε)
glossary.θεοειδὴς: θεοειδής — godlike in form; masc. nom. sg.
glossary.θην: θήν — surely, I warrant, to be sure; emphatic particle
glossary.κάλλιον: καλός — good, fine, fair; comparative κάλλιον, neut. nom./acc. sg. used predicatively: ’better, finer’
glossary.κάρτος: κράτος (epic κάρτος, metathesis) — strength, might; neut. nom./acc. sg.; often acc. of respect: ’in strength’
glossary.κέλομαι: κέλομαι — bid, order, urge; pres. 1 sg.
glossary.κέρασσεν: κεράννυμι — mix (wine with water); aor. 3 sg., unaugmented, epic σσ (= Attic ἐκέρασε)
glossary.καθεῦδε: καθεύδω — sleep, lie down to sleep; impf. 3 sg., no augment shown (Attic καθηῦδε or ἐκάθευδε; Attic too often leaves εὐ- unchanged)
glossary.καλά: καλός — good, fine, beautiful; neut. nom./acc. pl.
glossary.κατέλεξας: καταλέγω — recount, tell in order; aor. 2 sg.: ’you have recounted’
glossary.καταλέξεται: καταλέγω — lay down; mid. lie down (from λέγω ’lay’, root of λέχος ’bed’; distinct from καταλέγω ’recount’); fut. 3 sg. mid. (epic aor. subj. has the same form)
glossary.καύκωνας: Καύκωνες — the Caucones, a people; masc. acc. pl.
glossary.κεράασθε: κεράννυμι (epic pres. κεράω) — mix (wine with water); pres. imper. or indic. mid. 2 pl., with distended vowel (= contracted κερᾶσθε)
glossary.κεράσσατο: κεράννυμι — mix (wine with water); aor. 3 sg. mid., unaugmented, epic σσ (= Attic ἐκεράσατο)
glossary.κνέφας: κνέφας — dusk, darkness, nightfall; neut. nom./acc. sg.
glossary.κοίλην: κοῖλος — hollow; fem. acc. sg., standing epithet of ships  ·  also of a place (κοίλην Λακεδαίμονα ’hollow Lacedaemon’, i.e. ringed by hills)
glossary.κοίλῃ: κοῖλος — hollow; fem. dat. sg., standing epithet of ships
glossary.κοίμησε: κοιμάω — put to bed, lull to sleep; aor. 3 sg., unaugmented (= Attic ἐκοίμησε)
glossary.κοίτοιο: κοῖτος — bed, rest, going to bed; masc. gen. sg., epic -οιο (= Attic -ου)
glossary.κρήδεμνον: κρήδεμνον — head-veil (of a woman); also the covering or seal of a wine-jar; neut. nom./acc. sg.
glossary.κρητῆρα: κρητήρ — mixing-bowl (for wine and water); masc. acc. sg.
glossary.κυδίστη: κύδιστος — most glorious, most honoured (superl. of κυδρός/κῦδος); fem. nom. sg.
glossary.λέχος: λέχος — bed, couch; neut. nom./acc. sg.
glossary.λίπωνται: λείπω — leave; aor. subj. 3 pl. pass. (mid. in form): ’are left, remain’
glossary.λακεδαίμονα: Λακεδαίμων — Lacedaemon, the land in which Sparta lies; fem. acc. sg.
glossary.λεξαίμην: λέγω — lay; mid. lie down (root of λέχος ’bed’; distinct from λέγω ’say’); aor. opt. mid. 1 sg.: ’I would/might lie down’
glossary.λεχέεσσιν: λέχος — bed, couch; neut. dat. pl., epic -εσσι, plural for a single bed
glossary.μεγαθύμους: μεγάθυμος — great-hearted, high-spirited; masc. acc. pl.
glossary.μεδώμεθα: μέδομαι — think of, take thought of, be mindful of (+ gen.); pres. subj. 1 pl.
glossary.νέῳ: νέος — young, new; masc./neut. dat. sg.
glossary.νεώτεροι: νέος — young; comparative νεώτερος, masc. nom. pl.: ’younger’
glossary.νηί: ναῦς (epic νηῦς) — ship; fem. dat. sg. νηί
glossary.νώμησαν: νωμάω — deal out, distribute, wield; aor. 3 pl., unaugmented (= Attic ἐνώμησαν)
glossary.ξείνοισιν: ξεῖνος — stranger, guest-friend (epic = Attic ξένος); masc. dat. pl., epic -οισιν
glossary.ξεινίζειν: ξεινίζω — entertain, receive as a guest (epic = Attic ξενίζω); pres. inf.
glossary.οἰχνεῦσιν: οἰχνέω — go, travel, make one’s way; pres. 3 pl., Ionic -εῦσι(ν) (contracted from -έουσι)
glossary.οἴχεθ: οἴχομαι — be gone, have gone, depart; pres. 3 sg. with perf. sense, elided and aspirated (οἴχεθ’ = οἴχεται)
glossary.πάρα: παρά — beside; πάρα (accent drawn back) stands for πάρεστι/πάρεισι ’is/are at hand, present’ · also prep. placed after its noun (anastrophe) · also adv. after its verb (anastrophe): ἐτίθει πάρα ’set beside’ (= παρετίθει)
glossary.πέμψον: πέμπω — send, send on one’s way, escort; aor. imper. 2 sg.
glossary.παίδεσσι: παῖς — child, son; dat. pl., epic -εσσι (= Attic παισί)
glossary.παρακοίτι: παράκοιτις — wife (lit. ’she who lies beside’); fem. dat. sg.
glossary.πείθεσθαι: πείθω — persuade; mid. πείθομαι obey, comply with (+ dat.); pres. inf. mid.
glossary.πεζός: πεζός — on foot, going by land; masc. nom. sg.
glossary.πεισίστρατον: Πεισίστρατος — Peisistratus, son of Nestor; masc. acc. sg.
glossary.πενιχροῦ: πενιχρός — poor, needy; masc. gen. sg.
glossary.περιχεύας: περιχέω — pour round, pour over; aor. part. masc. nom. sg.
glossary.πομπῆες: πομπεύς — escort, guide, conductor; masc. nom. pl., epic πομπῆες
glossary.προλιπὼν: προλείπω — leave behind, abandon; aor. part. masc. nom. sg.
glossary.πόρσυνε: πορσύνω — prepare, make ready, provide; impf. or aor. 3 sg. (the forms coincide), unaugmented (= Attic ἐπόρσυνε)
glossary.σοῖς: σός — your, yours; masc./neut. dat. pl.
glossary.σοῖσιν: σός — your, yours; masc./neut. dat. pl., epic -οισιν
glossary.σπείσαντες: σπένδω — pour a libation; aor. part. act. masc. nom. pl.
glossary.σπεῖσάν: σπένδω — pour a libation; aor. 3 pl., unaugmented (= Attic ἔσπεισαν)
glossary.σῇ: σός — your, yours; fem. dat. sg.
glossary.τάμνετε: τέμνω (epic τάμνω) — cut; pres. imper. or indic. 2 pl.
glossary.τηλεμάχου: Τηλέμαχος — Telemachus, son of Odysseus; masc. gen. sg.
glossary.τηϋσίην: τηΰσιος — vain, fruitless, to no purpose; fem. acc. sg.; derivation not agreed
glossary.τοῖο: ὁ, ἡ, τό — he, she, it; that (in Homer a pronoun/demonstrative); masc./neut. gen. sg., epic -οιο (= Attic τοῦ): ’of it, of that’
glossary.τοῦδ: ὅδε — this, this here; demonstrative pron., masc. gen. sg., elided (τοῦδ’ = τοῦδε)
glossary.τρητοῖς: τρητός — bored, pierced (with holes for cords); masc./neut. dat. pl.
glossary.τριτογένεια: Τριτογένεια — Tritogeneia, title of Athena; fem. nom. sg.; meaning disputed (linked to a lake/river Triton, to a word for ’head’, or to ’third-born’)
glossary.τό: ὁ, ἡ, τό — he, she, it; that (in Homer a pronoun); neut. nom./acc. sg. ’it, that’; may anticipate a following clause: ’this (namely that…)’
glossary.υἱέι: υἱός — son; masc. dat. sg., epic stem υἱε- (= Attic υἱεῖ)
glossary.φάγωσιν: ἐσθίω — eat; aor. subj. 3 pl. (aor. ἔφαγον); with κατά in tmesis ’eat up’
glossary.φάος: φάος — light (epic uncontracted = Attic φῶς); neut. nom./acc. sg.
glossary.φήνῃ: φήνη — a bird of prey; species uncertain (sea-eagle, osprey and lammergeier have been proposed); fem. dat. sg.
glossary.φιλότητι: φιλότης — friendship, love, affection; fem. dat. sg.
glossary.χλαῖναι: χλαῖνα — thick woollen cloak (also used as a blanket); fem. nom. pl.
glossary.χρεῖός: χρέος (epic χρεῖος) — debt, need; neut. nom./acc. sg.
glossary.ἀγακλυτὰ: ἀγακλυτός — very renowned, glorious; neut. nom./acc. pl.
glossary.ἀδμήτην: ἄδμητος — unbroken, untamed, unyoked (ἀ- + δάμνημι ’tame’); fem. acc. sg.
glossary.ἀλάλησο: ἀλάομαι — wander, roam; perf. imper. mid. 2 sg. (perf. ἀλάλημαι with present sense): ’wander!’
glossary.ἀλεξήσειε: ἀλέξω — ward off, avert, defend against; aor. opt. 3 sg., in a wish: ’may (he) ward off’
glossary.ἀνείμονος: ἀνείμων — without clothing, unclad (ἀ- + εἷμα ’garment’); masc. gen. sg.
glossary.ἀνιστάμενοι: ἀνίστημι — mid./intrans. rise up, stand up; pres. part. masc. nom. pl.: ’rising up’
glossary.ἀποσπένδων: ἀποσπένδω — pour out a libation; pres. part. masc. nom. sg.
glossary.ἀποσφήλωσιν: ἀποσφάλλω — make to miss, drive off course, baffle; aor. subj. 3 pl.
glossary.ἄλλοθεν: ἄλλοθεν — from elsewhere, from another place; adv. (ἄλλος + -θεν ’from’)
glossary.ἄλλοις: ἄλλος — other, another; masc./neut. dat. pl.
glossary.ἄμφω: ἄμφω — both; dual pron./adj., used with a dual verb · also with a plural noun: ἄμφω χεῖρας ’both hands’
glossary.ἄναλκιν: ἄναλκις — without defensive strength, feeble, powerless; masc. acc. sg.
glossary.ἄνασσ: ἄνασσα — queen, lady, mistress; fem. nom./voc. sg., elided (ἄνασσ’ = ἄνασσα)
glossary.ἐλαφρότατοι: ἐλαφρός — light, nimble, swift; superl. ἐλαφρότατος, masc. nom. pl.: ’lightest, swiftest’
glossary.ἐλθοῦσιν: ἔρχομαι — go, come; aor. part. masc. dat. pl.: ’when they had come’
glossary.ἐμεῖο: ἐγώ — I; epic gen. sg. ἐμεῖο (= Attic ἐμοῦ)
glossary.ἐμὰ: ἐμός — my, mine; neut. nom./acc. pl.
glossary.ἐνίσπῃ: ἐνέπω — tell, relate, speak; aor. subj. 3 sg.
glossary.ἐνεύδειν: ἐνεύδω — sleep in, sleep on; pres. inf.
glossary.ἐπέλειβον: ἐπιλείβω — pour (a libation) over; impf. 3 pl.
glossary.ἐπαρξάμενοι: ἐπάρχω (mid. ἐπάρχομαι) — make a beginning of a rite, pour the first drops for a libation; aor. part. mid. masc. nom. pl.
glossary.ἐριδούπῳ: ἐρίδουπος — loud-echoing, loud-thundering (ἐρι- + δοῦπος ’thud, din’); masc./fem./neut. dat. sg.
glossary.ἐσθλόν: ἐσθλός — good, noble, brave; masc. acc. sg. or neut. nom./acc. sg.
glossary.ἐτίμα: τιμάω — honour; impf. 3 sg., contracted: ’used to honour’
glossary.ἐυμμελίην: ἐυμμελίης — with a good ash-spear (ἐύς ’good’ + μελίη ’ash-spear’); masc. acc. sg.
glossary.ἐχόντων: ἔχω — have, hold; pres. part. masc./neut. gen. pl.: ’of those who hold’ · also pres. imper. 3 pl.: ’let them hold’
glossary.ἔδυ: δύω — go in, sink, set (of the sun); aor. 3 sg. (root aorist)
glossary.ἔκλυε: κλύω — hear, hearken to, heed; aor. 3 sg. (+ gen. of person heard)
glossary.ἔλθῃς: ἔρχομαι — go, come; aor. subj. 2 sg.
glossary.ἔλποιτό: ἔλπω (mid. ἔλπομαι) — hope, expect; pres. opt. 3 sg. mid.
glossary.ἔλυσε: λύω — loose, undo, untie; aor. 3 sg.; with ἀπό in tmesis (ἀπὸ … ἔλυσε = ἀπέλυσε) ’loosed off’
glossary.ἔοικεν: ἔοικα — be like, seem, be fitting; perf. 3 sg., impersonal: ’it is fitting’
glossary.ἔπιον: πίνω — drink; aor. 1 sg. or 3 pl.
glossary.ἔσεσθαι: εἰμί — be; fut. inf.: ’to be, will be’
glossary.ἔφησθα: φημί — say, speak; impf. 2 sg., with the old ending -σθα (Attic ἔφησθα or ἔφης): ’you said’
glossary.ἕκαστα: ἕκαστος — each, every; neut. acc. pl. used substantivally: ’each thing, everything’
glossary.ἠίθεος: ἠίθεος — unmarried young man, bachelor; masc. nom. sg.
glossary.ἡγεμόνευε: ἡγεμονεύω — lead the way, be the guide (+ dat.); impf. 3 sg. (augment not visible on ἡ-) · also pres. imper. 2 sg.: ’lead the way!’
glossary.ἤθελε: ἐθέλω — wish, be willing, want; impf. 3 sg.
glossary.ἦνιν: ἦνις — a year old, yearling (of a calf); rare word, precise sense not certain; fem. acc. sg.
glossary.ἰδόντας: ὁράω — see; aor. part. masc. acc. pl. (stem ἰδ-): ’those who saw’
glossary.ἰκριόφιν: ἴκρια — half-decks, deck-planks (at bow and stern of a ship); neut. pl. in -φι(ν), serving as gen. or dat.
glossary.ἱέσθην: ἵημι (mid.) — be eager, hasten, set oneself; impf. mid. 3 dual: ’were eager (to go)’
glossary.ἵκετο: ἱκνέομαι — come, arrive at, reach; aor. 3 sg.; where the metre makes the ι long, that is the augment, which the spelling cannot show; with short ι, unaugmented
glossary.ἵκηται: ἱκνέομαι — come, arrive at, reach; aor. subj. 3 sg. (short ι; subjunctives take no augment)
glossary.ἵκοντο: ἱκνέομαι — come, arrive at, reach; aor. 3 pl.; with short ι (by metre) unaugmented; where the metre makes the ι long, augmented (the spelling cannot show it)
glossary.ἵληθι: ἵλημι (mid. ἵλαμαι) — be gracious, be propitious; epic imper. 2 sg.: ’be gracious!’
glossary.ὀλίγον: ὀλίγος — small, little, slight; masc. acc. sg. or neut. nom./acc. sg.
glossary.ὀλύμπια: Ὀλύμπιος — Olympian, of Olympus; neut. nom./acc. pl.
glossary.ὀνόμαζεν: ὀνομάζω — call by name, name; impf. 3 sg., unaugmented (= Attic ὠνόμαζε); with ἐκ in tmesis (ἔκ … ὀνόμαζεν) ’called by name’
glossary.ὀφέλλεται: ὀφείλω — owe; pres. 3 sg. pass., epic ὀφέλλεται (= Attic ὀφείλεται): ’is owed’
glossary.ὄρχαμον: ὄρχαμος — chief, leader (+ gen. ’of men’); masc. acc. sg.
glossary.ὅθεν: ὅθεν — from where, whence; relative adv.
glossary.ὅσον: ὅσος — as much as, as many as; masc. acc. sg. or neut. nom./acc. sg.; neut. often adverbial: ’as much as’
glossary.ὑπερφιάλους: ὑπερφίαλος — overbearing, arrogant, presumptuous; masc. acc. pl.
glossary.ὥρη: ὥρα (Ionic ὥρη) — season, the right time, hour; fem. nom. sg. (Ionic η = Attic ᾱ): ’it is time (for)’
glossary.ῥέξω: ῥέζω — do, perform, sacrifice; fut. 1 sg. or aor. subj. 1 sg.: ’I will do, sacrifice’
glossary.ῥήγεα: ῥῆγος — rug, coverlet (laid on a bed); neut. nom./acc. pl.
glossary.αἰθούσης: αἴθουσα — portico, colonnade; fem. gen. sg.
glossary.αὐχενίους: αὐχένιος — of the neck; masc. acc. pl.
glossary.βάλεν: βάλλω — throw, cast; aor. 3 sg., unaugmented, in tmesis with ἀμφί: ’threw about’ · also in tmesis with ἐπί (βάλεν δ’ ἐπὶ ... ἑκάστῳ = ἐπέβαλε): ’threw over, cast upon’
glossary.βάλλων: βάλλω — throw, cast; pres. part. masc. nom. sg.: ’casting’
glossary.βήσετο: βαίνω — go, step; mixed aor. mid. 3 sg. (aor. stem βησ- with impf. endings), unaugmented: ’went’; with ἀνά in tmesis ’mounted’
glossary.βοὸς: βοῦς — ox, cow, heifer; gen. sg.
glossary.δίπτυχα: δίπτυχος — twofold, double-folded; neut. acc. pl., predicative with ποιέω (δίπτυχα ποιήσαντες ’folding (it) double’)
glossary.δίφρον: δίφρος — chariot-platform, chariot; masc. acc. sg.
glossary.δαίνυνθ: δαίνυμι — feast, give a feast; mid. impf. 3 pl., unaugmented, elided (δαίνυνθ’ = δαίνυντο), τ>θ before rough breathing: ’they feasted’
glossary.δαμεὶς: δάμνημι — subdue, overcome; aor. pass. part. masc. nom. sg.: ’overcome’
glossary.δεπάεσσιν: δέπας — cup; neut. dat. pl., epic -εσσι(ν)
glossary.διέχευαν: διαχέω — pour apart, cut up (a carcass); aor. 3 pl.: ’they cut her apart’
glossary.διοκλῆος: Διοκλῆς — Diocles, host of Telemachus at Pherae; masc. gen. sg.
glossary.διοτρεφέες: διοτρεφής — Zeus-nurtured (of kings); masc. nom. pl., epic uncontracted (= Attic διοτρεφεῖς)
glossary.δμῳῇσιν: δμῳή — serving-woman, slave-woman; fem. dat. pl., epic -ῃσι(ν) (= Attic -αις)
glossary.εἰργάζετο: ἐργάζομαι — work, fashion; impf. 3 sg., augment εἰ- (the verb once began with ϝ): ’he worked’
glossary.εἴπατε: εἶπον — say, tell; aor. imper. 2 pl.: ’tell!’ (also indic. ’you said’)
glossary.εἶχε: ἔχω — have, hold; impf. 3 sg., augmented (contracted from ἔ-εχε): ’held’
glossary.εἷς: εἷς — one; numeral, masc. nom. sg. (ὁ μέν … εἷς δ’ … εἷς δ’ ’one … another … another’)
glossary.εἷσαν: ἵζω — make to sit, seat; aor. 3 pl., causative sense: ’seated (him)’
glossary.εὐνῆφι: εὐνή — bed; sg. with the epic case-ending -φι(ν), serving as gen. or dat. (ἐξ εὐνῆφι ’out of bed’; = Attic ἐξ εὐνῆς)
glossary.εὐρυδίκη: Εὐρυδίκη — Eurydice, wife of Nestor; fem. nom. sg.
glossary.εὐρυοδείης: εὐρυόδεια — wide-wayed (fem. adj., of the earth); fem. gen. sg.
glossary.εὔξαντο: εὔχομαι — pray, vow; aor. 3 pl.: ’they prayed’
glossary.ζεύγνυντ: ζεύγνυμι — yoke; mid. impf. 3 pl., unaugmented, elided (ζεύγνυντ’ = ζεύγνυντο): ’had (the horses) yoked’
glossary.ζεύξαθ: ζεύγνυμι — yoke; aor. imper. 2 pl., elided (ζεύξαθ’ = ζεύξατε, τ>θ before rough breathing): ’yoke!’
glossary.θάλειαν: θάλεια — abundant, flourishing (fem. adj., from θάλλω ’flourish’); fem. acc. sg.
glossary.θαλάμων: θάλαμος — chamber, room; masc. gen. pl.
glossary.θεοείκελον: θεοείκελος — god-resembling, godlike (θεός + εἴκελος ’like’); masc. acc. sg.
glossary.θρασυμήδης: Θρασυμήδης — Thrasymedes, son of Nestor; masc. nom. sg.
glossary.καλλίτριχας: καλλίθριξ — fair-maned, fair-haired (καλός + θρίξ); masc./fem. acc. pl.
glossary.καλὴ: καλός — beautiful, fair; fem. nom. sg.
glossary.κατά: κατά — down, down from, throughout; prep. + gen./acc. · also as preverb in tmesis (κατά … ἐκάλυψαν = κατεκάλυψαν ’covered over’); acute kept before an enclitic
glossary.κατήρχετο: κατάρχομαι — begin (a rite) with; impf. 3 sg., + acc.: ’began (the rite) with’
glossary.κελέσθω: κέλομαι — bid, command; pres. imper. 3 sg.: ’let him bid’
glossary.κεράων: κέρας — horn; neut. gen. pl., epic uncontracted (= Attic κερῶν): ’by the horns’
glossary.κηρὶ: κήρ — death, doom allotted to a person; fem. dat. sg.
glossary.κλυμένοιο: Κλύμενος — Clymenus, father of Eurydice; masc. gen. sg., epic -οιο (= Attic -ου)
glossary.κλύον: κλύω — hear, hearken; aor. 3 pl., unaugmented: ’they heard’
glossary.κνίσῃ: κνῖσα (epic κνίση) — fat enveloping the entrails, savour of burning fat; fem. dat. sg.
glossary.κρηήνατ: κραιαίνω — fulfil, accomplish; aor. imper. 2 pl., elided (κρηήνατ’ = κρηήνατε): ’fulfil!’
glossary.λάζετο: λάζομαι — take hold of, seize; impf. 3 sg., unaugmented: ’took hold of’
glossary.λέβητι: λέβης — cauldron, basin; masc. dat. sg.
glossary.λίθοισιν: λίθος — stone; masc. dat. pl., epic -οισι(ν) (= Attic -οις)
glossary.λίπ: λίπα — richly, thickly; adv. (perh. instead an elided case-form of a noun ’fat’, cf. λίπος), elided (λίπ’ = λίπα)
glossary.λαέρκεα: Λαέρκης — Laerces, a goldsmith; masc. acc. sg.
glossary.λευκοί: λευκός — white, bright; masc. nom. pl.
glossary.λεῖβε: λείβω — pour, pour as a libation; impf. 3 sg., unaugmented: ’poured’
glossary.λιπέτην: λείπω — leave; aor. dual 3rd pers., unaugmented: ’the two left’
glossary.λιπέτω: λείπω — leave; aor. imper. 3 sg.: ’let him leave’
glossary.λοῦσέν: λούω — bathe, wash; aor. 3 sg., unaugmented, accented before an enclitic (λοῦσέν τε)
glossary.λοῦσεν: λούω — bathe, wash; aor. 3 sg., unaugmented: ’bathed’
glossary.μέλαν: μέλας — black, dark; neut. nom./acc. sg.
glossary.μένετ: μένω — stay, remain; pres. imper. (or indic.) 2 pl., elided (μένετ’ = μένετε): ’stay!’
glossary.μίστυλλόν: μιστύλλω — cut into small pieces; impf. 3 pl., unaugmented: ’they cut into small pieces’
glossary.μεγαλήτορος: μεγαλήτωρ — great-hearted, great of spirit (μέγας + ἦτορ ’heart’); masc. gen. sg.
glossary.μενεπτόλεμος: μενεπτόλεμος — steadfast in battle (μένω + πόλεμος); masc. nom. sg.
glossary.μηρία: μηρίον — thigh-piece, the god’s portion of a sacrifice; neut. nom./acc. pl.
glossary.νηλεὺς: Νηλεύς — Neleus, Nestor’s father, former king of Pylos; masc. nom. sg.
glossary.νηληϊάδαο: Νηληϊάδης — son of Neleus (patronymic, of Nestor); masc. gen. sg., epic -αο (= Attic -ου)
