glossary.νύκτ: νύξ — night; fem. acc. sg., accusative of duration, elided (νύκτ’ = νύκτα): ’for the night’
glossary.ξείνια: ξείνιος (Attic ξένιος) — of or for a guest; τὰ ξείνια as noun, gifts and entertainment due to a guest; neut. nom./acc. pl.
glossary.ξεστοῖσι: ξεστός — polished, smoothed (verbal adj. of ξέω ’scrape smooth’); masc. dat. pl., epic -οισι (= Attic -οῖς)
glossary.ξύλα: ξύλον — wood, firewood; neut. acc. pl.
glossary.οἰνοχοεῦντες: οἰνοχοέω — pour wine; pres. part. masc. nom. pl., Ionic -ευ- (= Attic -ουντες): ’pouring wine’
glossary.οἰσέμεν: φέρω — carry, bring; epic inf. built on οἰσ- (the stem of fut. οἴσω), usu. classed with the mixed aor. (imper. οἶσε): ’to bring’
glossary.οἴους: οἶος — alone, only; masc. acc. pl.: ’only, alone’ (δύ’ οἴους ’two only’)
glossary.οἷσίν: ὅς, ἥ, ὅ (relative) — who, which; masc./neut. dat. pl., accented before an enclitic (οἷσίν τε ’with which’, epic τε) · also possessive ὅς, ἥ, ὅν: his own, her own; masc./neut. dat. pl.
glossary.οὐλοχύτας: οὐλοχύται — barley scattered on a sacrificial victim (οὐλαί + χέω ’pour’); fem. acc. pl.
glossary.οὐλὰς: οὐλαί — whole barley-grains (for sprinkling on a victim); fem. acc. pl.
glossary.πένεσθαι: πένομαι — busy oneself about, prepare, work at; pres. inf.
glossary.πανημέριοι: πανημέριος — all day long; masc. nom. pl., used adjectivally where English has an adverb
glossary.παράκοιτις: παράκοιτις — bedfellow, wife; fem. nom. sg.
glossary.πείρατα: πεῖραρ — end, limit, the means to an end; neut. nom./acc. pl. (πείρατα τέχνης ’the ends, the completion, of a craft’)
glossary.πεδίονδ: πεδίον — plain; acc. sg. + -δε ’to, towards’, elided (πεδίονδ’ = πεδίονδε): ’to the plain’
glossary.πεμπώβολα: πεμπώβολον — five-pronged fork/spit (Aeolic πέμπε ’five’ + ὀβελός ’spit’); neut. acc. pl.
glossary.περίχευεν: περιχέω — pour round, overlay; aor. 3 sg., unaugmented: ’poured round’
glossary.περιχεύῃ: περιχέω — pour round, overlay; aor. subj. 3 sg.: ’may pour round’
glossary.περσεύς: Περσεύς — Perseus, son of Nestor; masc. nom. sg.
glossary.περσεὺς: Περσεύς — Perseus, son of Nestor; masc. nom. sg.
glossary.πετέσθην: πέτομαι — fly; impf. dual 3rd pers., unaugmented: ’the two flew’
glossary.ποιήσαντες: ποιέω — make, do; aor. part. masc. nom. pl.: ’having made’
glossary.ποικίλ: ποικίλος — inlaid, intricately worked; neut. acc. pl., elided (ποικίλ’ = ποικίλα)
glossary.ποιμένα: ποιμήν — shepherd; masc. acc. sg. (ποιμένα λαῶν ’shepherd of the people’, apposition)
glossary.πολυκάστη: Πολυκάστη — Polycaste, youngest daughter of Nestor; fem. nom. sg.
glossary.πρέσβα: πρέσβα (poet. fem. of πρέσβυς) — eldest, first in rank; august, revered (a title of honour, as of goddesses); fem. nom./voc. sg.; with partitive gen. ’eldest of’
glossary.πρήσσῃσιν: πρήσσω (Attic πράττω) — do, accomplish; pass over, make one’s way; pres. subj. 3 sg., epic -ῃσι(ν); + gen. of the way: ’may make his way (along)’
glossary.προβάλοντο: προβάλλω — throw forward, cast before; aor. mid. 3 pl., unaugmented: ’they threw forward’
glossary.πυρηφόρον: πυρηφόρος — wheat-bearing (πυρός ’wheat’ + φέρω ’bear’); masc./fem. acc. sg. or neut. nom./acc. sg.
glossary.σεῖον: σείω — shake; impf. 3 pl., unaugmented: ’they shook’
glossary.στάς: ἵστημι — stand; aor. part. masc. nom. sg.: ’standing’
glossary.στρατίος: Στρατίος — Stratius, son of Nestor; masc. nom. sg.
glossary.σφ: σφεῖς — they; epic encl. pron., elided σφ’ for dat. σφι ’for them’ or acc. σφε ’them’
glossary.σφάξεν: σφάζω — cut the throat, slaughter; aor. 3 sg., unaugmented: ’cut her throat’
glossary.σχίζῃς: σχίζα — split wood, billet; fem. dat. pl., epic -ῃς (= Attic -αις)
glossary.τάμνον: τάμνω (epic for τέμνω) — cut; impf. 3 pl., unaugmented, in tmesis with ἐκ: ’they cut out’
glossary.τένοντας: τένων — sinew, tendon; masc. acc. pl.
glossary.τέχνης: τέχνη — craft, skill; fem. gen. sg.
glossary.τἆλλα: ἄλλος — other; τἆλλα, crasis of τὰ ἄλλα: the rest, the other things; neut. nom./acc. pl.
glossary.υἱέος: υἱός — son; masc. gen. sg. (υἱέος Ὀρτιλόχοιο ’son of Ortilochus’, in apposition to Diocles)
glossary.φηρὰς: Φηραί — Pherae, a town on the road from Pylos to Lacedaemon; fem. acc. pl.
glossary.χέρνιβά: χέρνιψ — water for washing the hands; acc. sg., accented before an enclitic
glossary.χαλκήια: χαλκήιος — of a smith, a smith’s; of bronze; neut. nom./acc. pl. (ὅπλα χαλκήια ’a smith’s tools’)
glossary.χαλκεὺς: χαλκεύς — smith, bronze-worker; masc. nom. sg.
glossary.χερσί: χείρ — hand; fem. dat. pl. (without movable ν)
glossary.χθονὸς: χθών — earth, ground; fem. gen. sg.
glossary.χρυσέοις: χρύσεος — golden; masc./neut. dat. pl., epic uncontracted (= Attic χρυσοῖς)
glossary.ἀέκοντε: ἄκων (ἀέκων) — unwilling; masc. nom. dual: ’the two unwilling’ (οὐκ ἀέκοντε ’not unwilling’)
glossary.ἀγέτην: ἄγω — lead; impf. dual 3rd pers., unaugmented (= Attic ἠγέτην): ’the two led’
glossary.ἀγέτω: ἄγω — lead, bring; pres. imper. 3 sg.: ’let him bring’
glossary.ἀκροπόρους: ἀκρόπορος — piercing at the point, sharp-pointed; masc. acc. pl.
glossary.ἀλείφατος: ἄλειφαρ — oil, unguent; neut. gen. sg.
glossary.ἀλφειὸς: Ἀλφειός — Alpheus, a river-god, father of Ortilochus; masc. nom. sg.
glossary.ἀμνίον: ἀμνίον — bowl to catch the blood of a sacrificial victim (sense from ancient explanation; only once in Homer); neut. acc. sg.
glossary.ἀνά: ἀνά — up, up along; prep. + acc., or adv. · also as preverb in tmesis (ἀνά … ἔβαινον = ἀνέβαινον ’mounted’); acute kept before an enclitic
glossary.ἀνέβαινε: ἀναβαίνω — go up, mount; impf. 3 sg.: ’mounted’
glossary.ἀνελόντες: ἀναιρέω — take up, lift; aor. part. masc. nom. pl.: ’having lifted’
glossary.ἀνθεμόεντι: ἀνθεμόεις — flowered, decorated with flowers; masc./neut. dat. sg.
glossary.ἀντίθεος: ἀντίθεος — godlike; masc. nom. sg., general epithet of heroes
glossary.ἀντιόωσα: ἀντιάω — come to meet, partake of; pres. part. fem. nom. sg., epic diectasis (= Attic ἀντιῶσα), + gen.
glossary.ἀολλέες: ἀολλής — all together, in a body; masc. nom. pl.
glossary.ἀπέκοψε: ἀποκόπτω — cut off, sever; aor. 3 sg.: ’cut through’
glossary.ἀπαρχόμενος: ἀπάρχομαι — make the first offering; pres. part. masc. nom. sg.
glossary.ἀποστίλβοντες: ἀποστίλβω — glisten, shine; pres. part. masc. nom. pl.: ’glistening’
glossary.ἀσκήσας: ἀσκέω — work skilfully, fashion with art; aor. part. masc. nom. sg.: ’having worked with skill’
glossary.ἄγαλμα: ἄγαλμα — a thing that delights, ornament, offering for a god; neut. acc. sg.
glossary.ἄγοντες: ἄγω — lead, bring; pres. part. masc. nom. pl.: ’bringing, leading’
glossary.ἄεσαν: ἀέσαι (root ἀϝεσ-, prob. akin to ἰαύω ’sleep’; distinct from ἄημι ’blow’) — sleep, pass the night; aor. 3 pl.: ’they passed the night’
glossary.ἄρητος: Ἄρητος — Aretus, son of Nestor; masc. nom. sg.
glossary.ἄρητός: Ἄρητος — Aretus, son of Nestor; masc. nom. sg. (acute added before the enclitic τε)
glossary.ἄϊδόσδε: ᾍδης (epic Ἀΐδης) — Hades; -δε ’to’ added to the gen. Ἄϊδος (δόμον understood): ’to (the house) of Hades’
glossary.ἅρμασιν: ἅρμα — chariot; neut. dat. pl. (pl. for a single chariot)
glossary.ἅρματ: ἅρμα — chariot; neut. acc. pl. (pl. for a single chariot), elided (ἅρματ’ = ἅρματα)
glossary.ἅρματα: ἅρμα — chariot; neut. nom./acc. pl. (pl. for a single chariot)
glossary.ἐέλδωρ: ἐέλδωρ — wish, desire; neut. nom./acc. sg.
glossary.ἐκάη: καίω — burn; aor. pass. 3 sg., augmented (unaugmented κάη), in tmesis with κατά (κατὰ … ἐκάη = κατεκάη): ’was burned up, were burned up’
glossary.ἐκάλυψαν: καλύπτω — cover, wrap; aor. 3 pl., augmented (unaugmented κάλυψαν); in tmesis with κατά (κατά … ἐκάλυψαν = κατεκάλυψαν ’covered over’)
glossary.ἐλάαν: ἐλαύνω — drive; epic pres. inf. of the by-form ἐλάω, with diectasis (contracted ἐλᾶν; Attic pres. inf. ἐλαύνειν): ’to drive on’ · also, same spelling, fut. inf. (Attic ἐλᾶν): ’to be going to drive’, told apart only by context
glossary.ἐλάσῃ: ἐλαύνω — drive; aor. subj. 3 sg.: ’may drive’
glossary.ἐλαίῳ: ἔλαιον — olive oil; neut. dat. sg.
glossary.ἐναργὴς: ἐναργής — plain to see, manifest, visible in true form; masc./fem. nom. sg.
glossary.ἐπίθοντο: πείθω — persuade; mid. obey; aor. mid. 3 pl., augmented (unaugmented πίθοντο): ’they obeyed’
glossary.ἐπιβουκόλος: ἐπιβουκόλος — one set over the cattle, herdsman; masc. nom. sg.
glossary.ἐπικόψων: ἐπικόπτω — strike, smite; fut. part. masc. nom. sg., of purpose: ’to strike’
glossary.ἐποίπνυον: ποιπνύω — bustle, be busy, hasten about; impf. 3 pl.: ’bustled about’
glossary.ἐριδούπου: ἐρίδουπος — loud-echoing, loud-thundering; masc./fem. gen. sg.
glossary.ἐυποίητόν: ἐυποίητος — well-made; masc./fem. acc. sg., accented before an enclitic
glossary.ἐφῖζε: ἐφίζω — sit upon; impf. 3 sg., augmented (ι lengthened to ῑ, shown by the circumflex): ’sat upon’
glossary.ἐχέφρων: Ἐχέφρων — Echephron, son of Nestor; masc. nom. sg. · also the adj. ἐχέφρων — sensible, prudent (ἔχω + φρήν); masc./fem. nom. sg.
glossary.ἑζόμενοι: ἕζομαι — sit down; pres. part. masc. nom. pl.: ’seated’
glossary.ἑτέρῃ: ἕτερος — the other (of two); fem. dat. sg., often with χειρί understood: ’with the other (hand)’
glossary.ἔβαινον: βαίνω — go, step; impf. 3 pl. (or 1 sg.), augmented; in tmesis with ἀνά (ἀνά … ἔβαινον = ἀνέβαινον ’they mounted’)
glossary.ἔδουσι: ἐσθίω — eat; pres. 3 pl., from the epic present ἔδω (= Attic ἐσθίουσι): ’they eat’
glossary.ἔδωχ: δίδωμι — give; aor. 3 sg., elided (ἔδωχ’ = ἔδωκε, κ>χ before rough breathing): ’gave’
glossary.ἔθηκεν: τίθημι — put, place; aor. 3 sg., augmented: ’placed’
glossary.ἔλασαν: ἐλαύνω — drive; aor. 3 pl., unaugmented, in tmesis with ἐκ: ’drove out’
glossary.ἔλθῃσιν: ἔρχομαι — go, come; aor. subj. 3 sg., epic -ῃσι(ν) (= Attic ἔλθῃ): ’may come’
glossary.ἔσχον: ἔχω — have, hold; aor. 3 pl. (or 1 sg.), augmented (ἐ- + aor. stem σχ-; unaugmented σχέθον is a different formation): ’they held’
glossary.ἔχεν: ἔχω — have, hold; impf. 3 sg., unaugmented (= εἶχεν): ’held’
glossary.ἕζετ: ἕζομαι — sit down; impf. 3 sg., elided (ἕζετ’ = ἕζετο), in tmesis with κατά: ’sat down’ · also plain, no tmesis: ’sat’ (ἕζετ’ ἔπειτ’ ἐπὶ θῖνα ’then sat down on the shore’)
glossary.ἕκτος: ἕκτος — sixth; ordinal numeral, masc. nom. sg.
glossary.ἤλασεν: ἐλαύνω — drive; also strike, deal a blow; aor. 3 sg., augmented (unaugmented ἔλασεν): ’drove, struck’
glossary.ἤλυθεν: ἔρχομαι — go, come; epic aor. 3 sg. (= Attic ἦλθεν): ’came’
glossary.ἦνον: ἄνω (by-form of ἀνύω; not the adv. ἄνω ’up’) — accomplish, complete; impf. 3 pl., augmented: ’they went on completing’ (ἦνον ὁδόν ’pressed on with their road’)
glossary.ἰδοῦσα: ὁράω (εἶδον) — see; aor. part. fem. nom. sg.: ’seeing’
glossary.ἱλάσσομ: ἱλάσκομαι — propitiate, appease; aor. subj. 1 sg. with the epic short vowel (same spelling as the fut. indic.), elided (ἱλάσσομ’ = ἱλάσσομαι): ’that I may propitiate’
glossary.ἱππηλάτα: ἱππηλάτης — horse-driver, charioteer (epithet of Nestor); masc. nom. sg., old form in short -α
glossary.ἱρῶν: ἱερός (Ionic ἱρός) — sacred, holy; neut. gen. pl.: ’of the sacred rites’
glossary.ἵζεσκεν: ἵζω — sit, sit down; impf. 3 sg., iterative in -σκ-, unaugmented (as iteratives usually are): ’used to sit’
glossary.ὀβελοῖσιν: ὀβελός — spit; masc. dat. pl., epic -οισι(ν) (= Attic -οῖς)
glossary.ὀλόλυξαν: ὀλολύζω — raise the ritual cry (of women); aor. 3 pl., unaugmented: ’they raised the cry’
glossary.ὀρτιλόχοιο: Ὀρτίλοχος — Ortilochus, father of Diocles; masc. gen. sg., epic -οιο (= Attic -ου)
glossary.ὁδόν: ὁδός — road, way, journey; fem. acc. sg.
glossary.ὁμοῖος: ὅμοιος — like, similar; masc. nom. sg., + dat.
glossary.ὁπλοτάτη: ὁπλότερος (superl. ὁπλότατος) — younger, youngest; fem. nom. sg.
glossary.ὄροντο: ὄρομαι — watch over, have charge of; impf. 3 pl., unaugmented (augmented would be ὠρ-): ’they waited on’ (some derive it from ὄρνυμι ’rose’)
glossary.ὄρχαμος: ὄρχαμος — chief, leader; masc. nom. sg. (ὄρχαμος ἀνδρῶν ’chief of men’)
glossary.ὄψα: ὄψον — relish, whatever is eaten with bread, esp. meat; neut. acc. pl.
glossary.ὑπέκφερον: ὑπεκφέρω — carry forward, bear onward (ὑπό + ἐκ + φέρω); impf. 3 pl., unaugmented: ’carried onward’
glossary.ὑπέρθυμος: ὑπέρθυμος — high-spirited, of overflowing spirit (ὑπέρ + θυμός); masc. nom. sg.
glossary.ὑφ: ὑπό (elided ὑφ’, before a rough breathing) — under, beneath; + gen., dat. or acc. · also as preverb in tmesis, apart from its verb (ὑφ’ ... ὦρσε = ὑπῶρσε ’aroused’)
glossary.ὑψηλάων: ὑψηλός — high, lofty; fem. gen. pl., epic -άων (= Attic -ῶν)
glossary.ὠμοθέτησαν: ὠμοθετέω — lay raw pieces (on the burning offering) (ὠμός ’raw’ + τίθημι ’place’); aor. 3 pl.: ’they laid raw pieces’
glossary.ῥύη: ῥέω — flow; aor. pass. 3 sg., unaugmented, in tmesis with ἐκ (ἐκρύη = ἐξερρύη): ’flowed out’
glossary.αἰγυπτίους: Αἰγύπτιος — Egyptian; masc. acc. pl. (οἱ Αἰγύπτιοι, the Egyptians)
glossary.αἰψηρὸς: αἰψηρός — swift, quick; masc. nom. sg.
glossary.αὐτούς: αὐτός — self; masc. acc. pl.: ’them’ · also intensive, ’the very men themselves’ (with a following τε … τε)
glossary.αὐτοὺς: αὐτός — self; masc. acc. pl.: ’them’ (grave, mid-clause form)
glossary.αὐτώ: αὐτός — self; masc. nom./acc. dual: ’themselves, the two of them’
glossary.βάζεις: βάζω — chatter, babble, talk; pres. 2 sg.
glossary.βάλον: βάλλω — throw, cast, put; aor. 3 pl., unaugmented (= ἔβαλον)
glossary.βασιλήων: βασιλεύς — king; masc. gen. pl., epic -ήων (= Attic -έων)
glossary.βασιλῆος: βασιλεύς — king; masc. gen. sg., epic -ῆος (= Attic -έως)
glossary.βοηθοΐδη: Βοηθοΐδης — son of Boethous (patronymic); masc. voc. sg.
glossary.γένος: γένος — stock, race, lineage, offspring; neut. nom. sg. · also neut. acc. sg., governed by μετά: ’after (blood and) lineage’
glossary.γέρα: γέρας — prize of honor, honorific portion; neut. acc. pl. (γέρα)
glossary.γεγαῶτ: γίγνομαι — become, be born; perf. part. masc. acc. sg., elided (γεγαῶτ’ = γεγαῶτα): ’having been born’
glossary.γλυκεροῖο: γλυκερός — sweet; gen. sg., epic -οιο (= Attic -οῦ)
glossary.γόοιο: γόος — wailing, lament; masc. gen. sg., epic -οιο (= Attic -ου)
glossary.γόῳ: γόος — wailing, lament; masc. dat. sg.: ’with wailing’
glossary.δαίνυντο: δαίνυμι — give a feast; mid. feast, banquet; impf. 3 pl., unaugmented: ’were feasting’
glossary.δαινύντα: δαίνυμι — give a feast; pres. part. act. masc. acc. sg.: ’feasting, holding a banquet’
glossary.δεικνύμενος: δείκνυμι — show, point out; pres. part. mid. masc. nom. sg.: ’gesturing’
glossary.διέσσυτο: διασεύομαι — rush through, dart through; aor. 3 sg. (impf. in form), augmented (δια- + ἐ- elides to δι-): ’sped through’
glossary.διὰ: διά — through, throughout; prep. + acc. · also as preverb in tmesis, standing apart from its verb: διὰ … τινάξῃ = διατινάξῃ ’shake apart, shatter’ · also + acc., causal, ’through, thanks to, by the aid of’ (διὰ … Ἀθήνην)
glossary.δοιὼ: δοιώ — two; numeral, dual (indeclinable, used with a dual noun)
glossary.δούλης: δούλη — female slave, bondwoman; gen. sg.
glossary.δωσέμεναι: δίδωμι — give; fut. inf., epic -έμεναι (= Attic δώσειν): ’that he would give’
glossary.δώμασι: δῶμα — house, home; neut. dat. pl.
glossary.εἰρησόμεθ: εἴρομαι — ask, inquire; fut. mid. 1 pl., elided (εἰρησόμεθ’ = εἰρησόμεθα): ’we shall ask’
glossary.εἰσίν: εἰμί — be; pres. 3 pl.: ’they are’ (Attic form, alongside the epic by-form ἔασιν)
glossary.εἰσῆγον: εἰσάγω — lead in, bring in; impf. 3 pl., augmented (root’s α lengthens to η): ’they led in’
glossary.εἴπ: εἶπον (aor. of λέγω/φημί) — say, tell; aor. imper. 2 sg., elided (εἴπ’ = εἰπέ)
glossary.εἶδος: εἶδος — form, look, beauty; neut. acc. sg. (accusative of respect): ’in beauty’
glossary.ζειάς: ζειά — spelt, emmer (a coarse grain fed to horses); fem. acc. pl.
glossary.ζηνός: Ζεύς — Zeus; gen. sg., epic stem Ζην- (Ζηνός = Διός)
glossary.ζηνὶ: Ζεύς — Zeus; dat. sg., epic stem Ζην- (Ζηνί = Διί)
glossary.θεράποντας: θεράπων — attendant, servant; masc. acc. pl.
glossary.θεράπων: θεράπων — attendant, servant; masc. nom. sg.
glossary.θεῖος: θεῖος — divine, god-inspired; masc. nom. sg.
glossary.θοινηθῆναι: θοινάω — feast, entertain; aor. pass. inf.: ’to be feasted’ (purpose)
glossary.θῆσθαι: θάομαι — suck (the breast); pres. mid. inf.: ’for the milking, sucking of it’

glossary.κακοὶ: κακός — bad, base, common (of low birth); masc. nom. pl.

glossary.λευκὸν: λευκός — white, bright; neut. acc. sg.

glossary.μενέλαε: Μενέλαος — Menelaus, king of Sparta; masc. voc. sg.

glossary.νεστορίδη: Νεστορίδης — son of Nestor (patronymic, of Peisistratus); masc. voc. sg.
glossary.ξείνω: ξεῖνος — stranger, guest-friend; masc. nom. dual: ’two strangers’
glossary.ξείνων: ξεῖνος — stranger, guest-friend; masc. gen. pl.: ’of the strangers’
glossary.ξεινήια: ξεινήιον — guest-gift, hospitality; neut. acc. pl.
glossary.ξύνετο: συνίημι — understand, perceive, take in; aor. mid. 3 sg., unaugmented, + gen. of the person heard: ’understood, took in’

glossary.οὔλας: οὖλος — thick, woolly, curly; fem. acc. pl.
glossary.πάρθεσαν: παρατίθημι — set before, serve; aor. 3 pl., unaugmented, apocope παρά > παρ- (πάρθεσαν): ’had set before’
glossary.πέλεν: πέλω — be, become; impf. 3 sg., unaugmented: ’was’
glossary.πέμπε: πέμπω — send, send off; impf. 3 sg., unaugmented: ’was sending’
glossary.πέμπεν: πέμπω — send, send off; impf. 3 sg., unaugmented (ν-movable): ’was sending’
glossary.πέμπωμεν: πέμπω — send, send off; pres. subj. 1 pl., deliberative: ’should we send’
glossary.πίονα: πίων — fat, rich; neut. acc. pl., agreeing with νῶτα: ’fat’ · also masc. acc. sg., agreeing with οἶκον: ’rich’
glossary.παθὼν: πάσχω — suffer, experience; aor. part. masc. nom. sg.: ’having suffered’
glossary.παμφανόωντα: παμφαίνω — shine all over, gleam brightly; pres. part. neut. acc. pl., diectasis (παμφανόωντα): ’all-shining’
glossary.παρέχουσιν: παρέχω — provide, supply, furnish; pres. 3 pl.

glossary.παύομαι: παύω — stop, cease; mid. pres. 1 sg.: ’I cease’
glossary.παύσῃ: παύω — stop, make cease; aor. subj. 3 sg. act., + gen.: ’may make (someone) cease from’
glossary.παῖδ: παῖς — child, daughter; fem. acc. sg., elided (παῖδ’ = παῖδα) · also masc. acc. sg. (παῖς is common gender; here of a son, Telemachus): ’son’
glossary.περικλυτόν: περικλυτός — famed all round, far-renowned; neut. acc. sg.
glossary.ποιμὴν: ποιμήν — shepherd, herdsman; masc. nom. sg.
glossary.πολλοῖσιν: πολύς — much, many; masc./neut. dat. pl., epic -οισι(ν) (= Attic πολλοῖς): ’for many’
glossary.προθύροισι: πρόθυρον — forecourt, porch; neut. dat. pl.

glossary.προτὶ: πρός (epic by-form προτί) — towards, to; prep. + acc.
glossary.σίτου: σῖτος — bread, grain, food; masc. gen. sg.

glossary.σκηπτούχων: σκηπτοῦχος — holding the scepter, scepter-bearing; masc. gen. pl.
glossary.σπέσθαι: ἕπομαι — follow, accompany; aor. inf.: ’to follow’
glossary.στεροπὴν: στεροπή — flash, gleam, lightning; fem. acc. sg.

glossary.σόοι: σόος — safe, unharmed (epic = Attic σῶς); masc. nom. pl.

glossary.τέκοιεν: τίκτω — beget, bring forth; aor. opt. 3 pl.: ’could beget’
glossary.τέρπομαι: τέρπω — delight, gladden; mid. pres. 1 sg.: ’I delight (my heart)’
glossary.τίκτει: τίκτω — bring forth, bear, give birth to; pres. 3 sg.
glossary.τελέθουσι: τελέθω — come to be, become, be; pres. 3 pl.
glossary.τελεσφόρον: τελεσφόρος — bringing to completion, full (of a year’s cycle); masc. acc. sg.

glossary.τηλύγετος: τηλύγετος — late-born (or, on another view, tenderly loved, darling — meaning disputed, no etymology certain); masc. nom. sg.
glossary.τινε: τις, τι — someone, something; indefinite pron., nom. dual: ’some two’

glossary.τοκήων: τοκεύς — parent, begetter; masc. gen. pl.

glossary.τριτάτην: τρίτατος — third; epic ordinal (= Attic τρίτος); fem. acc. sg.

glossary.τώδε: ὅδε — this, this here; demonstrative pron., masc. nom. dual: ’these two’

glossary.φαγόντε: ἐσθίω — eat; aor. part. masc. nom. dual: ’having eaten’

glossary.φράζεο: φράζομαι — take note, observe, consider; pres. mid. imper. 2 sg.: ’mark, take note’
glossary.χαίρετον: χαίρω — rejoice, be glad; pres. imper. 2 dual: ’rejoice, welcome’
glossary.χαλκοῦ: χαλκός — bronze, copper; masc. gen. sg.
glossary.χλαίνας: χλαῖνα — a thick cloak, mantle; fem. acc. pl.
glossary.χρυσέης: χρύσεος — golden; fem. gen. sg., epic uncontracted (= Attic χρυσῆς)
glossary.ἀγγελέων: ἀγγέλλω — announce, bring word; fut. part. masc. nom. sg., purpose: ’to bring word, to announce’
glossary.ἀγλαὸς: ἀγλαός — splendid, radiant; masc. nom. sg.
glossary.ἀγορεύοντος: ἀγορεύω — speak, speak publicly; pres. part. masc. gen. sg. (genitive absolute): ’while he was speaking’
glossary.ἀγχοῦ: ἀγχοῦ — near, close by; adv. (by-form of ἄγχι)
glossary.ἀδελφεὸν: ἀδελφεός — brother (epic form = Attic ἀδελφός); masc. acc. sg.
glossary.ἀλέκτορος: Ἀλέκτωρ — Alector, a Spartan (father of Megapenthes’ bride); masc. gen. sg.
glossary.ἀπεχθαίρει: ἀπεχθαίρω — make hateful, cause to be hated; pres. 3 sg.
glossary.ἀποίχεται: ἀποίχομαι — be gone, be away, have departed; pres. 3 sg.
glossary.ἀσαμίνθους: ἀσάμινθος — bathtub (origin unknown); fem. acc. pl.
glossary.ἀχνύμενός: ἄχνυμαι — grieve, be distressed; pres. part. masc. nom. sg.: ’grieved (though I am)’
glossary.ἄλλοτε: ἄλλοτε — at another time, at one time … at another; adv.
glossary.ἄνασσεν: ἀνάσσω — be lord of, rule over (+ dat.); impf. 3 sg., unaugmented: ’was lord over’
glossary.ἄνδρε: ἀνήρ — man; masc. nom. dual: ’two men’
glossary.ἄρνες: ἀρήν — lamb, sheep; masc./fem. nom. pl. (ἄρνες)
glossary.ἄσπετα: ἄσπετος — unspeakable, untold, unutterable; neut. nom. pl.
glossary.ἄχος: ἄχος — grief, pain, distress; neut. nom. sg.
glossary.ἅπτεσθον: ἅπτομαι — take hold of, grasp, partake of (+ gen.); pres. imper. 2 dual mid.
glossary.ἐδίνευον: δινεύω — whirl, spin round; impf. 3 pl., augmented: ’were whirling’
glossary.ἐδωδὴν: ἐδωδή — food, eating; fem. acc. sg.
glossary.ἐμέλπετο: μέλπω — sing and dance to music; mid. impf. 3 sg., augmented: ’was making music’

glossary.ἐμόγησεν: μογέω — toil, labor, suffer hardship; aor. 3 sg., augmented (ν-movable): ’toiled’
glossary.ἐνώπια: ἐνώπια — the inner wall-faces of the porch (fixed architectural term); neut. acc. pl.
glossary.ἐξάρχοντος: ἐξάρχω — lead off, begin (a song); pres. part. masc. gen. sg. (genitive absolute): ’while he led off (the song)’
glossary.ἐξετέλειον: ἐκτελέω — bring fully to completion, fulfil; impf. 3 pl., augmented (ἐκ- becomes ἐξ- before the augment): ’were bringing to fulfillment’
glossary.ἐξοπίσω: ἐξοπίσω — hereafter, in time to come; adv.

glossary.ἐπηετανὸν: ἐπηετανός — continuous, unfailing, year-long; neut. acc. sg.
glossary.ἐπιδευὴς: ἐπιδευής — in want, lacking (+ gen.); masc. nom. sg.

glossary.ἐρατεινήν: ἐρατεινός — lovely, charming; fem. acc. sg.
glossary.ἐρεμβοὺς: Ἐρεμβοί — the Erembians, a people of disputed/unknown identity (perhaps Arabs; the name itself may be corrupt); masc. acc. pl.
glossary.ἐσθλά: ἐσθλός — good, noble, excellent; neut. acc. pl.
glossary.ἐστον: εἰμί — be; pres. 2 dual: ’you two are’

glossary.ἐυξέστας: ἐΰξεστος — well-planed, well-polished; fem. acc. pl.
glossary.ἑλένῃ: Ἑλένη — Helen, wife of Menelaus; fem. dat. sg.
glossary.ἑνός: εἷς, μία, ἕν — one; masc. gen. sg.: ’of one (man)’

glossary.ἑρμιόνην: Ἑρμιόνη — Hermione, daughter of Menelaus and Helen; fem. acc. sg.

glossary.ἔβαλον: βάλλω — throw, cast, put down; aor. 3 pl., augmented: ’they threw down’
glossary.ἔικτον: ἔοικα — seem, resemble, be like; perf. 3 dual: ’they seemed alike’
glossary.ἔκλιναν: κλίνω — lean, prop; aor. 3 pl., augmented: ’they leaned’
glossary.ἔλειπε: λείπω — leave, leave behind; impf. 3 sg., augmented: ’he left’
glossary.ἔλων: ἐλαύνω — drive (a chariot, etc.); aor. 3 pl., root aorist, unaugmented: ’they drove’
glossary.ἔμιξαν: μίγνυμι — mix, mingle; aor. 3 pl., augmented: ’they mixed in’
glossary.ἔνδοθεν: ἔνδοθεν — from within, within; adv., -θεν suffix of place
glossary.ἔπεφνεν: θείνω — strike, slay; aor. 3 sg., root aorist ἔπεφνον, reduplicated stem πεφν- (a defective verb with no live present): ’slew’
glossary.ἔς: εἰς (epic ἐς) — into, to; prep. + acc.
glossary.ἔται: ἔτης — kinsman, clansman (not to be confused with ἔτος ’year’); masc. nom. pl.
glossary.ἔτῃσιν: ἔτης — kinsman, clansman; masc. dat. pl., epic -ῃσι(ν)
glossary.ἔφαινον: φαίνω — show, bring to light; impf. 3 pl., augmented: ’were granting (the birth of)’
glossary.ἠγαγόμην: ἄγω — lead, bring; aor. mid. 1 sg., augmented (root’s α lengthens to η): ’I brought home’
glossary.ἠελίου: ἥλιος (epic ἠέλιος) — sun; masc. gen. sg.
glossary.ἠλώμην: ἀλάομαι — wander, roam; impf. 1 sg., augmented (root’s α lengthens to η): ’I was wandering’
glossary.ἠχήεντα: ἠχήεις — echoing, resounding; neut. acc. pl.
glossary.ἡμετέροισιν: ἡμέτερος — our; masc./neut. dat. pl., epic -οισι(ν)
glossary.ἤγετο: ἄγω — lead, bring; mid. impf. 3 sg., augmented (root’s α lengthens to η): ’was leading home (as a bride)’

glossary.ἰδόντες: ὁράω — see; aor. part. masc. nom. pl., unaugmented: ’having seen’
glossary.ἱδρώοντας: ἱδρώω — sweat; pres. part. masc. acc. pl.: ’sweating’

glossary.ἱκόμεθ: ἱκνέομαι — come, arrive; aor. mid. 1 pl., unaugmented, elided (ἱκόμεθ’ = ἱκόμεθα): ’we have come’
glossary.ἱκόμην: ἱκνέομαι — come, arrive; aor. mid. 1 sg., unaugmented: ’I came’
glossary.ἱππείῃσι: ἵππειος — of horses, equine; fem. dat. pl., epic -ῃσι (= Attic -αις)
glossary.ἱστάμενος: ἵστημι — set, stand; pres. mid. part. masc. nom. sg.: ’standing’
glossary.ἴδετο: ὁράω — see; aor. 3 sg., middle in form, passive/intransitive in sense, unaugmented: ’caught sight of’
glossary.ἴδμεν: οἶδα — know; pres. 1 pl., epic ἴδμεν (= Attic ἴσμεν): ’we know’
glossary.ἵπποισι: ἵππος — horse; masc. dat. pl., epic -οισι (= Attic -οις)
glossary.ἵππω: ἵππος — horse; masc. nom./acc. dual: ’two horses’
glossary.ὀδύρομαι: ὀδύρομαι — lament, mourn, grieve; pres. 1 sg.
glossary.ὀδύρονταί: ὀδύρομαι — lament, mourn, grieve; pres. 3 pl.
glossary.ὀτρηροὺς: ὀτρηρός — brisk, active, ready; masc. acc. pl.
glossary.ὀτρηρὸς: ὀτρηρός — brisk, active, ready; masc. nom. sg.

glossary.ῥά: ἄρα — then, so, as it seems; inferential particle, weak enclitic form ῥα, accented ῥά
glossary.ῥηξήνορος: ῥηξήνωρ — breaking the ranks of men (standing epithet of Achilles); masc. gen. sg. · also the proper name Ῥηξήνωρ, Rhexenor, father of Arete; masc. gen. sg.
glossary.αἰγυπτίῃς: Αἰγύπτιος — Egyptian; adj., fem. dat. pl., agreeing with Θήβῃς (Θήβῃς Αἰγυπτίῃς ’Egyptian Thebes’)
glossary.αὐδῇ: αὐδή — voice, speech; fem. dat. sg.
glossary.βαλέειν: βάλλω — throw, cast, let fall; aor. inf., epic βαλέειν (= Attic βαλεῖν)
glossary.βεβυσμένον: βύω — stuff, cram full; perf. pass. part. masc. acc. sg. (agreeing with τόν, the basket): ’filled, crammed’
glossary.βολαὶ: βολή — a throw, cast; of the eyes, a glance; fem. nom. pl.: ’glances’
glossary.γέρας: γέρας — privilege, honor, due portion; neut. nom./acc. sg.
glossary.γαμέοντί: γαμέω — marry; pres. part. masc. dat. sg.: ’at his marrying’
glossary.γεινομένῳ: γείνομαι — be born, come into being (mid. of γείνω ’beget’); pres. part. masc. dat. sg.: ’at his birth’
glossary.γηρασκέμεν: γηράσκω — grow old; pres. inf., epic -έμεν (= Attic γηράσκειν)
glossary.γύναι: γυνή — woman, wife; fem. voc. sg.: ’wife’
glossary.δάκρυον: δάκρυον — tear; neut. acc. sg., by-form of δάκρυ
glossary.διέκρινεν: διακρίνω — separate, part; aor. 3 sg., augment hidden behind the preverb (δι’ ἔκρινεν): ’parted, separated’
glossary.διαειπέμεν: διεῖπον (δια- + εἶπον) — tell fully, discuss thoroughly; aor. inf., epic -έμεν (= Attic διειπεῖν)
glossary.διοτρεφές: διοτρεφής — Zeus-nurtured (epithet of kings); adj., masc. voc. sg.
glossary.δοιοὺς: δοιοί — two (poetic alternative to δύο); numeral adj., masc. acc. pl.
glossary.δόμοις: δόμος — house; masc. dat. pl.: ’in houses’ (ἐν postponed, with anastrophe)
glossary.δόρπου: δόρπον — supper, evening meal; neut. gen. sg.
glossary.εἰσορόωσαν: εἰσοράω — look upon, gaze at; pres. part. fem. acc. sg., epic uncontracted -όωσαν (= Attic -ῶσαν)
glossary.εἴσ: εἰμί — be; pres. 3 pl., elided (εἴσ’ = εἰσί): ’there are’
glossary.εἵνεκ: εἵνεκα (elided εἵνεκ’) — for the sake of, because of; prep. + gen., epic (= Attic ἕνεκα)
glossary.εἶβε: εἴβω — let flow, shed (of tears); impf. 3 sg., unaugmented: ’let flow, shed’
glossary.εἶρος: εἶρος — wool; neut. acc. sg., epic form (= ἔριον)
glossary.εὐχετόωνται: εὔχομαι — declare, claim, boast; pres. 3 pl., diectasis εὐχετόωνται (= Attic εὔχονται)
glossary.εὔτυκτον: εὔτυκτος — well-made, well-wrought; adj., fem. acc. sg.
glossary.θάνῃσι: θνῄσκω — die; aor. subj. 3 sg., epic -ῃσι (= Attic θάνῃ)
glossary.θήβῃς: Θῆβαι — Thebes, Egyptian or Boeotian by context; fem. dat. pl., epic short -ῃς (= Attic -αις)
glossary.θοῇσι: θοός — swift; adj., fem. dat. pl., epic -ῃσι (= Attic -αις)
glossary.θρασὺν: θρασύς — bold, daring; adj., masc. acc. sg.
glossary.θυώδεος: θυώδης — fragrant, sweet-smelling; adj., masc. gen. sg., epic uncontracted -εος (= Attic -ους)
glossary.κάκιστος: κακός — bad; superlative κάκιστος, masc. nom. sg.: ’worst’
glossary.κάλλιμα: κάλλιμος — beautiful, fine (poetic by-form of καλός); adj., neut. acc. pl.
glossary.κείρασθαί: κείρω — cut, shear; aor. mid. inf.: ’to cut (one’s own hair)’
glossary.κεκράαντο: κραίνω — accomplish, complete, finish; plpf. pass. 3 pl., epic diectasis (uncontracted stem vowel) = Attic ἐκέκραντο: ’were finished’
glossary.κλαίειν: κλαίω — weep, mourn; pres. inf.: ’to weep’
glossary.κλαυθμὸν: κλαυθμός — weeping, wailing; masc. acc. sg.
glossary.κλαῖε: κλαίω — weep, mourn; impf. 3 sg., unaugmented (= ἔκλαιε): ’wept’
glossary.κλισίην: κλισίη — seat, chair (general sense); fem. acc. sg.
glossary.κλισμῷ: κλισμός — chair with a back, armchair; masc. dat. sg.
glossary.κτήμασι: κτῆμα — possession, property; neut. dat. pl.
glossary.κυνώπιδος: κυνῶπις — dog-faced, dog-eyed, shameless (Helen’s self-reproach); adj., fem. gen. sg. · also of a bride, Aphrodite: κυνώπιδος … κούρης ’the shameless girl’
glossary.λαοῖσι: λαός — people, host; masc. dat. pl., epic -οισι (= Attic -οῖς)
glossary.λιπαρῶς: λιπαρῶς — sleekly, comfortably, in ease; adv.
glossary.μέλλεις: μέλλω — be about to, be likely to, be bound to; pres. 2 sg.
glossary.μίαν: εἷς, μία, ἕν — one; numeral, fem. acc. sg.
glossary.μαλακοῦ: μαλακός — soft; adj., neut./masc. gen. sg.
glossary.μαχητήν: μαχητής — fighter, warrior; masc. acc. sg.
glossary.μεμνημένος: μιμνήσκομαι — remember, be mindful of (+ gen.); perf. part. masc. nom. sg.: ’mindful, remembering’
glossary.μεταδόρπιος: μεταδόρπιος — after supper; adj., masc. nom. sg., used predicatively
glossary.μνησθῆναι: μιμνήσκομαι — call to mind, make mention of (+ gen.); aor. pass. inf., mid. sense: ’to make mention’
glossary.μνησώμεθα: μιμνήσκομαι — turn one’s thoughts to, call to mind (+ gen.); aor. subj. 1 pl., hortatory: ’let us turn our minds to’
glossary.μυθεόμην: μυθέομαι — tell, relate, speak of; impf. 1 sg., epic uncontracted (= Attic ἐμυθούμην): ’was telling’
glossary.μῦθοι: μῦθος — word, speech, talk; masc. nom. pl.
glossary.νάσσα: ναίω — dwell; also causative, settle, give a home to; aor. 1 sg.: ’I would have settled’
glossary.νήματος: νῆμα — thread, yarn; neut. gen. sg.
glossary.νεμεσσᾶται: νεμεσάω — feel indignation, resent, be ashamed; pres. 3 sg. mid., epic geminated σ (νεμεσσᾶται, = Attic νεμεσᾶται)
glossary.νεμεσσῶμαί: νεμεσάω — feel indignation, resent, think it shame; pres. 1 sg. mid., epic geminated σ, accented before enclitic γε: ’I feel resentment’
glossary.νοέω: νοέω — perceive, form a judgment, think; pres. 1 sg.
glossary.νόησε: νοέω — perceive, notice; aor. 3 sg., unaugmented (= ἐνόησε): ’noticed’
glossary.νῶιν: ἐγώ (dual νῶι) — we two; dat. dual νῶιν: ’to us two’
glossary.οὐδὲν: οὐδείς, οὐδεμία, οὐδέν — no one, nothing; neut. acc./nom. sg. used adverbially: ’not at all’ · also neut. nom. sg. as subject: ’nothing’ (οὐδὲν γλύκιον … γίγνεται ’nothing is sweeter’)
glossary.πίθοιό: πείθω — persuade; mid. obey, heed (+ dat.); aor. opt. 2 sg., accented before enclitic μοι: ’may you heed’
glossary.πειρήσαιτο: πειράω — try, test, make trial of; aor. opt. 3 sg. mid.: ’might test’
glossary.περιναιετάουσιν: περιναιετάω — lie round about, be situated nearby; pres. 3 pl., epic uncontracted (= Attic περιναιετῶσιν)
glossary.πικρὸν: πικρός — bitter; adj., neut. acc. sg.
glossary.πινυτούς: πινυτός — sensible, wise, of sound mind; adj., masc. acc. pl.
glossary.πλεῖστα: πολύς — much, many; superlative πλεῖστος, neut. nom./acc. pl.: ’most, the greatest amount’
glossary.πομπὸν: πομπός — escort, guide, companion on a journey; masc. acc. sg.
glossary.πορφυρέην: πορφύρεος — purple, dark-gleaming; adj., fem. acc. sg.
glossary.προγενέστερος: προγενής — born before, elder; adj., comparative προγενέστερος, masc. nom. sg.: ’older’
glossary.πτερόεντ: πτερόεις — winged, feathered; adj., neut. acc. pl., elided (πτερόεντ’ = πτερόεντα)
glossary.πόρε: πόρω (defective, aor. only) — furnish, grant, give; aor. 3 sg., unaugmented: ’gave’ · also aor. imper. 2 sg. (same form): τοῦτο πόρε ’give this!’
glossary.σαόφρων: σαόφρων — self-possessed, temperate, of sound mind; adj., masc./fem. nom. sg., epic by-form (= Attic σώφρων)
glossary.σεῖο: σύ — you (sg.); gen. sg., epic σεῖο (= Attic σοῦ)
glossary.τάλαντα: τάλαντον — talent (unit of weight of gold/silver); neut. acc. pl.
glossary.τάλαρόν: τάλαρος — basket; masc. acc. sg., accented before enclitic θ’
glossary.τάπητα: τάπης — rug, carpet, coverlet; masc. acc. sg.
glossary.τέκεϊ: τέκος — child, offspring; neut. dat. sg., epic uncontracted -εϊ (= Attic -ει)
glossary.τέρπομ: τέρπομαι — take delight, find pleasure; pres. 1 sg. mid., elided (τέρπομ’ = τέρπομαι)
glossary.ταχὺν: ταχύς — swift, quick; adj., masc. acc. sg.
glossary.ταῦθ: οὗτος, αὕτη, τοῦτο — this; neut. acc. pl., elided and aspirated (ταῦθ’ = ταῦτα)
glossary.τερπομένω: τέρπομαι — take delight in one another; pres. part. masc. nom./acc. dual: ’delighting’
glossary.τερπόμεθ: τέρπομαι — take delight, delight in (+ dat.); pres. 1 pl. mid., elided (τερπόμεθ’ = τερπόμεθα)
glossary.τετάνυστο: τανύω — stretch, lay out; plpf. pass. 3 sg. with impf. force: ’lay stretched, lay spread’
glossary.τοίου: τοῖος — such, of such a kind; demonstrative/correlative adj., masc. gen. sg.
glossary.τοιαίδε: τοιόσδε — such, of this kind; demonstrative adj., fem. nom. pl.
glossary.τοιοίδε: τοιόσδε — such, of this kind; demonstrative adj., masc. nom. pl.
glossary.τόσα: τόσος — so much, so many; correlative demonstrative adj., neut. acc. pl.: ’so much’
glossary.υἱέας: υἱός — son; masc. acc. pl., epic υἱέας (= Attic υἱούς/υἱεῖς)
glossary.υἷι: υἱός — son; masc. dat. sg., epic υἷι (= Attic υἱεῖ)
glossary.φάσχ: φάσκω — say, assert, allege; impf. 3 sg., iterative, elided (φάσχ’ = φάσκε): ’used to say’
glossary.φέρεν: φέρω — bring, carry; impf. 3 sg., unaugmented (= ἔφερε): ’was bringing’
glossary.φαεινῆς: φαεινός — shining, bright; adj., fem. gen. sg.
glossary.φημι: φημί — say, declare, assert; pres. 1 sg.
glossary.φιλέοντέ: φιλέω — love, cherish; pres. part. masc. nom./acc. dual, accented before enclitic τε: ’loving’
glossary.φιλησέμεν: φιλέω — love, cherish; fut. inf., epic -έμεν (= Attic φιλήσειν)
glossary.φυλὼ: Φυλώ — Phylo, a handmaid of Helen; fem. nom. sg.
glossary.χαμάδις: χαμάδις — to the ground, groundward; adv.
glossary.χαῖται: χαίτη — hair of the head, mane; fem. nom. pl.
glossary.χείλεα: χεῖλος — lip, rim, brim; neut. nom. pl., epic uncontracted
glossary.χευάντων: χέω — pour; aor. imper. 3 pl. act., epic: ’let them pour’
glossary.χλαῖναν: χλαῖνα — cloak, mantle; fem. acc. sg.
glossary.χρυσέην: χρύσεος — golden; adj., fem. acc. sg., epic uncontracted (= Attic χρυσῆν)
glossary.χρυσηλακάτῳ: χρυσηλάκατος — of the golden distaff (epithet of Artemis); adj., fem. dat. sg.
glossary.χρυσοῖο: χρυσός — gold; masc. gen. sg., epic -οιο (= Attic -οῦ)
glossary.χρυσῷ: χρυσός — gold; masc. dat. sg.: ’with gold’
glossary.ψεύσομαι: ψεύδομαι — lie, speak falsely; fut. 1 sg., deliberative: ’shall I speak falsely?’
glossary.ἀγάσσεσθαι: ἄγαμαι — feel envy, grudge, resent; fut. inf. mid., epic ἀγάσσεσθαι (= Attic ἀγάσεσθαι)
glossary.ἀγαγὼν: ἄγω — lead, bring; aor. part. masc. nom. sg.: ’having brought, bringing’
glossary.ἀδακρύτω: ἀδάκρυτος — tearless, free of tears; adj., neut. acc. dual (agreeing with ὄσσε): ’tearless’
glossary.ἀδελφεός: ἀδελφεός — brother; masc. nom. sg., epic/Ionic form (= Attic ἀδελφός)
glossary.ἀδρήστη: Ἀδρήστη — Adreste, a handmaid of Helen; fem. nom. sg.
glossary.ἀκούσας: ἀκούω — hear (+ gen. of person/thing heard); aor. part. masc. nom. sg.: ’having heard, on hearing’
glossary.ἀλάλκοιεν: ἀλέξω — ward off, keep off; redupl. aor. opt. 3 pl., epic ἀλάλκοιεν: ’might ward off’
glossary.ἀλκάνδρη: Ἀλκάνδρη — Alcandre, wife of Polybus; fem. nom. sg.
glossary.ἀλκίππη: Ἀλκίππη — Alcippe, a handmaid of Helen; fem. nom. sg.
glossary.ἀλλήλους: ἀλλήλων — one another; reciprocal pron., masc. acc. pl.
glossary.ἀμφεκάλυψεν: ἀμφικαλύπτω — cover round about, envelop; aor. 3 sg., augmented: ’covered over’
glossary.ἀμφοτέρῃσιν: ἀμφότερος — both; adj., fem. dat. pl., epic -ῃσι(ν) (= Attic -αις): ’with both (hands)’
glossary.ἀνάσσονται: ἀνάσσω — rule, be lord over; pres. 3 pl. pass.: ’are ruled’ (+ dat. of agent)
glossary.ἀνασχών: ἀνέχω — hold up, raise; aor. part. masc. nom. sg.: ’having raised’
glossary.ἀνασχὼν: ἀνέχω — hold up, raise; aor. part. masc. nom. sg., grave accent (mid-clause): ’having raised’
glossary.ἀναφαίνειν: ἀναφαίνω — show forth, reveal, bring to light; pres. inf.: ’to show forth, blurt out’
glossary.ἀντίλοχον: Ἀντίλοχος — Antilochus, son of Nestor; masc. acc. sg.
glossary.ἀντιλόχοιο: Ἀντίλοχος — Antilochus, son of Nestor; masc. gen. sg., epic -οιο (= Attic -ου)
glossary.ἀνόστιμον: ἀνόστιμος — without a return, denied a homecoming; adj., masc. acc. sg.
glossary.ἀοσσητῆρες: ἀοσσητήρ — helper, defender; masc. nom. pl.
glossary.ἀρίγνωτος: ἀρίγνωτος — easily recognized, well-known; adj., masc. nom. sg.
glossary.ἀρίστους: ἀγαθός — good; superlative ἄριστος, masc. acc. pl.: ’best’
glossary.ἀργείη: Ἀργεῖος — Argive; adj., fem. nom. sg.
glossary.ἀργυρέας: ἀργύρεος — silver, made of silver; adj., fem. acc. pl., epic uncontracted (= Attic ἀργυρᾶς)
glossary.ἀργύρεον: ἀργύρεος — silver, made of silver; adj., masc. acc. sg., epic uncontracted (= Attic ἀργυροῦν) · also neut. nom./acc. sg., agreeing with a neuter noun (ἀργύρεον ὑπερθύριον ’a silver lintel’)
glossary.ἀσκητοῖο: ἀσκητός — wrought, well-worked, skilfully made; adj., masc./neut. gen. sg., epic -οιο (= Attic -οῦ)
glossary.ἀσφαλίων: Ἀσφαλίων — Asphalion, an attendant of Menelaus; masc. nom. sg.
glossary.ἀτρεΐδη: Ἀτρεΐδης — son of Atreus; masc. voc. sg.
glossary.ἄνδρ: ἀνήρ — man; masc. acc. sg., elided (ἄνδρ’ = ἄνδρα)
glossary.ἄντ: ἄντα (elided ἄντ’) — opposite, before, in front of; adv./prep. + gen./dat.: ’before’
glossary.ἐάσειε: ἐάω — let, allow, permit; aor. opt. 3 sg.: ’might let, allow’
glossary.ἐάσομεν: ἐάω — let, allow; leave off, give up; fut. 1 pl., used hortatively: ’let us leave off’
glossary.ἐέλδετο: ἐέλδομαι — desire, long for; impf. 3 sg., unaugmented, reduplicated epic stem: ’was longing’
glossary.ἐίσκεις: ἐΐσκω — liken, guess, conjecture; pres. 2 sg.
glossary.ἐκγεγαυῖα: ἐκγίγνομαι — be sprung from, be born of; perf. part. fem. nom. sg.: ’sprung (from)’
glossary.ἐλθόντα: ἔρχομαι — go, come; aor. part. masc. acc. sg.: ’having come, on his coming’
glossary.ἐξαλαπάξας: ἐξαλαπάζω — sack utterly, empty out; aor. part. masc. nom. sg.: ’having sacked, having emptied out’
glossary.ἐξαῦτις: ἐξαῦτις — again, once more, anew; adv., epic (= Attic αὖθις)
glossary.ἐξερέοιτο: ἐξερέομαι — ask closely, question; aor. opt. 3 sg.: ’might question’
glossary.ἐπίσπῃ: ἐφέπω — come upon, meet with, pursue; aor. subj. 3 sg., epic ἐπίσπῃ: ’meets with’
glossary.ἐπεσβολίας: ἐπεσβολία — a rash, thrown-out word (ἔπος + βάλλω); fem. acc. pl.: ’reckless words’
glossary.ἐπικλώσῃ: ἐπικλώθω — spin, allot by spinning (of fate); aor. subj. 3 sg.: ’spins, allots’
glossary.ἐπιμνησαίμεθα: ἐπιμιμνήσκομαι — call to mind, mention (+ gen.); aor. opt. 1 pl.: ’we called to mind’
glossary.ἐρέεινεν: ἐρεείνω — ask, question; impf. 3 sg.: ’was questioning, began questioning’
glossary.ἐρέοιμεν: εἴρομαι (ἐρέομαι) — ask, inquire; pres. opt. 1 pl., epic ἐρέοιμεν: ’we questioned, we might ask’
glossary.ἐρίοιο: ἔριον — wool; neut. gen. sg., epic -οιο (= Attic -ου)
glossary.ἐφύπερθέ: ἐφύπερθε — from above, on top, above; adv./prep. + gen.
glossary.ἑλένη: Ἑλένη — Helen, wife of Menelaus; fem. nom. sg.
glossary.ἔγχεσιν: ἔγχος — spear; neut. dat. pl.: ’with spears’ (dat. of respect)
glossary.ἔναι: ναίω — dwell; impf. 3 sg., elided (ἔναι’ = ἔναιε): ’dwelt’
glossary.ἔξοχον: ἔξοχος — pre-eminent, beyond others; adj., neut./masc. acc. sg. used adverbially: ’beyond, above’
glossary.ἔτευξα: τεύχω — make, build, construct; aor. 1 sg.: ’built’
glossary.ἔτυμον: ἐτυμός — true, real; adj., neut. acc. sg. used adverbially: ’truly’
glossary.ἔφην: φημί — say, declare; impf. 1 sg., augmented, ἐ- before the consonant-initial stem φη-: ’I said’
glossary.ἔχουσα: ἔχω — have, hold; pres. part. fem. nom. sg.: ’holding’
glossary.ἔωσιν: εἰμί — be; pres. subj. 3 pl., epic ἔωσιν (= Attic ὦσιν)
glossary.ἕκαστά: ἕκαστος — each, every; neut. acc. pl. used substantivally, accented before enclitic τε: ’each thing, everything’
glossary.ἠοῦς: Ἠώς — Dawn; fem. gen. sg. Ἠοῦς
glossary.ἠὼς: Ἠώς — Dawn; fem. nom. sg. · also a common noun, ’morning’ (ὄφρα μὲν ἠὼς ἦν ’as long as it was morning’)
glossary.ἠῶθέν: ἠῶθεν — from dawn, at dawn, in the morning; adv.
glossary.ἤλθεθ: ἔρχομαι — go, come; aor. 2 pl., epic ἤλθετε, elided and aspirated (ἤλθεθ’): ’you came’
glossary.ἤντησ: ἀντάω (ἀντιάω) — meet, encounter (+ gen.); aor. 1 sg., elided (ἤντησ’ = ἤντησα): ’I met’
glossary.ἰοδνεφὲς: ἰοδνεφής — violet-dark, dusky violet (ἴον + δνόφος); adj., neut. acc. sg.; exact shade uncertain
glossary.ἴδμεναι: οἶδα — know; perf. inf., epic ἴδμεναι (= Attic εἰδέναι)
glossary.ἵκεθ: ἱκνέομαι — come, arrive; aor. 3 sg. mid., elided (ἵκεθ’ = ἵκετο); augment orthographically indeterminate, ι-initial stem: ’has come’
glossary.ἵμερον: ἵμερος — longing, desire, yearning; masc. acc. sg.
glossary.ὀιζυροῖσι: ὀϊζυρός — wretched, miserable; adj., masc. dat. pl., epic -οισι (= Attic -οῖς)
glossary.ὀιζύσας: ὀϊζύω — suffer misery, toil in wretchedness; aor. part. masc. nom. sg.: ’having suffered misery’
glossary.ὀλύμπιος: Ὀλύμπιος — Olympian, of Olympus; adj., masc. nom. sg. (epithet of Zeus)
glossary.ὀφθαλμοῖιν: ὀφθαλμός — eye; masc. dat. dual, epic -οῖιν: ’before his two eyes’
glossary.ὀφρύσι: ὀφρύς — eyebrow, brow; fem. dat. pl., epic -υσι (= Attic -ύσι)
glossary.ὄπασσεν: ὀπάζω — grant, bestow, give; aor. 3 sg.: ’gave’
glossary.ὄρχαμε: ὄρχαμος — chief, leader (etymology uncertain); masc. voc. sg.: ’chief’ (ὄρχαμε λαῶν, variant of ὄρχαμος ἀνδρῶν)
glossary.ὄσσε: ὄσσε — the two eyes; neut. dual noun, no sg., epic (= Attic ὄμματα)
glossary.ὅσ: ὅσος — as much/many as; relative correlative pron., neut. acc. pl., elided (ὅσ’ = ὅσα)
glossary.ὑποθήσεαι: ὑποτίθημι — suggest, counsel, put before (mid. advise); fut. 2 sg. mid., epic -εαι (= Attic ὑποθήσῃ): ’you might counsel’
glossary.ὑπόκυκλον: ὑπόκυκλος — running on wheels, set on a wheeled stand; adj., masc. acc. sg.
glossary.ὑψορόφοιο: ὑψόροφος — high-roofed; adj., masc. gen. sg., epic -οιο (= Attic -ου)
glossary.ὥρμαινε: ὁρμαίνω — ponder, turn over in the mind, debate; impf. 3 sg., augmented (ο→ω): ’was pondering’
glossary.ῥέξειε: ῥέζω — do, act, perform; aor. opt. 3 sg.: ’would do’
glossary.αἰγυπτίη: Αἰγύπτιος — Egyptian; fem. nom. sg. (of Polydamna, ’the Egyptian woman’, in apposition to παράκοιτις)
glossary.αὐτόθι: αὐτόθι — here, on the spot, right there; adv.
glossary.βάλοι: βάλλω — throw, cast, let fall; aor. opt. 3 sg.: ’would let fall’ (κατὰ δάκρυ βάλοι ’would shed a tear’)
glossary.βαλών: βάλλω — throw, cast; aor. part. masc. nom. sg., unaugmented: ’having thrown’
glossary.γενέθλης: γενέθλη — stock, race, offspring; fem. gen. sg.
glossary.γλυκερῷ: γλυκερός — sweet; masc./neut. dat. sg. (ὕπνῳ γλυκερῷ ’sweet sleep’)
glossary.δάος: δάος — torch(es); neut. acc. sg., rare collective form (elsewhere δαΐς, δαΐδα), from δαίω ’kindle’
glossary.δέκτῃ: δέκτης — beggar, one who receives; masc. dat. sg., from δέχομαι
glossary.δέμνι: δέμνιον — bedstead, bed; neut. acc. pl., elided (δέμνι’ = δέμνια)
glossary.δέμνια: δέμνιον — bedstead, bed; neut. acc. pl.
glossary.δαίνυσθε: δαίνυμαι — feast, dine; pres. mid. indic./imper. 2 pl.: ’you feast’
glossary.δαμάσσας: δαμάζω — subdue, tame, overpower; aor. part. masc. nom. sg., unaugmented: ’having subdued’
glossary.δευόμενον: δεύομαι — lack, be in want of (+ gen.); pres. part. masc. acc. sg.: ’lacking’
glossary.δηΐφοβος: Δηΐφοβος — Deiphobus, a son of Priam, a leading Trojan warrior; masc. nom. sg.
glossary.δηιόῳεν: δηϊόω — slay, cut down; pres. opt. 3 pl., diectasis -όῳεν (= -οῖεν)
glossary.διδοῖ: δίδωμι — give; pres. 3 sg., uncontracted (= Attic δίδωσι)
glossary.δμῳῇσι: δμῳή — female slave, handmaid; fem. dat. pl., epic -ῇσι (= Attic -αις)
glossary.δῶχ: δίδωμι — give; aor. 3 sg., unaugmented, elided (δῶχ’ = δῶκε)
glossary.εὐρυάγυιαν: εὐρυάγυιος — wide-streeted (of a city); fem. acc. sg. εὐρυάγυιαν, agreeing with πόλιν (εὐρύς + ἄγυια ’street’)
glossary.ζείδωρος: ζείδωρος — grain-giving (of ploughland); fem. nom. sg.; meaning disputed: usually ’giving ζειά (a kind of grain)’, an ancient alternative reads ’life-giving’ (from ζάω)
glossary.θάλαμόν: θάλαμος — chamber, room; masc. acc. sg., accented before enclitic τε
glossary.θέμεναι: τίθημι — put, place, set; aor. inf. act., epic -έμεναι (= Attic θεῖναι)
glossary.θεοείκελος: θεοείκελος — god-resembling, like a god; masc. nom. sg.
glossary.θοὰς: θοός — swift, quick; fem. acc. pl., agreeing with νῆας: ’swift (ships)’
glossary.θῶνος: Θῶν — Thon, an Egyptian king, husband of Polydamna; masc. gen. sg.
glossary.κέλευσέ: κελεύω — bid, order; aor. 3 sg., unaugmented (= Attic ἐκέλευσε)
glossary.κέλευσεν: κελεύω — bid, order; aor. 3 sg., unaugmented, ν-movable (= Attic ἐκέλευσε)
glossary.καθήμενοι: κάθημαι — sit, be seated; pres. part. masc. nom. pl.: ’sitting’
glossary.καθύπερθεν: καθύπερθεν — from above, on top; adv.
glossary.κακόν: κακός — bad, evil; neut. acc. sg.: ’a bad thing, evil’ · also neut. nom. sg., subject of an impersonal passive (κακόν τ’ ἀγαθόν τε τέτυκται ’whatever, good or bad, has come to pass’)
glossary.κακῶν: κακός — bad, evil; neut. gen. pl.: ’of ills, of misfortunes’
glossary.καρτερὸν: καρτερός — strong, mighty, staunch; masc. acc. sg. (καρτερὸν ὅρκον ’a mighty oath’)
glossary.καρτερὸς: καρτερός — strong, mighty; masc. nom. sg. (καρτερὸς ἀνήρ ’the strong man’, of Odysseus)
glossary.κατέδυ: δύω — sink, enter, go down into; aor. 3 sg., root aorist, augmented, in tmesis (κατά … ἔδυ = κατέδυ): ’went down into’
glossary.κατέλεξεν: καταλέγω — recount in full and in order; aor. 3 sg.: ’recounted, told in full’
glossary.καταβρόξειεν: καταβρόχω — gulp down, swallow; aor. opt. 3 sg.: ’should gulp down’
glossary.κατακρύπτων: κατακρύπτω — hide, conceal completely; pres. part. masc. nom. sg.
glossary.κατατεθναίη: θνῄσκω — die; perf. opt. 3 sg., compound κατα-: ’were dead, had died’
glossary.κελευσέμεναι: κελεύω — bid, order; aor. inf. act., epic -έμεναι (= Attic κελεῦσαι)
glossary.κερδοσύνῃ: κερδοσύνη — craftiness, cunning, native wit; fem. dat. sg. instrumental, rare word: ’by his craftiness’
glossary.κληηδόνα: κληδών — report, rumor, tidings; fem. acc. sg., Ionic κληηδών (root of κλέος, κλύω)
glossary.κλισίας: κλισίη — hut, shelter (of soldiers or herdsmen); fem. acc. pl., epic (= Attic κλισία)
glossary.κοιμήσαντο: κοιμάω — put to sleep; mid. lie down to sleep; aor. 3 pl. mid., unaugmented: ’they lay down to sleep’
glossary.κοιμηθέντες: κοιμάω — put to sleep; pass. lie down to sleep; aor. pass. part. masc. nom. pl.: ’having lain down’
glossary.κοῖλον: κοῖλος — hollow; masc. acc. sg. (κοῖλον λόχον ’the hollow ambush’, i.e. inside the wooden horse)
glossary.κρατερῇσι: κρατερός — strong, mighty; fem. dat. pl., epic -ῇσι (= Attic -αῖς): ’with strong (hands)’
glossary.λίγ: λιγύς — clear-toned, shrill; neut. acc. sg. λίγα used adverbially, elided (λίγ’ = λίγα): ’shrilly’
glossary.λόεον: λούω — wash, bathe; impf. 1 sg. act., unaugmented, epic λόω (= Attic ἔλουον)
glossary.λόχον: λόχος — ambush, body of men lying in wait; masc. acc. sg. (of the men hidden inside the wooden horse)
glossary.μάστακα: μάσταξ — mouth (poetic word, root of μασάομαι ’chew’); fem. acc. sg.
glossary.μέσσοισιν: μέσος — middle; neut. dat. pl., epic -οισιν, substantival: ’in the midst’
glossary.μεμιγμένα: μίγνυμι — mix, mingle; perf. pass. part. neut. nom./acc. pl.: ’mixed in’
glossary.μενεήναμεν: μενεαίνω — be eager, strain toward, be impatient; aor. 1 pl., unaugmented: ’we were eager’
glossary.μετέστενον: στένω — groan, lament, mourn over; impf. 1 sg., in compound μετα- (μετέστενον): ’I lamented over’
glossary.μητιόεντα: μητιόεις — cunning, subtly wrought; neut. acc. pl., agreeing with φάρμακα (from μῆτις ’cunning intelligence’)
glossary.μιγείη: μίγνυμι — mix, mingle; aor. pass. opt. 3 sg.: ’should be mixed, had been mixed’
glossary.μυθήσομαι: μυθέομαι — tell, relate, speak of; fut. 1 sg.: ’I shall tell’
glossary.μύθοις: μῦθος — word, speech, story; masc. dat. pl.: ’with stories’ (μύθοις τέρπεσθε)
glossary.νηπενθές: νηπενθής — grief-banishing, that eases grief; neut. nom./acc. sg. (νη- privative + πένθος ’grief’)
glossary.νοσφισσαμένην: νοσφίζομαι — forsake, part from, abandon; aor. part. mid. fem. acc. sg.: ’having forsaken’
glossary.νωλεμέως: νωλεμέως — without a break, relentlessly, unyieldingly; adv.
glossary.ξεστῷ: ξεστός — smoothed, planed (of worked wood); masc. dat. sg. (ἵππῳ ξεστῷ ’the horse of polished wood’)
glossary.οἰκῆι: οἰκεύς — household slave, servant; masc. dat. sg. (οἰκῆι ἐοικώς ’like a household slave’)
glossary.οἰνοχοῆσαι: οἰνοχοέω — pour wine, act as wine-pourer; aor. inf. act.: ’to pour the wine’
glossary.οἶκόνδ: οἶκόνδε — homeward, to one’s house; adv., -δε suffix of direction, elided (οἶκόνδ’ = οἶκόνδε)
glossary.πίεζεν: πιέζω — press, squeeze, throttle; impf. 3 sg., in tmesis (ἐπὶ … πίεζεν = ἐπίεζεν): ’pressed down upon’
glossary.παιήονός: Παιήων — Paieon, a healing god distinct from Apollo; masc. gen. sg.
glossary.παρῖζεν: παρίζω — sit down beside; impf. 3 sg., augment fused in the long ῑ: ’sat down beside’
glossary.παῖδά: παῖς — child, son, daughter; fem. acc. sg., accented before enclitic τε: ’daughter’
glossary.περίστειξας: περιστείχω — walk around, circle round; aor. 2 sg.: ’you walked around’
glossary.πλεῖος: πλεῖος — full (+ gen.); masc. nom. sg.: ’full of’
glossary.πληγῇσιν: πληγή — blow, stroke; fem. dat. pl., epic -ῇσιν (= Attic -αῖς)
glossary.πολέων: πολύς — much, many; masc. gen. pl., uncontracted epic πολέων (= Attic πολλῶν): ’of many’
glossary.πολλήν: πολύς — much, many; fem. acc. sg.: ’much’ (φρόνιν … πολλήν ’much knowledge’)
glossary.πολύδαμνα: Πολύδαμνα — Polydamna, wife of Thon, an Egyptian woman; fem. nom. sg.
glossary.πορφύρε: πορφύρεος — purple; neut. acc. pl., elided (πορφύρε’ = πορφύρεα), agreeing with ῥήγεα
glossary.προδόμῳ: πρόδομος — forecourt, front part of the house; masc. dat. sg.
glossary.προπάροιθεν: προπάροιθεν — before, in front, in one’s presence; adv.
glossary.πόρεν: πόρω — give, grant, furnish (defective, aor. only); aor. 3 sg., unaugmented (= Attic ἔπορεν)
glossary.σάωσε: σαόω — save, keep safe; aor. 3 sg., unaugmented, epic (= Attic ἔσωσε, from σῴζω)
glossary.σιδηρέη: σιδήρεος — of iron, iron; fem. nom. sg. (κραδίη σιδηρέη ’a heart of iron’, image of an unbreakable will)
glossary.σπεῖρα: σπεῖρον — cloth, wrapping, rag; neut. acc. pl. (σπεῖρα κακά ’foul rags’)
glossary.στορέσαι: στόρνυμι — spread, strew; aor. inf. act.: ’to spread’
glossary.στόρεσαν: στόρνυμι — spread, strew; aor. 3 pl., unaugmented: ’they spread’
glossary.τάπητας: τάπης — carpet, rug; masc. acc. pl.
glossary.τέρπεσθε: τέρπομαι — take delight in, enjoy (+ dat.); pres. mid. indic. 2 pl.: ’you take delight’
glossary.τέτραπτο: τρέπω — turn; pass. plpf. 3 sg.: ’had been turned, had turned’ (κραδίη τέτραπτο νέεσθαι ’her heart had turned to return’)
glossary.ταλασίφρονός: ταλασίφρων — enduring-minded, steadfast; masc. gen. sg., accented before enclitic εἰσι (epithet of Odysseus, from τλῆναι ’endure’)
glossary.ταναήκεϊ: ταναήκης — long-edged, long-pointed; masc. dat. sg., epic -εϊ (ταναός ’long’ + ἀκή ’edge, point’)
glossary.τανύπεπλος: τανύπεπλος — long-robed; fem. nom. sg., epithet of Helen (τανύ- ’long’ + πέπλος ’robe’)
glossary.ταρπώμεθα: τέρπομαι — take one’s fill of, enjoy (+ dat.); aor. subj. mid. 1 pl.: ’we may take our fill’
glossary.τοῖα: τοῖος — such, of such a kind; neut. acc. pl., agreeing with φάρμακα: ’such (drugs)’
glossary.τράπεθ: τρέπω — turn; aor. imper. 2 pl. act., elided (τράπεθ’ = τράπετε): ’turn (us), send (us)’
glossary.τρώεσσ: Τρῶες — the Trojans; masc. dat. pl., elided (Τρώεσσ’ = Τρώεσσι)
glossary.τρώεσσι: Τρῶες — the Trojans; masc. dat. pl.
glossary.τρώεσσιν: Τρῶες — the Trojans; masc. dat. pl., ν-movable
glossary.τρῳαὶ: Τρῳαί — the Trojan women; fem. nom. pl. (feminine of Τρῶες)
glossary.τυδεΐδης: Τυδεΐδης — son of Tydeus, i.e. Diomedes; masc. nom. sg. (patronymic)
glossary.φάρμακα: φάρμακον — drug, potion (healing or harmful); neut. nom./acc. pl.
glossary.φωνὴν: φωνή — voice; fem. acc. sg., internal accusative with ἴσκουσα: ’making (her) voice (like)’
glossary.χαῖρ: χαίρω — rejoice, be glad; impf. 3 sg., unaugmented, elided (χαῖρ’ = χαῖρε): ’rejoiced’
glossary.χρῖον: χρίω — anoint; impf. 1 sg., unaugmented (= Attic ἔχριον)
glossary.ἀβάκησαν: ἀβακέω — be struck speechless with amazement; aor. 3 pl. (ἀ- privative + the root of βάζω ’speak’)
glossary.ἀγαθόν: ἀγαθός — good; neut. acc. sg.: ’good, a good thing’ · also neut. nom. sg., subject of an impersonal passive (κακόν τ’ ἀγαθόν τε τέτυκται ’whatever, good or bad, has come to pass’)
glossary.ἀεικελίῃσι: ἀεικέλιος — unseemly, degrading, shameful; fem. dat. pl., epic -ῃσι (= Attic -αις)
glossary.ἀκούσαμεν: ἀκούω — hear; aor. 1 pl., unaugmented (= Attic ἠκούσαμεν), + gen.: ’we heard’
glossary.ἀλέεινεν: ἀλεείνω — avoid, shun, evade; impf. 3 sg., unaugmented (Attic would lengthen to η-): ’evaded’
glossary.ἀλόχοισιν: ἄλοχος — wife; fem. dat. pl., epic -οισιν, dative of comparison: ’like (to) the wives’
glossary.ἀμειβομένη: ἀμείβομαι — answer, reply, exchange (words); pres. part. fem. nom. sg.: ’answering’
glossary.ἀμφαφόωσα: ἀμφαφάω — feel, touch all over; pres. part. fem. nom. sg., uncontracted diectasis (= Attic -ῶσα): ’feeling it all over’
glossary.ἀμφοτέρω: ἀμφότερος — both; masc. nom. dual, doubling the dual pronoun for emphasis: ’both of us’
glossary.ἀνέγνων: ἀναγιγνώσκω — recognize; aor. 1 sg., augment fused (ἀνα- + ἔγνων): ’I recognized’
glossary.ἀναφῆναι: ἀναφαίνω — reveal, disclose, bring to light; aor. inf. act.: ’to reveal’
glossary.ἀνηρώτων: ἀνερωτάω — ask, question; impf. 1 sg., augment fused (ἀνα- + ἠρώτων): ’I questioned’
glossary.ἀπήγαγε: ἀπάγω — lead away, take away; aor. 3 sg., augmented: ’led away’
glossary.ἀργείους: Ἀργεῖοι — the Argives, i.e. the Greeks; masc. acc. pl.
glossary.ἀφικέσθαι: ἀφικνέομαι — arrive at, reach; aor. inf. mid.: ’to arrive’
glossary.ἀφροδίτη: Ἀφροδίτη — Aphrodite, goddess of love; fem. nom. sg.
glossary.ἁπάντων: ἅπας — all, the whole of; neut. gen. pl.: ’of all (ills)’ · also masc. gen. pl., in comparison: ’of all (mortals)’ · also gen. pl. with a noun: ’of all (men)’
glossary.ἄγετ: ἄγω — lead; pl. imper. ’come now!’, elided (ἄγετ’ = ἄγετε), addressed to a group
glossary.ἄεθλοι: ἄεθλος — trial, contest, ordeal, labor; masc. nom. pl.
glossary.ἄλγιον: ἄλγος — pain, grief; comparative adv. ἄλγιον used absolutely: ’an added grief, all the more painful’
glossary.ἄντικλος: Ἄντικλος — Antiklos, an Achaean at Troy, mentioned only here in the poem; masc. nom. sg.
glossary.ἄτην: ἄτη — ruinous blindness, delusion (sent by a god), ruin; fem. acc. sg.
glossary.ἄχολόν: ἄχολος — free from anger, anger-easing; neut. acc. sg., accented before enclitic τε (ἀ- privative + χόλος ’bile, anger’)
glossary.ἐβούλετο: βούλομαι — wish, want, be minded; impf. 3 sg.: ’he wished’
glossary.ἐβόησας: βοάω — shout, cry out; aor. 2 sg., augmented: ’you cried out’
glossary.ἐδάην: δάω — learn, get to know; aor. pass./dep. 1 sg., augmented, root δα-: ’I have learned’
glossary.ἐκώκυον: κωκύω — wail, cry aloud (esp. a woman’s ritual lament); impf. 3 pl., augmented: ’wailed’
glossary.ἐλέξατο: λέχομαι — lie down, lay oneself down to sleep; aor. mid. 3 sg.: ’lay down’ (πὰρ δ’ Ἑλένη … ἐλέξατο ’beside him lay Helen’)
glossary.ἐμβαλέειν: ἐμβάλλω — throw in, cast upon; aor. inf. act., epic -έειν (= Attic ἐμβαλεῖν): ’to throw on’
glossary.ἐνέηκε: ἐνίημι — put in, send into; aor. 3 sg., augmented, augment ἐ- uncontracted before the root’s own long η (= Attic ἐνῆκε): ’put it in’
glossary.ἐνήμεθα: ἧμαι (compound ἐν-) — sit in; impf. 1 pl.: ’we sat, we were sitting’ (ἵππῳ ἔνι … ἐνήμεθα ’where we sat inside the horse’)
glossary.ἐνίσποις: ἐνέπω/ἐνίσπω — tell, relate, declare; aor. opt. 2 sg.: ’you might tell’
glossary.ἐνθέμεναι: ἐντίθημι — put in, place in; aor. inf. act., epic -έμεναι (= Attic ἐνθεῖναι): ’to put in’
glossary.ἐνόησ: νοέω — perceive, notice, devise; aor. 3 sg., augmented, elided (ἐνόησ’ = ἐνόησε): ’devised’
glossary.ἐξελθέμεναι: ἐξέρχομαι — go out, come out; aor. inf. act., epic -έμεναι (= Attic ἐξελθεῖν): ’to go out’
glossary.ἐοικώς: ἔοικα — be like, resemble, seem; perf. part. masc. nom. sg.: ’resembling, looking like’
glossary.ἐπίληθον: ἐπίληθος — causing forgetfulness (+ gen.); neut. nom./acc. sg., agreeing with φάρμακον: ’a forgetting (of all ills)’
glossary.ἐπελήλυθα: ἐπέρχομαι — come over, traverse; perf. 1 sg.: ’I have traversed’ (+ acc. γαῖαν)
glossary.ἐπιστάμενος: ἐπίσταμαι — know, understand, be skilled in; pres. part. masc. nom. sg., + gen. of comparison: ’skilled beyond (all men)’
glossary.ἐσθίεταί: ἐσθίω — eat, devour; pres. pass. 3 sg., accented before enclitic μοι: ’is being eaten up’
glossary.ἐσθλῶν: ἐσθλός — good, noble, excellent; masc. gen. pl.
glossary.ἐφημέριός: ἐφήμερος — lasting a day, for that day; masc. nom. sg., epic ἐφημέριος, accented before enclitic γε (ἐπί + ἡμέρα)
glossary.ἐφύπερθε: ἐφύπερθε — over the top, above, on top of; adv.
glossary.ἔμελλε: μέλλω — be about to, be destined to (+ inf.); impf. 3 sg.: ’was destined, was about to’
glossary.ἔπινον: πίνω — drink; impf. 3 pl.: ’they were drinking, they drank’
glossary.ἔρεξε: ῥέζω — do, perform, accomplish; aor. 3 sg., augmented: ’did, performed’
glossary.ἔσκε: εἰμί — be; impf. 3 sg., unaugmented, iterative: ’used to be, was’
glossary.ἔσχεθεν: ἔχω — have, hold, restrain; aor. 3 sg., epic by-form ending -θε(ν): ’restrained, checked’
glossary.ἔχ: ἔχω — have, hold; impf. 3 sg., unaugmented, elided (ἔχ’ = ἔχε): ’held, kept’
glossary.ἔχουσαι: ἔχω — have, hold; pres. part. fem. nom. pl.: ’holding’
glossary.ἕσασθαι: ἕννυμι — clothe, put on; aor. inf. mid.: ’to wear, put on (for oneself)’
glossary.ἕσπετ: ἕπομαι — follow, accompany (+ dat.); aor. 3 sg., elided (ἕσπετ’ = ἕσπετο): ’followed, accompanied’
glossary.ἕσσα: ἕννυμι — clothe, put on; aor. 1 sg. act., unaugmented: ’I put (garments) on (him)’
glossary.ἤγαγε: ἄγω — lead, bring; aor. 3 sg., augmented: ’led, brought’
glossary.ἤθελεν: ἐθέλω — be willing, wish; impf. 3 sg., augmented, + inf.: ’he wished’
glossary.ἤισκε: ἴσκω — make like, liken; impf. 3 sg., augmented (η- from ε-): ’made (himself) seem, likened’
glossary.ἤλυθον: ἔρχομαι — come, go; aor. 1 sg., augmented, epic root ἐλυθ- with epenthetic -υ- (= Attic ἦλθον): ’I have come’
glossary.ἤρκεσε: ἀρκέω — be enough to ward off, avail, suffice; aor. 3 sg., augmented, + acc./dat.: ’warded off, availed against’
glossary.ἦλθες: ἔρχομαι — come, go; aor. 2 sg., augmented: ’you came’
glossary.ἰητρὸς: ἰατρός — physician, healer; masc. nom. sg., Ionic ἰητρός (= Attic ἰατρός)
glossary.ἰούσῃ: εἶμι — go; pres. part. fem. dat. sg.: ’as you were going’
glossary.ἱεμένω: ἵεμαι — be eager, strain forward, be impatient; pres. part. masc. dual: ’(though) eager, straining forward’
glossary.ἴδιον: ἴδιος — private, one’s own; neut. nom./acc. sg., substantival, opp. δήμιον: ’a private matter’
glossary.ἴκελος: ἴκελος — like, resembling (+ dat.); masc. nom. sg.: ’looking like (him)’
glossary.ἴσκουσ: ἴσκω — liken, make resemble; pres. part. fem. nom. sg., elided (ἴσκουσ’ = ἴσκουσα): ’making (her voice) like’
glossary.ἵππῳ: ἵππος — horse; masc. dat. sg. (of the wooden horse of Troy, ἵππῳ ξεστῷ)
glossary.ὀνομήνω: ὀνομαίνω — name, call by name; fut./aor. subj. 1 sg. (the epic forms coincide): ’I shall name’
glossary.ὀνομακλήδην: ὀνομακλήδην — calling by name, by name; adv. (formed on ὄνομα)
glossary.ὀνόμαζες: ὀνομάζω — call by name, name; impf. 2 sg., unaugmented (= Attic ὠνόμαζες): ’you called by name’
glossary.ὀρέξαι: ὀρέγω — stretch out, offer, grant; aor. inf. act.: ’to grant’ (+ acc. κῦδος ’glory’)
glossary.ὁρμηθέντε: ὁρμάω — set in motion, urge on; pass. start up, rush; aor. pass. part. masc. dual: ’having started up’
glossary.ὁρῷτο: ὁράω — see; pres. opt. 3 sg.: ’he should see, might see’
glossary.ὄλωλε: ὄλλυμι — destroy; perf. intr. 3 sg.: ’stands ruined, is lost’
glossary.ὑπακοῦσαι: ὑπακούω — listen and respond, answer (from within); aor. inf. act.: ’to answer’
glossary.ὕπνῳ: ὕπνος — sleep; masc. dat. sg. (ὕπνῳ γλυκερῷ ’sweet sleep’)
glossary.ὕπο: ὑπό — under, in; postpositive prep. + dat., anastrophe (ὕπνῳ ὕπο = ὑπὸ ὕπνῳ): ’in (sweet sleep)’ · also as a preverb apart from its verb (tmesis): φυγὼν ὕπο = ὑποφυγών ’having escaped’ (φυγὼν ὕπο νηλεὲς ἦμαρ ’having escaped the pitiless day’) · also + gen. of agent, postpositive: Κικόνων ὕπο ’at the hands of the Cicones’
glossary.ὤμοσα: ὄμνυμι — swear; aor. 1 sg., augmented: ’I swore’
glossary.αἰγύπτου: Αἴγυπτος — Egypt, the river/land; fem. gen. sg. (Αἰγύπτου προπάροιθε ’off the coast of Egypt’)
glossary.βάλλουσιν: βάλλω — throw, cast; here of launching ships into the sea; pres. 3 pl.
glossary.βίη: βίη — might, bodily strength, force; fem. nom. sg.
glossary.βίης: βίη — might, force; fem. gen. sg., gen. of separation with σχέσθαι ’hold back from force’
glossary.βοσκομένη: βόσκω — feed, pasture; mid. graze; pres. part. mid. fem. nom. sg. (of the hind grazing)
glossary.βούλοντο: βούλομαι — wish, will, be minded; impf. 3 pl., unaugmented (= ἐβούλοντο): ’they wished’
glossary.βροτῷ: βροτός — mortal; masc. dat. sg., agreeing with ἀνδρί: ’to/for a mortal man’
glossary.γέροντος: γέρων — old man, elder; masc. gen. sg. (ἁλίοιο γέροντος ’of the old man of the sea’, θείοιο/τοῖο γέροντος ’of the divine/that old man’, epithets of Proteus)
glossary.γίγνονται: γίγνομαι — become, come into being; pres. 3 pl.: ’they come to be’ (of creatures that exist upon earth)
glossary.γαλαθηνοὺς: γαλαθηνός — milk-fed, suckling, still at the breast; epic compound adj., masc. acc. pl.
glossary.γαστέρα: γαστήρ — belly, stomach; fem. acc. sg.
glossary.γιγνόμενος: γίγνομαι — become; pres. part. masc. nom. sg.: ’becoming, turning into’ (of Proteus’s shape-shifting)
glossary.γλαφυροῖσιν: γλαφυρός — hollow; masc./neut. dat. pl., epic -οισιν (= Attic -οῖς): ’in the hollow caves’ (σπέσσι γλαφυροῖσιν)
glossary.γλαφυρὴ: γλαφυρός — hollow; fem. nom. sg. (γλαφυρὴ νηῦς ’a hollow ship’, of a ship’s rounded hull)
glossary.γναμπτοῖς: γναμπτός — bent, curved; verbal adj. of γνάμπτω ’bend’; masc. dat. pl., agreeing with ἀγκίστροισιν: ’with bent hooks’
glossary.γουνούμενος: γουνόομαι — supplicate, entreat (lit. clasp by the knees, γόνυ); pres. part. mid. masc. nom. sg.
glossary.δήθ: δηθά (elided δήθ’) — for long, long since; adv., intensified by δή: ’for so long now’
glossary.δολιχὴν: δολιχός — long; adj., fem. acc. sg., agreeing with ὁδόν: ’a long (journey)’
glossary.δύναιο: δύναμαι — be able, can; pres. opt. 2 sg. mid.: ’you might be able, if you could’ (εἴ πως ... δύναιο, potential condition)
glossary.δύνασαι: δύναμαι — be able, can; pres. 2 sg. mid., epic uncontracted (= Attic δύνασαι/δύνῃ): ’you can, you are able’
glossary.εἰδοθέη: Εἰδοθέη — Eidothea, a sea-nymph, daughter of Proteus, who helps Menelaus; fem. nom. sg. (first appearance in the poem)
glossary.εἰρωτᾷς: εἰρωτάω (epic = ἐρωτάω) — ask, question; pres. 2 sg.
glossary.εἰσήλυθεν: εἰσέρχομαι — go/come into, enter; epic aor. 3 sg. εἰσήλυθεν (= Attic εἰσῆλθεν): ’he came into’
glossary.εἴποιμι: εἶπον (aor. of λέγω/φημί) — say, tell; aor. opt. 1 sg., potential with ἄν: ’I would say’
glossary.εἴπῃσιν: εἶπον — say, tell; aor. subj. 3 sg., epic -ῃσιν (ν-movable, = Attic εἴπῃ)
glossary.εἴρεσθαι: εἴρομαι (= ἔρομαι) — ask, inquire; aor. inf. mid., used as an imperative: ’(and) ask!’
glossary.εὐνάσω: εὐνάζω — lay to bed, lay down to rest; fut. 1 sg. act.: ’I will lay (you) down’
glossary.εὐνηθῆναι: εὐνάω — lay in bed; aor. pass. inf. εὐνηθῆναι, used in a middle sense: ’to lie (in bed)’
glossary.εὐρυπόροιο: εὐρύπορος — wide-wayed, with wide paths (εὐρύς + πόρος); adj., fem. gen. sg., epic -οιο (= Attic -ου)
glossary.εὑρέμεναι: εὑρίσκω — find; aor. inf. act., epic -έμεναι (= Attic εὑρεῖν)
glossary.ζεφύροιο: Ζέφυρος — the West Wind, personified; masc. gen. sg., epic -οιο (= Attic -ου)
glossary.θεσπιδαὲς: θεσπιδαής — wondrously blazing (θέσπις + δαίω ’burn’); adj., neut. nom./acc. sg., epithet of fire
glossary.καλυφθείς: καλύπτω — cover, hide; aor. pass. part. masc. nom. sg.: ’covered, veiled’
glossary.καλῆς: καλός — beautiful, fair; fem. gen. sg.
glossary.κατέφθιτο: καταφθίνω (root φθίω/φθίνω) — perish, be destroyed utterly; aor. mid. 3 sg., with κε in an unreal past condition: ’would have perished’
glossary.κατερύκομαι: κατερύκω — hold back, detain; pres. pass. 1 sg.: ’I am held back, detained’
glossary.κατευνηθέντα: κατευνάω — lull, lay to rest; aor. pass. part. masc. acc. sg.: ’laid down to rest, asleep’ (of Proteus)
glossary.κείνοισιν: κεῖνος (= Attic ἐκεῖνος) — that, yonder; demonstr. pron./adj., masc. dat. pl.: ’upon those men’
glossary.κεχάροντο: χαίρω — rejoice, be glad; redupl. aor. 3 pl., unaugmented: ’they rejoiced’
glossary.κικλήσκουσι: κικλήσκω (= καλέω) — call, name; pres. 3 pl., ν lost before enclitic: ’they call (it)’
glossary.κιόντι: κίω — go, walk; pres. part. masc. dat. sg., agreeing with μοι: ’as (I) went’
glossary.κνημοὺς: κνημός — mountain slope, spur, ridge; masc. acc. pl.
glossary.κοιμήθημεν: κοιμάω — put to sleep; pass. lie down to rest; aor. pass. 1 pl.: ’we lay down to sleep’
glossary.κοιμήσασα: κοιμάω — lull to sleep, put to rest; aor. part. act. fem. nom. sg.: ’having lulled to rest’
glossary.κοιμᾶται: κοιμάω — mid. lie down to rest, sleep; pres. 3 sg. mid.: ’he lies down to sleep’
glossary.κρίνασθαι: κρίνω — pick out, choose, select; aor. inf. mid., used as an imperative: ’choose!’
glossary.κρατεροῖο: κρατερός — strong, mighty; masc. gen. sg., epic -οιο (= Attic -οῦ)
glossary.κρατερόφρονος: κρατερόφρων — strong-minded, stout of heart (κρατερός + φρήν); adj., masc. gen. sg.
glossary.κρατερῶς: κρατερῶς — mightily, forcefully; adv. from κρατερός
glossary.κυμαίνοντα: κυμαίνω — swell, billow (of the sea, from κῦμα ’wave’); pres. part. masc. acc. sg., agreeing with πόντον: ’billowing, surging’
glossary.λέξεται: λέχομαι (root λεχ-, distinct from λέγω ’say, gather’) — lie down to rest; fut. mid. 3 sg.: ’he will lie down’
glossary.λίσσεαι: λίσσομαι — beg, entreat, beseech; pres. 2 sg. mid., epic uncontracted (= Attic λίσσῃ)
glossary.λελαβέσθαι: λαμβάνω — take, seize, catch; perf. inf. mid. (reduplicated), stressing a firm grip: ’to get hold of, catch fast’
glossary.λιμός: λιμός — hunger, famine; masc. nom. sg.
glossary.λιμὴν: λιμήν — harbor, haven; masc. nom. sg.
glossary.λοχησάμενος: λοχάω — lie in ambush, lie in wait; aor. part. mid. masc. nom. sg.: ’having lain in ambush’
glossary.λῦσαί: λύω — loose, release, let go; aor. inf. act., used as an imperative: ’release!, let go!’
glossary.μάλιστά: μάλα — very, much; superl. adv. μάλιστα, accented μάλιστά before a following enclitic (γε): ’most of all, especially’
glossary.μέλλω: μέλλω — be about to, be likely to; pres. 1 sg. + inf., expressing a supposition: ’I must be...’
glossary.μένε: μένος — might, vigor, strength; neut. acc. pl. μένεα, elided μένε(’) before a vowel: ’the men’s strength’ (κατέφθιτο ... μένε’ ἀνδρῶν) · also μένω — stay, hold one’s ground; impf. 3 sg., unaugmented (= ἔμενε): ’she stayed, stood firm’
glossary.μέσσῃσι: μέσος (epic μέσσος) — middle, in the midst; fem. dat. pl. μέσσῃσι used substantively: ’among them, in their midst’ (of Proteus among the seals)
glossary.μήλων: μῆλον — sheep, small cattle; neut. gen. pl.
glossary.μεθίεις: μεθίημι — let go, relax; mid. sense here, relax one’s effort, give up; pres. 2 sg. act.: ’you give up, you slacken’
glossary.μεμαῶτα: μέμονα — be eager, be minded, strive; perf. part. (pres. sense) masc. acc. sg. μεμαώς, μεμαῶτα: ’eager, straining’
glossary.μεμνῆσθαι: μιμνήσκω — remind; mid./pass. remember, be mindful; perf. inf. mid., pres. force: ’to be mindful’ + gen.
glossary.μινύθει: μινύθω — lessen, waste away, dwindle; pres. 3 sg. intrans.: ’wastes away’
glossary.μᾶλλόν: μάλα — very; comparative adv. μᾶλλον ’more, rather’, accented μᾶλλόν before the enclitic τε: ’all the harder’
glossary.νέποδες: νέποδες — offspring, brood; masc./fem. nom. pl., used only of these seals in Homer, ’children (of Halosydne)’; formation and precise meaning disputed
glossary.νήπιός: νήπιος — foolish, childish, witless; adj., masc. nom. sg., accented νήπιός before the enclitic εἰς
glossary.νεβροὺς: νεβρός — fawn, young deer; masc./fem. acc. pl.
glossary.νεηγενέας: νεηγενής — newborn, newly-born (νέος + γίγνομαι); epic compound adj., masc./fem. acc. pl.
glossary.νημερτής: νημερτής — unerring, infallible, truthful (νη- + ἁμαρτάνω); adj., masc. nom. sg., standing epithet of Proteus (γέρων ἅλιος νημερτής)
glossary.νημερτὴς: νημερτής — unerring, infallible, truthful; adj., masc. nom. sg., running-text (grave) accent, standing epithet of Proteus
glossary.νηῶν: ναῦς — ship; fem. gen. pl., epic νηῶν (= Attic νεῶν)
glossary.νομεὺς: νομεύς — herdsman, shepherd; masc. nom. sg.
glossary.ξυλόχῳ: ξύλοχος — thicket, copse, lair; masc. dat. sg.
glossary.οἴῳ: οἶος — alone, only; adj., masc. dat. sg., agreeing with an implied dat. of the speaker: ’alone’
glossary.οἷός: οἷος — such as, of what sort; relative adj., masc. nom. sg., correlative with τοῖος: ’such as, as ... when’
glossary.οὐδέν: οὐδείς, οὐδεμία, οὐδέν — no one, nothing; neut. acc. sg.: ’nothing, no (word)’
glossary.οὖροι: οὖρος — a fair, favouring wind; masc. nom. pl.
glossary.πάσας: πᾶς — all, every; fem. acc. pl., substantival: ’all of them’ (the seals) · also fem. acc. pl., plain attributive adj. agreeing with a noun: πάσας … ἀέλλας ’all the blasts’
glossary.πάσχων: πάσχω — suffer, experience; pres. part. masc. nom. sg.: ’suffering’
glossary.πανημερίη: πανημέριος — all day long, the whole day; adj., fem. nom. sg. used adverbially with νηῦς ἤνυσεν: ’in a whole day’s sailing’
glossary.παρακλιδόν: παρακλιδόν — aslant, evasively, swerving from the truth; rare adv.
glossary.παρὲξ: παρέξ — beside, past, beyond; adv./prep. + acc., here adverbial with εἴποιμι: ’say otherwise, speak beside the point’
glossary.πεδάᾳ: πεδάω — fetter, shackle, hold fast; pres. ind. 3 sg., epic uncontracted
glossary.πειρήσεται: πειράω — try, test, make trial of; fut. mid. 3 sg.
glossary.πεμπάσσεται: πεμπάζομαι — count by fives (from πέμπε, old form of πέντε); aor. subj. 3 sg. mid., after ἐπήν in a generalizing temporal clause: ’when he has counted them’
glossary.πεποίθεα: πείθω — persuade; mid./pass. trust, rely on; plpf. 1 sg. (impf./perf. force): ’I had come to trust, I trusted’ + dat.
glossary.πιέζειν: πιέζω — press, squeeze hard, grip; pres. inf. act., used as an imperative: ’press hard, grip!’
glossary.πνείοντες: πνέω — blow, breathe; pres. part. masc. nom. pl., agreeing with οὖροι: ’blowing’
glossary.πνοιῇ: πνοιή — breath, blast, breeze; fem. dat. sg.
glossary.ποιήεντα: ποιήεις — grassy; adj., neut. acc. pl., epithet of ἄγκεα ’glens’
glossary.πολυβενθέος: πολυβενθής — very deep, many-fathomed (πολύς + βένθος); adj., fem. gen. sg.
glossary.πολυκλύστῳ: πολύκλυστος — much-dashed-by-waves, much-surging (κλύζω ’surge, wash over’); adj., masc. dat. sg.
glossary.προδαεὶς: προδαείς (προ- + δαῆναι ’learn’) — having learned beforehand, having got wind of; aor. pass. part. masc. nom. sg.
glossary.προσέειπον: προσεῖπον (aor. of πρόσφημι) — speak to, address; aor. 1 sg.
glossary.προϊδὼν: προοράω — see beforehand, foresee; aor. part. act. masc. nom. sg.
glossary.πρωτέος: Πρωτεύς — Proteus, the shape-shifting old man of the sea; masc. gen. sg., epic uncontracted (= Attic Πρωτέως)
glossary.πρωτεὺς: Πρωτεύς — Proteus, the shape-shifting old man of the sea, servant of Poseidon; masc. nom. sg.
glossary.πωλεῖταί: πωλέομαι — come and go regularly, frequent; pres. 3 sg. mid., iterative force: ’he comes here regularly’
glossary.πόρφυρε: πορφύρω — heave, seethe, churn (properly of the sea darkening/heaving); impf. 3 sg., unaugmented, applied metaphorically to a troubled heart
glossary.πώεσι: πῶυ — flock (esp. of sheep); neut. dat. pl., epic -εσι
glossary.πώς: πώς (= enclitic πως) — somehow, in any way; accented πώς because followed by a further enclitic (με): ’lest he somehow...’
glossary.πᾶσαν: πᾶς — all, every; fem. acc. sg., agreeing with ἰθύν: ’for every (undertaking)’ · also ’the whole’ (of a single extent, not distributive ’every’): πᾶσαν ἠοίην ’the whole morning’, acc. of duration
glossary.στᾶσα: ἵστημι — stand, set; aor. part. act. fem. nom. sg. (root aor. ἔστην): ’having stood, standing’
glossary.συνήντετο: συναντάω — meet, come upon; impf. 3 sg. mid., augmented (ε+α > η), + dat.: ’she met (me)’
glossary.σχέσθαι: ἔχω — have, hold; mid. σχέσθαι, restrain oneself, hold back; aor. inf. mid., used as an imperative, + gen. of separation: ’hold back (your force)!’
glossary.τέκμωρ: τέκμωρ — a fixed mark, sign, end, limit; neut. nom./acc. sg. (indecl.), of an escape not found
glossary.τέρπεαι: τέρπω — mid. delight in, take pleasure; pres. 2 sg. mid., epic uncontracted (= Attic τέρπῃ)
glossary.τέτυκται: τεύχω — make, build; pass. come to pass, happen; perf. pass. 3 sg.: ’has been made, has come to pass’
glossary.τεκέσθαι: τίκτω — bring forth, beget; aor. inf. mid., of the father’s part in begetting (the act. is used of the mother’s bearing): ’to have begotten’
glossary.τεληέσσας: τεληείς — complete, fulfilling, perfect (of sacrifice, from τέλος); adj., fem. acc. pl.
glossary.τῆμος: τῆμος — then, at that time; correlative temporal adv. answering ἦμος ’when’
glossary.φάρον: Φάρος — Pharos, an island off Egypt; acc. sg., proper name, first appearance in the poem
glossary.φαίνονθ: φαίνω — show; mid./pass. appear; impf. 3 pl. mid., elided φαίνονθ’ (= ἐφαίνοντο), unaugmented: ’they appeared’
glossary.φαινομένηφιν: φαίνομαι — appear, show oneself; pres. part. (dat. sg. sense) φαινομένηφιν, the rare -φι(ν) suffix, elsewhere confined to nouns, attached here unusually to a participle: ’(Dawn) as she appears’ — a genuinely rare formation
glossary.φιλομηλεΐδῃ: Φιλομηλεΐδης — Philomeleides, a legendary king of Lesbos known only from this wrestling-story; masc. dat. sg.
glossary.φράζευ: φράζω — mid. think out, devise, plan; pres. imper. 2 sg. mid., epic -ευ (= Attic -ου): ’devise! plan!’
glossary.φρικὶ: φρίξ — ripple, roughening of the sea’s surface; fem. dat. sg.
glossary.φώκας: φώκη — seal (the sea-animal); fem. acc. pl.
glossary.φώνησέν: φωνέω — utter, speak aloud, call out; aor. 3 sg., accented φώνησέν before the enclitic τε
glossary.φῶκαι: φώκη — seal (the sea-animal); fem. nom. pl.
glossary.χαλέπτει: χαλέπτω — be harsh to, afflict, vex (from χαλεπός); pres. 3 sg.
glossary.χαλίφρων: χαλίφρων — slack-minded, foolish (χαλάω ’slacken’ + φρήν); adj., masc. nom. sg., rare compound
glossary.ψαμάθοισιν: ψάμαθος — sand; fem. dat. pl., epic -οισιν (= Attic -οις)
glossary.ἀγαγοῦσα: ἄγω — lead, bring; aor. part. act. fem. nom. sg.
glossary.ἀγκίστροισιν: ἄγκιστρον — fish-hook; neut. dat. pl., epic -οισιν (= Attic -οις)
glossary.ἀθανάτους: ἀθάνατος — immortal, deathless; masc. acc. pl., substantival: ’the immortals’ · also adjectival, ’deathless’, agreeing with a noun (κύνες ... ἀθανάτους ὄντας)
glossary.ἀλέηται: ἀλέομαι — avoid, escape, shun; aor. subj. mid. 3 sg., after μή in a clause of fearing: ’lest he escape’
glossary.ἀλιτέσθαι: ἀλιταίνω — sin against, transgress against, offend; aor. inf. mid., with μέλλω: ’to be offending’
glossary.ἀλύξαι: ἀλύσκω — flee, escape, avoid; aor. inf. act., epexegetic: ’to escape’ (of Proteus straining to get away)
glossary.ἀλώμενοι: ἀλάομαι — wander, roam; pres. part. mid. masc. nom. pl.
glossary.ἀμβροσίη: ἀμβρόσιος — ambrosial, divine, immortal; adj., fem. nom. sg., standing epithet of night
glossary.ἀμείβετο: ἀμείβομαι — answer, reply; impf. 3 sg. mid., unaugmented
glossary.ἀμφιβεβήκῃ: ἀμφιβαίνω — stride astride, bestride; perf. subj. 3 sg., in a generalizing temporal clause: ’has reached (the zenith)’
glossary.ἀμφοτέροισι: ἀμφότερος — both (of two); masc. dat. pl., epic -οισι (= Attic -οις)
glossary.ἀνάλκιδες: ἄναλκις — without might, strengthless, feeble (ἀ- + ἀλκή); adj., masc. nom. pl., predicate
glossary.ἀναστάς: ἀνίστημι — raise up; intrans. aor. part. act. masc. nom. sg. ἀναστάς: ’having risen up, rising’
glossary.ἀνείρηται: ἀνείρομαι (= ἔρομαι) — ask, question, inquire of; aor. subj. mid. 3 sg.
glossary.ἀποπνείουσαι: ἀποπνέω — breathe out, exhale; pres. part. act. fem. nom. pl.
glossary.ἀργαλέην: ἀργαλέος — hard, grievous, painful; fem. acc. sg.
glossary.ἀργαλέος: ἀργαλέος — hard, difficult, grievous; adj., masc. nom. sg., predicate: ’(a god is) hard (for a mortal to master)’
glossary.ἀστεμφέως: ἀστεμφέως — unyieldingly, unflinchingly, without wavering; adv.
glossary.ἀφυσσάμενοι: ἀφύσσω — draw (water or wine); aor. part. mid. masc. nom. pl.: ’having drawn (for themselves)’
glossary.ἁθρόαι: ἁθρόος — crowded together, in a mass, all together; adj., fem. nom. pl.
glossary.ἁλίοιο: ἅλιος — of the sea, belonging to the sea; adj., masc. gen. sg., epic -οιο (= Attic -ου), epithet of γέρων ’the old man of the sea’
glossary.ἁλιαέες: ἁλιαής — blowing off the sea, sea-borne (of winds); adj., masc. nom. pl., rare compound found only here in Homer
glossary.ἁλοσύδνης: Ἁλοσύδνη — Halosydne, an epithet-name for a sea-goddess (usually identified with Amphitrite), whose formation and exact meaning are uncertain; fem. gen. sg., kept as a proper name
glossary.ἄγκεα: ἄγκος — glen, valley, mountain-hollow; neut. acc. pl.
glossary.ἄγον: ἄγω — lead, bring, take along; impf. 1 sg., unaugmented (= ἦγον): ’I took along’
glossary.ἄνευθ: ἄνευθε(ν) (elided ἄνευθ’) — far off, apart, away; adv.
glossary.ἅλιος: ἅλιος — of the sea, belonging to the sea; adj., masc. nom. sg., part of the standing epithet γέρων ἅλιος νημερτής ’the old man of the sea’ (of Proteus)
glossary.ἐδύσετο: δύω/δύνω — enter, sink into, plunge; aor. mid. 3 sg., epic sigmatic (ἐδύσετο, = Attic ἔδυ): ’she plunged (in)’
glossary.ἐλεύσεαι: ἔρχομαι (fut. ἐλεύσομαι) — go, come; fut. mid. 2 sg., epic uncontracted: ’you shall come’ (the fixed νόστον formula)
glossary.ἐλεύσομαι: ἔρχομαι (fut. ἐλεύσομαι) — go, come; fut. mid. 1 sg., epic uncontracted: ’I shall come’
glossary.ἐξαναδῦσαι: ἐξαναδύω — rise up out of, emerge from; aor. part. act. fem. nom. pl.
glossary.ἐξερέῃσι: ἐξερέομαι — search out, range over, explore; pres. subj. 3 sg., epic -ῃσι, generalizing with ὁπότε (no ἄν/κε needed): ’ranges over’
glossary.ἐπάλαισεν: παλαίω — wrestle; aor. 3 sg., + dat. of the opponent: ’he wrestled (against)’
glossary.ἐπί: ἐπί — on, upon, towards; here as preverb in tmesis, separated from its verb (ἐπί ... ἤλυθεν = ἐπῆλθεν ’came on, came upon’); accented ἐπί before the following enclitic τε
glossary.ἐπικεύσω: ἐπικεύθω — hide further, keep back, conceal in addition; fut. 1 sg.
glossary.ἐπιπνείῃσιν: ἐπιπνέω — blow upon, blow after; pres. subj. 3 sg., epic -ῃσιν, generalizing (parallel to ἐξερέῃσι): ’blows (behind it)’
glossary.ἐρύκεαι: ἐρύκω — hold back, restrain, detain; pass. be held back; pres. 2 sg. pass., epic uncontracted (= Attic ἐρύκῃ)
glossary.ἐσάωσε: σαόω (= σῴζω) — save, preserve; aor. 3 sg., augmented: ’saved’
glossary.ἐσσύμενόν: σεύω — set in motion, drive; mid./pass. perf. part. ἐσσύμενος, rush, be eager, strain; masc. acc. sg., accented before the enclitic περ: ’straining hard, eager’
glossary.ἐυκτιμένῃ: ἐυκτίμενος — well-built, well-founded (ἐύ + κτίζω); adj., fem. dat. sg., epithet here of an island
