glossary.ἐυσσέλμοισιν: ἐύσσελμος — well-benched (σέλμα ’rowing-bench, deck-beam’); adj., fem. dat. pl., epic -οισιν, epithet of ships
glossary.ἐφάμην: φημί — say, speak; impf. mid. 1 sg., epic uncontracted: ’I was speaking, I spoke’
glossary.ἐφήσει: ἐφίημι — send/let loose upon, launch at; fut. 3 sg.
glossary.ἐφετμέων: ἐφετμή — command, injunction, behest; fem. gen. pl., rare epic noun
glossary.ἐφῆκεν: ἐφίημι — send/let loose upon; aor. 3 sg., augmented
glossary.ἐχέμεν: ἔχω — have, hold; pres. inf. act., epic -έμεν (= Attic ἔχειν), used as an imperative: ’hold on!’ · also inf. as the wish after αἲ γάρ: ’(would that you) might have (my daughter)’ · also inf. of purpose: ’to have, to bear’
glossary.ἐύορμος: ἐύορμος — with good anchorage, well-mooring (ὅρμος ’anchorage’); adj., masc. nom. sg.
glossary.ἐών: εἰμί — be; pres. part. masc. nom. sg., epic ἐών (= Attic ὤν), accented ἐών before a pause: ’being’ (τοῖος ἐών ’being such’)
glossary.ἑρπετὰ: ἑρπετόν — creeping thing; broadly, any living creature, not narrowly reptiles; neut. nom./acc. pl.
glossary.ἑὴν: ἑός (= ὅς, ἥ, ὅν possessive) — his own, her own; 3rd-person reflexive possessive adj., fem. acc. sg. ἑήν, agreeing with εὐνήν: ’his own (lair)’
glossary.ἔβαλε: βάλλω — throw, cast, throw down; aor. 3 sg., here in tmesis with κατά (κὰδ δ’ ἔβαλε = κατέβαλε): ’threw down’
glossary.ἔδησε: δέω — bind, tie; aor. 3 sg., + gen. of separation: ’has bound (me) away from’
glossary.ἔλαφος: ἔλαφος — deer, hind; fem. nom. sg.
glossary.ἔπεισιν: ἔπειμι (εἶμι + ἐπί) — go over, go among, inspect; pres. 3 sg., used with future sense alongside ἀριθμήσει: ’(will) go among (them), inspect’
glossary.ἔρεξα: ῥέζω — do, perform; esp. offer sacrifice; aor. 1 sg.
glossary.ἔριδος: ἔρις — strife, quarrel, contention; fem. gen. sg.
glossary.ἔρροντι: ἔρρω — wander, roam (elsewhere often ’go to ruin, go wretchedly’); pres. part. dat. sg., agreeing with μοι (elided μ’): ’as I wandered’
glossary.ἔτειρε: τείρω — wear away, distress, afflict; impf. 3 sg., augmented
glossary.ἠοῖ: ἠώς — dawn; fem. dat. sg. ἠοῖ
glossary.ἤθελον: ἐθέλω — be willing, wish; impf. 3 pl., augmented: ’they wished’
glossary.ἤματ: ἦμαρ — day; neut. acc. pl. ἤματα, elided ἤματ’ before a vowel: ’(for) days’
glossary.ἤνυσεν: ἀνύω — accomplish, achieve, complete (a distance/journey); aor. 3 sg.
glossary.ἰθύν: ἰθύς (noun) — a direct course, an undertaking, a purpose; fem. acc. sg., distinct from the homographic adverb ἰθύς ’straight’
glossary.ἰφθίμου: ἴφθιμος — stout, strong, mighty; adj., masc. gen. sg.
glossary.ἰχθυάασκον: ἰχθυάω — fish (denom. of ἰχθύς); impf. iterative 1 pl., epic -ασκ- suffix marking repeated action: ’we used to fish, we kept fishing’
glossary.ἴδησθε: εἶδον (aor. of ὁράω) — see; aor. subj. mid. 2 pl., in a generalizing temporal clause: ’when you see’ · also aor. subj. mid. 2 pl. in a purpose clause after ἵνα: ’so that you may see’
glossary.ἴδηται: εἶδον (aor. of ὁράω) — see; aor. subj. mid. 3 sg., in a generalizing temporal clause: ’when he looks (them) over’
glossary.ὀδμήν: ὀδμή — smell, odor; fem. acc. sg.
glossary.ὀλοφύρατο: ὀλοφύρομαι — lament, pity, feel compassion for; aor. 3 sg. mid.
glossary.ὀλοφώια: ὀλοφώιος — baneful, harmful, deceitful (formation disputed, perhaps connected with ὄλλυμι ’destroy’); adj. used substantively, neut. acc. pl.: ’baneful arts/wiles’
glossary.ὁπλισάμεσθ: ὁπλίζω — make ready, prepare, equip; aor. mid. 1 pl., elided ὁπλισάμεσθ’ (= ὁπλισάμεσθα): ’we got (supper) ready’
glossary.ὁπότ: ὁπότε (elided ὁπότ’) — when, whenever; temporal conj., here introducing a vivid simile
glossary.ὄρινα: ὀρίνω — stir, move, arouse (the heart, emotions); aor. 1 sg., unaugmented (= ὤρινα): ’I moved, stirred’
glossary.ὅθ: ὅθι (elided ὅθ’) — where; relative adv. of place (distinct from ὅτε ’when’, similarly elided ὅτ’) · also ὅτε (elided and aspirated ὅθ’ before rough breathing, cf. ἔφαθ’) — when; temporal conj.: ὅθ’ ἑὸς δόμος ἀμφεκάλυψε ’when his own house sheltered (me)’
glossary.ὅσσον: ὅσος (epic ὅσσος) — as much/great as; neut. acc. sg. used adverbially, correlative with τόσσον: ’as far as’ · also in an indirect exclamation, ’how greatly’ (ὅσσον ἄρισται ’how excellent they are’)
glossary.ὑποδμώς: ὑποδμώς — an underling, a subject slave (ὑπό + δμώς ’slave’); masc. nom. sg., a startling word applied here to Proteus as subordinate to Poseidon
glossary.ᾗ: ὅς, ἥ, ὅ — who, which; relative pron., fem. dat. sg.: ’for which, to which’ (referring back to the ship, νηῦς) · also ’on which’, of a road: τὴν ὁδὸν ᾗ δὴ ’the journey on which’
glossary.ῥηγμῖνι: ῥηγμίς — the line of breaking surf, the beach at the waterline (ῥήγνυμι ’break’); fem. dat. sg.
glossary.αἰγίσθου: Αἴγισθος — Aegisthus, seducer of Clytemnestra and killer of Agamemnon; gen. sg.
glossary.αἰγύπτοιο: Αἴγυπτος — Egypt; also the river Nile, called by the same name; gen. sg., epic -οιο (= Attic -ου)
glossary.αἰνότατος: αἰνός — dreadful, dire; adj., superl. masc. nom. sg.: ’most dreadful’
glossary.αἴγυπτόνδ: Αἴγυπτος — Egypt; acc. sg. + -δε suffix of direction, elided (Αἴγυπτόνδ’ = Αἴγυπτόνδε): ’to Egypt’
glossary.αὐδήσαντος: αὐδάω — cry out, speak aloud; aor. act. part. gen. sg. (agreeing with the person heard, governed by a verb of hearing): ’as he cried aloud’
glossary.αὐτήν: αὐτός — self; intensive/personal pron., fem. acc. sg.: ’her, it’
glossary.βάλλομεν: βάλλω — throw, cast; pres. 1 pl., in tmesis with ἀμφί (ἀμφὶ ... βάλλομεν = ἀμφιβάλλομεν): ’we threw around, embraced’
glossary.βαρέα: βαρύς — heavy, grievous; adj., neut. acc. pl. used adverbially: ’heavily’ (βαρέα στενάχοντα ’groaning heavily’)
glossary.βουλάς: βουλή — counsel, plan; fem. acc. pl.
glossary.γίγνετο: γίγνομαι — become, happen, come to be; impf. 3 sg., unaugmented (= ἐγίγνετο): ’was becoming, turned into’
glossary.γυραίην: Γυραῖος — Gyraean, of Gyrae; adj., fem. acc. sg. — the place is unidentified and disputed since antiquity, kept as a proper name
glossary.γυρῇσίν: Γυραῖος — Gyraean, of Gyrae; adj., fem. dat. pl., epic -ῃσι(ν) — the place is unidentified and disputed since antiquity, kept as a proper name
glossary.δάμεν: δαμάζω — overpower, subdue, kill; aor. pass. 3 pl., unaugmented (= ἐδάμησαν): ’were slain’
glossary.δένδρεον: δένδρεον — tree; neut. nom./acc. sg. (Homeric by-form of Attic δένδρον)
glossary.δέρμα: δέρμα — skin, hide; neut. acc. sg.
glossary.δέρματ: δέρμα — skin, hide; neut. acc. pl., elided (δέρματ’ = δέρματα)
glossary.δαῆναι: δάω — learn, come to know; aor. inf. (root aorist, δαῆναι); shares its root with the disputed epithet δαΐφρων
glossary.δειπνίσσας: δειπνίζω — give a meal to, feast, entertain at dinner; aor. act. part. masc. nom. sg.: ’having feasted (him)’
glossary.διί: Ζεύς — Zeus; masc. dat. sg. (Διί, from the stem Δι-)
glossary.διαγλάψασ: διαγλάφω — scoop out, hollow out; aor. act. part. fem. nom. sg., elided (διαγλάψασ’ = διαγλάψασα), rare verb
glossary.διείρεαι: διέρομαι — ask closely about, inquire about (intensive of ἔρομαι); pres. mid. 2 sg.
glossary.διιπετέος: διιπετής — fallen from the sky, sky-fed (Διός + πίπτω); adj., masc./fem. gen. sg., standing epithet of a great river
glossary.δοιὰ: δοιοί — two, a pair of; numeral adj., neut. acc. pl. (poetic beside δύο)
glossary.δολίην: δόλιος — guileful, crafty, treacherous; adj., fem. acc. sg. (agreeing with τέχνην)
glossary.δολίης: δόλιος — guileful, crafty, treacherous; adj., fem. gen. sg. (agreeing with τέχνης)
glossary.δολιχηρέτμοισι: δολιχήρετμος — long-oared (δολιχός + ἐρετμόν); adj., fem./masc. dat. pl., epic -οισι(ν), of ships
glossary.δράκων: δράκων — serpent, snake; masc. nom. sg.
glossary.δύναμαι: δύναμαι — be able, can; pres. 1 sg.
glossary.δώσουσιν: δίδωμι — give, grant; fut. 3 pl.: ’they will give’
glossary.εἰδότ: οἶδα — know; perf. part. masc. acc. sg., elided (εἰδότ’ = εἰδότα): ’knowing’ (οὐκ εἰδότα ’not knowing’)
glossary.εἰναλίῳ: ἐνάλιος — of the sea, marine; adj., masc./neut. dat. sg.
glossary.εἶδε: ὁράω (aor. stem εἰδ-) — see; aor. 3 sg. (εἶδε, from the same root as εἶδον)
glossary.εἷσε: ἵζω — make sit, set, station (causative); aor. act. 3 sg.: ’set, seated, stationed’
glossary.εὐνάζοντο: εὐνάζω — put to bed; mid./pass. lie down, bed oneself down; impf. 3 pl.: ’were lying down to rest’
glossary.εὐνὰς: εὐνή — bed, lair, resting-place; fem. acc. pl.
glossary.εὔνησε: εὐνάω — lay to rest, put to bed (causative of εὕδω); aor. act. 3 sg.
glossary.ζατρεφέας: ζατρεφής — well-fed, sleek (ζα- intensive + τρέφω); adj., fem. acc. pl., rare compound
glossary.θεοῖσι: θεός — god; masc. dat. pl., epic -οισι (= Attic θεοῖς)
glossary.θερμὰ: θερμός — hot, warm; adj., neut. acc. pl. (agreeing with δάκρυα) · also neut. nom. pl., agreeing with λοετρά: ’warm baths’
glossary.θούριδος: θοῦρις — impetuous, rushing, furious; adj., fem. gen. sg. (θούριδος ἀλκῆς ’furious valor’)
glossary.θυέστης: Θυέστης — Thyestes, brother of Atreus and father of Aegisthus; masc. nom. sg.
glossary.θυεστιάδης: Θυεστιάδης — son of Thyestes, patronymic of Aegisthus; masc. nom. sg.
glossary.θύελλα: θύελλα — storm-blast, squall, whirlwind; fem. nom. sg.
glossary.κάλ: καλός — fair, beautiful, goodly; adj., neut. acc. pl., elided (κάλ’ = καλά), agreeing with ἱερά
glossary.κήτεος: κῆτος — sea-monster, huge sea-creature; neut. gen. sg.
glossary.κήτεσιν: κῆτος — sea-monster, huge sea-creature; neut. dat. pl.
glossary.κήτεϊ: κῆτος — sea-monster, huge sea-creature; neut. dat. sg., epic uncontracted (= Attic κήτει)
glossary.καθεῖσεν: καθίζω — set, seat, station (causative); aor. act. 3 sg.
glossary.καλέων: καλέω — call, summon, invite; pres. part. masc. nom. sg.: ’calling’
glossary.κατέπεφνεν: πέφνω (defective, found only in the aorist) — slay, kill; redupl. aor. 3 sg. of the compound κατα-πέφνω: ’slew’
glossary.κατεκλάσθη: κατακλάω — break down, shatter; aor. pass. 3 sg.: ’was broken down’ (of the heart)
glossary.κελεύεις: κελεύω — bid, command, order; pres. 2 sg.
glossary.κοιμηθείη: κοιμάω — mid./pass. κοιμάομαι, lie down to sleep; aor. pass. opt. 3 sg.: ’could sleep’
glossary.κρινάμενος: κρίνω — pick out, choose, select; aor. mid. part. masc. nom. sg.: ’having picked out (for himself)’
glossary.κόλπον: κόλπος — fold, bosom (of a garment, or of the sea); masc. acc. sg.
glossary.κύνει: κυνέω — kiss; impf. 3 sg., unaugmented (= ἐκύνει)
glossary.λάθοι: λανθάνω — escape the notice of, elude; aor. opt. 3 sg.: ’might escape notice, might slip by’
glossary.λέγε: λέγω — gather, count, pick out (the Homeric sense, source of the later dominant sense ’say, tell’); impf. 3 sg., unaugmented (= ἔλεγε): ’was counting’
glossary.λέκτο: λέγω — count, reckon; aor. mid. 3 sg.: ’he counted’ · also λέχομαι — lie down to rest; aor. mid. 3 sg.: ’he lay down’ — the identical forms of two different verbs are a deliberate wordplay
glossary.λίπεθ: λείπω — leave, leave behind; aor. mid. 3 sg. used passively, elided and aspirated before a rough breathing (λίπεθ’ = λίπετο): ’was left behind’
glossary.λίπομεν: λείπω — leave, leave behind; aor. act. 1 pl., unaugmented: ’we left’
glossary.λίποντο: λείπω — leave behind; aor. mid. 3 pl. used passively: ’were left behind, survived’
glossary.λαῖτμα: λαῖτμα — the gulf, the deep (of the sea); neut. nom./acc. sg.
glossary.λόχος: λόχος — ambush, body of men lying in wait; masc. nom. sg.
glossary.μάχῃ: μάχη — battle, fight; fem. dat. sg.
glossary.μένομεν: μένω — remain, wait, stay; pres./impf. 1 pl. (the form itself does not distinguish tense), with past force in narration: ’we waited’
glossary.μένουσ: μένω — remain, wait; pres. part. fem. nom. sg., elided (μένουσ’ = μένουσα): ’waiting’
glossary.μεγάλῃσι: μέγας — great; adj., fem. dat. pl., epic -ῃσι (= Attic μεγάλαις), agreeing with πέτρῃσι
glossary.μεῖνε: μένω — remain, stay; aor. 3 sg., unaugmented (= ἔμεινε): ’remained’
glossary.μισθὸν: μισθός — wage, pay, reward; masc. acc. sg.
glossary.μνήσαιτο: μιμνήσκομαι — call to mind, remember; aor. opt. 3 sg.
glossary.μοῦνοι: μόνος (Ionic μοῦνος) — only, alone; adj., masc. nom. pl.
glossary.ναῖε: ναίω — dwell, inhabit, live; impf. 3 sg., unaugmented (= ἔναιε): ’was dwelling, used to live’
glossary.νεόδαρτα: νεόδαρτος — newly flayed, freshly skinned (νέος + δέρω); adj., neut. nom./acc. pl., rare compound
glossary.νόστῳ: νόστος — homecoming, return; masc. dat. sg. (ἐν νόστῳ ’on the way home’)
glossary.οἶσθα: οἶδα — know; perf. 2 sg. with pres. force: ’you know’
glossary.οὕνεκά: οὕνεκα — because, for the reason that (= οὗ ἕνεκα, contracted); conj.
glossary.πάρδαλις: πάρδαλις — leopard, panther; fem. nom. sg.
glossary.πέτρῃσιν: πέτρη — rock; fem. dat. pl., epic -ῃσι(ν) (= Attic πέτραις)
glossary.πίεν: πίνω — drink; aor. 3 sg., unaugmented (= ἔπιε)
glossary.παρατροπέων: παρατροπέω — turn aside, divert, put off with evasions; pres. part. masc. nom. sg.
glossary.παριών: πάρειμι (from εἶμι ’go’; distinct from πάρειμι ’be present’ from εἰμί, whose part. is παρών) — go past, pass by; pres. part. masc. nom. sg.
glossary.παρῆσθα: πάρειμι (πάρα + εἰμί) — be present, be there; impf. 2 sg. (ἦσθα, ordinary also in Attic, not a distinctively epic ending — contrast the genuinely epic subjunctive ending -ῃσθα, as in ἐθέλῃσθα): ’you were present’
glossary.πατρίδ: πατρίς — fatherland, native land; fem. acc. sg., elided (πατρίδ’ = πατρίδα)
glossary.πνείουσαν: πνέω — breathe, blow, give off (a scent); pres. part. fem. acc. sg.: ’breathing, giving off fragrance’
glossary.ποταμοῖο: ποταμός — river; masc. gen. sg., epic -οιο (= Attic -ου)
glossary.πρώτους: πρῶτος — first; adj., masc. acc. pl.: ’the first, foremost’
glossary.πόντου: πόντος — sea, open sea; masc. gen. sg.
glossary.πότνια: πότνια — lady, mistress (title of respect for a goddess); fem. nom. sg. · also of a mortal woman, a respectful title: ’revered, honoured’ (πότνια μήτηρ ’the honoured mother’)
glossary.σκοπιῆς: σκοπιή — watch-post, lookout point, height; fem. gen. sg.
glossary.σκοπός: σκοπός — watcher, watchman, lookout, scout; masc. nom. sg.
glossary.στενάχοντα: στενάχω — groan, moan; pres. part. masc. acc. sg.: ’groaning’
glossary.στιβαρῇσιν: στιβαρός — sturdy, strong, stout; adj., fem. dat. pl., epic -ῃσι(ν) (of hands)
glossary.στρέψαν: στρέφω — turn; aor. 3 pl., unaugmented (= ἔστρεψαν): ’turned’
glossary.συμφράσσατο: συμφράζομαι — plan together with, contrive jointly (+ dat. of person, + acc. of the plan); aor. mid. 3 sg.
glossary.σχεδὸν: σχεδόν — near, close by (+ gen.); adv. · also + dat.: σχεδὸν ἀλλήλῃσι ’close to one another’
glossary.σὸς: σός — your, yours (2 sg. possessive); adj., masc. nom. sg.
glossary.σῦς: σῦς — swine, pig, boar; masc./fem. nom. sg.
glossary.τέο: τίς, τί — who? what?; interrog. pron., Homeric/Ionic gen. sg. (= Attic τίνος), with impersonal χρή: ’of what’
glossary.τέσσαρα: τέσσαρες — four; numeral, neut. acc. pl.
glossary.τέχνην: τέχνη — craft, skill, cunning device; fem. acc. sg.
glossary.τελέω: τελέω — accomplish, fulfil, bring to pass; fut. 1 sg. (contracted from τελέσω): ’I will accomplish’
glossary.τετληότι: τλάω — endure, have the heart to bear; perf. part. (τετληώς) masc./neut. dat. sg.: ’enduring’
glossary.τεῖρε: τείρω — wear down, distress, oppress; impf. 3 sg., unaugmented (= ἔτειρε)
glossary.τρίαιναν: τρίαινα — trident, Poseidon’s weapon; fem. acc. sg.
glossary.τρύφος: τρύφος — a broken-off piece, fragment; neut. nom./acc. sg., rare noun
glossary.υἱέ: υἱός — son; masc. voc. sg. (Ἀτρέος υἱέ ’son of Atreus’)
glossary.φάτνῃ: φάτνη — manger, crib, stall; fem. dat. sg.
glossary.φίλους: φίλος — dear, one’s own; substantival masc. acc. pl.: ’dear ones, kin’ · also adjective, ’dear’, agreeing with ἑταίρους
glossary.φυγέειν: φεύγω — flee, escape; aor. inf., epic uncontracted (= Attic φυγεῖν)
glossary.φωκάων: φώκη — seal (the sea creature); fem. gen. pl.
glossary.φύλασσε: φυλάσσω — keep watch, guard; impf. 3 sg., unaugmented (= ἐφύλασσε): ’was keeping watch’
glossary.φῆ: φημί — say, declare, assert; impf. 3 sg., unaugmented (= ἔφη): ’said, declared’
glossary.φῶτας: φώς — man, warrior, mortal; masc. acc. pl.
glossary.χέοντ: χέω — pour, shed; impf. mid. 3 pl., elided (χέοντ’ = χέοντο): ’were streaming, were being shed’ (of tears)
glossary.ψαμάθοισι: ψάμαθος — sand; fem. dat. pl., epic -οισι (= Attic -οις)
glossary.ἀάσθη: ἀάω — blind, infatuate, delude (root of the goddess Ἄτη); aor. pass. 3 sg.: ’was blinded, was struck with delusion’
glossary.ἀγαμέμνονα: Ἀγαμέμνων — Agamemnon, king of Mycenae, leader of the Achaeans at Troy; masc. acc. sg.
glossary.ἀδελφεὸς: ἀδελφεός (Ionic/epic by-form of ἀδελφός) — brother; masc. nom. sg.
glossary.ἀδευκέι: ἀδευκής — bitter, harsh; adj., masc./neut. dat. sg., of disputed further derivation, glossed ’bitter’ since antiquity
glossary.ἀλκῆς: ἀλκή — might, valor, prowess in battle; fem. gen. sg. (θούριδος ἀλκῆς ’furious valor’)
glossary.ἀμβροσίην: ἀμβροσίη — ambrosia, the fragrant food/substance of the gods; fem. acc. sg.
glossary.ἀνήγαγε: ἀνάγω — lead up, bring up; aor. 3 sg., augmented: ’led up, brought up’
glossary.ἀνίαζ: ἀνιάζω — be distressed, grow weary, be vexed; impf. 3 sg., unaugmented, elided (ἀνίαζ’ = ἀνίαζε)
glossary.ἀναβαινέμεν: ἀναβαίνω — go up, go aboard, embark; pres. inf., epic -έμεν (= Attic ἀναβαίνειν)
glossary.ἀναρπάξασα: ἀναρπάζω — snatch up, carry off; aor. act. part. fem. nom. sg.: ’having snatched up’
glossary.ἀνειρόμενος: ἀνείρομαι — ask, inquire; pres. part. masc. nom. sg.: ’asking’
glossary.ἀπήμονες: ἀπήμων — unharmed, unscathed, safe; adj., masc. nom. pl.
glossary.ἀπήμων: ἀπήμων — unharmed, safe; adj., masc./fem. nom. sg. (νόστος ἀπήμων ’a safe homecoming’)
glossary.ἀπόλωλεν: ἀπόλλυμι — destroy; mid.-pass. perish, be lost, die; perf. 3 sg. with vivid narrative force: ’has perished, is dead’
glossary.ἀριθμόν: ἀριθμός — number, count, total; masc. acc. sg.
glossary.ἀρχοὶ: ἀρχός — leader, chief; masc. nom. pl.
glossary.ἀσπασίως: ἀσπάσιος — glad, welcome; adv. ἀσπασίως: ’gladly, joyfully’
glossary.ἀτρέος: Ἀτρεύς — Atreus, father of Agamemnon and Menelaus; masc. gen. sg.
glossary.ἀτρεΐδεω: Ἀτρεΐδης — son of Atreus; masc. gen. sg., epic -εω (= Attic -ου)
glossary.ἁλιοτρεφέων: ἁλιοτρεφής — sea-bred, sea-nurtured (ἅλς + τρέφω); adj., masc./fem. gen. pl., rare compound
glossary.ἁλμυρὸν: ἁλμυρός — briny, salty; adj., neut. acc. sg. (agreeing with ὕδωρ)
glossary.ἁλός: ἅλς — sea, salt water; fem. gen. sg.
glossary.ἁπτόμενος: ἅπτω — mid. ἅπτομαι, take hold of, touch (+ gen.); pres. part. masc. nom. sg.: ’taking hold of’
glossary.ἄκλαυτον: ἄκλαυτος — unwept, without tears (ἀ- + κλαίω); adj., masc./fem. acc. sg.
glossary.ἄλλοισίν: ἄλλος — other; adj., masc. dat. pl.: ’to the others’
glossary.ἄνωγεν: ἄνωγα (defective, perf. with pres. force) — command, bid, order; 3 sg., ν-movable, used with past narrative force (+ inf.): ’commands, bade’
glossary.ἐείκοσι: εἴκοσι — twenty; numeral, indeclinable, epic prothetic ἐ- (ἐείκοσι = εἴκοσι)
glossary.ἐξεσάωσε: ἐκσαόω (= ἐκσῴζω) — save, bring safely out of; aor. 3 sg.: ’saved, brought safely out’
glossary.ἐπεβήσετο: ἐπιβαίνω — set foot upon, step upon (+ gen.); aor. mid. 3 sg.: ’set foot upon’
glossary.ἐπελήθετο: ἐπιλανθάνομαι — forget (+ gen.); aor. mid. 3 sg.: ’forgot’
glossary.ἐπεμήδετο: ἐπιμήδομαι — devise, plot against (+ dat.); impf. mid. 3 sg.: ’was devising against’
glossary.ἐπεσσύμεθ: ἐπισεύομαι — rush upon, hasten against; perf. mid. 1 pl. with pres. force, elided (ἐπεσσύμεθ’ = ἐπεσσύμεθα): ’we rushed upon’
glossary.ἐρύκομαι: ἐρύκω — hold back, detain, keep; pres. pass. 1 sg.: ’I am held back’
glossary.ἐσχατιήν: ἐσχατιή — edge, border, outlying land; fem. acc. sg.
glossary.ἐφαίνετο: φαίνομαι — appear, seem; impf. 3 sg.: ’was appearing, seemed’
glossary.ἐφεζόμενος: ἐφέζομαι — sit upon (+ dat.); pres. part. masc. nom. sg.: ’sitting upon’
glossary.ἐφράσσατο: φράζομαι (mid. of φράζω) — devise, contrive, think of; aor. mid. 3 sg., with geminated σ by metre (= ἐφράσατο): ’devised’
glossary.ἐφόρει: φορέω — carry, bear (along, repeatedly); impf. 3 sg.: ’was carrying, bore along’
glossary.ἐχθόμενός: ἔχθομαι — be hated (+ dat.); pres. part. masc. nom. sg., passive sense: ’being hated’
glossary.ἑλὼν: αἱρέω — take, seize, grasp; aor. act. part. masc. nom. sg. (ἑλών): ’having seized’
glossary.ἑξῆς: ἑξῆς — in order, one after another; adv. (by-form of ἑξείης)
glossary.ἑτάρων: ἑταῖρος (epic ἕταρος) — companion, comrade; masc. gen. pl. (= Attic ἑταίρων)
glossary.ἑτέρωθι: ἑτέρωθι — elsewhere, in another place; adv.
glossary.ἔκβαλε: ἐκβάλλω — cast out, throw out, let slip (a word); aor. 3 sg., unaugmented (= ἐξέβαλε) · also of trees, ’fell, cut down’
glossary.ἔκταθεν: κτείνω — kill, slay; aor. pass. 3 pl. (root κτα-); its augment status is left undescribed for want of certainty: ’were slain’
glossary.ἔκφυγε: ἐκφεύγω — flee out, escape; aor. 3 sg., unaugmented (= ἐξέφυγε)
glossary.ἔμπεσε: ἐμπίπτω — fall into, fall upon (+ dat.); aor. 3 sg., unaugmented: ’fell into’
glossary.ἔναιε: ναίω — dwell, inhabit, live; impf. 3 sg., augmented: ’was dwelling, lived’
glossary.ἔνδιος: ἔνδιος — at midday, at noon; adj. used adverbially
glossary.ἔνεικε: φέρω (suppletive aor. stem ἐνεκ-) — bring, carry; aor. 3 sg.; whether this form has lost an augment is uncertain: ’brought’
glossary.ἔσχετο: ὑπισχνέομαι (aor. mid. of ἔχω; in tmesis ὑπὸ ... ἔσχετο = ὑπέσχετο) — promise; aor. mid. 3 sg.: ’promised’ · also ἔχω (ἴσχω) — hold, check; aor. mid. 3 sg.: ’was checked’ (θαλερὴ ἔσχετο φωνή)
glossary.ἔσχισεν: σχίζω — split, cleave; aor. 3 sg. (in tmesis ἀπὸ ... ἔσχισεν = ἀπέσχισεν): ’split off’
glossary.ἔχομεν: ἔχω — have, hold; pres./impf. 1 pl. (the form does not distinguish tense), past force in narration: ’we held (on)’
glossary.ἔχουσι: ἔχω — have, hold; pres. 3 pl.: ’they hold’
glossary.ἕλοις: αἱρέω — take, seize, catch; aor. opt. 2 sg.: ’you might take, catch’
glossary.ἠοίην: ἠοῖος — of morning, at dawn; adj., fem. acc. sg. used substantively for ’the morning’ (πᾶσαν ἠοίην ’the whole morning’), acc. of duration
glossary.ἠυγένειος: ἠυγένειος (= ἐυγένειος) — well-maned, fine-bearded (ἐύ- + γένειον); adj., masc. nom. sg.
glossary.ἡδὺ: ἡδύς — sweet, pleasant; adj., neut. acc. sg. used adverbially: ’sweetly’
glossary.ἤλασε: ἐλαύνω — drive, strike; aor. 3 sg.: ’drove, struck’
glossary.ἤλθομεν: ἔρχομαι — go, come; aor. 1 pl.: ’we came’
glossary.ἥρη: Ἥρη (Ionic/epic by-form of Ἥρα) — Hera, wife of Zeus; fem. nom. sg.
glossary.ἰάχοντες: ἰάχω — shout, cry out; pres. part. masc. nom. pl.: ’shouting’
glossary.ἰδέειν: ὁράω (aor. stem εἰδ-) — see; aor. inf., epic uncontracted (= Attic ἰδεῖν)
glossary.ἵξεσθαι: ἱκνέομαι — come to, reach, arrive at; fut. inf. mid. (ἵξομαι), after ἔμελλε: ’to be about to reach’
glossary.ἵπποισιν: ἵππος — horse; masc./fem. dat. pl., epic -οισι(ν) (= Attic ἵπποις)
glossary.ὀδμή: ὀδμή — smell, odor, scent; fem. nom. sg.
glossary.ὀλοώτατος: ὀλοός — deadly, destructive, baneful; adj., superl. masc. nom. sg.: ’most deadly’
glossary.ὄλεσσε: ὄλλυμι — destroy; aor. 3 sg., unaugmented (= ὤλεσε)
glossary.ὄνειαρ: ὄνειαρ — help, benefit, remedy, boon; neut. nom./acc. sg.
glossary.ὄχεσφιν: ὄχος — chariot; masc./neut. dat.-instr. pl., old case-suffix -φι(ν) (= Attic ὄχοις)
glossary.ὑγρὸν: ὑγρός — wet, moist, flowing; adj., neut. nom./acc. sg. (agreeing with ὕδωρ) · also agreeing with ἔλαιον: ’liquid (oil)’
glossary.ὑπάλυξεν: ὑπαλύσκω — slip away from, escape; aor. 3 sg.: ’slipped away, got clear away’
glossary.ὑπερφίαλον: ὑπερφίαλος — overweening, arrogant, presumptuous; adj., neut. acc. sg.
glossary.ὑποδῦσα: ὑποδύω — dive under, slip beneath; aor. act. part. fem. nom. sg.: ’having dived under’
glossary.ὑψιπέτηλον: ὑψιπέτηλος — high-leaved, tall-leaved (ὑψι- + πέταλον); adj., neut. nom./acc. sg.
glossary.ὠΐσθη: ὀΐομαι — suppose, think, suspect; aor. pass. (deponent) 3 sg., uncontracted (= Attic ᾠήθη): ’suspected’
glossary.ὤλετ: ὄλλυμι — mid. ὄλλυμαι, perish, be lost, die; aor. mid. 3 sg., elided (ὤλετ’ = ὤλετο): ’perished’
glossary.ὤφελλες: ὀφείλω — owe, be obligated; impf. 2 sg. + inf., idiom for an unfulfilled past obligation, without ἄν: ’you ought to have...’
glossary.ῥέξας: ῥέζω — do, perform (a sacrifice); aor. act. part. masc. nom. sg.: ’having performed’ · also general, not of a sacrifice, ’do, act (to someone)’: οὔτε τινὰ ῥέξας ἐξαίσιον
glossary.ῥέξῃς: ῥέζω — do, perform (a sacrifice); aor. subj. 2 sg.: ’you might perform’
glossary.ῥῖνα: ῥίς — nose; fem. acc. sg. (ὑπὸ ῥῖνα ’beneath the nose’)
glossary.αἰγίβοτος: αἰγίβοτος — goat-pasturing, goat-grazed; adj. (2-term.), fem. nom. sg., predicative (of Ithaca)
glossary.αἰγανέῃσιν: αἰγανέη — light javelin, hunting-spear; fem. dat. pl., epic -ῃσιν (= Attic -αις)
glossary.αἵματός: αἷμα — blood; neut. gen. sg. (αἵματος ἀγαθοῖο ’of good blood’)
glossary.βιοτὴ: βιοτή — life, livelihood; fem. nom. sg. (ῥηίστη βιοτὴ ’the easiest life’)
glossary.γίγνεται: γίγνομαι — come to be, happen, arise; pres. 3 sg. (χρεὼ γίγνεται ’a need arises’)
glossary.γαμβρὸς: γαμβρός — son-in-law, relative by marriage; masc. nom. sg.
glossary.δήομεν: δήω — find; defective verb (pres.-stem forms only), short-vowel subj. 1 pl. with future sense: ’we shall find’ (= Attic εὑρήσομεν)
glossary.δίσκοισιν: δίσκος — discus; masc. dat. pl., epic -οισιν (= Attic -οις), dat. of means: ’with discuses’
glossary.δαιτυμόνες: δαιτυμών — guest at a feast, feaster; masc. nom. pl.
glossary.δαμασαίμην: δαμάζω — tame, break in, subdue; aor. opt. mid. 1 sg., potential with κε: ’I might break in (for myself)’
glossary.δαπέδῳ: δάπεδον — level ground, floor, pavement; neut. dat. sg. (τυκτῷ δαπέδῳ ’on the wrought, levelled floor’)
glossary.δεῖπνον: δεῖπνον — meal, supper; neut. acc. sg. (περὶ δεῖπνον ’about the meal’)
glossary.διαβήμεναι: διαβαίνω — cross over, pass across; aor. inf., epic -μεναι (= Attic διαβῆναι)
glossary.δοίης: δίδωμι — give; aor. opt. 2 sg.: ’you might give’
glossary.δρόμοι: δρόμος — running-track, race-course; masc. nom. pl.
glossary.δώρων: δῶρον — gift; neut. gen. pl., partitive with κειμήλια: ’of the gifts’
glossary.εὐρέες: εὐρύς — wide, broad; masc. nom. pl., epic uncontracted (= Attic εὐρεῖς)
glossary.εὐρέος: εὐρύς — wide, broad; gen. sg., agreeing with πεδίοιο: ’of a wide plain’
glossary.εὐρυφυὲς: εὐρυφυής — broad-growing, spreading wide (εὐρύς + φύω); adj., neut. nom. sg. (κρῖ ... εὐρυφυὲς ’broad-growing barley’)
glossary.εὐρύχορον: εὐρύχορος — with wide dancing-places, spacious; adj., fem. acc. sg. (Ἤλιδ’ ἐς εὐρύχορον ’to spacious Elis’)
glossary.ζειαί: ζειά — spelt (a grain); fem. nom. pl.
glossary.ζώειν: ζώω — live; pres. inf., epic uncontracted (= Attic ζῆν)
glossary.θέσφατόν: θέσφατος — declared/decreed by a god, fated; adj., neut. nom. sg. (θέσφατόν ἐστι ’it is fated, god-decreed’)
glossary.θήλειαι: θῆλυς — female; adj., fem. nom. pl. (ἵπποι ... θήλειαι ’mares’)
glossary.θαλερὸν: θαλερός — blooming, vigorous, swelling; adj., neut. acc. sg. (θαλερὸν δάκρυ ’a swelling tear’) · also masc. acc. sg. (θαλερὸν γάμον ’a flourishing marriage’)
glossary.θανών: θνῄσκω — die; aor. part. masc. nom. sg.: ’having died, dead’
glossary.κάλλιστον: καλός — beautiful, fine; superl. κάλλιστος, neut. nom./acc. sg.: ’fairest, finest’
glossary.καθῆστο: κάθημαι — sit; plpf.-in-form 3 sg. with impf. sense: ’was sitting’
glossary.καλλικρήδεμνοι: καλλικρήδεμνος — fair-veiled, with a beautiful headband (κρήδεμνον); adj., fem. nom. pl.
glossary.καλυψοῦς: Καλυψώ — Calypso, a nymph; fem. gen. sg.
glossary.κατέπαυσα: καταπαύω — bring to a stop, check, appease; aor. 1 sg.
glossary.κατέρεξεν: καταρρέζω — stroke, caress (with the hand); aor. 3 sg.
glossary.κατήλθομεν: κατέρχομαι — come/go down; aor. 1 pl. (distinct stem from κατήλυθον, same sense)
glossary.κειμήλια: κειμήλιον — treasure, thing laid up, keepsake (from κεῖμαι); neut. nom./acc. pl.
glossary.κεκλίαται: κλίνω — lean, lie; perf. pass.-in-form 3 pl., Ionic -αται (= Attic κέκλινται): ’lie’ (of islands lying on the sea)
glossary.κεκράανται: κραίνω — accomplish, bring to pass, finish off; perf. pass. 3 pl., epic diectasis (= κέκρανται): ’are finished, wrought’ (of metalwork, agreeing with neut. pl. χείλεα)
glossary.κεῖσέ: κεῖσε — thither, to that place; adv.
glossary.κιχήσεαι: κιχάνω — come upon, reach, find; fut. mid. 2 sg. (κιχήσεαι = Attic κιχήσῃ): ’you shall find, come upon’
glossary.κλαίων: κλαίω — weep, wail; pres. part. masc. nom. sg.
glossary.κλαῖ: κλαίω — weep, wail; pres. imper. 2 sg., elided (κλαῖ’ = κλαῖε)
glossary.κορέσθην: κορέννυμι — sate, glut, fill; aor. pass.-in-form (deponent) 1 sg., unaugmented (= ἐκορέσθην): ’I had my fill’, + two agreeing nom. participles for what one had enough of
glossary.κτεῖνεν: κτείνω — kill, slay; aor. 3 sg., used with future force, of an act pictured as already accomplished: ’will have killed’
glossary.κυλινδόμενός: κυλίνδομαι — roll, roll about, writhe (in grief); pres. part. masc. nom. sg.
glossary.κύπειρον: κύπειρον — galingale, a marsh sedge; neut. nom. sg.
glossary.λαέρτεω: Λαέρτης — Laertes, father of Odysseus; masc. gen. sg., epic -εω (= Attic -ου)
glossary.λείψω: λείπω — leave, leave behind; fut. 1 sg.
glossary.λειμών: λειμών — meadow, grassland; masc. nom. sg.
glossary.λευκόν: λευκός — white, bright; adj., neut. nom./acc. sg. (κρῖ ... λευκόν ’white barley’)
glossary.λιγὺ: λιγύς — clear-sounding, shrill; adj., neut. acc. sg. used adverbially: ’shrilly’ (λιγὺ πνείοντος ’blowing shrill’)
glossary.λωτὸς: λωτός — lotus; here read as a kind of clover or trefoil grazed by horses, the ordinary sense in a pastoral list; masc. nom. sg.
glossary.μήλοισι: μῆλον — sheep, goat, flock-animal; neut. dat. pl., epic -οισι (= Attic -οις)
glossary.μεταστήσω: μεθίστημι — change, alter, substitute; fut. 1 sg.
glossary.ναίων: ναίω — dwell, inhabit; pres. part. masc. nom. sg.: ’dwelling’
glossary.νεόμην: νέομαι — return, go home; impf. 1 sg., inceptive force: ’I set out for home’
glossary.νεῖτ: νέομαι — return, go home; pres. 3 sg. (νεῖται, contracted from νέεται) with future sense, elided (νεῖτ’ = νεῖται): ’is to return’
glossary.νηλήιον: Νηλήιος — Neleian, of Neleus, founder-king of Pylos; adj., masc. acc. sg.
glossary.νιφετός: νιφετός — snowfall, snowstorm; masc. nom. sg.
glossary.νοήμων: Νοήμων — Noemon, son of Phronius, an Ithacan who lent Telemachus his ship; masc. nom. sg.
glossary.νύμφης: νύμφη — nymph, young bride; fem. gen. sg.
glossary.νῆά: ναῦς — ship; acc. sg., epic νῆα, here with an added acute before the following enclitic μοι (νῆά μοι)
glossary.οἴχεσθαι: οἴχομαι — be gone, have gone off; pres. inf., perfect sense: ’to have gone off’ (in indirect statement after ἔφαντο)
glossary.οὕνεκ: οὕνεκα — because, for that reason; conj., elided (οὕνεκ’ = οὕνεκα)
glossary.πάμπρωτον: πάμπρωτος — first of all, very first; adj., neut. acc. sg. used adverbially: ’first of all’
glossary.πέλει: πέλω — be, come to be, exist; pres. 3 sg. (= Attic ἐστί): ’there is’
glossary.πέμποιεν: πέμπω — send, convey, escort; pres. opt. 3 pl., potential in a relative clause of characteristic: ’who might convey’
glossary.πέμψουσιν: πέμπω — send, convey, escort; fut. 3 pl.: ’they will send’
glossary.παρέμμεναι: πάρειμι — be near, be present; pres. inf., epic -μεναι (= Attic παρεῖναι)
glossary.πασέων: πᾶς — all, every; fem. gen. pl. πασέων, epic (= Attic πασῶν)
glossary.πείρα: πειράω — try, attempt, make an effort; pres. imper. 2 sg.: ’try!’
glossary.πεδίοιο: πεδίον — plain; neut. gen. sg., epic -οιο (= Attic -ου), governed by ἀνάσσεις · also gen. of the space traversed: κονίοντες πεδίοιο ’raising dust over the plain’
glossary.πνείοντος: πνέω — blow, breathe; pres. part. masc. gen. sg., agreeing with Ζεφύροιο: ’blowing’
glossary.πολιὴν: πολιός — grey, hoary; adj., fem. acc. sg. (πολιὴν ἅλα ’the grey sea’)
glossary.πολύς: πολύς — much, many; masc. nom. sg.
glossary.πολὺς: πολύς — much, many; masc. nom. sg., grave accent, mid-clause form (χειμὼν πολὺς ’much winter storm’)
glossary.προσηύδων: προσαυδάω — speak to, address; impf. 1 sg. (καί μιν ... προσηύδων ’I addressed him’)
glossary.πόθος: πόθος — longing, yearning; masc. nom. sg.
glossary.πύλῳ: Πύλος — Pylos, city in the Peloponnese; fem. dat. sg.
glossary.σιδονίων: Σιδόνιος — Sidonian, of Sidon (Phoenician city); adj./noun, masc. gen. pl.: ’of the Sidonians’
glossary.σπένδῃσθα: σπένδω — pour a libation; pres. subj. mid. 2 sg., epic -ῃσθα (= Attic σπένδῃ)
glossary.στῆσα: ἵστημι — set, make stand; aor. 1 sg. transitive: ’I brought to a stand, moored’ (νέας ’the ships’)
glossary.τέκος: τέκος — child, offspring; neut. voc. sg. (φίλον τέκος ’dear child’)
glossary.ταλαεργοὶ: ταλαεργός — enduring toil, hard-working; adj., masc. nom. pl., standing epithet of mules
glossary.τελευτήσας: τελευτάω — bring to an end, complete, finish; aor. part. masc. nom. sg.: ’having finished’
glossary.τετυγμένον: τεύχω — make, fashion, construct; perf. pass. part. masc. acc. sg.: ’wrought, well-made’
glossary.τεῒν: σύ — you (sg.); epic dat. sg. τεΐν (= Attic σοί)
glossary.τιθέμεσθα: τίθημι — put, place, set; impf. mid. 1 pl., epic -μεσθα (= Attic -μεθα): ’we set, were setting (for ourselves)’
glossary.τιμηέστατόν: τιμήεις — held in honour, precious, prized; adj., superl. τιμηέστατος, neut. nom. sg.: ’most honoured, most prized’
glossary.τοιαῦτα: τοιοῦτος — such, of such a kind; demonstr. pron./adj., neut. nom./acc. pl.: ’such things’
glossary.τυκτῷ: τυκτός — wrought, made, fashioned (from τεύχω); adj., neut. dat. sg. (τυκτῷ δαπέδῳ ’the wrought, levelled floor’)
glossary.χέοντα: χέω — pour; pres. part. masc. acc. sg., tmesis κατὰ ... χέοντα = καταχέοντα: ’pouring down, shedding’
glossary.χειμὼν: χειμών — winter, winter storm; masc. nom. sg.
glossary.χεῦ: χέω — pour; aor. 3 sg., elided (χεῦ’ = χεῦε), idiomatic of heaping up a mound: ’heaped up’ (τύμβον χεῦε ’raised a tomb’) · also of sleep poured over the eyes, the standard onset-of-sleep formula: ὕπνον ἐπ’ ὄμμασι χεῦ’ ’poured sleep upon his eyes’
glossary.χρεὼ: χρεώ — need, necessity; fem. nom. sg. (indeclinable), impersonal with γίγνεται: ’a need arises’
glossary.ἀήτας: ἀήτης — gust, blast, breeze; masc. acc. pl.
glossary.ἀγαθοῖο: ἀγαθός — good, noble; adj., neut. gen. sg., epic -οιο (= Attic -οῦ)
glossary.ἀγλαὰ: ἀγλαός — splendid, shining, glorious; adj., neut. acc. pl. (ἀγλαὰ δῶρα ’splendid gifts’)
glossary.ἀγρῶν: ἀγρός — field, countryside; masc. gen. pl.
glossary.ἀγόρευον: ἀγορεύω — speak, say, declare; impf. 3 pl.
glossary.ἀδμῆτες: ἀδμής — unbroken, untamed, unyoked; adj., masc. nom. pl.
glossary.ἀθανάτοις: ἀθάνατος — immortal, deathless; adj., masc. dat. pl.
glossary.ἀμφεκάλυψε: ἀμφικαλύπτω — enclose, cover round, shelter; aor. 3 sg. (ἀμφί + καλύπτω): ’sheltered, enclosed’
glossary.ἀνάσσεις: ἀνάσσω — rule, be lord (+ gen.); pres. 2 sg.
glossary.ἀνίησιν: ἀνίημι — send up, let go, release; pres. 3 sg.
glossary.ἀναψύχειν: ἀναψύχω — refresh, cool, revive; pres. inf., epexegetic: ’so as to refresh’
glossary.ἀνεχοίμην: ἀνέχομαι — hold out, endure, bear to remain; pres. opt. mid. 1 sg., potential with κε: ’I could bear to remain’
glossary.ἀνιάζουσιν: ἀνιάζω — be distressed, grow anxious/grieved; pres. 3 pl.
glossary.ἀντίνοον: Ἀντίνοος — Antinous, a leading suitor; masc. acc. sg.
glossary.ἀντιβολήσαις: ἀντιβολέω — meet, come upon, encounter (+ gen.); aor. opt. 2 sg., potential with κε: ’you might come upon’ (τάφου ’his funeral rites’)
glossary.ἀντιθέοις: ἀντίθεος — godlike, equal to the gods; adj., masc. dat. pl.
glossary.ἀργύρεος: ἀργύρεος — silver, made of silver; adj., masc. nom. sg.
glossary.ἀρετῇ: ἀρετή — excellence, virtue, prowess; fem. dat. sg., dat. of respect: ’in excellence’
glossary.ἀχνυμένῳ: ἄχνυμαι — grieve, be distressed; pres. part. masc. dat. sg.: ’grieved (though I was)’
glossary.ἄνυσίν: ἄνυσις — accomplishment, result, success (from ἀνύω); fem. acc. sg.
glossary.ἄξομαι: ἄγω — lead, bring; fut. mid. 1 sg.: ’I will lead away, take (for myself)’
glossary.ἄσβεστον: ἄσβεστος — unquenchable, inextinguishable (ἀ- + σβέννυμι); adj., neut. nom./acc. sg. (ἄσβεστον κλέος ’fame unquenchable’)
glossary.ἅπας: ἅπας — all, the whole of, entirely; adj., masc. nom. sg. (ἀργύρεος ... ἔστιν ἅπας ’it is entirely silver’)
glossary.ἐίσῃς: ἐΐσος (= ἴσος) — equal, well-balanced, symmetrical; adj., fem. dat. pl. (νηυσὶν ἐίσῃς ’well-balanced ships’)
glossary.ἐθάμβεον: θαμβέω — be astonished, marvel; impf. 3 pl.
glossary.ἐλασσάμενος: ἐλαύνω — drive, drive off; aor. part. mid. masc. nom. sg.: ’having driven off (for himself)’
glossary.ἐμέθεν: ἐγώ — I; epic gen. sg. ἐμέθεν (= Attic ἐμοῦ): ’of me’
glossary.ἐμοῖσιν: ἐμός — my, mine; adj., masc./neut. dat. pl., epic -οισιν (= Attic -οις)
glossary.ἐνιαυτὸν: ἐνιαυτός — year; masc. acc. sg., acc. of duration: ’for a year’
glossary.ἐπήρατος: ἐπήρατος — lovely, desired, charming; adj., masc./fem. nom. sg.
glossary.ἐπισπεῖν: ἐφέπω — follow, meet, come upon (+ acc., of fate); aor. inf. ἐπισπεῖν
glossary.ἐρετμοῖς: ἐρετμόν — oar; neut. dat. pl., instrumental: ’with oars’
glossary.ἐρύκεις: ἐρύκω — hold back, detain, keep; pres. 2 sg.
glossary.ἐρύσσαμεν: ἐρύω — draw, drag (a ship down to the sea); aor. 1 pl., epic double-σ
glossary.ἐυήνορα: ἐυήνωρ — making men brave, heartening (ἐύ + ἀνήρ); adj., masc. acc. sg. (ἐυήνορα οἶνον ’heartening wine’)
glossary.ἐυλείμων: ἐυλείμων — rich in meadow, well-meadowed; adj., masc./fem. nom. sg.
glossary.ἐύξοον: ἐύξοος — well-polished, well-carved (ἐύ + ξέω); adj., masc. acc. sg. (δίφρον ἐύξοον ’a well-polished chariot’) · also neut. acc. sg., agreeing with a neut. noun: ’well-polished bow’ (τόξον ἐύξοον)
glossary.ἑλένην: Ἑλένη — Helen, wife of Menelaus; fem. acc. sg.
glossary.ἑὸς: ἑός — his own, her own (3rd-person possessive adj., epic, = possessive ὅς); masc. nom. sg. (ἑὸς δόμος ’his own house’)
glossary.ἔξοχ: ἔξοχα — exceedingly, surpassingly; adv., elided (ἔξοχ’ = ἔξοχα)
glossary.ἔπεσσί: ἔπος — word, speech; neut. dat. pl., epic -εσσι(ν) (= Attic ἔπεσι)
glossary.ἔφαντο: φημί — say; mid. ’think, suppose, believe’; impf. mid. 3 pl.: ’they supposed’
glossary.ἕλοι: αἱρέω — take, seize, take hold of; aor. opt. 3 sg., potential with κε: ’would take hold of’ (of longing, + gen.)
glossary.ἠγαθέῃ: ἠγάθεος — very holy, sacred (intensive formation); adj., fem. dat. sg. (Πύλῳ ἠγαθέῃ ’holy Pylos’)
glossary.ἠλύσιον: Ἠλύσιος — Elysian; adj., neut. acc. sg. (Ἠλύσιον πεδίον ’the Elysian plain’)
glossary.ἡφαίστοιο: Ἥφαιστος — Hephaestus, god of the forge; masc. gen. sg., epic -οιο (= Attic -ου)
glossary.ἤλιδ: Ἦλις — Elis, region in the Peloponnese; fem. acc. sg., elided (Ἤλιδ’ = Ἤλιδα)
glossary.ἥμενος: ἧμαι — sit; pres. part. masc. nom. sg.: ’sitting’
glossary.ἦγον: ἄγω — lead, bring, drive; impf. 3 pl.
glossary.ἰάνθη: ἰαίνω — warm, gladden, cheer; aor. pass. 3 sg.: ’was warmed, was gladdened’
glossary.ἰθάκη: Ἰθάκη — Ithaca, Odysseus’ island home; fem. nom. sg.
glossary.ἱέντες: ἵημι — throw, hurl, let fly; pres. part. masc. nom. pl.: ’throwing’
glossary.ἱππήλατος: ἱππήλατος — fit for driving horses upon; adj., fem. nom. sg.
glossary.ἱπποβότῳ: ἱππόβοτος — horse-pasturing, grazed by horses; adj., neut. dat. sg.
glossary.ἱστοὺς: ἱστός — mast; masc. acc. pl. · also loom, web: ἱστοὺς ὑφόωσι ’weave at the looms’
glossary.ἴσχει: ἴσχω — hold, hold back, restrain (intensive of ἔχω); pres. 3 sg.
glossary.ὀπάσσαι: ὀπάζω — grant, bestow, give as a companion-gift; aor. inf., epic double-σ
glossary.ὁρᾶν: ὁράω — see, look upon; pres. inf. (= Attic ὁρᾶν)
glossary.ὄμβρος: ὄμβρος — rain, rainstorm; masc. nom. sg.
glossary.ὑποφθάμενος: ὑποφθάνω — get ahead of, forestall, anticipate; aor. part. masc. nom. sg.: ’forestalling’
glossary.ὠκεανὸς: Ὠκεανός — Oceanus, the river encircling the world; masc. nom. sg.
glossary.ῥαδάμανθυς: Ῥαδάμανθυς — Rhadamanthus, a judge of the dead in Elysium; masc. nom. sg.
glossary.ῥηίστη: ῥᾴδιος — easy; adj., superl. ῥηίστη (epic, = Attic ῥᾴστη), fem. nom. sg.: ’easiest’
glossary.αἰτίζῃ: αἰτίζω — ask, beg; pres. subj. 3 sg., generalizing (’whenever he asks’)
glossary.αὐτοῖς: αὐτός — self; masc. dat. pl., intensive with σφίσι: ’for themselves’
glossary.βάντα: βαίνω — go, step; aor. part. masc. acc. sg. (κατ’ οὐδοῦ βάντα ’having stepped down at the threshold’)
glossary.βίην: βίη — strength, might, force; fem. acc. sg.
glossary.βίῃ: βίη — strength, force; fem. dat. sg. used adverbially: ’by force’
glossary.βαίνοντ: βαίνω — go, step; pres. part. masc. acc. sg., elided (βαίνοντ’ = βαίνοντα): ’stepping, boarding’
glossary.βασίλεια: βασίλεια — queen, princess; fem. voc. sg., address to Penelope · also nom. sg., third-person reference rather than address: ’the queen’ (πολυμνήστη βασίλεια ’the much-wooed queen’) · also fem. voc. sg., address to Arete: ’O queen’
glossary.βουλὰς: βουλή — plan, counsel; fem. acc. pl.
glossary.βυσσοδόμευον: βυσσοδομεύω — devise secretly, brood over (in one’s heart); impf. 3 pl., unaugmented: ’were secretly devising’
glossary.γοόωσα: γοάω — wail, sob, lament; pres. part. fem. nom. sg., epic uncontracted (= Attic γοῶσα)
glossary.γούνατα: γόνυ — knee; neut. nom. pl., epic γούνατα (= Attic γόνατα)
glossary.δίκη: δίκη — custom, right, the way things are done; fem. nom. sg.
glossary.δακρυόφι: δάκρυ — tear; instrumental in -φι, epic: ’with tears’
glossary.δαναοῖσιν: Δαναοί — the Danaans (a name for the Greeks); masc. dat. pl., epic -οισι(ν)
glossary.δειπνήσειαν: δειπνέω — dine, take a meal; aor. opt. 3 pl., in a wish: ’might they dine’
glossary.δμῶ: δμώς — slave, thrall (male, taken in war); masc. acc. sg., elided (δμῶ’ = δμῶα)
glossary.δμῶές: δμώς — slave, thrall (male); masc. nom. pl.
glossary.δολίον: Δολίος — Dolios, an old household slave, gardener of Penelope and Laertes; masc. acc. sg.
glossary.δόσιν: δόσις — gift, giving; fem. acc. sg.
glossary.δύναιτό: δύναμαι — be able, can; pres. opt. 3 sg. with κε, potential: ’he could’
glossary.δῶκα: δίδωμι — give; aor. 1 sg., unaugmented (= ἔδωκα)
glossary.δῶκας: δίδωμι — give; aor. 2 sg., unaugmented (= ἔδωκας)
glossary.δῶμ: δῶμα — house, home; neut. acc. sg., elided (δῶμ’ = δῶμα)
glossary.εἰπέμεναι: εἶπον — say, tell; aor. inf., epic (= Attic εἰπεῖν)
glossary.θέσθε: τίθημι — put, place; aor. mid. 2 pl., unaugmented (= ἔθεσθε): ’you put (in your minds)’
glossary.θαλερὴ: θαλερός — blooming, vigorous, full; fem. nom. sg., epithet of the voice or of tears · also of fat: ’abundant’ (θαλερὴ ἀλοιφή)
glossary.θαυμάζω: θαυμάζω — marvel at, wonder; pres. 1 sg.
glossary.θείων: θεῖος — divine, godlike; masc. gen. pl.
glossary.θυμολέοντα: θυμολέων — lion-hearted; masc. acc. sg., compound epithet (θυμός + λέων)
glossary.θυμοφθόρον: θυμοφθόρος — soul-destroying, heart-consuming; neut. nom. sg., agreeing with ἄχος
glossary.θύελλαι: θύελλα — storm-wind, whirlwind; fem. nom. pl.
glossary.θῆτές: θής — hired laborer, one who works for wages; masc. nom. pl.
glossary.κάθισαν: καθίζω — make sit down, seat; aor. 3 pl., causative: ’they made (them) sit down’
glossary.καλέσειε: καλέω — call, summon; aor. opt. 3 sg., in a wish: ’let him call, may he call’
glossary.κατακείρετε: κατακείρω — cut down, waste, consume; pres. 2 pl.
glossary.κατακτάμεν: κατακτείνω — kill, slay; aor. inf., epic (= Attic κατακτεῖναι)
glossary.καταλέξῃ: καταλέγω — recount, tell in order, relate in full; aor. subj. 3 sg., purpose clause: ’so that he may recount’
glossary.κεκασμένον: καίνυμαι — excel, surpass; perf. pass. part. masc. acc. sg., + dat.: ’distinguished (by)’
glossary.κιούσῃ: κίω — go, come; pres. part. fem. dat. sg., agreeing with a dat. pronoun: ’as she came, coming’
glossary.κλῦτε: κλύω — hear, listen; aor. imper. 2 pl., epic: ’hear!’
glossary.κρίνας: κρίνω — pick out, choose, judge; aor. part. masc. nom. sg.: ’having picked out’
glossary.κτῆσιν: κτῆσις — possessions, property; fem. acc. sg.
glossary.κῆπον: κῆπος — garden, orchard; masc. acc. sg.
glossary.λάβε: λαμβάνω — take, seize; aor. 3 sg., unaugmented (= ἔλαβε)
glossary.λίπηται: λείπω — leave, leave behind; aor. pass. subj. 3 sg.: ’might be left’
glossary.λαμπετόωντι: λαμπετάω — blaze, gleam, flash (extended epic form of λάμπω); pres. part. neut./masc. dat. sg., uncontracted: ’blazing’
glossary.λαοῖσιν: λαός — people, host, folk; masc. dat. pl., epic -οισι(ν)
glossary.λεχέων: λέχος — bed, couch; neut. gen. pl.
glossary.λοχήσομαι: λοχάω — lie in wait for, ambush; fut. mid. 1 sg.
glossary.λύτο: λύω — loose, undo; aor. pass. 3 sg., unaugmented root-aorist form (= ἐλύθη): ’was loosed, gave way’
glossary.μέδων: Μέδων — Medon, herald of Odysseus’s household; masc. nom. sg.
glossary.μένεος: μένος — might, fury, passion; neut. gen. sg., genitive of cause: ’with fury’
glossary.μέντορα: Μέντωρ — Mentor, an Ithacan elder, friend of Odysseus, whose shape Athena assumes; masc. acc. sg.
glossary.μέτρον: μέτρον — measure, full measure; neut. acc. sg. (ἥβης μέτρον ’the measure of manhood’)
glossary.μελεδήματα: μελέδημα — care, anxious thought; neut. acc. pl.
glossary.μεμάασι: μέμαα — be eager, be intent on, strive (perf. w/ pres. force); 3 pl. μεμάασι(ν): ’they are eager’
glossary.μεμάασιν: μέμαα — be eager, be intent on, strive (perf. w/ pres. force); 3 pl. μεμάασιν, movable-ν form of μεμάασι: ’they are eager’
glossary.μετέφη: μετάφημι — speak among, address a group; aor. 3 sg.: ’spoke among them’
glossary.μετόπισθ: μετόπισθε — afterward, thereafter, hereafter; adv., elided (μετόπισθ’ = μετόπισθε)
glossary.μεῖζόν: μέγας — great; comparative μείζων, neut. nom./acc. sg. μεῖζον, agreeing with ἄλλο: ’greater’
glossary.μινύριζον: μινυρίζω — moan softly, whimper; impf. 3 pl., unaugmented
glossary.μνηστεύσαντες: μνηστεύω — woo, court, seek in marriage; aor. part. masc. nom. pl.
glossary.νέος: νέος — new, young; masc. nom. sg.
glossary.ναυτίλλεται: ναυτίλλομαι — sail, make a voyage; pres. mid. 3 sg., vivid present for a future event: ’sails, will sail’
glossary.νημερτές: νημερτής — unerring, infallible; neut. acc. sg. used adverbially: ’truly, unerringly’ (νη- ’not’ + the root of ἁμαρτάνω ’miss the mark’)
glossary.νισόμενον: νίσομαι — go, return, journey; pres. part. masc. acc. sg.: ’returning, on his way’
glossary.οἴκτρ: οἰκτρός — pitiable, piteous; neut. acc. pl. used adverbially, elided (οἴκτρ’ = οἰκτρά): ’piteously’
glossary.πίμπλαντ: πίμπλημι — fill; impf. pass. 3 pl., elided (πίμπλαντ’ = πίμπλαντο): ’were filling, were being filled’
glossary.παντοίῃς: παντοῖος — of every kind, of all sorts; fem. dat. pl.
glossary.παρεζόμενος: παρέζομαι — sit down beside; pres. part. masc. nom. sg.
glossary.παύσασθαι: παύω — stop, cease; aor. mid. inf., + gen.: ’to cease from’
glossary.παῦσαν: παύω — stop, cause to cease; aor. 3 pl., causative, + gen.: ’they made (them) stop (from)’
glossary.περόωσι: περάω — cross, pass over/through; pres. 3 pl., epic uncontracted (= Attic περῶσι)
glossary.πλεῖστον: πολύς — much, many; superl. πλεῖστος, neut. nom. sg., predicate with τόδε κακόν: ’greatest, most’
glossary.πλῆσθεν: πίμπλημι — fill; aor. pass. 3 pl., epic apocopated ending -θεν (= -θησαν): ’were filled’
glossary.πολλόν: πολύς — much, many; masc. acc. sg., agreeing with βίοτον: ’much’
glossary.πολυδένδρεον: πολυδένδρεος — many-treed, full of trees; masc. acc. sg., agreeing with κῆπον
glossary.πολυκμήτου: πολύκμητος — much-labored-over, elaborately wrought; masc./neut. gen. sg., agreeing with θαλάμοιο
glossary.πορθμῷ: πορθμός — strait, ferry-passage, channel; masc. dat. sg.
glossary.πουλὺν: πολύς — much, vast (epic πουλύς); masc. acc. sg., fixed phrase πουλὺν ἐφ’ ὑγρήν ’over the vast deep’ (ὑγρή substantival, ’the sea’)
glossary.προσπτύξατο: προσπτύσσομαι — fold oneself toward, embrace, hence entreat, plead with; aor. mid. 3 sg.: ’clasped, entreated’
glossary.πρόεσαν: προίημι — send forth, send out; aor. 3 pl., unaugmented (= Attic προῆκαν): ’they sent forth’
glossary.πρόσθεν: πρόσθεν — before, in front, formerly; adv. (τὸ πρόσθεν ’in time past, formerly’) · also prep. + gen., ’in front of, before’
glossary.πυθόμην: πυνθάνομαι — learn, learn by inquiry; aor. mid. 1 sg., unaugmented, in an unreal-past condition: ’I had learned’
glossary.πότ: πότε — when?; interrog. adv., elided (πότ’ = πότε)
glossary.πύθηται: πυνθάνομαι — learn, inquire; aor. subj. 3 sg., purpose clause: ’so that he may learn’
glossary.πύλονδε: Πύλος — Pylos; + directional suffix -δε: ’to Pylos, Pylos-ward’
glossary.πύματα: πύματος — last, final, hindmost; neut. acc. pl. used adverbially, doubling ὕστατα for emphasis: ’for the very last time’
glossary.σάμοιό: Σάμος — Same, an island near Ithaca (distinct from Samos in the Aegean); gen. sg., epic -οιο (= Attic -ου)
glossary.σφίσι: σφεῖς — they; dat. pl., epic σφίσι, often reflexive: ’to/for themselves’
glossary.σχέτλιαι: σχέτλιος — cruel, hard-hearted, merciless; fem. voc. pl. (form identical to nom.)
glossary.τεθνηκυῖαν: θνήσκω — die; perf. part. fem. acc. sg.: ’dead, having died’
glossary.τελέσειε: τελέω — bring to pass, accomplish, fulfil; aor. opt. 3 sg., in a wish with μή: ’may he not bring to pass’
glossary.τελέσσαι: τελέω — bring to pass, accomplish; aor. inf., epic uncontracted (= Attic τελέσαι)
glossary.τινὰ: τις, τι — someone, something, anyone; indef. pron., masc./fem. acc. sg.
glossary.τοιοῦτος: τοιοῦτος — such, of such a kind; demonstrative pron./adj., masc. nom. sg.
glossary.τοκεῦσιν: τοκεύς — parent, begetter; masc. dat. pl., epic -εῦσι(ν)
glossary.τοσσῶνδ: τοσόσδε — so many, so great (epic τοσσόσδε, deictic -δε compound of τόσος, distinct from the directional -δε of motion); gen. pl. τοσσῶνδε, elided (τοσσῶνδ’ = τοσσῶνδε): ’of so many (of us)’
glossary.τράφεν: τρέφω — nourish, rear, bring up; aor. pass. 3 pl., unaugmented (= ἐτράφησαν): ’were reared, grew up’
glossary.τῇς: ὁ, ἡ, τό — he, she, it; that (in Homer a pronoun; later the article); fem. dat. pl., epic τῇς (= Attic ταῖς): ’to/among them’
glossary.φάμεν: φημί — say, speak; impf. 1 pl., unaugmented (= ἔφαμεν)
glossary.φίλαι: φίλος — dear, beloved; fem. voc. pl., used substantivally: ’friends’ (of the serving-women)
glossary.φαίνεται: φαίνω — show, make appear; pres. mid./pass. 3 sg.: ’appears, is plain to see’
glossary.φθῖσαι: φθίνω — waste away, perish (aor. act. transitive: destroy); aor. act. inf.: ’to destroy’
glossary.φιλοίη: φιλέω — love, befriend; pres. opt. 3 sg., generalizing mood, epic (= Attic φιλοῖ): ’he may love’
glossary.φράζονται: φράζομαι — consider, devise, plot; pres. mid. 3 pl.
glossary.φρένες: φρήν — mind, heart, midriff (seat of feeling); fem. nom. pl.
glossary.φυλάξω: φυλάσσω — guard, watch, watch for; fut. 1 sg.
glossary.χάρις: χάρις — grace, favor, gratitude, thanks; fem. nom. sg.
glossary.χαλεπόν: χαλεπός — hard, difficult, harsh; neut. nom. sg., impersonal predicate: ’(it is) hard’
glossary.χθιζὸν: χθιζός — of yesterday; neut. acc. sg. used adverbially: ’yesterday’
glossary.ἀέκοντος: ἄκων (ἀέκων) — unwilling; masc. gen. sg., idiom βίῃ ἀέκοντος ’by force, against one’s will’ (gen. loosely agreeing with the person referred to)
glossary.ἀγάσσατο: ἄγαμαι — wonder at, be amazed, be indignant at; aor. mid. 3 sg.
glossary.ἀγαπητὸν: ἀγαπητός — beloved, cherished (esp. of an only child); masc. acc. sg.
glossary.ἀγειρόμενοι: ἀγείρω — gather, assemble; pres. part. mid. masc. nom. pl.: ’gathering (together)’
glossary.ἀκλέα: ἀκλεής — without fame, unheralded, inglorious; masc./fem. acc. sg. ἀκλέα, epic uncontracted
glossary.ἀκουὴν: ἀκουή — hearing, news, tidings, report; fem. acc. sg.
glossary.ἀμφασίη: ἀμφασίη — speechlessness, being at a loss for words; fem. nom. sg.
glossary.ἀμφεχύθη: ἀμφιχέω — pour around, envelop; aor. pass. 3 sg.
glossary.ἀμφιμέλαιναι: ἀμφιμέλας — black all about, black on both sides; fem. nom. pl., epithet of φρένες
glossary.ἀνήνασθαι: ἀναίνομαι — refuse, deny, disown; aor. mid. inf.
glossary.ἀνεγεῖραι: ἀνεγείρω — wake up, rouse; aor. act. inf.
glossary.ἀνστάντες: ἀνίστημι — stand up, rise; intrans. aor. part. masc. nom. pl., epic apocope (ἀνστάντες = ἀναστάντες)
glossary.ἀντιθέοιο: ἀντίθεος — godlike; masc. gen. sg., epic -οιο (= Attic -ου)
glossary.ἀργαλεώτερον: ἀργαλέος — grievous, painful, troublesome; comp. neut. nom./acc. sg. ἀργαλεώτερον, agreeing with ἄλλο: ’more grievous’
glossary.ἀρετῇσι: ἀρετή — excellence, virtue, valor; fem. dat. pl., epic -ῃσι(ν) (= Attic -αις)
glossary.ἀριστεύουσι: ἀριστεύω — be best, excel, be foremost; pres. 3 pl.
glossary.ἀρχὸν: ἀρχός — leader, chief; masc. acc. sg.
glossary.ἀτάσθαλον: ἀτάσθαλος — wanton, reckless, presumptuous; masc. acc. sg., adjectival (distinct from the noun ἀτασθαλίαι)
glossary.ἀχνύμενος: ἄχνυμαι — grieve, be vexed, be distressed; pres. part. masc. nom. sg.
glossary.ἁδινὸν: ἁδινός — thick, close-packed, crowded; neut. acc. sg. used adverbially, of weeping: ’in a thick flood, heavily’
glossary.ἄκουσα: ἀκούω — hear; aor. 1 sg., unaugmented (= ἤκουσα)
glossary.ἄλλοθ: ἄλλοτε — at another time, elsewhere, ever again; adv., elided (ἄλλοθ’ = ἄλλοτε)
glossary.ἄμυδις: ἄμυδις — together, at once, in a body; adv.
glossary.ἄρξει: ἄρχω — begin, be first, rule; fut. 3 sg., + complementary inf.: ’he will begin (to be)’
glossary.ἐίκτην: ἔοικα — be like, resemble; plpf. w/ impf. force, dual 3rd pers., agreeing with a dual subject (ὄσσε): ’were like’
glossary.ἐκέλευον: κελεύω — urge, exhort, bid; impf. 3 pl., unaugmented
glossary.ἐξαίρετοι: ἐξαίρετος — picked out, choice, select; masc. nom. pl.
glossary.ἐξαίσιον: ἐξαίσιος — beyond what is fitting, outrageous; neut./masc. acc. sg.
glossary.ἐξελθὼν: ἐξέρχομαι — go out, come out; aor. part. masc. nom. sg. (= ἐξελθών)
glossary.ἐπέων: ἔπος — word, speech; neut. gen. pl.
glossary.ἐπεύθετο: πεύθομαι (epic present by-form of πυνθάνομαι) — learn, inquire, get wind of; impf. mid. 3 sg. ἐπεύθετο, augmented
glossary.ἐπιβαινέμεν: ἐπιβαίνω — go upon, embark on, board; pres. inf., epic -έμεν (= Attic ἐπιβαίνειν), + gen.
glossary.ἐπιστάμεναι: ἐπίσταμαι — know, understand, know well; pres. part. fem. nom. pl.
glossary.ἐπῄνεον: ἐπαινέω — praise, approve, applaud; impf. 3 pl., unaugmented
glossary.ἐρυσσάμενος: ἐρύω — draw, drag, haul; aor. part. mid. masc. nom. sg., of launching a ship: ’having drawn down, having launched’
glossary.ἐσσύμενός: σεύω — drive, hasten, urge on; perf. mid./pass. part. w/ pres. force, masc. nom. sg., + gen.: ’eager (for), hastening (toward)’
glossary.ἐτελέσθη: τελέω — bring to pass, accomplish, fulfil; aor. pass. 3 sg.: ’has been brought to pass’
glossary.ἐυεργέων: εὐεργέω (epic ἐϋεργέω) — do good, do a service, benefit; pres. part. gen. pl., substantival: ’of good deeds done, of benefactions’
glossary.ἐυπείθεος: Εὐπείθης — Eupeithes, father of Antinous; masc. gen. sg., spelled ἐυ- (the edition prints ἐυ-/ἐυ- without a diaeresis)
glossary.ἐφέζεσθαι: ἐφέζομαι — sit down upon, sit on; pres. inf.
glossary.ἐφωρμήθη: ἐφορμάω — stir up, urge on; aor. pass. 3 sg.: ’was stirred, was urged on’
glossary.ἐχθαίρῃσι: ἐχθαίρω — hate; pres. subj. 3 sg., epic ending -ῃσι, generalizing: ’he may hate’
glossary.ἐώργει: ἔοργα (perf. of ἔρδω/ῥέζω) — have done, be wont to do; plpf. w/ impf. force, 3 sg.: ’treated, used to treat’
glossary.ἑκάστη: ἕκαστος — each, each one; fem. nom. sg.
glossary.ἑκών: ἑκών — willing, of one’s own free will; masc. nom. sg.
glossary.ἑοὶ: ὅς, ἥ, ὅν (possessive, enlarged epic form ἑός) — his own, her own; masc. nom. pl. ἑοί: ’his own (men)’
glossary.ἑοῦ: ὅς, ἥ, ὅν (possessive, enlarged epic form ἑός) — his own, her own; masc. gen. sg. ἑοῦ (πατρὸς ἑοῦ ’of his own father’)
glossary.ἔλειπεν: λείπω — leave, leave behind; impf. 3 sg., in an unreal-past conditional: ’would have left’
glossary.ἔμβη: ἐμβαίνω — step into, embark; aor. 3 sg., unaugmented root aorist (= ἐνέβη)
glossary.ἔμεινε: μένω — stay, remain, wait; aor. 3 sg., in an unreal-past conditional: ’would have stayed’
glossary.ἔνισπε: ἐνέπω — tell, relate, declare; aor. imper. 2 sg.: ’tell!’
glossary.ἔπεσσιν: ἔπος — word; neut. dat. pl., epic -εσσι(ν) (= Attic -εσι)
glossary.ἔργων: ἔργον — deed, work, task; neut. gen. pl.
glossary.ἕποντ: ἕπομαι — follow, accompany; impf. 3 pl., elided (ἕποντ’ = ἕποντο)
glossary.ἥβης: ἥβη — youth, young manhood, prime of life; fem. gen. sg. (ἥβης μέτρον ’the measure of manhood’)
glossary.ἰόντα: εἶμι — go; pres. part. masc. acc. sg.: ’going, as he goes’
glossary.ἷζε: ἵζω — sit, sit down, take one’s seat; aor. 3 sg. (root form), unaugmented: ’sat down’
glossary.ὀδύρεται: ὀδύρομαι — lament, mourn, make complaint; pres. mid. 3 sg.
glossary.ὀλέσειε: ὄλλυμι — destroy, lose; aor. opt. 3 sg., in a wish: ’may he destroy’
glossary.ὀτρηρῶς: ὀτρηρός — quick, prompt, ready for service; adv. ὀτρηρῶς: ’briskly, promptly’
glossary.ὁμιλήσαντες: ὁμιλέω — consort, meet together, gather; aor. part. masc. nom. pl.
glossary.ὁμοῦ: ὁμοῦ — together, together with, at the same place; adv.
glossary.ὁρμαίνοντα: ὁρμαίνω — ponder, plan, turn over in one’s mind; pres. part. masc. acc. sg.
glossary.ὁρμηθέντος: ὁρμάομαι — set out, start, rush forth; aor. pass. part. masc. gen. sg., with a verb of perception: ’of his having set out’
glossary.ὄνομ: ὄνομα — name; neut. nom. sg., elided (ὄνομ’ = ὄνομα), subject of λίπηται: ’his name’
glossary.ὅσαι: ὅσος — as much as, as many as; correlative/relative pron., fem. nom. pl.
glossary.ὅσσαι: ὅσος (epic ὅσσος) — as much as, as many as; fem. nom. pl., epic geminated form ὅσσαι (= ὅσαι)
glossary.ὑγρήν: ὑγρός — wet, moist; fem. acc. sg. ὑγρήν, substantival: ’the wet (element), the sea’ (an understood noun, e.g. ἅλμη)
glossary.ὑμετέροισι: ὑμέτερος — your (pl.), yours; masc. dat. pl., epic -οισι(ν) (= Attic -οις)
glossary.ὑμετέρων: ὑμέτερος — your (pl.), yours; masc. gen. pl.
glossary.ὑπηοῖον: ὑπηοῖος — of early dawn, at daybreak; neut. acc. sg. used adverbially: ’at dawn’ (χθιζὸν ὑπηοῖον ’yesterday, at dawn’)
glossary.ὑφήνας: ὑφαίνω — weave, hence devise, contrive; aor. part. masc. nom. sg.: ’having devised, having woven (a plan)’
glossary.ὕστατα: ὕστατος — last, latest; neut. acc. pl. used adverbially, doubling πύματα for emphasis: ’for the last time’
glossary.ὕφαινον: ὑφαίνω — weave, hence devise, contrive; impf. 3 pl., unaugmented: ’were weaving, were devising’
glossary.ὠκυπόρων: ὠκύπορος — swift-faring, swift-traveling; fem. gen. pl., epithet of ships
glossary.ὤρορεν: ὄρνυμι — stir up, rouse, urge on; aor. 3 sg., reduplicated form, unaugmented: ’roused, stirred up’
glossary.αὐδῆς: αὐδή — voice, speech, utterance; fem. gen. sg., governed by ἔκλυες ’you heard’
glossary.βάζειν: βάζω — speak, chatter, prattle; pres. inf.: ’to babble, to talk’
glossary.βένθοσδε: βένθος — depth; neut. acc. sg. with the directional suffix -δε: ’to the depth (of the sea)’
glossary.βὰν: βαίνω — go, walk, step; aor. 3 pl., epic unaugmented (= Attic ἔβησαν): ’they went’
glossary.γονὴν: γονή — offspring, stock, breed, race; fem. acc. sg.
glossary.γοόωσαν: γοάω — wail, lament; pres. part. fem. acc. sg., epic uncontracted -όωσαν (= Attic -ῶσαν)
glossary.γυναιξίν: γυνή — woman; fem. dat. pl., epic -ξιν (ν-movable)
glossary.γυναιξὶν: γυνή — woman; fem. dat. pl., epic -ξιν (ν-movable), grave mid-clause form
glossary.γόοιό: γόος — wailing, lament; masc. gen. sg., epic -οιο (= Attic -ου), accented on the ultima before the enclitic τε
glossary.γόον: γόος — wailing, lament; masc. acc. sg.
glossary.δαιμόνιοι: δαιμόνιος — strange, possessed, mad; a vocative of rebuke or wonder, not a compliment; masc. voc. pl.
glossary.δακρυόεντος: δακρυόεις — tearful, causing tears; masc. gen. sg., agreeing with γόοιο
glossary.δαμείη: δάμνημι (= δαμάζω) — overpower, subdue, overcome; aor. pass. opt. 3 sg.
glossary.δείδια: δείδω — fear, be afraid; perf. with pres. sense, 1 sg. (= Attic δέδοικα): ’I fear’
glossary.δείδιθι: δείδω — fear, be afraid; rare perf. imper. 2 sg.: ’fear!’
glossary.δείσας: δείδω — fear, be afraid; aor. part. masc. nom. sg.: ’having grown afraid’
glossary.δερματίνοισιν: δερμάτινος — made of leather, leathern; masc. dat. pl., epic -οισι(ν)
glossary.διηνεκέως: διηνεκής — continuous, unbroken; adv. διηνεκέως: ’continuously, from end to end, at full length’
glossary.δυσμενέες: δυσμενής — hostile, ill-disposed; used substantivally, ’enemies’; masc. nom. pl., epic uncontracted (= Attic δυσμενεῖς)
glossary.δόλιον: δόλιος — deceitful, treacherous, full of guile; masc. acc. sg.
glossary.δόμοισι: δόμος — house, home; masc. dat. pl., epic -οισι(ν) (εἰν Ἀίδαο δόμοισι ’in the house of Hades’)
glossary.δώματά: δῶμα — house, dwelling; neut. acc. pl., accented on the ultima before the enclitic θ’
glossary.εἰπὸν: εἶπον — say, speak; aor. part. neut. nom. sg., agreeing with the neuter εἴδωλον in place of masc. εἰπών: ’having spoken’
glossary.εἰσῆλθε: εἰσέρχομαι — go in, enter; aor. 3 sg.
glossary.εἴδωλον: εἴδωλον — phantom, image, likeness (esp. a dream-figure sent by a god); neut. nom./acc. sg.
glossary.εἵμαθ: εἷμα — garment, clothing; neut. acc. pl., aspirated and elided (εἵματα → εἵμαθ’ before rough breathing)
glossary.εὔμηλος: Εὔμηλος — Eumelus, a man of Pherae, husband of Iphthime; masc. nom. sg.
glossary.εὔχε: εὔχομαι — pray, vow; pres. imper. mid. 2 sg., elided (εὔχεο → εὔχε’): ’pray!’
glossary.εὗδε: εὕδω — sleep; impf. 3 sg., unaugmented: ’was sleeping, slept’
glossary.ζώοντες: ζώω (Attic ζάω) — live, be alive; pres. part. masc. nom. pl., epic uncontracted (= Attic ζῶντες)
glossary.θεοῖό: θεός — god; masc. gen. sg., accented on the ultima before the enclitic τε
glossary.κάκου: κακόν — ill, trouble, misery (neut. of κακός used as a noun); gen. sg., governed by κεκακωμένον
glossary.κέλεαι: κέλομαι — bid, command, urge, exhort; pres. mid. 2 sg.
glossary.καθαρὰ: καθαρός — clean, pure; neut. acc. pl., agreeing with εἵματα
glossary.κατάκτανε: κατακτείνω — kill outright, slay; aor. imper. 2 sg.
glossary.κεκακωμένον: κακόω — afflict, mistreat, wear down; perf. pass. part. masc. acc. sg.
glossary.κεῖτ: κεῖμαι — lie; impf. 3 sg., elided (κεῖτο → κεῖτ’ before a vowel): ’lay, was lying’
glossary.κλαυθμοῖο: κλαυθμός — weeping, wailing; masc. gen. sg., epic -οιο (= Attic -οῦ)
glossary.κληῖδα: κληΐς — bolt, bar (of a door-latch); also key; fem. acc. sg.
glossary.κληῖδος: κληΐς — bolt, bar (of a door-latch); also key; fem. gen. sg.
glossary.κνώσσουσ: κνώσσω — slumber, sleep deeply; pres. part. fem. nom. sg., elided (κνώσσουσα → κνώσσουσ’)
glossary.κύκλον: κύκλος — circle, ring; masc. acc. sg.
glossary.λιάσθη: λιάζομαι — slip away, glide off, turn aside; aor. pass. 3 sg.
glossary.λοχόωντες: λοχάω — lie in wait, lie in ambush; pres. part. masc. nom. pl., epic uncontracted -όωντες (= Attic -ῶντες)
glossary.λύθεν: λύω — loosen, release, undo; aor. pass. 3 pl., epic unaugmented (= Attic ἐλύθησαν)
glossary.μέθυ: μέθυ — wine; neut. acc. sg. · also neut. nom. sg. (identical form), subject of a passive verb (μέθυ πίνετο ’wine was drunk’)
glossary.μέσσῃ: μέσος — middle, mid-; epic μέσσος (doubled σ), fem. dat. sg.
glossary.μεγάλη: μέγας — great, large; fem. nom. sg.
glossary.μεσσηγὺς: μεσσηγύς — between, in the midst; adv./prep. + gen.
glossary.μύθους: μῦθος — word, speech, thing said; masc. acc. pl.
glossary.νήδυμος: νήδυμος — sweet, refreshing (stock epithet of sleep; formation disputed, sometimes linked by folk-etymology to ἡδύς); masc. nom. sg.
glossary.ναύλοχοι: ναύλοχος — sheltering ships, fit for anchoring; masc./fem. nom. pl.
glossary.νηλέι: νηλής — pitiless, ruthless; masc./neut. dat. sg., epic uncontracted (= Attic νηλεῖ)
glossary.νηός: ναῦς — ship; gen. sg., epic (= Attic νεώς)
glossary.νοτίῳ: νότιος — of the south wind; here a technical term, the open-water anchorage (as against hauling a ship up on the beach); neut. dat. sg.
glossary.νόστιμός: νόστιμος — of a homecoming, destined to return; masc. nom. sg.
glossary.νύμφα: νύμφη — young wife, bride; here an affectionate title of address; fem. voc. sg.
glossary.πάθῃσιν: πάσχω — suffer, experience; aor. subj. 3 sg. in -ῃσι, epic (= Attic πάθῃ)
glossary.πέτασσαν: πετάννυμι — spread out; aor. 3 pl., unaugmented (= Attic ἐπέτασαν)
glossary.παρεστάμεναι: παρίστημι — stand beside, be present to help; perf. inf. with pres. force, epic -μεναι (= Attic παρεστάναι)
glossary.παύσειε: παύω — stop, cause to cease; aor. opt. 3 sg. act., expressing purpose after a past main verb, + gen.
glossary.παῖς: παῖς — child, son, daughter; nom. sg.
glossary.πηνελόπειαν: Πηνελόπεια — Penelope, wife of Odysseus; acc. sg.
glossary.πνοιὰς: πνοιή — blowing, blast, breath (esp. of wind); fem. acc. pl.
glossary.ποίησε: ποιέω — make, create, fashion; aor. 3 sg., unaugmented (= ἐποίησε)
glossary.πολλέων: πολύς — much, many; fem. gen. pl., epic uncontracted (= Attic πολλῶν)
glossary.πολυμνήστη: πολυμνήστη — much-wooed (epithet of Penelope, punning on μνηστῆρες ’suitors’); fem. nom. sg.
glossary.πομπὸς: πομπός — escort, guide, conductor (esp. divine); masc./fem. nom. sg.
glossary.ποτῆτος: ποτής — drink, drinking; fem. gen. sg.
glossary.πωλέ: πωλέομαι — come habitually, frequent, visit regularly; impf. mid. 2 sg., epic uncontracted, elided (πωλέ’ = πωλέεο)
glossary.πόνων: πόνος — toil, hardship, labor; masc. gen. pl.
glossary.πόρον: πόρον — defective aorist (no present in use), suppletive of δίδωμι: ’gave, granted, provided’; 1 sg. or 3 pl. act.; here 1 sg.
glossary.πύλῃσιν: πύλη — gate; fem. dat. pl., epic -ῃσι(ν)
glossary.σάωσον: σαόω (= σῴζω) — save, keep safe; aor. imper. 2 sg.
glossary.σιγῇ: σιγή — silence; fem. dat. sg. used adverbially: ’in silence’
glossary.σταθμοῖο: σταθμός — door-post, jamb (also stall, station, dwelling); masc. gen. sg., epic -οιο (= Attic -οῦ)
glossary.σχέθε: ἔχω — hold, check, restrain; aor. 3 sg., root aorist, unaugmented (= ἔσχε)
glossary.τελέωμεν: τελέω — accomplish, bring to fulfillment, complete; subj. 1 pl. hortatory, epic uncontracted (= Attic τελῶμεν)
glossary.τετιημένη: τετίημαι — be distressed, be worn down with grief (defective verb, only perf./plup.); perf. part. fem. nom. sg.
glossary.τεύχεα: τεῦχος — tool, gear, armor, equipment; neut. nom./acc. pl.
glossary.τοίη: τοῖος — such, of such a kind; fem. nom. sg.
glossary.τροποῖς: τρόπος — here, oar-thong, the leather loop holding an oar to the gunwale (distinct from the common sense ’manner, way’); masc. dat. pl.
glossary.υἷα: υἱός — son; acc. sg., epic υἷα (= Attic υἱόν)
glossary.φερῇς: Φεραί — Pherae, a town in Thessaly; fem. dat. pl., locative with ἐν/ἔνι
glossary.φόνος: φόνος — murder, slaughter, bloodshed; masc. nom. sg.
glossary.φύγοι: φεύγω — flee, escape; aor. opt. 3 sg., within an indirect question
glossary.χροῒ: χρώς — skin, flesh, the body’s surface; dat. sg. χροΐ
glossary.ἀίδαο: Ἀΐδης (Ἅιδης) — Hades; masc. gen. sg., epic -αο (= Attic -ου): ’of/in Hades’ house’
glossary.ἀγαπητὸς: ἀγαπητός — beloved, cherished (esp. of an only or especially dear child); masc. nom. sg.
glossary.ἀγοράων: ἀγορή — assembly, gathering, public speaking; fem. gen. pl., epic (= Attic ἀγορῶν)
glossary.ἀθηναίῃ: Ἀθηναίη — Athena, epic full form (= Ἀθήνη); fem. dat. sg.
glossary.ἀκάχησθαι: ἄχομαι (redupl. ἀχεύω) — grieve, be distressed; perf. inf. mid./pass., epic
glossary.ἀλέασθε: ἀλέομαι — avoid, shun, keep away from; aor. imper. mid. 2 pl.
glossary.ἀλιτήμενός: ἀλιταίνω — sin against, transgress, offend; perf. mid./pass. part. masc. nom. sg., + dat.
glossary.ἀμαυρόν: ἀμαυρός — dim, faint, indistinct; neut. nom./acc. sg.
glossary.ἀμολγῷ: ἀμολγός — milking-time; only in νυκτὸς ἀμολγῷ ’in the dead of night’ (lit. ’in the milking-time of night’), sense/etymology disputed; masc. dat. sg.
glossary.ἀμφίδυμοι: ἀμφίδυμος — with two entrances, double; masc./fem. nom. pl.
glossary.ἀμφιτρομέω: ἀμφιτρομέω — tremble all around, tremble for someone, be afraid on another’s behalf; pres. 1 sg.
glossary.ἀνακλινθεῖσα: ἀνακλίνω — lean back, cause to recline; aor. pass. part. fem. nom. sg.
glossary.ἀναστάντες: ἀνίστημι — stand up, rise; intransitive aor. part. masc. nom. pl. (= Attic ἀναστάντες)
glossary.ἀνεμώλια: ἀνεμώλιος — windy, idle, vain (of words); neut. acc. pl.
glossary.ἀπάλαλκε: ἀλαλκεῖν (redupl. aor., root of ἀλκή/ἀλέξω) — ward off, keep away, defend against; aor. imper. 2 sg., with prefix ἀπό-
glossary.ἀπαγγείλῃσι: ἀπαγγέλλω — report, bring back word; aor. subj. 3 sg. in -ῃσι, epic (= Attic ἀπαγγείλῃ)
glossary.ἀπαμειβόμενον: ἀπαμείβομαι — answer, reply; pres. part. neut. nom. sg., agreeing with the neuter εἴδωλον (not the nearby accusative τήν, a distinct word)
glossary.ἀπόπροθι: ἀπόπροθι — far off, at a distance; adv.
glossary.ἀρκεισιάδαο: Ἀρκεισιάδης — son of Arceisius (patronymic of Laertes); masc. gen. sg., epic -αο (= Attic -ου)
glossary.ἀρτύει: ἀρτύω — prepare, arrange, contrive; pres. 3 sg.
glossary.ἀρῆς: ἀρά — prayer (also curse, by context); fem. gen. sg.
glossary.ἀστερίς: Ἀστερίς — Asteris, a small island in the strait between Ithaca and Same; fem. nom. sg.
glossary.ἀτρυτώνη: Ἀτρυτώνη — Atrytone, cult-title of Athena, traditionally ’the Unwearied’, though the derivation is uncertain; fem. voc./nom. sg.
glossary.ἄγωσι: ἄγω — lead, drive; pres. subj. 3 pl.
glossary.ἄπαστος: ἄπαστος — tasting nothing, without food; masc./fem. nom. sg., + gen.
glossary.ἄσιτος: ἄσιτος — without food, fasting; masc./fem. nom. sg.
glossary.ἅψεα: ἅψεα — limbs, joints (Attic ἄρθρα/μέλη), often paired with λύω of sleep or death; neut. nom./acc. pl.
glossary.ἐκέλευε: κελεύω — bid, command, urge; impf. 3 sg.: ’kept bidding’
glossary.ἐκείνου: κεῖνος (= ἐκεῖνος) — that, that one; demonstrative pron., masc. gen. sg.
glossary.ἐκρίνατ: κρίνω — pick out, choose, select; aor. mid. 3 sg., elided (ἐκρίνατο → ἐκρίνατ’)
glossary.ἐλεαίρει: ἐλεαίρω — pity, feel compassion for (epic by-form of ἐλεέω); pres. 3 sg.
glossary.ἐναργὲς: ἐναργής — clear, vivid, manifest (esp. of a dream or divine appearance); neut. nom./acc. sg.
glossary.ἐπέπλεον: ἐπιπλέω — sail upon, sail over; impf. 3 pl.: ’were sailing over’
glossary.ἐπέσσεται: ἔπειμι (εἰμί + ἐπί) — be thereafter, exist in the future, survive; fut. 3 sg., epic -σσ- (= Attic ἔσται)
glossary.ἐπέσσυτο: ἐπισεύομαι — rush upon, come upon swiftly; aor. 3 sg., epic reduplicated, unaugmented
glossary.ἐπήλυθε: ἐπέρχομαι — come upon; aor. 3 sg., epic ἐπήλυθε (= Attic ἐπῆλθε)
glossary.ἐρέειν: ἐρέω (= εἴρω/λέγω) — say, tell, speak; fut. inf., epic uncontracted -έειν (= Attic ἐρεῖν)
glossary.ἐρέθουσι: ἐρέθω (= ἐρεθίζω) — provoke, irritate, stir up; pres. 3 pl.
glossary.ἐτέτυκτο: τεύχω — make, contrive, bring about; pass. come to pass, happen; plup. pass. 3 sg. with impf. sense: ’had been wrought, had come about’
glossary.ἐτίθεντο: τίθημι — put, place, set; impf. mid. 3 pl.: ’they set, placed (for themselves)’
glossary.ἐῶσι: ἐάω — allow, let, permit; pres. 3 pl.
glossary.ἑλοῦσα: αἱρέω — take, take up; aor. part. mid. fem. nom. sg., unaugmented: ’having taken’
glossary.ἔειπεν: εἶπον — say, speak; aor. 3 sg., epic augmented (ἔ-ειπεν, = Attic εἶπεν)
glossary.ἔθετ: τίθημι — put, place; aor. mid. 3 sg., unaugmented, elided (ἔθετο → ἔθετ’)
glossary.ἔκλυες: κλύω — hear; aor. 2 sg., + gen.: ’you heard’
glossary.ἔρυσσαν: ἐρύω — draw, drag, haul; aor. 3 pl., epic doubled-σ (= Attic εἴρυσαν): ’they hauled’
glossary.ἔχθεσθ: ἔχθομαι — be hated, be an object of hatred; pres. inf. pass., elided (ἔχθεσθαι → ἔχθεσθ’), + dat.
glossary.ἔχῃσι: ἔχω — have, hold, possess; pres. subj. 3 sg. in -ῃσι, epic (= Attic ἔχῃ)
glossary.ἕλετο: αἱρέω — take; aor. mid. 3 sg., unaugmented (= εἵλετο): ’took (for himself/herself)’
glossary.ἕλοντο: αἱρέω — take; aor. mid. 3 pl., unaugmented (= εἵλοντο): ’took (for themselves)’
glossary.ἠρτύναντο: ἀρτύνω — fit together, prepare, arrange (by-form of ἀρτύω); aor. mid. 3 pl.: ’they fitted (for themselves)’
glossary.ἡδύ: ἡδύς — sweet, pleasant; neut. acc. sg., attributive
glossary.ἤικτο: ἔοικα — be like, resemble; plup. pass. 3 sg. with impf. sense, epic (= Attic ᾔκτο/ἐῴκει), + dat.: ’was like’
glossary.ἤνεικαν: φέρω — carry, bring; aor. 3 pl., epic root ἐνεικ- (= Attic ἤνεγκαν)
glossary.ἤραρεν: ἀραρίσκω — fit together, join; redupl. aor. 3 sg., figuratively ’fitted, suited, pleased’, of a plan agreeable to all
glossary.ἰάπτῃς: ἰάπτω — harm, mar, damage; pres. subj. 2 sg.
glossary.ἰφθίμῃ: Ἰφθίμη — Iphthime, Penelope’s sister, wife of Eumelus; fem. dat. sg.
glossary.ἱμάντα: ἱμάς — strap, thong (esp. of a door-latch); masc. acc. sg.
glossary.ὀδυνάων: ὀδύνη — pain, ache, anguish; fem. gen. pl., epic -άων (= Attic -ῶν)
glossary.ὀδυρομένην: ὀδύρομαι — lament, mourn, grieve; pres. part. fem. acc. sg.
glossary.ὀλόλυξε: ὀλολύζω — raise the ritual cry (esp. of women at prayer or sacrifice); aor. 3 sg.
glossary.ὀνειρείῃσι: ὀνείρειος — of dreams; fem. dat. pl., epic -ῃσι(ν)
glossary.ὁμίλῳ: ὅμιλος — throng, crowd, gathering (esp. of men); masc. dat. sg.
glossary.ὁμῶς: ὁμῶς — alike, in like manner, equally; adv.
glossary.ὁρμαίνουσ: ὁρμαίνω — ponder, turn over in the mind, debate; pres. part. fem. nom. sg., elided (ὁρμαίνουσα → ὁρμαίνουσ’)
glossary.ὁρμαίνουσαν: ὁρμαίνω — ponder, turn over in the mind, debate; pres. part. fem. acc. sg.
glossary.ὄνειρον: ὄνειρος — dream (Homeric also has the neut. by-form ὄνειρον, τό, beside the masc.); neut. nom./acc. sg.
glossary.ὄπυιε: ὀπυίω — have as wife, be married to, wed; impf. 3 sg., unaugmented
glossary.ὑδρηναμένη: ὑδραίνομαι — wash oneself, bathe; aor. mid. part. fem. nom. sg.
glossary.ὑπέρθυμοι: ὑπέρθυμος — high-spirited, high-hearted; masc. nom. pl.
glossary.ὑπερηνορέοντας: ὑπερηνορέω — be overweening, play the overbearing man (ὑπέρ + ἀνήρ); pres. part. masc. acc. pl., epic uncontracted
glossary.ὑπερωίῳ: ὑπερῷον — upper chamber, women’s upstairs room; neut. dat. sg.
glossary.ὑψοῦ: ὑψοῦ — on high, high up; adv.
glossary.ᾔδε: οἶδα — know; plup. 1 sg. with past sense, elided (ᾔδεα → ᾔδε’): ’I knew’
glossary.αἰδοῖός: αἰδοῖος — worthy of respect, reverend, august; masc. nom. sg., predicate adj. agreeing with the implied ’you’ (subject of εἰλήλουθας), not itself a vocative form: ’honored’
glossary.αἰθέρος: αἰθήρ — the bright upper air, sky; masc./fem. gen. sg. (ἐξ αἰθέρος ’from the upper air’)
glossary.αἴγειρός: αἴγειρος — poplar (tree); fem. nom. sg. (a 2nd-decl. noun that is feminine, as tree-names often are)
glossary.αἶσαν: αἶσα — portion, share, lot; fem. acc. sg. (ἀπὸ ληίδος αἶσαν ’his share of the spoil’)
glossary.αὐτή: αὐτός — self; fem. nom. sg., intensive, stressing the subject herself: ’(you) yourself’
glossary.αὔδα: αὐδάω — speak, say; pres. imper. 2 sg. act.: ’speak!’
glossary.βὰς: βαίνω — go, step, walk; aor. part. act. masc. nom. sg., root aorist (ἔβην): ’having stepped, stepping’
glossary.γεγάασιν: γίγνομαι — become, come to be, be; epic redupl. perf. 3 pl. γεγάασι(ν) (pres. force): ’they are, they have come to be’
glossary.γλαφυροῖο: γλαφυρός — hollow; masc./neut. gen. sg. (here with the neut. σπείους), epic -οιο (= Attic -ου)
glossary.δάκρυσι: δάκρυον (by-form δάκρυ) — tear; neut. dat. pl. (from the athematic stem δάκρυ-)
glossary.δαιομένων: δαίω — kindle, burn; pres. part. mid./pass. gen. pl. (agreeing with κέδρου, θύου): ’as they were burning’
glossary.δείπνησε: δειπνέω — dine, take a meal; aor. 3 sg. act.: ’he dined’
glossary.δεινοὺς: δεινός — dread, terrible, fearful; masc. acc. pl.
glossary.δερκέσκετο: δέρκομαι — look, gaze; impf. iterative 3 sg. mid. in -σκε- (epic): ’kept gazing, would gaze again and again’
glossary.δεύεται: δεύω — wet, moisten; pres. 3 sg. mid. with retained acc. (πτερὰ δεύεται): ’wets its (own) wings’ · also pres. 3 sg. mid./pass.: ’is drenched’ (ὄμβρῳ δεύεται ’is drenched by rain’) · also δεύομαι (= δέομαι) — lack, be without, + gen.: νόου ... ἐσθλοῦ δεύεται ’lacks good sense’
glossary.διάκτορος: διάκτορος — the guide; standing epithet of Hermes, masc. nom. sg.; sense not actually known (’the guide’ is a conventional gloss)
glossary.δόντες: δίδωμι — give; aor. part. act. masc. nom. pl.: ’having given’
glossary.εἰκοστῷ: εἰκοστός — twentieth; ordinal adj., masc./neut. dat. sg. (ἤματι εἰκοστῷ ’on the twentieth day’)
glossary.εἰλήλουθας: ἔρχομαι — come, go; redupl. perf. 2 sg., epic (= Attic ἐλήλυθας): ’you have come’
glossary.εἰνάλιαι: εἰνάλιος — of or in the sea, sea-; fem. nom. pl., epic -ει- (= Attic ἐνάλιος)
glossary.εἰπεῖν: εἶπον (aor. of φημί/λέγω, ’say, speak’) — say, tell; aor. inf. act., standing for an imperative: ’go and tell’
glossary.εὐκεάτοιο: εὐκέατος — easily split; masc./fem. gen. sg., epic -οιο (= Attic -ου), of wood cut for burning
glossary.εὐώδης: εὐώδης — fragrant, sweet-smelling; fem. nom. sg. (2-termination adj., agreeing with κυπάρισσος)
glossary.θήλεον: θηλέω — bloom, flourish; impf. 3 pl. act., unaugmented (= ἐθήλεον); a distinct by-form beside θάλλω, not that verb’s own imperfect
glossary.θαλάσσια: θαλάσσιος — of the sea; neut. nom./acc. pl. (θαλάσσια ἔργα ’the works of the sea’)
glossary.θαμίζεις: θαμίζω — come often, be a frequent visitor; pres. 2 sg. act., negated by οὔ τι: ’you were no frequent visitor’
glossary.θηήσαιτο: θηέομαι — gaze at, marvel at, behold; aor. opt. 3 sg. mid., general potential: ’might gaze in wonder’
glossary.θηήσατο: θηέομαι — gaze at, marvel at, behold; aor. ind. 3 sg. mid.: ’gazed at, wondered at’
glossary.θηεῖτο: θηέομαι — gaze at, marvel at, behold; impf. 3 sg. mid.: ’was gazing in wonder’
glossary.θρόνῳ: θρόνος — throne, chair of state; masc. dat. sg.
glossary.θύου: θύον — a fragrant wood, conventionally ’citron-wood’ or thyine wood; neut. gen. sg. (the exact tree is not certainly identified)
glossary.θῶκόνδε: θῶκος — session, seat, sitting-place; masc. acc. sg. + directional suffix -δε: ’to their session, to the sitting-place’
glossary.κέρασσε: κεράννυμι — mix (esp. wine or nectar with water); aor. 3 sg. act.: ’mixed’
glossary.κήδεα: κῆδος — care, trouble, sorrow; neut. nom./acc. pl., epic uncontracted (= Attic κήδη)
glossary.καίετο: καίω — burn, kindle; impf. 3 sg. mid./pass., intransitive: ’was burning, blazed’
glossary.καθίζανον: καθιζάνω — take one’s seat, settle down; impf. 3 pl. act.: ’were taking their seats’
glossary.καλυψώ: Καλυψώ — Calypso, a nymph; fem. nom. sg.
glossary.κείνους: κεῖνος (= ἐκεῖνος) — that, that one; demonstr. pron., masc. acc. pl.: ’those men’
glossary.κερκίδ: κερκίς — shuttle (of a loom); fem. acc. sg., elided (κερκίδ’ = κερκίδα)
glossary.κορῶναι: κορώνη — crow; here εἰνάλιαι κορῶναι, a ’sea-crow’ (perhaps a cormorant or shag; exact species uncertain); fem. nom. pl.
glossary.κρατέρ: κρατερός — mighty, strong, harsh; neut. acc. pl., elided (κρατέρ’ = κρατερά)
glossary.κρατὺς: κρατύς — strong, mighty; masc. nom. sg.
glossary.κρῆναι: κρήνη — spring, fountain; fem. nom. pl.
glossary.κόλπους: κόλπος — gulf, bosom, fold (of the sea); masc. acc. pl.
glossary.κῆρι: κῆρ — heart; neut. dat. sg., in the fixed adverbial idiom περὶ κῆρι ’exceedingly, at heart’ (περί used adverbially)
glossary.λαχὼν: λαγχάνω — obtain by lot, get one’s share; aor. part. act. masc. nom. sg.: ’having got (his share)’
glossary.λείβων: λείβω — pour, let fall drop by drop; pres. part. act. masc. nom. sg. (δάκρυα λείβων ’pouring tears’), kept distinct from δάκρυ χέων ’shedding a tear’
glossary.λευκῷ: λευκός — white, bright, clear; neut. dat. sg. (ὕδατι λευκῷ ’with bright water’)
glossary.ληίδος: ληΐς (λεία) — booty, plunder, spoil; fem. gen. sg.
glossary.μάκαρες: μάκαρ — blessed, happy (esp. of the gods); masc. nom. pl. · also voc. pl. in address: μάκαρες θεοί ’blessed gods!’
glossary.μέλε: μέλω — be a care to (someone); aor. 3 sg. act., unaugmented (= ἔμελε(ν)), + dat.: ’was a care to’
glossary.μέμηλεν: μέλω — be a care to (someone); perf. 3 sg. act. (pres. force), + dat.: ’is a care to’
glossary.μαλακοὶ: μαλακός — soft; masc. nom. pl. (λειμῶνες μαλακοί ’soft meadows’)
glossary.μεγαλήτορα: μεγαλήτωρ — great-spirited, great-hearted; masc. acc. sg. (of Odysseus)
glossary.μνησαμένη: μιμνήσκομαι — remember, call to mind; aor. part. mid. fem. nom. sg., + gen.: ’having called (him) to mind’
glossary.νέκταρ: νέκταρ — nectar, the gods’ drink; neut. acc. sg. (also identical in form to the nom. sg.)
glossary.ναῖεν: ναίω — dwell, inhabit, have one’s home; impf. 3 sg. act., unaugmented: ’dwelt’
glossary.πέτετο: πέτομαι — fly; impf. 3 sg. mid., unaugmented: ’was flying, flew’
glossary.πίσυρες: πίσυρες — four; Aeolic-epic numeral (= Attic τέσσαρες), nom. pl., indeclinable for case beyond number
glossary.παλιμπετὲς: παλιμπετής — back again, backward; neut. acc. sg. used adverbially (built on πάλιν): ’back the way one came’
glossary.πεφύκει: φύω — grow, come to be, be by nature; plpf. 3 sg. act. with impf. force: ’had grown, was growing’
glossary.πιερίην: Πιερίη — Pieria, a region at the northern edge of Olympus; fem. acc. sg.
glossary.πλήσασα: πίμπλημι — fill; aor. part. act. fem. nom. sg., + gen. of content: ’having filled (it) with’
glossary.πλησίαι: πλήσιος — near, close; fem. nom. pl., + gen.: ’close to one another’ (πλησίαι ἀλλήλων)
glossary.πολέεσσιν: πολύς — much, many; masc./neut. dat. pl., epic uncontracted (= Attic πολλοῖς)
