glossary.πολυδέσμου: πολύδεσμος — of many bonds, many-lashed; fem. gen. sg. (of a raft lashed together with many ties)
glossary.πομπῇ: πομπή — convoy, escort, safe conduct; fem. dat. sg.
glossary.πυκινὰ: πυκινός — close-packed, thick, close; neut. acc. pl. (πυκινὰ πτερά ’close-packed wings’)
glossary.πῖνε: πίνω — drink; impf. 3 sg. act., unaugmented: ’was drinking, drank’
glossary.σελίνου: σέλινον — (wild) celery, parsley; neut. gen. sg.
glossary.σεύατ: σεύω (mid. σεύομαι) — dart, rush, speed; aor. mid. 3 sg., unaugmented, elided (σεύατ’ = σεύατο): ’sped, darted’
glossary.σιγαλόεντι: σιγαλόεις — glossy, shining, gleaming; masc./neut. dat. sg.
glossary.σκῶπές: σκώψ — a kind of small or horned owl (exact species uncertain); masc. nom. pl.
glossary.σπέος: σπέος — cave, grotto; neut. nom./acc. sg. (an irregular neuter noun declined σπέος, σπείους, etc.)
glossary.σπείους: σπέος — cave, grotto; neut. gen. sg., epic σπείους (= Attic σπέους)
glossary.σταφυλῇσι: σταφυλή — bunch of grapes, cluster; fem. dat. pl., epic -ῃσι(ν) (= Attic -αῖς)
glossary.στοναχῇσι: στοναχή — groaning, wailing, lamentation; fem. dat. pl., epic -ῃσι(ν) (= Attic -αῖς)
glossary.σχεδίης: σχεδίη — raft; fem. gen. sg. (the raft Odysseus will build, named here for the first time)
glossary.σχερίην: Σχερίη — Scheria, the Phaeacians’ island; fem. acc. sg.
glossary.τέτμεν: τέτμον (defective aor., ’find, come upon’) — find, come upon; aor. 3 sg. act., unaugmented (= ἔτετμεν)
glossary.τανύγλωσσοί: τανύγλωσσος — long-tongued; fem. nom. pl. (of crows, perhaps referring to their harsh, drawn-out cry)
glossary.τεθήλει: θάλλω — bloom, flourish; plpf. 3 sg. act. with impf. force: ’was flourishing’
glossary.τερφθείη: τέρπω — delight, gladden; aor. pass. opt. 3 sg., general potential: ’might take delight (in)’
glossary.τετραμμέναι: τρέπω — turn; perf. pass. part. fem. nom. pl.: ’turned’ (τετραμμέναι ἄλλυδις ἄλλη ’turned each a different way’)
glossary.τηλεθόωσα: τηλεθάω — flourish, bloom luxuriantly; pres. part. act. fem. nom. sg., diectasis (uncontracted, stretched vowel)
glossary.τηλόσε: τηλόσε — to a distance, afar, far off; adv. of place
glossary.τιθωνοῖο: Τιθωνός — Tithonus, mortal prince loved by Dawn; masc. gen. sg., epic -οιο (= Attic -ου)
glossary.τιμήσουσιν: τιμάω — honor; fut. 3 pl. act., in a relative clause of characteristic with κε: ’(who) will honor’
glossary.τῇσίν: ὁ, ἡ, τό — he, she, it; that (in Homer a pronoun; later the article); used relatively, fem. dat. pl., epic -ῃσι(ν), ν-movable: ’to whom’
glossary.φέροι: φέρω — bring, carry; pres. opt. 3 sg. act., purpose clause: ’might bring, would bring’
glossary.φαεινῷ: φαεινός — shining, bright, radiant; masc./neut. dat. sg.
glossary.φαιήκων: Φαίηξ — a Phaeacian; masc. gen. pl.
glossary.φρονέεις: φρονέω — think, have in mind, intend; pres. 2 sg. act., epic uncontracted (= Attic φρονεῖς)
glossary.φωνήσασα: φωνέω — speak, utter one’s voice; aor. part. act. fem. nom. sg.: ’having spoken’
glossary.φόως: φῶς (φάος) — light; neut. acc. sg., epic uncontracted (= Attic φῶς)
glossary.χρυσόρραπι: χρυσόρραπις — of the golden wand, golden-wanded; standing epithet of Hermes, masc. voc. sg.
glossary.ἀγνῶτες: ἄγνως (ἄγνωτος) — unknown, not known; masc. nom. pl.
glossary.ἀγρώσσων: ἀγρώσσω — hunt, chase, catch; pres. part. act. masc. nom. sg.
glossary.ἀγχίθεοι: ἀγχίθεος — near the gods, close to the gods; masc. nom. pl.
glossary.ἀθάνατός: ἀθάνατος — immortal, deathless; masc. nom. sg. (ἀθάνατός περ ’though he be immortal’)
glossary.ἀμβροσίης: ἀμβροσία — ambrosia, the gods’ food; fem. gen. sg. (partitive, with πλήσασα): ’filled with ambrosia’
glossary.ἀοιδιάουσ: ἀοιδιάω — sing (to oneself, at one’s work); pres. part. act. fem. nom. sg., elided (ἀοιδιάουσ’ = ἀοιδιάουσα)
glossary.ἀπίθησε: ἀπιθέω — disobey; aor. 3 sg. act., unaugmented, negated by οὐδέ: ’did not disobey’
glossary.ἀποκτεῖναι: ἀποκτείνω — kill, slay; aor. inf. act.
glossary.ἀπονέωνται: ἀπονέομαι — go back, return; pres. subj. 3 pl. mid., purpose clause: ’may they turn back’
glossary.ἀργεϊφόντης: Ἀργεϊφόντης — ’Argeïphontes’, standing epithet of Hermes, conventionally ’slayer of Argus’; masc. nom. sg.; the meaning is disputed, not actually known
glossary.ἀσκηθὴς: ἀσκηθής — unharmed, unscathed; masc./fem. nom. sg.
glossary.ἄλγεσι: ἄλγος — pain, grief; neut. dat. pl.
glossary.ἄλλη: ἄλλος — other, another; fem. nom. sg., adverbial in the idiom ἄλλυδις ἄλλη ’one this way, another that’ · also plain adj., fem. nom. sg.: ’other’ (οὔ τις ... ἄλλη ’no other woman’)
glossary.ἄλλυδις: ἄλλυδις — in one direction, elsewhere; adv. (ἄλλυδις ἄλλη ’each a different way’)
glossary.ἅλμῃ: ἅλμη — brine, sea-water, salt water; fem. dat. sg.
glossary.ἐβούλευσας: βουλεύω — plan, devise, deliberate; aor. 2 sg. act.: ’you devised, you planned’
glossary.ἐγείρει: ἐγείρω — wake, rouse; pres. 3 sg. act.
glossary.ἐδωδῇ: ἐδωδή — food, meat; fem. dat. sg.
glossary.ἐξήρατ: ἐξαίρω — carry off, take away (for oneself); aor. mid. 3 sg., elided (ἐξήρατ’ = ἐξήρατο): ’carried off’
glossary.ἐπιβὰς: ἐπιβαίνω — step upon, set foot on, alight; aor. part. act. masc. nom. sg.; usually + gen., but here + acc. (Πιερίην), an epic extension meaning ’reach, arrive at’: ’having stepped upon, alighting’
glossary.ἐπισταμένως: ἐπισταμένως — skilfully, knowingly, expertly; adv. (from ἐπίσταμαι)
glossary.ἐποιχομένη: ἐποίχομαι — go to and fro at, ply; pres. part. mid. fem. nom. sg. (ἱστὸν ἐποιχομένη ’plying the loom’) · also ’go at, come upon, assail’ (βελέεσσιν ἐποιχομένη ’coming upon him with her shafts’) · also ’go after, seek out’ (πόσιν ἐποιχομένη ’going after a husband’)
glossary.ἐρέεινε: ἐρεείνω — question, ask; impf. 3 sg. act., unaugmented: ’questioned, was questioning’ · also pres. imper. 2 sg.: ’question!’ (μηδ’ ἐρέεινε ’and do not question’)
glossary.ἐρέχθων: ἐρέχθω — rack, agitate, torment; pres. part. act. masc. nom. sg., + acc.: ’racking (his heart)’
glossary.ἐρίβωλον: ἐρίβωλος — rich-clodded, rich in soil, fertile; fem. acc. sg. (of Scheria)
glossary.ἐρυθρόν: ἐρυθρός — red; neut. acc. sg. (νέκταρ ἐρυθρόν ’red nectar’)
glossary.ἐσθῆτά: ἐσθής — clothing, raiment; fem. acc. sg.
glossary.ἐσχαρόφιν: ἐσχάρα — hearth; fem. sg. with the instrumental-locative suffix -φι(ν): ’at the hearth’
glossary.ἐυπλόκαμος: ἐϋπλόκαμος — fair-tressed, with fine hair; fem. nom. sg. (Calypso’s standing epithet) · also used of Demeter (5.125), so not unique to Calypso despite the parenthetical above · also of Dawn (ἐυπλόκαμος Ἠώς ’fine-plaited Dawn’)
glossary.ἑρμεία: Ἑρμείας — Hermes, fuller epic form of Ἑρμῆς; masc. voc. sg.
glossary.ἑρμῆς: Ἑρμῆς — Hermes; masc. nom. sg. (the plain form, beside the fuller Ἑρμείας used elsewhere in the same part)
glossary.ἑῷ: ἑός (= ὅς, ἥ, ὅν possessive) — his own, her own; 3rd-pers. reflexive possessive adj., masc./neut. dat. sg., agreeing with θυμῷ: ’in his own (heart)’
glossary.ἔνδον: ἔνδον — within, inside, at home; adv. (distinct from the by-form ἔνδοθι, also ’within’)
glossary.ἕπεο: ἕπομαι — follow, accompany; pres. imper. 2 sg. mid., loosely: ’come along, follow’
glossary.ἠγνοίησεν: ἀγνοέω — fail to recognize, not know; aor. 3 sg. act., negated by οὐδέ: ’did not fail to recognize’
glossary.ἡβώωσα: ἡβάω — be in youthful bloom, be in one’s prime; pres. part. act. fem. nom. sg., diectasis (uncontracted, of a vine)
glossary.ἡμερὶς: ἡμερίς — cultivated (garden) vine, as against a wild vine; fem. nom. sg.
glossary.ἤιεν: εἶμι (ibo-verb) — go; impf. 3 sg. act., epic ἤιε(ν) (= Attic ᾔει): ’was going, went’
glossary.ἤματί: ἦμαρ — day; neut. dat. sg., epic (= Attic ἡμέρᾳ)
glossary.ἤπειρόνδε: ἤπειρος — mainland; fem. acc. sg. + directional suffix -δε: ’to the mainland’
glossary.ἤραρε: ἀραρίσκω — fit, join; here transitive and figurative, aor. 3 sg. act.: ’fitted, satisfied’ (θυμὸν ἐδωδῇ ’satisfied his heart with food’)
glossary.ἦσθε: ἔδω (defective, ’eat’) — eat; impf. 3 sg. act., augmented (ε lengthens to η): ’was eating, ate’
glossary.ἰδὼν: ὁράω (aor. stem εἰδ-) — see; aor. part. act. masc. nom. sg., epic (= Attic ἰδών): ’seeing’
glossary.ἰοειδέος: ἰοειδής — violet-dark, violet-colored; masc. gen. sg. (a fourth distinct sea-colour epithet, from ἴον ’violet’)
glossary.ἱδρύσασα: ἱδρύω — set, seat, establish; aor. part. act. fem. nom. sg.
glossary.ἴρηκές: ἴρηξ (= ἱέραξ) — hawk, falcon; masc. nom. pl.
glossary.ἵκοιτο: ἱκνέομαι — come to, arrive at, reach; aor. opt. 3 sg. mid., wish/potential: ’might come, may he reach’
glossary.ὀδμὴ: ὀδμή — smell, scent, fragrance; fem. nom. sg.
glossary.ὀδυσσῆα: Ὀδυσσεύς — Odysseus; masc. acc. sg., double-σ form (metrical variant of Ὀδυσῆα)
glossary.ὀδώδει: ὄζω — smell (of), give off a smell; plpf. 3 sg. act. with impf. force: ’was wafting, smelled of’
glossary.ὀπὶ: ὄψ — voice; fem. dat. sg. (ὀπὶ καλῇ ’with a beautiful voice’)
glossary.ὀχήσατο: ὀχέομαι — be borne, be carried, ride; aor. mid. 3 sg.
glossary.ὄρνιθι: ὄρνις — bird; masc./fem. dat. sg. (λάρῳ ὄρνιθι ἐοικώς ’like a gull, a bird’)
glossary.ὑπνώοντας: ὑπνόω — sleep, be asleep; pres. part. act. masc. acc. pl., diectasis (uncontracted): ’sleeping’
glossary.ὑψιβρεμέτης: ὑψιβρεμέτης — high-thundering (ὑψι- ’on high’ + βρέμω ’thunder, roar’); standing epithet of Zeus, masc. nom. sg.
glossary.ὕλη: ὕλη — wood, woodland, forest; fem. nom. sg.
glossary.ὕφαινεν: ὑφαίνω — weave; impf. 3 sg. act., unaugmented: ’was weaving, wove’
glossary.ὤρνυθ: ὄρνυμι — stir, rouse; here intransitive, ’rise, arise’; impf. 3 sg. mid., augmented (ο lengthens to ω), elided (ὤρνυθ’ = ὤρνυτο): ’was rising’
glossary.ῥάβδον: ῥάβδος — wand, rod, staff; fem. acc. sg. (Hermes’s standing attribute)
glossary.ῥέον: ῥέω — flow; impf. 3 pl. act., unaugmented: ’were flowing’
glossary.αἰὼν: αἰών — life, lifetime, one’s span of life; masc. nom. sg.
glossary.αἶσα: αἶσα — portion, lot, destiny; fem. nom. sg., used impersonally with an inf.: ’it is not his lot to…’ · also plain subject: ’portion, lot’ (ἅσσα οἱ αἶσα … νήσαντο ’whatever his portion … spun for him’)
glossary.αὐτάρ: αὐτάρ — but, and then; epic conj. (= Attic δέ, ἀλλά)
glossary.βαλὼν: βάλλω — throw, hit, strike; aor. part. act. masc. nom. sg.: ’having struck, striking’
glossary.βεβαῶτα: βαίνω — go, step, mount; perf. part. act. masc. acc. sg. (περὶ τρόπιος βεβαῶτα ’astride the keel’), epic (= Attic βεβηκότα)
glossary.βουλευσέμεν: βουλεύω — plan, devise, contrive; fut. inf., epic -σέμεν (= Attic βουλεύσειν)
glossary.βροτὸν: βροτός — mortal; masc. acc. sg. (agreeing with ἄνδρα ’a mortal man’)
glossary.γλυκὺς: γλυκύς — sweet; masc. nom. sg. (γλυκὺς αἰών ’sweet life’)
glossary.δακρυόφιν: δάκρυον (by-form δάκρυ) — tear; neut. gen./abl. with the epic suffix -φιν (number not marked), marking separation: ’dry of tears’ (with τέρσομαι)
glossary.δεινότατός: δεινός — terrible, dread; superl. masc. nom. sg.: ’most dread’
glossary.δεκάτῳ: δέκατος — tenth; masc./neut. dat. sg., dat. of time: ’in the tenth (year)’
glossary.δημήτηρ: Δημήτηρ — Demeter, goddess of grain and harvest; fem. nom. sg.
glossary.διαδράμοι: διατρέχω — run, race across; aor. opt. 3 sg. (root δραμ-), potential: ’would race across’
glossary.δούρατα: δόρυ — beam, timber, plank (also spear); neut. acc. pl. δούρατα: ’timbers’
glossary.εἴξασα: εἴκω — yield, give way; aor. part. act. fem. nom. sg.: ’yielding’
glossary.εἵματά: εἷμα — garment, clothing; neut. acc. pl. εἵματα: ’clothes’
glossary.εὐνάζεσθαι: εὐνάζω — lay to rest, put to bed; mid. lie with, go to bed; pres. mid. inf.: ’to lie (with)’
glossary.εὐρεῖαν: εὐρύς — wide, broad; fem. acc. sg. (agreeing with σχεδίην ’broad raft’)
glossary.εὐρὺς: εὐρύς — wide, broad; masc. nom. sg. (οὐρανὸς εὐρύς ’the wide sky’)
glossary.ζηλήμονες: ζηλήμων — jealous, envious; masc. nom. pl., agreeing with θεοί
glossary.θήσειν: τίθημι — put, place, make; fut. inf. θήσειν: ’to make’ (+ pred. adj.)
glossary.κάμμορε: κάμμορος (= κατάμορος) — ill-fated, wretched; masc. voc. sg. (κατά cut short, τ assimilated to μ)
glossary.καθήμενον: κάθημαι — sit, be seated; pres. part. masc. acc. sg.: ’sitting’
glossary.καθίζων: καθίζω — sit down, take one’s seat; pres. part. act. masc. nom. sg.: ’sitting’
glossary.κατείβετο: κατείβω — let flow down; mid. flow away, ebb; impf. mid. 3 sg.: ’was ebbing away’ (of αἰών ’life’)
glossary.κατειβόμενον: κατείβω — let flow down; mid. flow down; pres. mid. part. neut. nom./acc. sg.: ’down-flowing’ (of the Styx’s water)
glossary.κοτεσσάμενος: κοτέω — bear a grudge, be angry; aor. part. mid. masc. nom. sg.: ’having taken offense, bearing a grudge’
glossary.κρῆναί: κραίνω — accomplish, bring to pass, fulfil; aor. inf., epic κρῆναι (= Attic κρᾶναι), infinitive of respect: ’to accomplish’
glossary.λιμὸν: λιμός — hunger, famine; masc. acc. sg.
glossary.μάχοντο: μάχομαι — fight; impf. 3 pl., unaugmented (= ἐμάχοντο): ’were fighting’
glossary.μέγιστος: μέγας — great; superl. masc. nom. sg.: ’greatest’
glossary.μέσῳ: μέσος — middle, in the middle of; masc./neut. dat. sg., agreeing with πόντῳ: ’in the middle of the sea’
glossary.μήδεαι: μήδομαι — devise, plan, contrive; pres. mid. 2 sg., epic uncontracted (= Attic μήδῃ)
glossary.μίγη: μίγνυμι — mix, unite; aor. pass. (sense mid.) 3 sg., unaugmented (= ἐμίγη): ’was united (with), lay (with)’ + dat.
glossary.μακρά: μακρός — long, tall, high; neut. nom./acc. pl. (κύματα μακρά ’long waves’)
glossary.μακρὰ: μακρός — long, tall, high; neut. nom./acc. pl. (δούρατα μακρὰ ’long timbers’)
glossary.μενοεικέ: μενοεικής — satisfying, suited to one’s desire; neut. acc. pl., elided (μενοεικέ’ = μενοεικέα)
glossary.μηδοίμην: μήδομαι — devise, plan, contrive; pres. opt. mid. 1 sg., potential with ἄν: ’I would devise’
glossary.νειῷ: νειός — fallow field; fem. dat. sg. (νειῷ ἔνι τριπόλῳ ’in a thrice-ploughed fallow field’)
glossary.νημερτέως: νημερτής — unerring; adv. νημερτέως: ’unerringly’ (νη- ’not’ + root of ἁμαρτάνω ’miss the mark’)
glossary.νοῆσαί: νοέω — perceive, devise, have in mind; aor. inf. νοῆσαι, infinitive of respect: ’to devise, in devising’
glossary.οἴνοπι: οἶνοψ — wine-dark, wine-faced (of the sea); masc. dat. sg., agreeing with πόντῳ
glossary.οὐρανὸς: οὐρανός — sky, heaven; masc. nom. sg.
glossary.οὔθ: οὔτε (elided οὔθ’, before rough breathing) — nor, and not; correlative negative conj.
glossary.οὔρῳ: οὖρος — fair wind, following wind; masc. dat. sg.
glossary.πέλασσε: πελάζω — bring near, draw near; aor. 3 sg., unaugmented, epic σσ (= Attic ἐπέλασε): ’brought near’
glossary.πέρσαντες: πέρθω — sack, destroy, lay waste; aor. part. act. masc. nom. pl.: ’having sacked’
glossary.πέτρῃσι: πέτρη — rock; fem. dat. pl., epic -ῃσι(ν) (= Attic πέτραις)
glossary.παρεξελθεῖν: παρεξέρχομαι — get past, slip past, evade; aor. inf. (παρα- + ἐξ- + ἐλθεῖν): ’to get past, evade’
glossary.παρεῖναι: πάρειμι — be present, be at hand, be with (someone); pres. inf.: ’to be with, to be present’
glossary.περάαν: περάω — pass through, cross; pres. inf., epic περάαν with vowel stretched (diectasis) (= Attic περᾶν)
glossary.περόωσιν: περάω — pass through, cross; pres. 3 pl., epic περόωσιν with vowel stretched (diectasis) (= Attic περῶσιν)
glossary.ποιήσετ: ποιέω — make; aor. subj. mid. 3 sg., epic short-vowel (= Attic ποιήσηται), elided ποιήσετ’: ’should make for herself’
glossary.πολύτλας: πολύτλας — much-enduring; adj., masc. nom. sg., standing epithet of Odysseus (πολύ ’much’ + root of τλῆναι ’endure’)
glossary.πομπήν: πομπή — convoy, escort, safe conduct (given a departing guest); fem. acc. sg.
glossary.πρόφρασσ: πρόφρων — willing, ready-minded; fem. πρόφρασσα, elided (πρόφρασσ’ = πρόφρασσα), nom. sg.
glossary.πῆξαι: πήγνυμι — fix, fasten; aor. inf. used as an imperative: ’fix, fasten!’ (or aor. mid. imper. 2 sg., the same form)
glossary.σιδήρεος: σιδήρεος — of iron, iron; masc. nom. sg. (θυμὸς ... σιδήρεος ’a heart of iron’)
glossary.στυγὸς: Στύξ — the Styx, the underworld river by which the gods swear their most binding oath; fem. gen. sg.
glossary.σχέτλιοί: σχέτλιος — cruel, hard-hearted, stubborn; masc. nom. pl., word of reproach
glossary.σχεδίῃ: σχεδίη — raft; fem. dat. sg., instrumental: ’on a raft’
glossary.τέρσοντο: τέρσομαι — become dry, dry up; impf. 3 pl., unaugmented (= ἐτέρσοντο): ’were becoming dry’
glossary.ταμὼν: τέμνω — cut; aor. part. act. masc. nom. sg.: ’having cut, cutting’
glossary.τοσσόνδε: τοσόσδε (epic τοσσόσδε, with -δε and double σ) — so much, so great; neut. acc. sg., agreeing with ὕδωρ: ’so great a stretch of’
glossary.τριπόλῳ: τρίπολος — thrice-ploughed, ploughed three times; fem. dat. sg., agreeing with νειῷ
glossary.τρόπιος: τρόπις — keel; fem. gen. sg., governed by περί: ’around, astride the keel’
glossary.τῇδ: τῇδε (elided τῇδ’) — here, in this place; adv.
glossary.φέρτεροί: φέρτερος — stronger, better, superior; comparative adj. (no positive in use), masc. nom. pl., + gen. of comparison: ’stronger than’
glossary.φέρῃσιν: φέρω — carry, bear; pres. subj. 3 sg., epic -ῃσι (= Attic φέρῃ), in a purpose clause: ’so that it may carry’
glossary.φίλεόν: φιλέω — love, hold dear; impf. 1 sg., unaugmented, uncontracted (= Attic ἐφίλουν): ’I loved’
glossary.φησί: φημί — say, assert; pres. 3 sg.: ’he/she says’
glossary.φθινέτω: φθίνω — waste away, decay, perish; pres. imper. 3 sg.: ’let it waste away’
glossary.φράσσομαι: φράζομαι — take thought, consider, devise; fut. 1 sg. (or short-vowel aor. subj.), epic σσ: ’I will take thought’
glossary.χαλεπήνῃ: χαλεπαίνω — be harsh, angry, deal harshly; aor. subj. 3 sg., in a clause of fear with μή: ’lest he be harsh’
glossary.χρυσόθρονος: χρυσόθρονος — golden-throned; adj., fem. nom. sg., epithet of goddesses (an old alternative derives the second element from θρόνα ’embroidered flowers’)
glossary.ἀγάασθε: ἄγαμαι — wonder at; resent, begrudge; pres. mid. 2 pl., epic diectasis (stretched vowel): ’you begrudge’
glossary.ἀγήραον: ἀγήραος (= ἀγήρως) — ageless, not growing old; masc./fem. acc. sg., predicate adj. with θήσειν: ’ageless’ (ἀ- + γῆρας)
glossary.ἀγαλλόμεναι: ἀγάλλω — glorify; mid. exult, glory (in); pres. part. mid. fem. nom. pl.: ’exulting’ (+ dat., in something)
glossary.ἀγορεῦσαι: ἀγορεύω — speak, say, proclaim; aor. inf.: ’to speak, to say’
glossary.ἀθάνατον: ἀθάνατος — immortal, deathless; masc./fem. acc. sg.
glossary.ἀκοίτην: ἀκοίτης — bedfellow, husband; masc. acc. sg. (ἀ- copulative + κοίτη ’bed’)
glossary.ἀλίτοντο: ἀλιταίνω — sin against, offend, transgress against; aor. mid. 3 pl., unaugmented (= ἠλίτοντο): ’they sinned against’ (+ acc.)
glossary.ἀλιτρός: ἀλιτρός — offender, sinner, rogue; masc. nom. sg. (built on the root of ἀλιταίνω ’sin against’)
glossary.ἀμφιέσω: ἀμφιέννυμι — clothe, put clothes on (someone); fut. 1 sg.: ’I will clothe’
glossary.ἀπέφθιθεν: ἀποφθίνω — perish, die; aor. pass. 3 pl., epic short ending -θεν (= Attic ἀπεφθίθησαν): ’perished’
glossary.ἀπονόσφιν: ἀπονόσφιν — far away, apart from; adv./prep. + gen.: ’far from’ (φίλων ἀπονόσφιν ’far from his dear ones’)
glossary.ἀποπέμψω: ἀποπέμπω — send away, send off, dismiss; fut. 1 sg.: ’I will send away’
glossary.ἀποπεμπέμεν: ἀποπέμπω — send away, send off; pres. inf., epic -έμεν (= Attic ἀποπέμπειν): ’to send away’
glossary.ἀποφώλια: ἀποφώλιος — empty, vain, idle; neut. acc. pl. (substantival), object of εἰδώς; formation obscure, sense conventional
glossary.ἀπόπεμπε: ἀποπέμπω — send away, send off; pres. imper. 2 sg.: ’send (him) away’
glossary.ἀργῆτι: ἀργής — bright, vivid white, gleaming; masc. dat. sg., of the lightning-flash (distinct root from ἀργός)
glossary.ἁγνὴ: ἁγνός — pure, holy, chaste; fem. nom. sg.
glossary.ἁλιῶσαι: ἁλιόω — make vain, frustrate, bring to nothing; aor. inf. (built on ἅλιος ’fruitless’): ’to bring to nothing’
glossary.ἁρμόζεο: ἁρμόζω — fit together, join, build; pres. imper. mid. 2 sg., epic uncontracted (= Attic ἁρμόζου): ’fit together (for yourself)’
glossary.ἂμ: ἀνά (shortened and assimilated ἂμ before π) — up, along, among; prep. + dat.: ’along, among’ · also + acc., ’along, across, over’ (motion): ἂμ πεδίον ’over the plain’, ἂμ πέλαγος ’over the open sea’
glossary.ἄγασθε: ἄγαμαι — wonder at; resent, begrudge; pres. mid. 2 pl.: ’you begrudge’
glossary.ἄρτεμις: Ἄρτεμις — Artemis, goddess of the hunt and of sudden painless death (esp. of women); fem. nom. sg.
glossary.ἄσπετον: ἄσπετος — unspeakable, vast beyond telling; neut. acc. sg., agreeing with ὕδωρ (ἀ- + root of ἔννεπε ’tell’)
glossary.ἅσσ: ὅστις (neut. pl. ἅσσα, epic = Attic ἅττα) — whoever, whatever; elided ἅσσ’ = ἅσσα: ’whatever things’
glossary.ἐθέλοντα: ἐθέλω — wish, be willing; pres. part. masc. acc. sg.: ’willing’ (οὐκ ἐθέλοντα ’not willing, unwillingly’)
glossary.ἐθέλωσι: ἐθέλω — wish, be willing; pres. subj. 3 pl., in a conditional clause with κε: ’are willing’
glossary.ἐκέασσε: κεάζω — split, shatter; aor. 3 sg., epic σσ (= Attic ἐκέασε): ’shattered’
glossary.ἐλεήμων: ἐλεήμων — pitying, compassionate; masc. nom. sg. (from ἔλεος ’pity’)
glossary.ἐμέ: ἐγώ — I; acc. sg., accented emphatic form (non-enclitic) (= enclitic με): ’me’
glossary.ἐναίσιμος: ἐναίσιμος — fitting, right, according to due measure; masc./fem. nom. sg. (built on αἶσα ’due share’)
glossary.ἐνθήσω: ἐντίθημι — put in, place in, stow aboard; fut. 1 sg.: ’I will put aboard’
glossary.ἐνισπήσω: ἐνέπω (by-form of ἐννέπω) — tell, relate; fut. 1 sg. ἐνισπήσω: ’I will tell’
glossary.ἐπέκλυεν: ἐπικλύω — hear, give ear to, listen to; aor. 3 sg., + gen.: ’she had heard’
glossary.ἐπεφράσθης: ἐπιφράζομαι — think of, devise, contrive; aor. 2 sg., passive in form: ’you thought of, you devised’
glossary.ἐπιβαίην: ἐπιβαίνω — set foot on, board, embark upon; aor. opt. 1 sg., potential with ἄν, + gen.: ’I would set foot on’
glossary.ἐποπίζεο: ἐποπίζομαι — regard with awe, respect, heed; pres. imper. mid. 2 sg., epic uncontracted: ’respect, beware’ (built on ὄπις, the gods’ watchful regard)
glossary.ἐποτρύνει: ἐποτρύνω — urge on, spur on, incite; pres. 3 sg.
glossary.ἐπῶρσ: ἐπόρνυμι — rouse, stir up (against); aor. 3 sg., augmented, elided (ἐπῶρσ’ = ἐπῶρσε): ’roused (against them)’
glossary.ἐρρέτω: ἔρρω — go to one’s ruin, be off, be gone; pres. imper. 3 sg.: ’let him go to ruin, be gone’ (a curse)
glossary.ἐρυθρὸν: ἐρυθρός — red; masc. acc. sg. (οἶνον ἐρυθρόν ’red wine’)
glossary.ἐρύκοι: ἐρύκω — keep off, ward off, hold back; pres. opt. 3 sg., potential with κε in a relative clause: ’which would keep off’
glossary.ἐσάωσα: σαόω (Attic σῴζω) — save, keep safe; aor. 1 sg.: ’I saved’
glossary.ἐῖσαι: ἐίσος (= ἴσος) — well-balanced, even (of ships; sense uncertain); fem. nom. pl. ἐῖσαι, agreeing with νῆες
glossary.ἔβησαν: βαίνω — go, walk, set off; aor. 3 pl.: ’they set off’
glossary.ἔλσας: εἴλω — hem in, pin down, confine; aor. part. act. masc. nom. sg.: ’having pinned down’
glossary.ἔτρεφον: τρέφω — nurture, rear, feed; impf. 1 sg.: ’I nurtured, I fed’
glossary.ἔφασκον: φημί — say, assert; impf. 1 sg., iterative in -σκ- (epic): ’I kept saying’
glossary.ἠγάασθε: ἄγαμαι — wonder at; resent, begrudge; impf. mid. 2 pl., epic diectasis (stretched vowel): ’you begrudged’
glossary.ἠιόνεσσι: ἠιών — beach, shore; fem. dat. pl., epic -εσσι (= Attic -όσι)
glossary.ἠνώγειν: ἄνωγα (defective, perf. with pres. force) — command, bid, order; plupf. 3 sg. in -ειν, epic variant (= ἠνώγει, often labelled impf.), serving as simple past: ’he bade’
glossary.ἤι: εἶμι — go; impf. 3 sg. ἤιε, elided ἤι’: ’she went’
glossary.ἰασίωνι: Ἰασίων — Iasion, a mortal loved by Demeter; masc. dat. sg.
glossary.ἰαύεσκεν: ἰαύω — sleep, pass the night; impf. 3 sg., iterative in -σκ- (epic): ’he would sleep’
glossary.ἱερά: ἱερός (neut. as noun ἱερόν) — sacred thing, offering, sacrifice; neut. acc. pl.: ’offerings’
glossary.ἱσταμένη: ἵστημι — set, make stand; mid. stand, come to stand; pres. part. mid. fem. nom. sg.: ’coming to stand, standing’
glossary.ἴκρια: ἴκρια — deck-planks, decking (of a ship or raft); neut. acc. pl.
glossary.ἴστω: οἶδα — know; perf. imper. 3 sg.: ’let it/him/her know’ (calling something to witness)
glossary.ἵκοι: ἱκνέομαι — come, arrive at, reach, come upon; aor. opt. 3 sg., conditional/potential optative: ’should come upon’ (of need, χρειὼ ... ἵκοι)
glossary.ὀδυρομένῳ: ὀδύρομαι — lament, mourn, bewail; pres. part. masc. dat. sg.: ’as he lamented’ (dative of the person concerned)
glossary.ὀδύρεο: ὀδύρομαι — lament, mourn; pres. imper. mid. 2 sg., epic uncontracted (= Attic ὀδύρου), after μή: ’do not lament’
glossary.ὀιζυρώτατον: ὀιζυρός — wretched, miserable; superl. masc. acc. sg.: ’most wretched’, + gen. of comparison
glossary.ὀμόσσαι: ὄμνυμι — swear; aor. inf., epic σσ (= Attic ὀμόσαι): ’to swear’
glossary.ὀρτυγίῃ: Ὀρτυγίη — Ortygia, ’Quail-island’, an unidentified place; fem. dat. sg.
glossary.ὠκύποροι: ὠκύπορος — swift-faring, swiftly passing; fem. nom. pl., agreeing with νῆες (ὠκύς ’swift’ + πόρος ’passage’)
glossary.ὠρίων: Ὠρίων — Orion, a hunter loved by Dawn; masc. acc. sg., elided (Ὠρίων’ = Ὠρίωνα)
glossary.ῥέζουσι: ῥέζω — do, perform; offer (a sacrifice); pres. 3 pl.
glossary.ῥίγησεν: ῥιγέω — shudder, shiver (with dread); aor. 3 sg., unaugmented (= ἐρρίγησεν) (root of ῥῖγος ’cold, frost’)
glossary.αἰθιόπεσσιν: Αἰθίοψ — an Ethiopian; masc. dat. pl., epic -εσσι(ν) (= Attic Αἰθίοψι)
glossary.αἰθιόπων: Αἰθίοψ — an Ethiopian; masc. gen. pl.
glossary.αὐτίχ: αὐτίκα — at once, straightaway; adv., elided and aspirated before a rough breathing (αὐτίχ’ = αὐτίκα)
glossary.αὖα: αὖος (= αὗος) — dry, withered; neut. nom./acc. pl.
glossary.βάλετ: βάλλω — throw; aor. 3 sg. mid., unaugmented, elided (βάλετ’ = βάλετο); in tmesis περὶ … βάλετ’ ’threw around (oneself)’
glossary.βοώτην: Βοώτης — Boötes, the constellation (lit. ’ox-driver’, βοῦς); masc. acc. sg.
glossary.βροτός: βροτός — mortal, a mortal; masc. or fem. nom. sg. (adj. of two terminations, so also of a woman)
glossary.γενέσθω: γίγνομαι — become, come to pass; aor. imper. 3 sg.: ’let it come to pass’
glossary.γηθόσυνος: γηθόσυνος — glad, joyful; masc. nom. sg., from γηθέω ’rejoice’
glossary.γλαφυρὸν: γλαφυρός — hollow; masc. acc. or neut. nom./acc. sg.
glossary.γόμφοισιν: γόμφος — peg, bolt, a wooden dowel; masc. dat. pl., epic -οισι(ν) (= Attic -οις)
glossary.δένδρεα: δένδρεον — tree; neut. nom./acc. pl., epic uncontracted (= Attic δένδρα)
glossary.δεῖξ: δείκνυμι — show; aor. 3 sg., unaugmented, elided (δεῖξ’ = δεῖξε; Attic ἔδειξε)
glossary.δοκεύει: δοκεύω — watch, spy, keep watch on; pres. 3 sg.
glossary.δοῦρα: δόρυ — tree-trunk, beam, timber; also spear-shaft, spear; neut. nom./acc. pl.
glossary.δύοντα: δύω — sink, set (of a star); pres. part. masc. acc. sg.: ’setting’
glossary.δῶκέν: δίδωμι — give; aor. 3 sg., unaugmented, with movable ν (= Attic ἔδωκε(ν))
glossary.εἰδείης: οἶδα — know; perf. opt. 2 sg. with pres. force (= Attic εἰδείης): ’you might know’
glossary.εἰσάντα: εἰσάντα — face to face, opposite; adv. (εἰσάντα ἰδέσθαι ’to look at face to face’)
glossary.εἴης: εἰμί — be; pres. opt. 2 sg.: ’you would be’
glossary.εἴσατο: εἴδομαι — appear, seem, look like; aor. 3 sg. · also + dat. of a person: ’come into view, appear (to someone)’
glossary.εἶλαρ: εἶλαρ — defence, shelter, protection; neut. nom./acc. sg.
glossary.εὐρείης: εὐρύς — wide, broad; fem. gen. sg., epic (= Attic εὐρείας)
glossary.ζώνην: ζώνη — belt, girdle; fem. acc. sg.
glossary.θαμέσι: θαμέες — close-set, crowded, frequent; masc. dat. pl. (fem. θαμειαί)
glossary.θνητὰς: θνητός — mortal; adj., fem. acc. pl.
glossary.θρόνου: θρόνος — chair, seat; masc. gen. sg.
glossary.θυώδεα: θυώδης — fragrant, sweet-smelling (θύος ’incense’); neut. acc. pl., epic uncontracted (= Attic θυώδη)
glossary.κάλους: κάλως (epic κάλος) — rope; of rigging, perhaps ’halyard’ (exact sense among a ship’s ropes uncertain); masc. acc. pl.
glossary.καθέζετ: καθέζομαι — sit down; impf. 3 sg., elided (καθέζετ’ = καθέζετο)
glossary.κακότητος: κακότης — evil, misery, wretchedness; fem. gen. sg.
glossary.καλέουσιν: καλέω — call; pres. 3 pl., epic uncontracted (= Attic καλοῦσι(ν))
glossary.καλύπτρην: καλύπτρη — veil, head-covering; fem. acc. sg. (from καλύπτω ’cover’)
glossary.καλὴν: καλός — beautiful, fair; fem. acc. sg.
glossary.κατείρυσεν: κατερύω — drag down, haul down (a ship to the sea); aor. 3 sg., on the lengthened stem εἰρυ- beside ἐρυ-
glossary.κείνης: κεῖνος (= ἐκεῖνος) — that, that one; fem. gen. sg.
glossary.κηρόθι: κῆρ — heart; with the suffix -θι of place: ’in the heart’, adv.
glossary.κινήσας: κινέω — move, set in motion, shake; aor. part. masc. nom. sg.: ’shaking’
glossary.κωρύκῳ: κώρυκος — leather sack, bag; masc. dat. sg.
glossary.λαερτιάδη: Λαερτιάδης — son of Laertes, patronymic of Odysseus; voc. sg.
glossary.λιαρόν: λιαρός — warm, mild; masc./neut. acc. sg.
glossary.λοετρῶν: λοετρόν — bath; neut. gen. pl., epic uncontracted (= Attic λουτρῶν)
glossary.λούσασα: λούω — wash, bathe; aor. part. fem. nom. sg.: ’having bathed’
glossary.μέγεθός: μέγεθος — size, stature; neut. nom./acc. sg.
glossary.μέλανος: μέλας — black, dark; masc./neut. gen. sg.
glossary.μένων: μένω — remain, stay; pres. part. masc. nom. sg.: ’staying’
glossary.μακρῇσιν: μακρός — long; fem. dat. pl., epic -ῃσι(ν) (= Attic -αῖς)
glossary.μεγαλήτορι: μεγαλήτωρ — great-spirited, great-hearted; masc. dat. sg.
glossary.μενοεικέα: μενοεικής — satisfying, to one’s heart’s desire (μένος + ἔοικα); neut. acc. pl.
glossary.μετεβούλευσαν: μεταβουλεύω — change one’s plans, take second thoughts; aor. 3 pl., augmented inside the compound (μετ-ε-βούλευσαν)
glossary.μοχλοῖσιν: μοχλός — lever, bar; masc. dat. pl., epic -οισι(ν) (= Attic -οις)
glossary.μυθήσατο: μυθέομαι — speak, say, tell; aor. 3 sg.
glossary.μόγησα: μογέω — toil, labour, suffer hardship; aor. 1 sg., unaugmented: ’I toiled’
glossary.ξέσσε: ξέω — plane, smooth, scrape; aor. 3 sg., epic σσ (= Attic ἔξεσε)
glossary.οἰσυΐνῃσι: οἰσύϊνος — of osier, made of willow-withies; fem. dat. pl., epic -ῃσι(ν)
glossary.οὐρανομήκης: οὐρανομήκης — reaching to heaven, heaven-high; adj., masc./fem. nom. sg.
glossary.πάλαι: πάλαι — long ago, of old; adv.
glossary.πέμπ: πέμπω — send, send off; impf. 3 sg., unaugmented, elided (πέμπ’ = πέμπε)
glossary.πέμπτῳ: πέμπτος — fifth; masc./neut. dat. sg. (sc. ἤματι), ’on the fifth (day)’
glossary.πέτασ: πετάννυμι — spread out; aor. 3 sg., unaugmented, elided (πέτασ’ = πέτασε)
glossary.παλάμῃσι: παλάμη — palm, hand; fem. dat. pl., epic -ῃσι (= Attic -αις)
glossary.πελέκκησεν: πελεκκάω — hew, shape with an axe (πέλεκυς); aor. 3 sg.
glossary.περίκηλα: περίκηλος — very dry, thoroughly dried (rare word, formation uncertain); neut. nom./acc. pl.
glossary.περικαλλὲς: περικαλλής — very beautiful; neut. nom./acc. sg.
glossary.πεῖραρ: πεῖραρ — end, limit; also rope, bond (which is meant in a given passage is often disputed); neut. nom./acc. sg.
glossary.πηδαλίῳ: πηδάλιον — steering-oar, rudder; neut. dat. sg.
glossary.πλέεν: πλέω — sail; impf. 3 sg., epic uncontracted and unaugmented (= Attic ἔπλει)
glossary.πληιάδας: Πληιάδες — the Pleiades, a star-cluster; fem. acc. pl.
glossary.πλώοιεν: πλώω (epic = πλέω) — float, sail; pres. opt. 3 pl.
glossary.ποίει: ποιέω — make; impf. 3 sg., unaugmented (= Attic ἐποίει)
glossary.ποιήσασθαι: ποιέω — make; aor. mid. inf.: ’to make for oneself’
glossary.ποιήσατ: ποιέω — make; aor. 3 sg. mid., elided (ποιήσατ’ = ποιήσατο)
glossary.ποιήσατο: ποιέω — make; aor. 3 sg. mid.: ’made for himself’
glossary.πολυμήχαν: πολυμήχανος — many-devising; voc. sg., elided (πολυμήχαν’ = πολυμήχανε)
glossary.ποντοπορευέμεναι: ποντοπορεύω — travel over the open sea; pres. inf. in -έμεναι, epic (= Attic ποντοπορεύειν)
glossary.ποντοπορεύων: ποντοπορεύω — travel over the open sea; pres. part. masc. nom. sg.
glossary.πότνα: πότνια — lady, mistress; voc. sg., shortened epic form πότνα (= πότνια)
glossary.σκέπαρνον: σκέπαρνον — a woodworking tool for dressing timber, usually taken as an adze, though its exact shape is not certain; neut. acc. sg.
glossary.σολύμων: Σόλυμοι — the Solymi, a people of Lycia; masc. gen. pl.
glossary.σπεῖος: σπέος — cave, grotto; neut. acc. sg., epic σπεῖος (= Attic σπέος)
glossary.στάθμην: στάθμη — carpenter’s line or rule, for marking a straight edge; fem. acc. sg.
glossary.στήσας: ἵστημι — set up, raise; aor. part. masc. nom. sg., transitive: ’having set up’
glossary.σταμίνεσσι: σταμίν — rib of a hull, or upright carrying the deck (exact referent uncertain); masc. dat. pl., epic -εσσι(ν)
glossary.στειλειὸν: στειλειόν — axe-haft, handle; neut. nom./acc. sg.
glossary.στρέφεται: στρέφω — turn; pres. 3 sg. mid./pass.: ’turns, wheels round’
glossary.τάμνετο: τάμνω (epic = τέμνω) — cut; impf. 3 sg. mid., unaugmented: ’was cutting for himself’
glossary.τέρετρα: τέρετρον — auger, borer, a tool for boring holes; neut. nom./acc. pl.
glossary.τέτρηνεν: τετραίνω — bore through, pierce; aor. 3 sg., unaugmented (= Attic ἐτέτρηνε)
glossary.ταλαπενθέα: ταλαπενθής — grief-enduring, patient in suffering; adj., masc./fem. acc. sg.
glossary.τεκτοσυνάων: τεκτοσύνη — carpentry, the craft of building; fem. gen. pl., epic -άων (= Attic -ῶν)
glossary.τερπέσθην: τέρπομαι — delight, take pleasure; impf. 3 dual, unaugmented: ’the two took delight’
glossary.τετέλεστο: τελέω — finish, accomplish; plpf. pass. 3 sg., unaugmented: ’had been finished’
glossary.τεχνήσατο: τεχνάομαι — work with skill, craft, fashion (τέχνη); aor. 3 sg., unaugmented
glossary.τλήσομαι: τλάω — endure, bear up under; fut. 1 sg.: ’I shall endure’
glossary.τορνώσεται: τορνόω — round off, mark out with a compass (τόρνος); aor. subj. 3 sg., short-vowel subj. (= Attic τορνώσηται)
glossary.τώ: ὁ, ἡ, τό — he, she, it (in Homer a pronoun); dual nom.: ’the two of them, they two’ (τώ γε)
glossary.φάρε: φᾶρος — large woven cloth, robe; neut. nom./acc. pl., uncontracted (φάρε’ = φάρεα)
glossary.φορτίδος: φορτίς — cargo-ship, freighter (φόρτος ’cargo’); fem. gen. sg.
glossary.φράξε: φράσσω — fence in, block off; aor. 3 sg., unaugmented
glossary.φυήν: φυή — stature, natural growth, form; fem. acc. sg.
glossary.φυλάσσοις: φυλάσσω — guard, keep watch over; pres. opt. 2 sg.: ’you would keep’
glossary.χαρίεν: χαρίεις — graceful, charming; neut. nom./acc. sg.
glossary.χερείων: χερείων — worse, inferior; epic comparative of κακός (= Attic χείρων); masc./fem. nom. sg.
glossary.χλαῖνάν: χλαῖνα — a thick woollen cloak; fem. acc. sg.
glossary.χρυσείην: χρύσειος — golden, of gold; fem. acc. sg.
glossary.χώεο: χώομαι — be angry; pres. imper. 2 sg., epic uncontracted (= Attic χώου)
glossary.ἀγήρως: ἀγήραος — ageless, not growing old (ἀ- + γῆρας); masc./fem. nom. sg., contracted ἀγήρως
glossary.ἀθανάτῃσι: ἀθάνατος — immortal; fem. dat. pl., epic -ῃσι(ν) (= Attic -αις)
glossary.ἀκιδνοτέρη: ἀκιδνός — slight, feeble, of little account (rare word); comparative, fem. nom. sg.
glossary.ἀμφιέσασα: ἀμφιέννυμι — put clothes around, clothe; aor. part. fem. nom. sg.: ’having clothed’
glossary.ἀμφοτέρωθεν: ἀμφότερος — both; adv. with suffix -θεν: ’on both sides’
glossary.ἀναπλῆσαι: ἀναπίμπλημι — fill up, fulfil, as one fills a measure; aor. inf.
glossary.ἀνιὼν: ἄνειμι — go back, come back, return; pres. part. masc. nom. sg.
glossary.ἀπήμονά: ἀπήμων — without harm (ἀ- + πῆμα): harmless, doing no harm, or unharmed, safe; masc./fem. acc. sg.
glossary.ἀραρὼν: ἀραρίσκω — fit together, join; aor. part. masc. nom. sg., transitive: ’fitting’
glossary.ἀργύφεον: ἀργύφεος — silver-white, shining white; masc./neut. acc. sg.
glossary.ἀριστερὰ: ἀριστερός — left; neut. acc. pl., used adverbially with ἐπί: ’on the left (hand)’
glossary.ἀσκὸν: ἀσκός — skin, leather bag for liquids; masc. acc. sg.
glossary.ἁρμονίῃσιν: ἁρμονίη — joint, fastening (exact device uncertain: perhaps mortise-and-tenon, clamps, or lashings); fem. dat. pl., epic -ῃσι(ν)
glossary.ἄγχιστον: ἄγχιστος — nearest, superlative of ἄγχι ’near’; neut. acc./nom. sg. used predicatively
glossary.ἄλλως: ἄλλως — otherwise, in another way; adv.
glossary.ἄμαξαν: ἄμαξα — wagon, cart; also a by-name of the Great Bear; fem. acc. sg.
glossary.ἄμμορός: ἄμμορος (= ἄμορος) — without a share, having no part; fem. nom. sg., + gen.
glossary.ἄνωγε: ἄνωγα — command, bid, order; perf. with pres./past force, 3 sg.: ’bade, had bidden’
glossary.ἄρασσεν: ἀράσσω — strike, hammer, dash together; impf. 3 sg., unaugmented (= Attic ἤρασσε)
glossary.ἄρκτον: ἄρκτος — bear; also the constellation, the Great Bear; fem. acc. sg.
glossary.ἄρμενον: ἀραρίσκω — fit, join; sync. aor. mid. part., ’fitted, fitting’; masc. acc. or neut. nom./acc. sg.
glossary.ἅδην: ἅδην — to one’s fill, to satiety; adv., + gen.
glossary.ἐέλδεαι: ἐέλδομαι (= ἔλδομαι) — yearn for, long for, desire; pres. 2 sg. mid., epic uncontracted (Attic ending -ῃ)
glossary.ἐέλδομαι: ἐέλδομαι (= ἔλδομαι) — yearn for, long for, desire; pres. 1 sg. mid.
glossary.ἐκφυγέειν: ἐκφεύγω — flee from, escape; aor. inf., epic (= Attic ἐκφυγεῖν)
glossary.ἐλάινον: ἐλάϊνος — of olive-wood (ἐλαία); masc./neut. acc. sg.
glossary.ἐλάτη: ἐλάτη — fir, silver fir, a tree (ancient tree-names do not always match modern species); fem. nom. sg.
glossary.ἐλαφρῶς: ἐλαφρός — light, nimble; adv. ἐλαφρῶς: ’lightly, easily’
glossary.ἐνέδησεν: ἐνδέω — bind in, fasten on; aor. 3 sg., augmented inside the compound (ἐν-έ-δησεν)
glossary.ἐναρηρός: ἐναραρίσκω — fit in, fix fast; perf. part. intrans., masc./neut. nom. sg.: ’fitted in, fixed fast’
glossary.ἐπίκλησιν: ἐπίκλησις — a name, surname, by-name; fem. acc. sg. used adverbially: ’by name, as a byname’
glossary.ἐπίκριον: ἐπίκριον — the yard, the spar fixed across the mast from which the sail hangs (a rare word); neut. nom./acc. sg.
glossary.ἐπεχεύατο: ἐπιχέω — pour on, heap on, of loose material in bulk; aor. 3 sg. mid.
glossary.ἐπηγκενίδεσσι: ἐπηγκενίδες — long planks laid along a hull’s sides over the ribs, a kind of gunwale (exact referent uncertain, rare word); fem. dat. pl., epic -εσσι(ν)
glossary.ἐπιπλώων: ἐπιπλώω — sail over, sail upon; pres. part. masc. nom. sg.
glossary.ἐρίζειν: ἐρίζω — vie, contend, rival; pres. inf., + dat.
glossary.ἐσορῶντι: ἐσοράω — look upon, watch, gaze at; pres. part. masc. dat. sg.
glossary.ἐσχατιῆς: ἐσχατιή — edge, border, remotest part; fem. gen. sg.
glossary.ἐφάνη: φαίνω — show; aor. pass. 3 sg., augmented (beside unaugmented φάνη): ’appeared’
glossary.ἐχώσατο: χώομαι — be angry, be enraged; aor. 3 sg.
glossary.ἑπτὰ: ἑπτά — seven; numeral, indecl. (ἑπτὰ καὶ δέκα ’seventeen’)
glossary.ἔδαφος: ἔδαφος — bottom, floor (of a ship’s hull), ground; neut. nom./acc. sg.
glossary.ἔθηκαν: τίθημι — put, place, set; aor. 3 pl., built like the sg. ἔθηκε rather than the root-aorist (= Attic ἔθεσαν)
glossary.ἔμεν: εἰμί — be; pres. inf., epic, shortened (= Attic εἶναι; cf. ἔμμεναι)
glossary.ἔσθειν: ἐσθίω — eat; pres. inf., epic by-form of ἐσθίειν (= Attic ἐσθίειν)
glossary.ἕννυτ: ἕννυμι — put on, clothe; impf. 3 sg. mid., unaugmented, elided (ἕννυτ’ = ἕννυτο)
glossary.ἕννυτο: ἕννυμι — put on, clothe; impf. 3 sg. mid., unaugmented
glossary.ἕτερον: ἕτερος — the other (of two); masc./neut. acc. sg. · also neut. nom. sg., ’one (part)’, correlative: ἕτερον μὲν θειλόπεδον ... ἑτέρας δέ ’one part a drying-ground ... other parts’
glossary.ἤνυτο: ἄνυμι (= ἀνύω) — accomplish, get done; impf. pass. 3 sg., athematic by-form: ’was getting done’
glossary.ἥρμοσεν: ἁρμόζω — fit together, join; aor. 3 sg.
glossary.ἰθύνετο: ἰθύνω — guide straight, steer; impf. 3 sg. mid.: ’kept steering’
glossary.ἰθύνοι: ἰθύνω — guide straight, steer; pres. opt. 3 sg., in a purpose clause: ’so that he might steer’
glossary.ἱμειρόμενός: ἱμείρομαι — long for, desire; pres. part. masc. nom. sg.; with concessive περ, ’though longing’
glossary.ἴθυνεν: ἰθύνω — make straight, guide, direct; aor. 3 sg.
glossary.ἷζεν: ἵζω — sit, sit down; impf. 3 sg.
glossary.ὀδυσσῆι: Ὀδυσσεύς — Odysseus; dat. sg., double-σ, metrical variant beside single-σ Ὀδυσῆι
glossary.ὀκτωκαιδεκάτῃ: ὀκτωκαιδέκατος — eighteenth; fem. dat. sg. (sc. ἡμέρῃ), ’on the eighteenth (day)’
glossary.ὀρέων: ὄρος — mountain; neut. gen. pl., epic uncontracted (= Attic ὀρῶν)
glossary.ὄρεα: ὄρος — mountain; neut. nom./acc. pl., epic uncontracted (= Attic ὄρη)
glossary.ὑπέρας: ὑπέρα — brace, a rope from the yard-end for swinging the yard (rigging term); fem. acc. pl.
glossary.ὕλην: ὕλη — wood, timber, brushwood; fem. acc. sg.
glossary.ὠκεανοῖο: Ὠκεανός — Ocean, the river encircling the earth; masc. gen. sg., epic -οιο (= Attic -οῦ)
glossary.ὠρίωνα: Ὠρίων — Orion, the constellation; masc. acc. sg.
glossary.ᾖα: ᾖα (contracted ἤια) — provisions for a journey; neut. nom./acc. pl. · also a different word, impf. 1 sg. of εἶμι ’go’: ’I was going’, unrelated to this noun
glossary.ῥίπεσσι: ῥίψ — plaited twigs, a wicker hurdle; fem. dat. pl., epic -εσσι(ν)
glossary.ῥαίῃσι: ῥαίω — break, shatter, wreck; pres. subj. 3 sg., epic -ῃσι (= Attic ῥαίῃ)
glossary.ῥινὸν: ῥινός — hide, skin; also a shield of hide; acc. sg. (its sense in the simile εἴσατο δ’ ὡς ὅτε ῥινόν was disputed in antiquity)
glossary.αἰγάς: Αἰγαί — Aegae, a seat of Poseidon (which of several places so called is meant is uncertain); fem. acc. pl.
glossary.αἰθρηγενέτης: αἰθρηγενέτης — born of the clear upper air (or, taken actively, ’bringing clear skies’); sense disputed; masc. nom. sg., epithet of Boreas
glossary.αἰθυίῃ: αἴθυια — a sea-bird of uncertain kind (shearwater, gull and diver all proposed); fem. dat. sg.
glossary.αἰπὺς: αἰπύς — steep, sheer; masc. nom. sg. (αἰπὺς ὄλεθρος ’steep destruction’, ruin pictured as a fall from a height)
glossary.αὐδήεσσα: αὐδήεις — endowed with speech or voice (from αὐδή); anciently explained as ’speaking with a human voice’, exact force debated; fem. nom. sg.
glossary.βορέην: Βορέας — the North Wind, personified; epic acc. sg. Βορέην
glossary.βορέης: Βορέας — the North Wind, personified; epic nom. sg. Βορέης (= Attic Βορέας)
glossary.βορέῃ: Βορέας — the North Wind, personified; epic dat. sg. Βορέῃ
glossary.βροτὸς: βροτός — mortal, as opposed to a god; masc./fem. nom. sg.
glossary.δέος: δέος — fear; also, of the thing feared, danger; neut. nom./acc. sg.
glossary.δαναοὶ: Δαναοί — the Danaans, one of Homer’s names for the Greeks; masc. nom. pl.
glossary.δείδω: δείδω (= δέδοικα) — fear, be afraid; pres. 1 sg., + μή and a verb: ’I fear that…’
glossary.δειλός: δειλός — wretched, miserable; also, in other contexts, cowardly; masc. nom. sg.
glossary.δεινὴ: δεινός — dread, terrible, awesome; fem. nom. sg.
glossary.διεσκέδασ: διασκεδάννυμι — scatter, disperse; aor. 3 sg., augmented inside the compound, elided (διεσκέδασ’ = διεσκέδασε); also gnomic, of what always happens
glossary.διοτρεφέεσσι: διοτρεφής — nurtured by Zeus, Zeus-nurtured (epithet of kings/princes); masc. dat. pl., epic -εσσι
glossary.διώκειν: διώκω — pursue, chase; pres. inf. of purpose: ’to chase’
glossary.δοκέεις: δοκέω — seem, think; pres. 2 sg., uncontracted (= Attic δοκεῖς)
glossary.δούρατ: δόρυ — beam, timber, plank; neut. nom./acc. pl., epic δούρατα, elided (δούρατ’ = δούρατα)
glossary.δούρατι: δόρυ — beam, timber, plank; neut. dat. sg., epic δούρατι
glossary.δυσαὴς: δυσαής — ill-blowing, blowing harshly (δυσ- + ἄημι); masc. nom. sg.
glossary.εἰπόντ: εἶπον — say, speak; aor. part. masc. acc. sg., elided (εἰπόντ’ = εἰπόντα)
glossary.εἴξασκε: εἴκω — yield, give way; iterative aor. 3 sg. in -σκ- (repeated action), unaugmented: ’kept yielding’
glossary.εἵμαρτο: μείρομαι — receive a share; pluperf. 3 sg. impersonal εἵμαρτο: ’it was fated’, + acc. and inf.
glossary.εἶπέ: εἶπον — say, speak; aor. 3 sg., accented εἶπέ before a following enclitic (τε)
glossary.εἶπε: εἶπον — say, speak; aor. 3 sg., without ν-movable
glossary.εἶπεν: εἶπον — say, speak; aor. 3 sg., ν-movable
glossary.εὖρος: Εὖρος — the East Wind, personified; masc. nom. sg.
glossary.εὖρός: Εὖρος — the East Wind, personified; masc. nom. sg., accented εὖρός before a following enclitic (τε)
glossary.ζέφυρός: Ζέφυρος — the West Wind, personified; masc. nom. sg., accented Ζέφυρός before a following enclitic (τε)
glossary.ζαὴς: ζαής — hard-blowing (ζα- intensive + ἄημι); masc. nom. sg.
glossary.ζεφύρῳ: Ζέφυρος — the West Wind, personified; masc. dat. sg.
glossary.θανάτῳ: θάνατος — death; masc. dat. sg., dat. of means: ’by a (pitiful) death’
glossary.θημῶνα: θημών — heap, pile; masc. acc. sg.
glossary.κάδμου: Κάδμος — Cadmus, founder of Thebes; masc. gen. sg.
glossary.κάλλιπ: καταλείπω — leave behind; aor. imper. 2 sg., κατα- cut short and assimilated (κάλλιπ’ = κατάλιπε), elided
glossary.κάλυψε: καλύπτω — cover, hide; aor. 3 sg., unaugmented (= ἐκάλυψε)
glossary.κάλυψεν: καλύπτω — cover, hide; aor. 3 sg., unaugmented, ν-movable (= ἐκάλυψεν)
glossary.κάππεσε: καταπίπτω — fall down; aor. 3 sg., κατα- cut short and assimilated (κάππεσε = κατέπεσε)
glossary.κέληθ: κέλης — a riding-horse, as against a chariot-horse; masc. acc. sg., elided and aspirated (κέληθ’ = κέλητα)
glossary.καθῖζε: καθίζω — sit down, take one’s seat; past 3 sg. (impf. or aor.; with long ι the augment cannot be seen)
glossary.καλλίσφυρος: καλλίσφυρος — fair-ankled (καλός + σφυρόν); fem. nom. sg.
glossary.καταφθίσει: καταφθίω (also καταφθίνω) — destroy utterly; fut. 3 sg.
glossary.κατηρεφές: κατηρεφής — roofed over, covering from above, of a wave curling over; neut. acc. sg.
glossary.κελάρυζεν: κελαρύζω — gurgle, babble, of running water, an onomatopoeic verb; impf. 3 sg., unaugmented (= ἐκελάρυζεν)
glossary.κελεύθους: κέλευθος — path, way; masc. acc. pl. (usu. neut. κέλευθα)
glossary.κλυτὰ: κλυτός — famous, renowned; neut. nom./acc. pl.
glossary.κραιπνὸν: κραιπνός — swift, rushing; masc. acc. sg.
glossary.κρατὸς: κάρη — head; gen. sg. κρατός, from the by-form κράς, genitive of separation: ’from his head’
glossary.κτερέων: κτέρεα — funeral honours, gifts and rites paid to the dead; neut. gen. pl.
glossary.κυλίνδων: κυλίνδω — roll; pres. part. masc. nom. sg.: ’rolling’
glossary.λίμνης: λίμνη — standing water, pool; also of the sea; fem. gen. sg.
glossary.λευγαλέῳ: λευγαλέος — pitiful, sorry, miserable; masc. dat. sg.
glossary.λευκοθέη: Λευκοθέη — Leucothea, ’White Goddess’, the sea-name of Ino; fem. nom. sg.
glossary.μήκιστα: μακρός — long; superl. adv. μήκιστα: ’at the last, in the end’
glossary.μεθορμηθεὶς: μεθορμάομαι — dart after, rush after (μετά + ὁρμάω); aor. part. masc. nom. sg.
glossary.μεμαώς: μέμονα (defective perf., pres. force) — be eager, be minded; perf. part. μεμαώς, masc. nom. sg.: ’eager’, + inf.
glossary.μενέω: μένω — stay, remain, wait; fut. 1 sg., uncontracted (= Attic μενῶ)
glossary.μενεαίνων: μενεαίνω — be furious, rage; pres. part. masc. nom. sg.
glossary.μιγήῃς: μίγνυμι — mix, mingle; aor. pass. subj. 2 sg., epic μιγήῃς (= Attic μιγῇς), + dat.: ’mingle with’
glossary.μισγομένων: μίσγω — mix, mingle; pres. part. mid./pass. gen. pl.: ’mingling’
glossary.νήξομ: νήχω — swim; fut. 1 sg., elided (νήξομ’ = νήξομαι)
glossary.νεφέεσσι: νέφος — cloud; neut. dat. pl., epic -εσσι
glossary.νηχέμεναι: νήχω — swim; pres. inf., epic -έμεναι (= Attic νήχειν)
glossary.οἵοισιν: οἷος — of what kind, what a; exclamatory rel., dat. pl., epic -οισι: ’with what (clouds)!’
glossary.οὐρανόθεν: οὐρανός — sky, heaven; adv. οὐρανόθεν, -θεν ’from’: ’from the sky’
glossary.πέσε: πίπτω — fall; aor. 3 sg., unaugmented (= ἔπεσε)
glossary.παθέειν: πάσχω — suffer, experience; aor. inf., epic uncontracted παθέειν (= Attic παθεῖν)
glossary.πείσομ: πείθομαι — obey, be persuaded; fut. 1 sg., elided (πείσομ’ = πείσομαι)
glossary.πελάγεσσι: πέλαγος — the open sea; neut. dat. pl., epic -εσσι
glossary.περιστέφει: περιστέφω — wreathe round, crown; pres. 3 sg.
glossary.πηλεΐωνι: Πηλεΐων — son of Peleus, i.e. Achilles (patronymic); masc. dat. sg.
glossary.πικρήν: πικρός — bitter, sharp; fem. acc. sg., Ionic η
glossary.πλεῖστοι: πολύς — much, many; superl. πλεῖστος, masc. nom. pl.: ’in the greatest numbers’
glossary.πολλὴ: πολύς — much, many; fem. nom. sg.: ’much, in plenty’
glossary.πρηνὴς: πρηνής — face down, headlong; masc. nom. sg.
glossary.προβάλεσκε: προβάλλω — throw before, toss to; iterative aor. 3 sg. in -σκ-, unaugmented: ’kept tossing’
glossary.προνοῆσαι: προνοέω — think of beforehand, foresee; aor. inf.
glossary.πρὸ: πρό — before, in front; prep. + gen.; also adv. or preverb in tmesis, ’ahead, forward’ (πρὸ … ἔαξεν ’broke ahead’)
glossary.πυκιναὶ: πυκινός — close-packed, thick, close; fem. nom. pl.
glossary.σπεῖρον: σπεῖρον — a woven cloth; of a ship, the sail; neut. nom./acc. sg.
glossary.στέρνοιο: στέρνον — chest, breast; neut. gen. sg., epic -οιο (= Attic -ου)
glossary.στόματος: στόμα — mouth; neut. gen. sg., genitive of separation: ’out of his mouth’
glossary.σύναγεν: συνάγω — bring together, gather; impf. 3 sg., unaugmented (= Attic συνῆγεν)
glossary.σῶς: σῶς — safe, sound; also ’sure, certain’; masc./fem. nom. sg.
glossary.τάνυσσεν: τανύω — stretch; aor. 3 sg., unaugmented, epic σσ (= ἐτάνυσε)
glossary.τέλος: τέλος — end, completion, fulfilment; neut. nom./acc. sg.
glossary.τανύσσαι: τανύω — stretch; aor. inf., epic σσ, used for an imperative: ’stretch!’
glossary.τειρόμενός: τείρω — wear down, distress; pres. part. pass. masc. nom. sg.: ’worn down, distressed’
glossary.τηλοῦ: τηλοῦ — far off, at a distance; adv.
glossary.τιμῆς: τιμή — honour, worth; fem. gen. sg.
glossary.τραπέσθαι: τρέπω (mid. τρέπομαι) — turn oneself; aor. inf., used for an imperative: ’turn away!’
glossary.τρῶες: Τρῶες — the Trojans; masc. nom. pl.
glossary.τόφρ: τόφρα — so long, during that time; adv., correlative with ὄφρα ’as long as’, elided (τόφρ’ = τόφρα)
glossary.τῆ: τῆ — here, take (this); old imperatival interjection used in handing something over
glossary.φαιήκεσσι: Φαίηξ — a Phaeacian; masc. dat. pl., epic -εσσι
glossary.φιληρέτμοισι: φιλήρετμος — fond of the oar, oar-loving (φίλος + ἐρετμόν); masc. dat. pl., epic -οισι
glossary.φορέῃσιν: φορέω — carry, bear repeatedly; pres. subj. 3 sg., epic -ῃσι, in a simile with ὡς ὅτε
glossary.φύξιμον: φύξιμος — affording escape, a place of refuge (from φεύγω); neut. nom. sg., predicate with εἶναι
glossary.χαλκήρεα: χαλκήρης — fitted with bronze; neut. acc. pl.
glossary.χείρεσσι: χείρ — hand; fem. dat. pl., epic -εσσι, instrumental: ’with your hands’
glossary.χείρεσσιν: χείρ — hand; fem. dat. pl., epic -εσσιν
glossary.χεῖρε: χείρ — hand; fem. acc. dual: ’his two hands’
glossary.ἀέλλας: ἄελλα — blast, gust, squall; fem. acc. pl.
glossary.ἀκάνθας: ἄκανθα — thistle, thorny plant; fem. acc. pl.
glossary.ἀλεείνων: ἀλεείνω — shun, avoid; pres. part. masc. nom. sg.
glossary.ἀλλήλῃσιν: ἀλλήλων — one another; fem. dat. pl., epic -ῃσι(ν)
glossary.ἀλόω: ἀλάομαι — wander; pres. imper. 2 sg., ἀλάεο contracted and drawn out to ἀλόω
glossary.ἀλώμενον: ἀλάομαι — wander; pres. part. masc. acc. sg.
glossary.ἀνέδυ: ἀναδύομαι — come up, emerge; aor. 3 sg., root aorist
glossary.ἀνέμοισι: ἄνεμος — wind; masc. dat. pl., epic -οισι
glossary.ἀναπλήσειν: ἀναπίμπλημι — fill up, fill to the full; fut. inf., + acc. of the thing endured: ’to fill up (one’s pains)’
glossary.ἀνεδύσετο: ἀναδύομαι — come up, emerge, rise up; aor. 3 sg., sigmatic thematic
glossary.ἀνσχεθέειν: ἀνέχω — hold up, rise up; aor. inf. from the stem σχεθ-, ἀν- for ἀνα-, epic -έειν: ’come up to the surface’
glossary.ἀπινύσσειν: ἀπινύσσω — be without understanding, lack sense (ἀ- + πινυτός); pres. inf.
glossary.ἀποβῆναι: ἀποβαίνω — step off, disembark; aor. inf., + gen.: ’to step off (the raft)’
glossary.ἀποδὺς: ἀποδύω — strip off; aor. part. masc. nom. sg., root aorist
glossary.ἀπολυσάμενος: ἀπολύω — loose from, untie; aor. part. mid. masc. nom. sg.: ’having untied it from himself’
glossary.ἀρήρῃ: ἀραρίσκω — fit, join; perf. subj. 3 sg., intransitive: ’stay fitted, hold together’
glossary.ἁλῶναι: ἁλίσκομαι — be caught, be taken; aor. inf. ἁλῶναι
glossary.ἄκρης: ἄκρη — top, peak, crest; fem. gen. sg., + κατά: ’down from the top’, of a wave breaking from its crest · also gen. with ἐπί: ’on, to the height’ (ἐρύσαντας ἐπ’ ἄκρης ’having dragged it to the top’)
glossary.ἄμβροτον: ἄμβροτος — deathless, immortal (ἀ- + βροτός); masc./fem. acc. or neut. nom./acc. sg.
glossary.ἄριστον: ἀγαθός — good; superl. ἄριστος, neut. nom./acc. sg.: ’best’
glossary.ἅλμην: ἅλμη — salt water, brine; fem. acc. sg.
glossary.ἐδυνάσθη: δύναμαι — be able; aor. 3 sg., passive-form (ἐδυνάσθη)
glossary.ἐκέλευσε: κελεύω — bid, order, command; aor. 3 sg., + inf.
glossary.ἐκπάγλως: ἔκπαγλος — terrible, vehement; adv. ἐκπάγλως: ’terribly, vehemently’
glossary.ἐλέησεν: ἐλεέω — pity, have compassion on; aor. 3 sg.
glossary.ἐλέλιξε: ἐλελίζω — whirl, make spin; aor. 3 sg.
glossary.ἐλαύνων: ἐλαύνω — drive, urge on; pres. part. masc. nom. sg.: ’driving, riding’
glossary.ἐλθοῦσα: ἔρχομαι — come, go; aor. part. fem. nom. sg.: ’having come, coming on’
glossary.ἐλλάβετ: λαμβάνω — take, seize; aor. mid. 3 sg., λ doubled (ἐλλάβετ’ = ἐλάβετο), elided, + gen.: ’took hold of’
glossary.ἐνόησεν: νοέω — perceive, devise, think of; aor. 3 sg.
glossary.ἐξαπέδυνε: ἐξαποδύω — strip off completely, double preverb; aor. 3 sg.
glossary.ἐπέρριψαν: ἐπιρρίπτω — hurl at, cast at; aor. 3 pl.
glossary.ἐπεσσύμενον: ἐπισεύομαι — rush upon; perf. part. (pres. force) masc. acc. or neut. nom./acc. sg.: ’rushing on’
glossary.ἐπιμαίεο: ἐπιμαίομαι — strive for, seek after; pres. imper. 2 sg., uncontracted (= Attic ἐπιμαίου), + gen.
glossary.ἐπισπέρχουσι: ἐπισπέρχω — drive on, press hard; pres. 3 pl.
glossary.ἐτάραξε: ταράσσω — stir up, trouble; aor. 3 sg.
glossary.ἐφάψεαι: ἐφάπτομαι — lay hold of, grasp; aor. subj. 2 sg., short-vowel (= Attic ἐφάψῃ), + gen.
glossary.ἑνὶ: εἷς, μία, ἕν — one; masc./neut. dat. sg. ἑνί
glossary.ἒξ: ἐκ (postpositive, accented ἒξ after its noun, anastrophe) — out of, from; + gen.: θεῶν ἒξ = ἐκ θεῶν
glossary.ἔαξεν: ἄγνυμι — break, snap; aor. 3 sg., syllabic augment ἐ- for a lost initial ϝ
glossary.ἔλασεν: ἐλαύνω — drive, strike; aor. 3 sg., unaugmented (= ἤλασεν)
glossary.ἔλαχον: λαγχάνω — obtain by lot, get as one’s share; aor. 1 sg. or 3 pl., + gen. of the share
glossary.ἔμμορε: μείρομαι — receive a share; perf. 3 sg. ἔμμορε, + gen.: ’has a share of’
glossary.ἔπεσον: πίπτω — fall; aor. 1 sg. or 3 pl., augmented (unaugmented πέσον); with σύν in tmesis, σὺν … ἔπεσον = συνέπεσον ’fell together, clashed’
glossary.ἔρξαι: ἔρδω — do; aor. inf., used for an imperative: ’do!’
glossary.ἔχονται: ἔχω (mid.) — hold oneself, cling; pres. mid. 3 pl., + πρός and dat.: ’cling to one another’
glossary.ἠΐων: ἠΐα — husks, chaff; fem. gen. pl. (a distinct word of the same form means ’provisions’)
glossary.ἠπείροιο: ἤπειρος — mainland, dry land; fem. gen. sg., epic -οιο (= Attic -ου)
glossary.ἰδόμην: ὁράω — see; aor. mid. 1 sg., unaugmented: ’I saw’
glossary.ἰνώ: Ἰνώ — Ino, daughter of Cadmus, later the sea-goddess Leucothea; fem. nom. sg.
glossary.ἵμασεν: ἱμάσσω — lash, whip (from ἱμάς ’strap’); aor. 3 sg.
glossary.ὀδυσῆ: Ὀδυσσεύς — Odysseus; masc. acc. sg. Ὀδυσῆα, elided (Ὀδυσῆ’ = Ὀδυσῆα)
glossary.ὀνόσσεσθαι: ὄνομαι — find fault with, scorn; with gen., ’make light of’; fut. inf.; its exact force with the gen. is debated (’think too slight’, or ironically ’complain of too little’)
glossary.ὀπωρινὸς: ὀπωρινός — of late summer/early autumn, from ὀπώρα; masc. nom. sg.
glossary.ὀρόθυνεν: ὀροθύνω — stir up, rouse; aor. 3 sg., unaugmented
glossary.ὀρώρει: ὄρνυμι — rouse; (intrans.) arise, spring up; pluperf. 3 sg., unaugmented: ’had sprung up’
glossary.ὁρμῆς: ὁρμή — onrush, onset, rush; fem. gen. sg.
glossary.ὄλεθρος: ὄλεθρος — destruction, ruin; masc. nom. sg.
glossary.ὑπόβρυχα: ὑπόβρυχα — under water, submerged; adv., predicative: ’set (him) under water’
glossary.ὑφαίνῃσιν: ὑφαίνω — weave; pres. subj. 3 sg., epic -ῃσι, in a fear clause: ’may be weaving’
glossary.ὠδύσατ: ὀδύσσομαι — be angry with, hate; aor. 3 sg. mid., elided (ὠδύσατ’ = ὠδύσατο); puns on the name Ὀδυσσεύς
glossary.ὤ: ὤ — oh! interjection of distress, esp. in ὤ μοι ’oh me!’
glossary.ῥόον: ῥόος — current, stream, flow; masc. acc. sg.
glossary.αἰδοῖος: αἰδοῖος — revered, held in respect; adj., masc. nom. sg., of a suppliant
glossary.αἰνὸς: αἰνός — dread, terrible; adj., masc. nom. sg.
glossary.αὔοι: αὔοι — perhaps ’kindle’ (lemma disputed); rare opt. 3 sg. of an unidentified verb, distinct from the common αὔω ’shout’; formation uncertain
glossary.βέβρυχεν: βρυχάομαι — roar (properly of a lion); perf. 3 sg. with pres. force: ’roars, is roaring’
glossary.βίοτος: βίοτος — life, livelihood; masc. nom. sg.
glossary.βλέφαρ: βλέφαρον (pl. βλέφαρα) — eyelid; neut. acc. pl., elided (βλέφαρ’ = βλέφαρα): ’eyelids’
glossary.βοήσας: βοάω — shout, cry out; aor. part. masc. nom. sg.: ’having shouted’
glossary.γέγωνε: γέγωνα (defective, akin to γεγωνέω) — be audible, make oneself heard; perf. 3 sg. with pres. force
glossary.γένωμαι: γίγνομαι — become, come to be; aor. subj. mid. 1 sg.
glossary.γαλήνη: γαλήνη — calm (of the sea); fem. nom. sg.
glossary.γαλήνην: γαλήνη — calm (of the sea); fem. acc. sg.
glossary.γλυκερὸς: γλυκερός — sweet; adj., masc. nom. sg., epic (= Attic γλυκύς)
glossary.γούνατ: γόνυ (pl. γούνατα) — knee; neut. acc. pl., elided (γούνατ’ = γούνατα)
glossary.δάσκιον: δάσκιος — thick-shaded, densely wooded; adj., fem. acc. sg.
glossary.δέξατο: δέχομαι — receive, take; aor. mid. 3 sg., unaugmented (= ἐδέξατο)
glossary.δαλὸν: δαλός — firebrand, brand; masc. acc. sg.
glossary.δαμάσῃ: δάμνημι/δαμάζω — subdue, overpower; aor. subj. 3 sg., in a clause of fearing with μή
glossary.διάη: διάημι — blow through; rare aor. subj. 3 sg.
glossary.διαμπερές: διαμπερές — right through, clean through; adv.
glossary.δοάσσατο: δοάσσατο — it seemed; rare aor. 3 sg. (lemma disputed, akin to δοκέω), impersonal
glossary.δοῦπον: δοῦπος — thud, booming sound; masc. acc. sg.
glossary.δρύφθη: δρύπτω — tear, strip off; aor. pass. 3 sg.
glossary.δυσκηδέα: δυσκηδής — bringing hard distress, troublous; adj., fem. acc. sg.
glossary.δυσπονέος: δυσπονής — hard-toiling, painful; adj., masc. gen. sg.
glossary.δύσετ: δύω — sink into, enter; aor. mid. 3 sg., unaugmented, elided (δύσετ’ = δύσετο); with ὑπό in tmesis, ’sank down in among’
glossary.δύστηνος: δύστηνος — wretched; adj., masc. nom. sg.
glossary.εἴλυτο: εἰλύω — wrap, envelop; plpf. pass. 3 sg. with stative force: ’lay wrapped’
glossary.εἴσιδε: εἰσεῖδον (used as aor. of εἰσοράω) — catch sight of; aor. 3 sg., unaugmented (= εἰσεῖδε)
glossary.θάμνοις: θάμνος — bush, thicket; masc. dat. pl.
glossary.θάμνους: θάμνος — bush, thicket; masc. acc. pl.
glossary.θήρεσσιν: θήρ — wild beast; masc. dat. pl., epic -εσσι(ν) (= Attic θηρσί)
glossary.θαλάμης: θαλάμη — den, lair (of an animal); fem. gen. sg.
glossary.θρασειάων: θρασύς — bold; adj., fem. gen. pl., epic (θρασειάων = Attic θρασειῶν), agreeing with χειρῶν
glossary.θύραζε: θύραζε — to the outside, out of doors; adv., directional suffix -δε (= -ζε after a vowel)
glossary.θῆλυς: θῆλυς — soft, delicate (properly ’female’, extended to ’soft’); adj., fem. nom. sg.
glossary.κήκιε: κηκίω — ooze, trickle out; impf. 3 sg., unaugmented (= ἐκήκιε)
glossary.κακὴ: κακός — bad, harmful; adj., fem. nom. sg.
glossary.καλλιρόοιο: καλλίρροος — fair-flowing; adj., masc. gen. sg., epic -οιο
glossary.καλύψατο: καλύπτω — cover; aor. mid. 3 sg.: ’covered himself’
glossary.καμάτοιο: κάματος — weariness, toil; masc. gen. sg., epic -οιο (= Attic -ου)
glossary.καταδράθω: καταδαρθάνω — lie down to sleep; aor. subj. 1 sg.
glossary.κεκαφηότα: κεκαφηότα — spent of breath, gasping, exhausted (lemma disputed, perhaps an old verb meaning ’breathe out, gasp’); rare perf. part. acc. sg., agreeing with θυμόν; formation not fully understood
glossary.κλιτὺν: κλιτύς — slope, hillside; fem. acc. sg.
glossary.κλυτὸς: κλυτός — famous, renowned; adj., masc. nom. sg.
glossary.κοτυληδονόφιν: κοτυληδών — sucker (of an octopus), cup-shaped hollow; old case-form in -φιν serving as dat. pl., ’to its suckers’
glossary.κύματι: κῦμα — wave; neut. dat. sg. (κύματι πηγῷ, a rare disputed epithet; see πηγῷ)
glossary.κύσε: κυνέω — kiss; aor. 3 sg., unaugmented (= ἔκυσε)
glossary.κῆτος: κῆτος — sea-monster (any large sea-creature, not necessarily a whale); neut. acc. sg.
glossary.λάιγγες: λάιγξ — pebble; fem. nom. pl., rare, found almost nowhere else in Homer
glossary.λίθακι: λίθαξ — rocky mass, boulder; rare noun, found nowhere else in Homer, dat. sg.; formation and exact sense disputed
glossary.λεῖος: λεῖος — smooth; adj., masc. nom. sg., + gen. of separation: ’free of, smooth of’
glossary.λιασθεὶς: λιάζομαι — turn aside, draw back; aor. pass. part. masc. nom. sg.
glossary.μεθείη: μεθίημι — let go, release; aor. opt. 3 sg., in a wish subordinate to a condition: ’in hope that it might release (me)’
glossary.μεθῆκεν: μεθίημι — let go, release; aor. 3 sg.
glossary.μελέη: μελεός — vain, fruitless, wretched; adj., fem. nom. sg.
glossary.νηνεμίη: νηνεμίη — windlessness, calm without wind; fem. nom. sg.
glossary.νούσῳ: νοῦσος (Attic νόσος) — sickness, disease; fem. dat. sg.
glossary.νῆχε: νήχω — swim; impf. 3 sg., unaugmented (= ἔνηχε)
glossary.ξερὸν: ξερός (Attic ξηρός) — dry (land); adj., neut. acc. sg.
glossary.πάγοι: πάγος — rocky peak, crag; masc. nom. pl.
glossary.πάθω: πάσχω — suffer, experience; aor. subj. 1 sg., deliberative: ’what am I to suffer?’ (τί πάθω) · also aor. subj. 1 sg. in a purpose clause after ὄφρα: ’that I may suffer’
glossary.πάνθ: πᾶς — all, every; neut. nom. pl., elided and aspirated (πάνθ’ = πάντα): ’everything’
glossary.παλιρρόθιον: παλιρρόθιος — flowing back, backwash; adj. used substantively, neut. nom. sg.: ’the backwash(-wave)’
glossary.παρανήξομαι: παρανήχομαι — swim along, swim further; fut. mid. 1 sg.
glossary.παραπλῆγας: παραπλήξ — struck on the side, beaten (of shelving shore where surf breaks gently); adj., fem. acc. pl.
glossary.παῦσεν: παύω — stop, check; aor. 3 sg., transitive
glossary.περάασκε: περάω — pass through; iterative impf. 3 sg. in -ασκε, marking repeated/habitual past action: ’used to pass through’
glossary.περιφαινομένῳ: περιφαίνομαι — show round about, be visible on every side; pres. pass. part. used as subst., dat. sg.: ’a place open to view on every side’
glossary.πετράων: πέτρη — rock; fem. gen. pl., epic (πετράων = Attic πετρῶν)
glossary.πεφυῶτας: φύω — grow; perf. part. acc. pl. masc.: ’having grown’ (agreeing with θάμνους)
glossary.πηγῷ: πηγός — a rare, disputed epithet of a wave; dat. neut. sg., agreeing with κῦμα; guessed as ’massed, solid’ (from πήγνυμι) or ’strong, mighty’; no certainty is possible
glossary.πλάζετο: πλάζω — drive astray, buffet, toss about; impf. mid./pass. 3 sg.: ’was tossed about’
glossary.πολιοῖο: πολιός — grey; adj., fem. gen. sg., epic -οιο; the fixed epithet of the sea (πολιὴ ἅλς ’grey sea’)
glossary.πολλή: πολύς — much, many; adj., fem. nom. sg.: ’much, in plenty’
glossary.πολύλλιστον: πολύλλιστος — much prayed to, much besought; adj., masc. acc. sg. (built on λίσσομαι ’entreat’)
glossary.πουλύποδος: πουλύπους (epic for πολύπους) — octopus; masc. gen. sg.
glossary.προβλῆτες: προβλής — jutting out, projecting; adj., fem. nom. pl. (of a rocky shoreline)
glossary.προρέοντα: προρέω — flow forward, flow forth; pres. part. acc. sg. masc. (agreeing with an understood ποταμόν)
glossary.προτιόσσετ: προτιόσσομαι — look ahead to, forebode; rare verb, impf. 3 sg., unaugmented, elided (προτιόσσετ’ = προτιόσσετο)
glossary.προχοάς: προχοή — outflow, the place where a river pours out; fem. acc. pl., a plural noun used for a single feature
glossary.προϊδών: προοράω — see before, see ahead; aor. part. masc. nom. sg.
glossary.πυκινοῖσι: πυκινός — thick, close-set; adj., masc. dat. pl., epic -οισι
glossary.πυκνοὶ: πυκνός — thick, close-set; adj., masc. nom. pl.
glossary.πόδεσσι: πούς — foot; masc. dat. pl., epic -εσσι(ν) (= Attic ποσί)
glossary.πόντοιο: πόντος — sea; masc. gen. sg., epic -οιο (= Attic -ου)
glossary.σά: σός — your; possessive adj., neut. acc. pl.
glossary.σκέπας: σκέπας — shelter, cover; neut. nom. sg. · also neut. acc. sg., ’shelter’ as goal of motion (ἐπὶ σκέπας)
glossary.σπέρμα: σπέρμα — seed; neut. acc. sg. (σπέρμα πυρὸς ’a seed of fire’, an idiom for embers kept alive under ash)
glossary.σπιλάδες: σπιλάς — reef, crag; fem. nom. pl.
glossary.σπιλάδεσσι: σπιλάς — reef, crag; fem. dat. pl., epic -εσσι(ν)
glossary.σποδιῇ: σποδιή — ashes, ash-heap; fem. dat. sg.
glossary.στήμεναι: ἵστημι (aor. root στη-) — stand; epic inf. in -μεναι (= Attic στῆναι)
glossary.στίβη: στίβη — hoar-frost, frost; fem. nom. sg.
glossary.στενάχων: στενάχω — groan, moan; pres. part. masc. nom. sg.
glossary.στιβαράς: στιβαρός — stout, sturdy; adj., fem. acc. pl.
glossary.στυγερὸς: στυγερός — hateful, dread; adj., masc. nom. sg.
glossary.στόμα: στόμα — mouth; neut. acc. sg.; also used of a river’s mouth
glossary.σχοίνῳ: σχοῖνος — rush, reed; masc./fem. dat. sg.
glossary.σόν: σός — your; possessive adj., masc. acc. sg.
glossary.σώζων: σῴζω — save, keep safe; pres. part. masc. nom. sg.
glossary.τέλεσ: τελέω — bring to an end, complete; aor. 3 sg., unaugmented, elided (τέλεσ’ = τέλεσε)
glossary.τηκόμενος: τήκω (mid./pass. τήκομαι) — waste away, melt; pres. part. masc. nom. sg.
glossary.τρέφει: τρέφω — nourish, rear, foster; pres. 3 sg. (of Amphitrite fostering sea-creatures)
glossary.τρηχεῖαν: τρηχύς — rugged, rough; adj., fem. acc. sg.
glossary.φέρῃ: φέρω — carry, bear; pres. subj. 3 sg., in a clause of fearing with μή
glossary.φίλῃσιν: φίλος — dear, one’s own; adj., fem. dat. pl., epic -ῃσι(ν)
glossary.φαέθων: φαέθω — shine, blaze; pres. part. masc. nom. sg.
glossary.φαίνεθ: φαίνω (mid./pass.) — appear, show itself; pres. 3 sg., elided and aspirated (φαίνεθ’ = φαίνεται): ’appears’
glossary.φανήῃ: φαίνομαι — appear; epic aor. subj. 3 sg. left uncontracted (= Attic φανῇ, from φανέῃ), with ἄν giving a general ’whenever’
glossary.φεύγων: φεύγω — flee; pres. part. masc. nom. sg.
glossary.φρονέοντι: φρονέω — think, consider; pres. part. dat. sg. masc., agreeing with οἱ: ’to him as he considered’
glossary.φυλάσσω: φυλάσσω — keep watch, guard; pres. subj. 1 sg., + acc. of duration: ’keep watch through (the night)’
glossary.φυλίης: φυλίη — wild olive; fem. gen. sg.
glossary.φύλλοισι: φύλλον — leaf; neut. dat. pl., epic -οισι
glossary.χαλεπαίνοι: χαλεπαίνω — be fierce, rage (of weather); pres. opt. 3 sg., general condition
glossary.χειμερίῃ: χειμέριος — wintry; adj., fem. dat. sg.
glossary.χύσιν: χύσις — a pouring, a heap; fem. acc. sg.
glossary.χύσις: χύσις — a pouring, a heap; fem. nom. sg.
glossary.χῶρος: χῶρος — place, spot; masc. nom. sg.
glossary.ψυχρὴ: ψυχρός — cold; adj., fem. nom. sg.
glossary.ἀέντων: ἄημι — blow; pres. part. gen. pl. masc., agreeing with ἀνέμων: ’of winds blowing’
glossary.ἀγχιβαθὴς: ἀγχιβαθής — deep close to shore; adj., fem. nom. sg. (ἄγχι ’near’ + βαθύς ’deep’)
glossary.ἀελπέα: ἀελπής — unhoped for; adj., fem. acc. sg., alpha-privative compound of ἔλπομαι
glossary.ἀκτήν: ἀκτή — shore, headland; fem. acc. sg.
glossary.ἀκταὶ: ἀκτή — shore, headland; fem. nom. pl.
glossary.ἀκτῖσιν: ἀκτίς — ray (of the sun); fem. dat. pl., epic -ισι(ν)
glossary.ἀμφικαλύψας: ἀμφικαλύπτω — cover round about; aor. part. masc. nom. sg.
glossary.ἀμφιτρίτη: Ἀμφιτρίτη — Amphitrite, Poseidon’s consort; nom. sg.; by extension, standing for the sea and its creatures generally
glossary.ἀμφοτέρῃσι: ἀμφότερος — both (of two); adj., fem. dat. pl., epic -ῃσι(ν) (= Attic -αις)
glossary.ἀναβὰς: ἀναβαίνω — go up, climb; aor. part. masc. nom. sg.
glossary.ἀναδέδρομε: ἀνατρέχω — run up; perf. 3 sg., of rock rising sheer from the water: ’has run up sheer’
glossary.ἀπέδρυφθεν: δρύπτω — tear off, strip; aor. pass. 3 pl.
glossary.ἀπῆν: ἄπειμι — be away, be distant; impf. 3 sg.
glossary.ἀράχθη: ἀράσσω — dash, shatter; aor. pass. 3 sg.; σύν … ἀράχθη is tmesis for συναράσσω ’dash together, shatter’
glossary.ἀρθείς: αἴρω — lift, raise; aor. pass. part. masc. nom. sg.
glossary.ἀσπάσιον: ἀσπάσιος — welcome; adj., masc. acc. sg., predicate agreeing with τόν: ’welcome’
glossary.ἀσπάσιος: ἀσπάσιος — welcome; adj., masc. nom. sg.
glossary.ἀσπαστὸν: ἀσπαστός — welcome; adj., neut. nom. sg., predicate: ’appeared welcome’
glossary.ἁλιμυρήεντα: ἁλιμυρήεις — flowing to the salt sea; adj., masc. acc. sg.
glossary.ἁρπάξαν: ἁρπάζω — snatch, seize; aor. part. neut. nom. sg., agreeing with κῦμα
glossary.ἄμπνυτο: ἀναπνέω/ἄμπνυμαι — recover breath, revive; unaugmented past tense 3 sg.
glossary.ἄναυδος: ἄναυδος — without voice, speechless; adj., masc. nom. sg., alpha-privative
glossary.ἄπνευστος: ἄπνευστος — without breath, breathless; adj., masc. nom. sg., alpha-privative
glossary.ἄριστος: ἀγαθός — good; superlative ἄριστος ’best’; adj., masc. nom. sg.
glossary.ἄχνῃ: ἄχνη — chaff; of the sea, foam; fem. dat. sg.
glossary.ἐκβαίνοντα: ἐκβαίνω — step out, disembark; pres. part. acc. sg. masc., agreeing with an understood ’me’ (μ’ ἐκβαίνοντα)
glossary.ἐλέαιρε: ἐλεαίρω (epic by-form of ἐλεέω) — pity; pres. imper. 2 sg.: ’pity!’
glossary.ἐλαίης: ἐλαίη — olive tree (cultivated, as opposed to wild φυλίη); fem. gen. sg.
glossary.ἐνέκρυψε: ἐγκρύπτω — hide in, bury in; aor. 3 sg.
glossary.ἐνιπάς: ἐνιπή — properly ’rebuke, scolding’; by extension, forceful chastisement, ’threats’; fem. acc. pl.
glossary.ἐννοσίγαιος: ἐννοσίγαιος — ’earth-shaker’, epithet/name of Poseidon (built on γαῖα, distinct from ἐνοσίχθων built on χθών); masc. nom. sg.
glossary.ἐξαναδύς: ἐξαναδύομαι — rise up out of; aor. part. masc. nom. sg.
glossary.ἐξελκομένοιο: ἐξέλκω — drag out, pull out; pres. pass. part. gen. sg., epic -οιο, agreeing with θαλάμης
glossary.ἐπέλθῃ: ἐπέρχομαι — come over, come upon; aor. subj. 3 sg.
glossary.ἐπέρησα: περάω — cross, pass through; aor. 1 sg.
glossary.ἐπαμήσατο: ἐπαμάω — heap up; aor. mid. 3 sg.
glossary.ἐπαμοιβαδίς: ἐπαμοιβαδίς — alternately, in turn; adv., extremely rare, found almost nowhere else in Homer
glossary.ἐπαύσατο: παύω (mid.) — cease, stop; aor. mid. 3 sg., intransitive
glossary.ἐπειγόμενος: ἐπείγω (mid.) — press on, hasten; pres. part. masc. nom. sg.
glossary.ἐπεσσύμενος: ἐπισεύω (mid./pass.) — rush upon; perf. part. (pres. force) masc. nom. sg.: ’rushing on, in a rush’
glossary.ἐπιβῆναι: ἐπιβαίνω — set foot on, step on (+ gen.); aor. inf.
glossary.ἐπισσεύῃ: ἐπισεύω — set upon, send against; aor. subj. 3 sg.
glossary.ἐπιφροσύνην: ἐπιφροσύνη — presence of mind, a timely thought; rare abstract noun, fem. acc. sg.
glossary.ἐπιωγαί: ἐπιωγή — a place of shelter from the wind, a roadstead (lesser than a λιμήν); fem. nom. pl.
glossary.ἐρευγόμενον: ἐρεύγομαι — belch, spew out; pres. part. neut. nom. sg., agreeing with κῦμα
glossary.ἐρεύγεται: ἐρεύγομαι — belch, spew out; pres. 3 sg. (of a wave against the shore)
glossary.ἐσάωσεν: σῴζω — save, bring safely; aor. 3 sg.
glossary.ἐσσί: εἰμί — be; pres. 2 sg., epic (= Attic εἶ)
glossary.ἐφεύροι: ἐφευρίσκω — find, come upon; aor. opt. 3 sg.
glossary.ἐφεύρω: ἐφευρίσκω — find, come upon; aor. subj. 1 sg.
glossary.ἔκβασις: ἔκβασις — way out, a place to disembark; fem. nom. sg.
glossary.ἔρυσθαι: ἔρυμαι — guard, protect, shelter; epic inf.
glossary.ἔφυν: φύω — grow; intransitive root aor. 3 pl. (a poetic 3 pl. in -ν, identical to the 1 sg.): ’they had grown’
glossary.ἔχετο: ἔχω (mid.) — hold onto, cling to (+ gen.); impf. 3 sg.
glossary.ἔχραε: χράω — attack, assail, befall; impf. 3 sg.
glossary.ἕο: reflexive pron. (= ἑαυτοῦ, Attic οὗ) — himself; gen. sg. · also referring back to a feminine subject: ’of herself, of it’ (ἐκέλευσεν ἕο μνήσασθαι, of the belly, ’bids one think of it’)
glossary.ἠιόνας: ἠιών — beach, shore; fem. acc. pl.
glossary.ἠῶθι: ἠώς — dawn, + place-suffix -θι: ’at dawn’ (ἠῶθι πρό ’before dawn’)
glossary.ἰνὼ: Ἰνώ — Ino, sea-goddess (formerly mortal), who earlier gave Odysseus her veil; nom. sg.
glossary.ἱκάνω: ἱκάνω (poetic by-form of ἱκνέομαι) — come to, arrive at, reach; pres. 1 sg.
glossary.ἵκανεν: ἱκάνω — come upon, reach; impf./aor. 3 sg.
glossary.ὀδυσεῖ: Ὀδυσσεύς — Odysseus; masc. dat. sg., single-σ metrical variant (= Ὀδυσσῆι)
glossary.ὀδώδυσται: ὀδύσσομαι — be angry at, hate; perf. 3 sg., mid./pass. form: ’is angry with, has taken a hatred to’; the same rare verb that puns on the hero’s name
glossary.ὀλιγηπελέων: ὀλιγηπελέω — be faint, have little strength; pres. part. masc. nom. sg.
glossary.ὀξέες: ὀξύς — sharp; adj., masc. nom. pl.
glossary.ὀστέ: ὀστέον (pl. ὀστέα) — bone; neut. nom. pl., elided (ὀστέ’ = ὀστέα)
glossary.ὁμόθεν: ὁμόθεν — from the same place; adv.
glossary.ὁρμή: ὁρμή — onrush, effort, attempt (of a ship or runner’s forward drive); fem. nom. sg.
glossary.ὁρώμενος: ὁράω (mid.) — look at, gaze toward; pres. part. masc. nom. sg.
glossary.ὄχοι: ὀχός — holder; masc. nom. pl., of a harbour (in a descriptive genitive phrase, ’holders of’ + gen.)
glossary.ὑπήλυθε: ὑπέρχομαι — go in under, creep beneath; aor. 3 sg., unaugmented (= ὑπῆλθε)
glossary.ὑπεκλίνθη: ὑποκλίνομαι — sink down, lay oneself down under; aor. pass. 3 sg.
glossary.ὥρῃ: ὥρα — season, time; fem. dat. sg.
glossary.ᾤδεε: οἰδέω — swell; plpf. 3 sg. with pres. force: ’was swollen’
glossary.ῥινοὶ: ῥινός — skin, hide; fem. nom. pl.
glossary.ῥινοὺς: ῥινός — skin, hide; fem. acc. pl.
glossary.ῥόθιον: ῥόθιος — rushing, surging; adj., neut. nom. sg., agreeing with κῦμα
glossary.ῥόχθει: ῥοχθέω — roar, dash noisily (of surf); impf. 3 sg.
glossary.ῥῖγος: ῥῖγος — chill, frost, cold; neut. nom. sg.
glossary.ῥῖνάς: ῥίς — nose, nostril (distinct from ῥινός ’skin, hide’); fem. acc. pl.
glossary.αἰγείῳ: αἴγειος — of a goat; masc. dat. sg. (ἀσκῷ αἰγείῳ ’goatskin bag’)
glossary.αἴδετο: αἰδέομαι — feel shame, be shy of; impf. 3 sg., epic (= Attic ᾐδεῖτο), + inf.: ’was ashamed to’ · also + acc., ’stood in awe of, respected’ (αἴδετο … πατροκασίγνητον)
glossary.αἴθρη: αἴθρη — clear bright sky, cloudless air; fem. nom. sg.
glossary.αὐγῇ: αὐγή — light, radiance, sunlight; fem. dat. sg.
glossary.βίηφι: βία — force, strength; dat. sg. with epic -φι (= Attic βίᾳ): ’in strength, by force’
glossary.βαλοῦσαι: βάλλω — throw, cast; aor. part. act. fem. nom. pl.: ’having thrown’; with ἀπό in tmesis ’having cast off’
glossary.βασιλῆας: βασιλεύς — king, chief; masc. acc. pl., epic -ῆας (= Attic -εῖς)
glossary.βουλεύειν: βουλεύω — take counsel, plan, deliberate; pres. inf. act.; βουλὰς βουλεύειν ’to give counsel’
glossary.βόθροισι: βόθρος — pit, trench, hollow; masc. dat. pl., epic -οισι (= Attic -οις)
glossary.γέγηθε: γηθέω — rejoice, be glad; epic perf. γέγηθα, 3 sg. with present force: ’is glad’
glossary.γείνατο: γείνομαι — beget, bear (of a mother); aor. 3 sg. mid., epic, unaugmented (= ἐγείνατο)
glossary.διεπέφραδε: διαφράζω — point out, tell plainly; epic reduplicated aor. 3 sg. (πέφραδε), augment inside the compound
glossary.δινήεντα: δινήεις — full of eddies, swirling; masc. acc. sg. (of a river)
glossary.δμώεσσιν: δμώς — servant, slave (male); masc. dat. pl., epic -εσσιν (= Attic δμωσί)
glossary.δμῳαί: δμῳή — female servant, slave-woman; fem. nom. pl.
glossary.δμῶες: δμώς — servant, slave (male); masc. nom. pl.
glossary.δύμαντος: Δύμας — Dymas, a Phaeacian, father of Nausicaa’s friend; masc. gen. sg.
glossary.δῆμόν: δῆμος — people, land, community; masc. acc. sg. (accent from the following enclitic)
glossary.εἵλοντο: αἱρέω — take; aor. mid. 3 pl.: ’took for themselves’; δεῖπνον εἵλοντο ’took their meal’
glossary.εἵματ: εἷμα — garment, clothing; neut. acc. pl., elided (εἵματ’ = εἵματα)
glossary.εὐρυχόρῳ: εὐρύχορος — with broad spaces, spacious; adj. of two endings, fem. dat. sg.
glossary.ζεῦξάν: ζεύγνυμι — yoke, harness; aor. 3 pl. act., unaugmented (= ἔζευξαν); accent from the following enclitic
glossary.ζῶστρά: ζῶστρον — girdle, belt; neut. acc. pl. (accent from the following enclitic τε)
glossary.θαλέθοντες: θαλέθω — bloom, flourish; pres. part. masc. nom. pl.: ’in full bloom’
glossary.θῖν: θίς — shore, beach; masc. acc. sg., elided (θῖν’ = θῖνα)
glossary.κάθηράν: καθαίρω — cleanse, wash clean; aor. 3 pl., unaugmented (= ἐκάθηραν); accent from the following enclitic
glossary.κάλεον: καλέω — call, summon; impf. 3 pl., epic uncontracted, unaugmented (= ἐκάλουν)
glossary.κάπροισι: κάπρος — wild boar; masc. dat. pl., epic -οισι (= Attic -οις)
glossary.κίον: κίω — go, move; epic impf. 3 pl. (= ἐπορεύοντο), unaugmented
glossary.κίστῃ: κίστη — basket, chest; fem. dat. sg.
glossary.καθῆραι: καθαίρω — cleanse, wash clean; aor. inf. act.: ’to clean’
glossary.καλαὶ: καλός — beautiful, fair; fem. nom. pl.
glossary.καμάτῳ: κάματος — toil, weariness; masc. dat. sg.
glossary.καναχὴ: καναχή — ring, clatter (of hooves, metal); fem. nom. sg.
glossary.κατέθηκεν: κατατίθημι — put down, stow; aor. 3 sg. act. (ν-movable): ’put down, stowed’
glossary.κεχάριστο: χαρίζομαι — be gracious to, be dear to; plpf. 3 sg. pass.: ’was dear (to)’, + dat.
glossary.κιχήσατο: κιχάνω — reach, come upon, find; aor. 3 sg. mid., epic, unaugmented
glossary.κλειτοὺς: κλειτός — famous, renowned (= κλυτός); masc. acc. pl.
glossary.κοιμᾶτ: κοιμάομαι — go to sleep, sleep; pres. 3 sg. mid., elided (κοιμᾶτ’ = κοιμᾶται)
glossary.κούρης: κούρη — girl, maiden, daughter (Attic κόρη); fem. gen. sg.
glossary.κοῦραι: κούρη — girl, daughter (Attic κόρη); fem. nom. pl.
glossary.κυκλώπων: Κύκλωψ — Cyclops, one of a race of one-eyed giants; masc. gen. pl.
glossary.λάιγγας: λάιγξ — pebble, small stone; fem. acc. pl.
glossary.λευκώλενος: λευκώλενος — white-armed; adj., nom. sg. (epithet of women, e.g. Nausicaa)
glossary.λευκὴ: λευκός — white, bright; fem. nom. sg.
glossary.λητώ: Λητώ — Leto, mother of Apollo and Artemis; nom. sg.
glossary.λοεσσάμεναι: λούω — wash, bathe (epic λοέω); aor. mid. part. fem. nom. pl.: ’having bathed’
glossary.μέτωπα: μέτωπον — forehead, brow; neut. acc. pl.
glossary.μεθήμονα: μεθήμων — slack, careless, remiss; fem. acc. sg. (adj. of two endings)
glossary.μελιηδέα: μελιηδής — honey-sweet; fem. acc. sg., uncontracted (adj. of two endings) · also masc. acc. sg., agreeing with a masc. noun (μελιηδέα καρπόν ’honey-sweet fruit’)
glossary.μετέπρεπε: μεταπρέπω — stand out among, be conspicuous among (+ dat.); impf. 3 sg.
glossary.μητιόωσα: μητιάω — devise, plan; pres. part. fem. nom. sg., epic uncontracted (= μητιῶσα)
glossary.ναυσίθοος: Ναυσίθοος — Nausithous, founder of the Phaeacian city; nom. sg.
glossary.ναυσικάα: Ναυσικάα — Nausicaa, daughter of Alcinous; nom. sg. · also voc. sg. (same form), in address
glossary.ναυσικάαν: Ναυσικάα — Nausicaa, daughter of Alcinous; acc. sg.
glossary.ναυσικλειτοῖο: ναυσικλειτός — famed for ships; masc. gen. sg., epic -οιο (= Attic -ου)
glossary.νεόπλυτα: νεόπλυτος — newly washed; neut. acc. pl.
glossary.νηοὺς: νηός (Attic ναός) — temple, shrine; masc. acc. pl.
glossary.νόει: νοέω — perceive, take in, understand; impf. 3 sg., unaugmented (= ἐνόει) · also pres. imper. 2 sg.: ’think, mark’
glossary.νύμφαι: νύμφη — nymph; also bride; fem. nom. pl.
glossary.ξύμβλητο: συμβάλλω — meet, encounter (+ dat.); athematic aor. 3 sg. mid., epic ξυμ- (= συμ-), unaugmented (Attic συνεβάλετο)
glossary.οἴην: οἶος — alone, only; fem. acc. sg.
glossary.οἵη: οἷος — of such a kind, such as; in a simile ’as’; fem. nom. sg.
glossary.οὔλυμπόνδ: Οὔλυμπος (Ὄλυμπος) — Olympus, home of the gods; acc. sg. with -δε ’to’, elided (Οὔλυμπόνδ’ = Οὔλυμπόνδε)
glossary.οὔρεα: ὄρος — mountain; neut. acc. pl., epic οὔρεα (= Attic ὄρη)
glossary.πάππα: πάππας — papa, daddy; masc. voc. sg., a child’s word for father
glossary.πέπλους: πέπλος — robe, woven cloth; masc. acc. pl.
glossary.πέπταται: πετάννυμι — spread out; perf. 3 sg. pass. (πέπταμαι): ’is spread out’
glossary.πέτασαν: πετάννυμι — spread out; aor. 3 pl., unaugmented (= ἐπέτασαν)
glossary.παίζουσι: παίζω — play, sport, dance; pres. 3 pl.
glossary.παντοίην: παντοῖος — of every kind, all sorts of; fem. acc. sg.
glossary.παρασχεῖν: παρέχω — provide, furnish, give; aor. inf. act.
glossary.παρθένος: παρθένος — maiden, unmarried girl; fem. nom. sg.
glossary.πασάων: πᾶς — all, every; fem. gen. pl., epic -άων (= Attic πασῶν)
glossary.περικαλλέ: περικαλλής — very beautiful; masc. acc. sg., elided (περικαλλέ’ = περικαλλέα)
glossary.περιμήκετον: περιμήκετος — very tall, very long; adj. of two endings, masc. acc. sg. (of a mountain); LSJ also lists περιμήκης
glossary.πλυνέουσα: πλύνω — wash; fut. part. fem. nom. sg., epic uncontracted (= πλυνοῦσα), of purpose: ’to wash’
glossary.πλυνέουσαι: πλύνω — wash; fut. part. fem. nom. pl., epic uncontracted (= πλυνοῦσαι), of purpose: ’to wash’
glossary.πλυνοί: πλυνός — washing-trough, washing-pool; masc. nom. pl.
glossary.πλυνοὶ: πλυνός — washing-trough, washing-pool; masc. nom. pl.
glossary.πλῦνάν: πλύνω — wash; aor. 3 pl., unaugmented (= ἔπλυναν); accent from the following enclitic
glossary.πνοιὴ: πνοιή — blast, breath, gust; fem. nom. sg. (Attic πνοιά)
