glossary.πολυδαίδαλον: πολυδαίδαλος — richly wrought, much-adorned; masc. acc. sg.
glossary.προφέρουσαι: προφέρω — bring forward, put forth; pres. part. fem. nom. pl.; ἔριδα προφέρειν ’put forth strife, vie’
glossary.πρώτοισιν: πρῶτος — first, foremost; masc. dat. pl., epic -οισιν (= Attic -οις)
glossary.πόδεσσιν: πούς — foot; masc. dat. pl., epic -εσσιν (= Attic ποσί)
glossary.σεῦαν: σεύω — drive, set in motion; aor. 3 pl., epic, unaugmented (= ἔσσευαν)
glossary.σιγαλόεντα: σιγαλόεις — glossy, gleaming (sense uncertain); neut. nom./acc. pl.
glossary.σινέσκοντο: σίνομαι — harm, plunder; iterative impf. 3 pl. mid. in -σκ- (= ἐσίνοντο): ’used to harm’
glossary.σταθμοῖιν: σταθμός — doorpost; masc. dual gen./dat., epic -οιιν (= Attic -οιν): ’by the two posts’
glossary.στεῖβον: στείβω — tread, trample; impf. 3 pl., unaugmented (= ἔστειβον)
glossary.στρωφῶσ: στροφάω (epic for στρέφω) — twist, spin; pres. part. fem. nom. sg., elided (στρωφῶσ’ = στρωφῶσα)
glossary.συνέριθος: συνέριθος — fellow-worker, helper; fem. nom. sg.
glossary.σχερίῃ: Σχερίη — Scheria, land of the Phaeacians; fem. dat. sg.
glossary.τάρφθεν: τέρπω — delight; aor. pass. 3 pl. (τάρφθεν, epic 2nd aor. = ἐτέρφθησαν), + gen.: ’took their fill of’
glossary.τέρπονται: τέρπω — delight, gladden; pres. 3 pl. mid.: ’take delight, enjoy themselves’
glossary.τανύοντο: τανύω — stretch, strain; impf. 3 pl. mid., unaugmented: ’stretched themselves, strained’
glossary.ταὶ: ὁ, ἡ, τό — he, she, it; that (in Homer a pronoun; later the article); fem. nom. pl., epic (= Attic αἱ): ’they’
glossary.τερπομένη: τέρπω — delight; pres. part. mid. fem. nom. sg., + dat.: ’taking delight (in)’
glossary.τερσήμεναι: τέρσομαι — become dry; aor. pass. inf., epic -ήμεναι (= Attic -ῆναι): ’to dry’
glossary.τηΰγετον: Τηΰγετος — Taygetus, mountain range in Laconia; masc. acc. sg.
glossary.τινάσσεται: τινάσσω — shake, toss; pres. 3 sg. mid./pass.: ’is shaken’
glossary.τούτων: οὗτος, αὕτη, τοῦτο — this, that; gen. pl.: ’of these’
glossary.τρώγειν: τρώγω — gnaw, munch, eat (of animals); pres. inf. act.
glossary.τῇσι: ὁ, ἡ, τό — he, she, it; that (in Homer a pronoun; later the article); fem. dat. pl., epic -ῃσι (= Attic ταῖς): ’among them’
glossary.φάτις: φάτις — report, talk, rumour; fem. nom. sg.
glossary.φέρτεροι: φέρτερος — stronger, better (comparative of ἀγαθός); masc. nom. pl.
glossary.φαίηκες: Φαίηξ — a Phaeacian; masc. nom. pl.
glossary.φαεινήν: φαεινός — bright, shining; fem. acc. sg.
glossary.φαειναί: φαεινός — bright, shining; fem. nom. pl.
glossary.φαινομένηφι: φαίνω — show; mid. appear; pres. part. mid. fem. dat. sg. with epic -ηφι (= Attic -ῃ): ’appearing’
glossary.φθονέω: φθονέω — begrudge, grudge (+ gen. of the thing); pres. 1 sg.
glossary.φρενὶ: φρήν — mind, wits, heart; fem. dat. sg.
glossary.φυὴν: φυή — stature, growth, form; fem. acc. sg., acc. of respect: ’in stature’
glossary.χέρσον: χέρσος — dry land; fem. acc. sg.
glossary.χαίρουσιν: χαίρω — rejoice, be glad; pres. 3 pl.
glossary.χαρίτων: Χάρις — Grace, one of the goddesses of charm; fem. gen. pl.
glossary.χορὸν: χορός — dance; dancing-place; masc. acc. sg.
glossary.χρισάμεναι: χρίω — anoint, rub with oil; aor. mid. part. fem. nom. pl.: ’having anointed themselves’
glossary.χροΐ: χρώς — skin, body; masc. dat. sg., epic χροΐ (= Attic χρωτί)
glossary.χρυσέῃ: χρύσεος — golden; fem. dat. sg., epic uncontracted (= Attic χρυσῇ)
glossary.χυτλώσαιτο: χυτλόω — anoint with oil; aor. opt. 3 sg. mid.: ’might anoint herself’
glossary.ἀγγείλειε: ἀγγέλλω — announce, report; aor. opt. 3 sg. act., Aeolic -ειε (= Attic ἀγγείλαι), in a purpose clause
glossary.ἀγρονόμοι: ἀγρονόμος — living in the fields, roaming the countryside; fem. nom. pl.
glossary.ἀδμής: ἀδμής — unbroken, unwedded (of a girl); fem. nom. sg.
glossary.ἀκηδέα: ἀκηδής — uncared for, neglected; neut. nom. pl., epic uncontracted (= ἀκηδῆ)
glossary.ἀλκίνοος: Ἀλκίνοος — Alcinous, king of the Phaeacians; nom. sg.
glossary.ἀλκινόοιο: Ἀλκίνοος — Alcinous, king of the Phaeacians; gen. sg., epic -οιο (= Attic -ου)
glossary.ἀλφηστάων: ἀλφηστής — ’bread-eating’ (epithet of men); sense disputed, some derive it from ἀλφεῖν ’earn’ (’industrious’); masc. gen. pl., epic -άων (= Attic -ῶν)
glossary.ἀνέφελος: ἀνέφελος — cloudless; adj. of two endings, fem. nom. sg.
glossary.ἀναβαίνει: ἀναβαίνω — go up, rise, mount; pres. 3 sg.
glossary.ἀναστήσας: ἀνίστημι — make rise, uproot, remove; aor. part. act. masc. nom. sg.: ’having moved (them) out’
glossary.ἀπήνην: ἀπήνη — mule-wagon, cart; fem. acc. sg.
glossary.ἀπήνης: ἀπήνη — mule-wagon, cart; fem. gen. sg.
glossary.ἀπήνῃ: ἀπήνη — mule-wagon, cart; fem. dat. sg.
glossary.ἀπεθαύμασ: ἀποθαυμάζω — wonder at; aor. 3 sg., elided (ἀπεθαύμασ’ = ἀπεθαύμασε), augment inside the compound
glossary.ἀποπλύνεσκε: ἀποπλύνω — wash off, wash away; iterative impf. 3 sg. in -εσκ-, unaugmented: ’used to wash away’
glossary.ἀραρυῖαν: ἀραρίσκω — fit together, fit; perf. part. act. fem. acc. sg.: ’fitted (with)’
glossary.ἀρημένος: ἀρημένος — worn down, distressed, oppressed; Homeric participle shaped like a perf. pass., masc. nom. sg.; verb and derivation uncertain (perh. tied to ἀρή ’harm’)
glossary.ἀριγνώτη: ἀριγνώτος — easily recognised, conspicuous; fem. nom. sg.
glossary.ἀριστῆες: ἀριστεύς — best man, chief; masc. nom. pl., epic -ῆες (= Attic -εῖς)
glossary.ἀρούρας: ἄρουρα — ploughland, field; fem. acc. pl.
glossary.ἀσκῷ: ἀσκός — skin, wineskin; masc. dat. sg.
glossary.ἀσφαλὲς: ἀσφαλής — unshaken, secure, steadfast; neut. nom./acc. sg.
glossary.ἀτάρ: ἀτάρ — but, yet, and; conj., poetic (= αὐτάρ)
glossary.ἁλιπόρφυρα: ἁλιπόρφυρος — sea-purple, dyed with sea purple; neut. acc. pl.
glossary.ἄγρωστιν: ἄγρωστις — grass, fodder-grass; fem. acc. sg.
glossary.ἄγωμαι: ἄγω — lead, carry; pres. subj. 1 sg. mid.: ’may take along (for myself)’
glossary.ἄγωνται: ἄγω — lead, carry; pres. subj. 3 pl. mid., with κε: ’may lead (home)’
glossary.ἄγῃσι: ἄγω — lead, carry; pres. subj. 3 sg. act., epic -σι (= Attic ἄγῃ), with κε: ’shall carry’
glossary.ἄμοτον: ἄμοτον — insatiably, unceasingly, eagerly; adv. (neut. acc. of ἄμοτος)
glossary.ἐδάσσατ: δατέομαι — divide, allot; aor. 3 sg. mid., elided (ἐδάσσατ’ = ἐδάσσατο): ’portioned out’
glossary.ἐδείματο: δέμω — build; aor. 3 sg. mid.: ’built (for himself)’
glossary.ἐεισαμένη: εἴδομαι — liken oneself to (+ dat.); aor. mid. part. fem. nom. sg., epic ἐεισ- (= εἰσαμένη): ’having made herself like’
glossary.ἐθέλουσι: ἐθέλω — wish, be willing; pres. 3 pl.
glossary.ἐκέκλετο: κέλομαι — command, call to; reduplicated aor. 3 sg. mid., epic, + dat.: ’called to, bade’
glossary.ἐλάφοισι: ἔλαφος — deer, stag; masc./fem. dat. pl., epic -οισι (= Attic -οις)
glossary.ἐμῇ: ἐμός — my, mine; fem. dat. sg.
glossary.ἐντύνεαι: ἐντύνω — make ready, deck out; pres. subj. 2 sg. mid., short-vowel subj. (= ἐντύνῃ), after ὄφρα: ’you get ready’
glossary.ἐξονομῆναι: ἐξονομαίνω — name, speak out; aor. inf. act.: ’to name, to speak of’
glossary.ἐπέκειντο: ἐπίκειμαι — lie upon, be laid to; impf. 3 pl. (of doors ’were shut’)
glossary.ἐπεβήσετ: ἐπιβαίνω — mount, step upon (+ gen.); aor. 3 sg. mid. in -σετο, elided (ἐπεβήσετ’ = ἐπεβήσετο)
glossary.ἐπηετανοί: ἐπηετανός — abundant, never-failing; masc. nom. pl.
glossary.ἐπιδέδρομεν: ἐπιτρέχω — run over, spread over; perf. 3 sg. (ἐπιδέδρομε(ν), = Attic ἐπιδεδράμηκε)
glossary.ἐπιπίλναται: ἐπιπίλναμαι — draw near, come over, spread over; pres. 3 sg. mid.
glossary.ἐπότρυνον: ἐποτρύνω — urge on, rouse; aor. imper. 2 sg. act. (pres. imper. would be ἐπότρυνε): ’urge, press’ · also impf. 1 sg./3 pl., unaugmented (= ἐπώτρυνον)
glossary.ἐρχομένῳ: ἔρχομαι — go, come; pres. part. mid. masc. dat. sg.: ’(to him) going’
glossary.ἐρύμανθον: Ἐρύμανθος — Erymanthus, mountain in Arcadia; masc. acc. sg.
glossary.ἐσθλή: ἐσθλός — good, noble; fem. nom. sg.
glossary.ἐσθῆτα: ἐσθής — clothing, raiment; fem. acc. sg.
glossary.ἐσφόρεον: εἰσφορέω — carry in, bring in; impf. 3 pl., epic uncontracted, unaugmented (= εἰσεφόρουν)
glossary.ἐυξέστῳ: εὔξεστος — well-polished, well-planed; adj. of two endings, fem. dat. sg.
glossary.ἐφοπλίσαι: ἐφοπλίζω — make ready, harness; aor. inf. act.
glossary.ἐφοπλίσσειας: ἐφοπλίζω — make ready, harness; aor. opt. 2 sg. act., Aeolic -ειας (= Attic -αις): ’could you ready?’
glossary.ἐφοπλίσσουσιν: ἐφοπλίζω — make ready, harness; pres. 3 pl.
glossary.ἐύθρονος: ἐύθρονος — fair-throned (epithet of Dawn); fem. nom. sg.
glossary.ἐύκυκλον: ἐύκυκλος — well-wheeled, with fair round wheels; adj. of two endings, fem. acc. sg. (of a wagon)
glossary.ἐύτροχον: ἐύτροχος — well-wheeled, running smoothly; adj. of two endings, fem. acc. sg. (of a wagon)
glossary.ἔγειρε: ἐγείρω — rouse, wake; indic. 3 sg., unaugmented (= ἤγειρε), aor. or impf. (the Attic form is the same for both): ’woke’ · also pres. imper. 2 sg.: ’wake!’
glossary.ἔλαβεν: λαμβάνω — take, seize; aor. 3 sg. act. (ν-movable)
glossary.ἔλασσε: ἐλαύνω — drive; aor. 3 sg., epic -σσ-, unaugmented (= ἤλασε); τεῖχος ἔλασσε ’drove (a wall), i.e. built’
glossary.ἔριδα: ἔρις — strife, rivalry, contest; fem. acc. sg.
glossary.ἔρχευ: ἔρχομαι — go, come; imper. 2 sg., epic ἔρχευ (= Attic ἔρχου)
glossary.ἕδος: ἕδος — seat, abode; neut. nom./acc. sg.
glossary.ἕννυσθαι: ἕννυμι — clothe, put on; pres. inf. mid.: ’to put on, wear’
glossary.ἠίθεοι: ἠίθεος — unmarried young man, bachelor; masc. nom. pl.
glossary.ἠλάκατα: ἠλάκατα — spun wool, yarn (neut. pl.; cf. ἠλακάτη ’distaff’); neut. acc. pl.
glossary.ἡμιονείην: ἡμιόνειος — of mules; adj., fem. acc. sg. (ἄμαξα ἡμιονείη ’mule-wagon’)
glossary.ἡμιόνοιιν: ἡμίονος — mule; dual gen./dat., epic -οιιν (= Attic -οιν): ’of the two mules’
glossary.ἰοχέαιρα: ἰοχέαιρα — arrow-shooting (epithet of Artemis); fem. nom. sg.
glossary.ὀπυίοντες: ὀπυίω — take as wife, marry; pres. part. masc. nom. pl.: ’married’
glossary.ὁμοίη: ὅμοιος — like, similar (+ dat.); fem. nom. sg., epic (= ὁμοία)
glossary.ὄχθῃσιν: ὄχθη — bank, river-bank; fem. dat. pl., epic -ῃσιν (= Attic -αις)
glossary.ὑπεκπροέλυσαν: ὑπεκπρολύω — loose from under, unyoke; aor. 3 pl. act., augment inside the compound (+ gen.)
glossary.ὑπεκπρόρεεν: ὑπεκπρορέω — flow out from under; impf. 3 sg., epic uncontracted, unaugmented
glossary.ὑπερείῃ: Ὑπερείη — Hypereia, the Phaeacians’ former home; fem. dat. sg. (Ionic -ῃ)
glossary.ὑπερτερίῃ: ὑπερτερίη — part of a wagon, perh. its cover or upper frame (sense uncertain; the word looks like ’upper part’, from ὑπέρτερος); fem. dat. sg.
glossary.ὕπαγον: ὑπάγω — lead under, bring under (the yoke); impf. 3 pl.
glossary.ὠκείῃς: ὠκύς — swift; fem. dat. pl., epic -ῃς (= Attic ὠκείαις)
glossary.ὥπλεον: ὁπλέω — make ready, equip; impf. 3 pl. act., epic uncontracted (= ὥπλουν)
glossary.ῥερυπωμένα: ῥυπόω — make dirty; perf. part. pass. neut. nom. pl. with reduplication: ’soiled’
glossary.ῥεῖά: ῥεῖα — easily; adv., epic (= Attic ῥᾳδίως); accent from the following enclitic
glossary.ῥυπόωντα: ῥυπόω — be dirty, be filthy; pres. part. neut. acc. pl., epic uncontracted (= ῥυπῶντα)
glossary.ῥύπα: ῥύπος — dirt, filth; neut. acc. pl. ῥύπα, epic
glossary.αἰδέομαι: αἰδέομαι — feel shame, be ashamed (to do something); pres. 1 sg. mid./dep., + inf.: ’I am ashamed’
glossary.αἰπεινὰ: αἰπεινός — steep, sheer, lofty; neut. acc. pl.
glossary.αὐδηέντων: αὐδήεις — endowed with speech, speaking; masc. gen. pl., epic -ήεντ- (ἀνθρώπων αὐδηέντων ’speaking men’)
glossary.αὐτῇσι: αὐτός — self; as a pronoun ’them’; fem. dat. pl., epic -ῃσι (= Attic αὐταῖς)
glossary.βαθείῃ: βαθύς — deep; fem. dat. sg., epic -είῃ (= Attic βαθείᾳ)
glossary.βρίσας: βρίθω — be heavy, weigh down, overload; aor. part. masc. nom. sg., + dat.: ’weighing down with, outdoing in’
glossary.γαστὴρ: γαστήρ — belly, stomach (as the seat of appetite); fem. nom. sg.
glossary.γουνοῦμαί: γουνόομαι — clasp the knees of, entreat (from γόνυ); pres. 1 sg. mid./dep.: ’I entreat’
glossary.γούνων: γόνυ — knee; neut. gen. pl., epic γούνων (= Attic γονάτων)
glossary.γοῦνα: γόνυ — knee; neut. acc. pl., epic γοῦνα (= Attic γόνατα)
glossary.γυίων: γυῖον — limb; neut. gen. pl. (used chiefly in the plural)
glossary.γυμνοῦσθαι: γυμνόω — strip, make bare; pres. inf. mid./pass.: ’to strip oneself, be naked’
glossary.γυμνός: γυμνός — naked, unclothed; masc. nom. sg.
glossary.δήλῳ: Δῆλος — Delos, island sacred to Apollo; fem. dat. sg. (place where)
glossary.δήν: δήν — for a long time; adv.
glossary.δίνῃ: δίνη — eddy, whirlpool; fem. dat. sg.
glossary.δείξειε: δείκνυμι — show, point out; aor. opt. 3 sg., after εἰ of hope: ’in case she might show’
glossary.δείξω: δείκνυμι — show, point out; fut. 1 sg.: ’I will show’
glossary.δευήσεαι: δεύομαι — lack, be in need of (+ gen.); fut. 2 sg., epic uncontracted (= Attic δεήσῃ): ’you will lack’
glossary.δεῖξον: δείκνυμι — show, point out; aor. imper. 2 sg.
glossary.δηιοτῆτα: δηιοτής — battle, strife, hostile violence; fem. acc. sg., epic
glossary.διερὸς: διερός — living, active (sense uncertain, perhaps ’a living man who walks about’); masc. nom. sg.
glossary.δοῖεν: δίδωμι — give; aor. opt. 3 pl., wish: ’may they give’
glossary.δυσμενέεσσι: δυσμενής — hostile, ill-disposed; used as noun ’enemies’; masc. dat. pl., epic -έεσσι (= Attic δυσμενέσι)
glossary.δόρυ: δόρυ — wood, tree-trunk, timber; also spear; neut. nom. sg.
glossary.δόσις: δόσις — giving, a gift; fem. nom. sg.
glossary.δότ: δίδωμι — give; aor. imper. 2 pl., elided (δότ’ = δότε)
glossary.δῶκαν: δίδωμι — give; aor. 3 pl., epic (= Attic ἔδοσαν)
glossary.εἰσοιχνεῦσαν: εἰσοιχνέω — go into, enter; pres. part. fem. acc. sg., agreeing with an implied ’her’: ’entering (the dance)’
glossary.εἴλυμα: εἴλυμα — wrapping, covering, cloth to wrap in; neut. acc. sg.
glossary.εἶδός: εἶδος — form, appearance, beauty; neut. acc. sg.; accented before enclitic τε
glossary.εἶσ: εἶμι — go, come; pres. 3 sg., elided (εἶσ’ = εἶσι): ’goes, comes’
glossary.εὐμενέτῃσι: εὐμενέτης — well-wisher, friendly one; masc. dat. pl., epic -ῃσι (= Attic εὐμενέταις)
glossary.ζεύξασ: ζεύγνυμι — yoke, harness; aor. part. fem. nom. sg., elided (ζεύξασ’ = ζεύξασα)
glossary.θάλος: θάλος — young shoot, sapling; of a young person, a ’sprig’; neut. acc. sg.
glossary.θάμνων: θάμνος — bush, thicket; masc. gen. pl.
glossary.θεουδής: θεουδής — god-fearing, pious; adj. of two terminations, masc./fem. nom. sg.
glossary.κάββαλε: καταβάλλω — throw down, cast down; aor. 3 sg., κατά assimilated before β, unaugmented (κάββαλε = κατέβαλε)
glossary.κάρηνα: κάρηνον (pl. of κάρη) — head; in the plural, mountain peaks; neut. acc. pl.
glossary.κέλευσαν: κελεύω — order, bid; aor. 3 pl., unaugmented (= ἐκέλευσαν)
glossary.κακοῖσιν: κακός — bad, base; used as noun ’the bad’; masc. dat. pl., epic -οισιν (= Attic -οις)
glossary.κεκακωμένος: κακόω — maltreat, afflict, ravage; perf. part. mid./pass. masc. nom. sg., + dat. of cause: ’worn down, ravaged’
glossary.κερδαλέον: κερδαλέος — crafty, cunning (from κέρδος ’gain’); masc. acc. sg.
glossary.κεῖνο: κεῖνος — that; demonstrative pron., neut. acc. sg., epic (= Attic ἐκεῖνο)
glossary.κλάσε: κλάω — break off; aor. 3 sg., unaugmented (= ἔκλασε)
glossary.κομέειν: κομέω — tend, take care of; pres. inf., epic uncontracted (= Attic κομεῖν)
glossary.κουράων: κούρη — girl, maiden; fem. gen. pl., epic -άων (= Attic κορῶν)
glossary.κούρῃσιν: κούρη — girl, maiden; fem. dat. pl., epic -ῃσιν (= Attic κόραις)
glossary.κραιπναί: κραιπνός — swift, rushing; fem. nom. pl.
glossary.κρεῖσσον: κρείσσων — better, stronger; neut. nom. sg., comparative, Ionic κρείσσων (= Attic κρείττων)
glossary.λίσσοιτ: λίσσομαι — beseech, entreat; pres. opt. 3 sg., elided (λίσσοιτ’ = λίσσοιτο), indirect deliberation: ’whether he should entreat’
glossary.λίσσοιτο: λίσσομαι — beseech, entreat; pres. opt. 3 sg., indirect deliberation after ἤ … ἦ: ’whether he should entreat’
glossary.λαβόντι: λαμβάνω — take, seize; aor. part. masc. dat. sg.: ’to him having taken’
glossary.λαβὼν: λαμβάνω — take, take hold of; aor. part. masc. nom. sg.: ’having taken’ (γούνων λαβών ’clasping the knees’, gen. of the part grasped)
glossary.λαός: λαός — people, host, band of followers; masc. nom. sg.
glossary.λευσσόντων: λεύσσω — look at, gaze upon; pres. part. masc. gen. pl.: ’as they gaze’
glossary.λοέσσομαι: λούω — wash, bathe; fut. 1 sg. mid., epic λοέσσομαι (= Attic λούσομαι), or aor. subj.: ’I shall wash myself’
glossary.λούσατέ: λούω — wash, bathe; aor. imper. 2 pl. act.: ’wash (him)’; accented before enclitic τε
glossary.λοῦσθαι: λούω — wash, bathe; pres. inf. mid.: ’to wash oneself’
glossary.μίξεσθαι: μίγνυμι — mix, mingle; fut. inf. mid., + dat., after ἔμελλε: ’to mingle with, come among’
glossary.μακάρτατος: μάκαρ — blessed, happy; masc. nom. sg., superlative, epic μακάρτατος (= Attic μακαριώτατος): ’most blessed’
glossary.μακρὸν: μακρός — long, far; neut. acc. sg. used adverbially: ’far, loudly’ · also masc. acc. sg. agreeing with a noun: ’tall’ (κίονα μακρὸν ’a tall pillar’)
glossary.μειλίχιον: μειλίχιος — soothing, gentle, winning; masc. acc. sg.
glossary.μειλιχίοισι: μειλίχιος — soothing, gentle, winning; masc. dat. pl., epic -οισι (= Attic -οις)
glossary.μερμήριξεν: μερμηρίζω — ponder, waver, be in doubt; aor. 3 sg.: ’pondered’
glossary.μετέρχεται: μετέρχομαι — go among, go after, attack; pres. 3 sg. (+ dat. or acc.)
glossary.νέμει: νέμω — distribute, dispense, allot; pres. 3 sg.
glossary.ναιετάουσιν: ναιετάω — dwell, inhabit; pres. 3 pl., epic uncontracted (= Attic ναιετῶσι)
glossary.νοήμασιν: νόημα — thought, mind, purpose; neut. dat. pl., dat. of respect: ’in thought’
glossary.νυμφάων: νύμφη — nymph, young woman; fem. gen. pl., epic -άων (= Attic νυμφῶν)
glossary.ξεῖνοί: ξεῖνος — stranger, guest; masc. nom. pl., epic (= Attic ξένος); accented before enclitic τε
glossary.οἰκέομεν: οἰκέω — dwell, inhabit; pres. 1 pl., epic uncontracted (= Attic οἰκοῦμεν)
glossary.οὔνομα: ὄνομα — name; neut. acc. sg., epic οὔνομα (= Attic ὄνομα)
glossary.πίσεα: πίσος — meadow, water-meadow; neut. acc. pl., uncontracted -εα (contracted -η)
glossary.παχείῃ: παχύς — thick, stout, strong; fem. dat. sg., epic -είῃ (= Attic παχείᾳ)
glossary.παύσεσθ: παύω — stop; mid. cease, leave off; fut. inf., elided (παύσεσθ’ = παύσεσθαι): ’to cease’
glossary.πειρήσομαι: πειράω — try, make trial (of); fut. 1 sg. mid., epic (= Attic πειράσομαι), or hortatory aor. subj.: ’I shall try’
glossary.πειρήσοντα: πειράω — try, make trial of (+ gen.); fut. part. masc. acc. sg., of purpose: ’to make trial of’
glossary.πεποιθώς: πείθω — persuade; perf. πέποιθα trust, rely on (+ dat.); perf. part. masc. nom. sg.: ’trusting in’
glossary.πηγὰς: πηγή — spring, source; fem. acc. pl.
glossary.προὐχούσας: προέχω — jut out, project; pres. part. fem. acc. pl. with crasis (προὐχ- = προ-ἐχ-): ’jutting out’
glossary.πρώτην: πρῶτος — first; fem. acc. sg., in ἐς πρώτην ’to the first (person)’ · also fem. acc. sg. agreeing with an understood object ’her’: πρώτην ἱκέτευσας ’you besought her first’
glossary.πτόρθον: πτόρθος — branch, shoot; masc. acc. sg.
glossary.πτύξασά: πτύσσω — fold; aor. part. fem. nom. sg. (accent from following enclitic τε)
glossary.πυκινὸν: πυκινός — thick, close-set, solid; masc. acc. sg.: ’solid’
glossary.πυκινῆς: πυκινός — thick, dense, close-set; fem. gen. sg.
glossary.πόσε: πόσε — to what place? whither?; interrog. adv.
glossary.σμερδαλέος: σμερδαλέος — terrible, dread, fearsome; masc. nom. sg.
glossary.σπείρων: σπεῖρον — cloth, wrapping; neut. gen. pl., dependent on εἴλυμα: ’wrapping of cloths’
glossary.στῆθ: ἵστημι — set, stand; aor. imper. 2 pl., intrans., elided (στῆθ’ = στῆτε): ’stand!’
glossary.στῆτέ: ἵστημι — set, stand; aor. imper. 2 pl., intrans. (accent from following enclitic μοι): ’stand still!’
glossary.σφισι: σφεῖς — they; epic encl. dat. pl. pron. (= Attic αὐτοῖς): ’to/for them’
glossary.τέθηπά: τέθηπα — be astonished, stand amazed (perf. of a root ταφ-); perf. with pres. sense, 1 sg. (accent from following enclitic τε)
glossary.τέων: τίς — who? what?; interrog. pron., masc. gen. pl., epic (= Attic τίνων): ’of what (mortals)’
glossary.τήνδε: ὅδε, ἥδε, τόδε — this (here); demonstrative pron., fem. acc. sg.
glossary.ταλαπείριον: ταλαπείριος — much-enduring, wretched; masc. acc. sg.
glossary.τελέουσι: τελέω — bring to pass, accomplish; fut. 3 pl., epic uncontracted (= Attic τελοῦσι)
glossary.τοιόνδε: τοιόσδε — such as this, of this kind; neut. acc. sg.
glossary.τρέσσαν: τρέω — flee in fear, tremble; aor. 3 pl., unaugmented, epic (= Attic ἔτρεσαν)
glossary.τῇδε: ὅδε, ἥδε, τόδε — this (here); demonstrative pron., fem. dat. sg. used adverbially: ’here, in this place’
glossary.φάσθ: φημί — say, think, suppose; pres. 2 pl. mid., elided (φάσθ’ = φάσθε): ’you say’
glossary.φεύγετε: φεύγω — flee, run away; pres. 2 pl.: ’you flee’
glossary.φιλόξεινοι: φιλόξεινος — loving strangers, hospitable; masc. nom. pl.
glossary.φοίνικος: φοῖνιξ — palm-tree, date-palm; masc. gen. sg.
glossary.φωτός: φώς — man, mortal; masc. gen. sg.
glossary.φᾶρός: φᾶρος — cloak, large piece of cloth; neut. acc. sg. (accent from following enclitic τε)
glossary.φῶτα: φώς — man, mortal; masc. acc. sg.
glossary.χάρματα: χάρμα — joy, delight; neut. nom. pl.
glossary.χολώσαιτο: χολόω — anger, enrage; aor. opt. 3 sg. mid., in a fear clause after μή: ’lest she be angered’
glossary.χρίσομαι: χρίω — anoint, rub with oil; mid. anoint oneself; fut. 1 sg., or aor. subj.: ’I shall anoint myself’
glossary.χροός: χρώς — skin, body, flesh; masc. gen. sg. (Attic χρωτός)
glossary.ἀήμενος: ἄημι — blow; pass. be blown upon; pres. part. masc. nom. sg.: ’buffeted by wind’
glossary.ἀγάγηται: ἄγω — lead, bring; aor. subj. 3 sg. mid., with κε in a relative clause: ’who shall lead (her) home for himself’
glossary.ἀγροτέρας: ἀγρότερος — of the wild, wild; fem. acc. pl.
glossary.ἀλκινόου: Ἀλκίνοος — Alcinous, king of the Phaeacians; masc. gen. sg.
glossary.ἀλκὶ: ἀλκή — strength, prowess, defensive might; fem. dat. sg.: ’in strength’
glossary.ἀλλήλῃσι: ἀλλήλων — one another; fem. dat. pl., epic -ῃσι (= Attic ἀλλήλαις)
glossary.ἀλοιφή: ἀλοιφή — fat, oil, unguent; fem. nom. sg.
glossary.ἀμφήλυθε: ἀμφέρχομαι — come round, surround; aor. 3 sg., epic (= Attic ἀμφῆλθε): ’came round (me)’
glossary.ἀμφίπολον: ἀμφίπολος — handmaid, attendant; fem. acc. sg.
glossary.ἀμφιβαλέσθαι: ἀμφιβάλλω — throw around, put around; aor. inf. mid.: ’to put around oneself’
glossary.ἀμφιπόλοισιν: ἀμφίπολος — handmaid, attendant; fem. dat. pl., epic -οισιν (= Attic -οις)
glossary.ἀμφιπόλου: ἀμφίπολος — handmaid, attendant; fem. gen. sg.
glossary.ἀνήλυθεν: ἀνέρχομαι — go up, come up; aor. 3 sg., epic (= Attic ἀνῆλθεν): ’came up, sprang up’
glossary.ἀνερχόμενον: ἀνέρχομαι — go up, come up, grow up; pres. part. neut. acc. sg.: ’springing up’
glossary.ἀντιάσαντα: ἀντιάω — meet, meet with, come by (+ gen.); aor. part. masc. acc. sg., agreeing with ἱκέτην: ’one who has met with’
glossary.ἀπολούσομαι: ἀπολούω — wash off; fut. 1 sg. mid., or aor. subj.: ’I shall wash off (from myself)’
glossary.ἀποσταδὰ: ἀποσταδά — standing apart, from a distance; adv.
glossary.ἀπόπροθεν: ἀπόπροθεν — from afar, far off; adv.
glossary.ἀρτέμιδί: Ἄρτεμις — Artemis; fem. dat. sg., after ἐίσκω (accent from following enclitic σε): ’to Artemis’
glossary.ἀυτή: ἀυτή — cry, shout; fem. nom. sg.
glossary.ἄγαμαί: ἄγαμαι — wonder at, admire; pres. 1 sg. mid./dep. (accent from following enclitic τε)
glossary.ἄγχιστα: ἄγχι — near; superl. adv. ἄγχιστα: ’nearest, most closely’
glossary.ἄνασσα: ἄνασσα — queen, lady, mistress; fem. nom./voc. sg.
glossary.ἄρειον: ἀρείων — better, more excellent; neut. nom. sg., comparative
glossary.ἄυσαν: ἀΰω — shout, cry out; aor. 3 pl., unaugmented (= ἤυσαν)
glossary.ἄφρονι: ἄφρων — senseless, foolish; masc. dat. sg.
glossary.ἅμαρτε: ἁμαρτάνω — miss (+ gen.); aor. 3 sg., unaugmented (= ἥμαρτε)
glossary.ἅψασθαι: ἅπτω — fasten; mid. touch, take hold of (+ gen.); aor. inf. mid.
glossary.ἐέδνοισι: ἔεδνα — bride-gifts (gifts given for a bride); neut. dat. pl., epic -οισι (= Attic -οις)
glossary.ἐίσκω: ἐίσκω — liken, compare, deem like (+ dat.); pres. 1 sg.: ’I liken’
glossary.ἐπέοιχ: ἔπεοικε — it is fitting, befits (+ dat.); perf. 3 sg. with pres. sense, elided (ἐπέοιχ’ = ἐπέοικε)
glossary.ἐπιμίσγεται: ἐπιμίσγομαι — have dealings with, mingle with (+ dat.); pres. 3 sg.
glossary.ἐσθλήν: ἐσθλός — good, noble; fem. acc. sg.
glossary.ἐσθλοῖς: ἐσθλός — good, noble; masc. dat. pl., used as noun: ’to the good’
glossary.ἐσθῆτος: ἐσθής — clothing, raiment; fem. gen. sg., gen. of want with δευήσεαι
glossary.ἐτεθήπεα: τέθηπα — be astonished, stand amazed (perf. of a root ταφ-); plpf. 1 sg., epic -εα (= Attic -η), impf. sense: ’I was amazed’
glossary.ἐυπλοκάμοισι: ἐυπλόκαμος — fair-tressed; fem. dat. pl., epic -οισι (= Attic -οις)
glossary.ἐυπλοκάμοισιν: ἐυπλόκαμος — fair-tressed; fem. dat. pl., epic -οισιν (= Attic -οις)
glossary.ἐυφροσύνῃσιν: εὐφροσύνη — good cheer, merriment; fem. dat. pl., epic -ῃσιν (= Attic -αις)
glossary.ἐυώπιδα: εὐῶπις — fair-faced, bright-eyed; fem. acc. sg.
glossary.ἑζόμενος: ἕζομαι — sit down, sit; pres. part. masc. nom. sg.: ’sitting up’
glossary.ἔγρετο: ἐγείρω — wake, rouse; aor. 3 sg. mid., 2nd aorist, epic (sense of Attic ἠγέρθη): ’awoke’
glossary.ἔγροιτο: ἐγείρω — wake, rouse; aor. opt. 3 sg. mid., purpose after ὡς: ’might wake’
glossary.ἔρνος: ἔρνος — young shoot, sapling; neut. acc. sg.
glossary.ἔσθ: εἰμί — be; pres. 3 sg., elided (ἔσθ’ = ἔστι): ’is’
glossary.ἔσταν: ἵστημι — set, stand; aor. 3 pl., root aorist, intrans., epic (= Attic ἔστησαν): ’stood’
glossary.ἔχες: ἔχω — have, hold; impf. 2 sg., unaugmented (= εἶχες): ’you had’
glossary.ἔχεται: ἔχω — have, hold; mid. cling to, depend on; pres. 3 sg. mid., with ἐκ + gen.: ’is dependent on’
glossary.ἔχητον: ἔχω — have, hold; pres. subj. dual (2nd/3rd person): ’the two keep’
glossary.ἔχουσ: ἔχω — have, hold, inhabit; pres. 3 pl., elided (ἔχουσ’ = ἔχουσι) · or fem. nom. pl. part. ἔχουσαι
glossary.ἡγήσαιτο: ἡγέομαι — lead the way, guide (+ dat.); aor. opt. 3 sg., purpose after ὡς: ’might lead’ · also potential with ἄν: ’would lead the way’ (καὶ ἂν πάϊς ἡγήσαιτο ’even a child could lead’)
glossary.ἤνωγον: ἄνωγα — order, bid, urge (perf. with pres. sense); impf. 3 pl. ἤνωγον, epic: ’they urged’
glossary.ἰαίνεται: ἰαίνω — warm, cheer; pres. 3 sg. pass.: ’is warmed, is cheered’
glossary.ἰδοῦσαι: ὁράω (aor. stem ἰδ-) — see; aor. part. fem. nom. pl.: ’having seen’
glossary.ἱκάνεις: ἱκάνω — come to, arrive at, reach; pres. 2 sg.
glossary.ἴδοι: ὁράω (aor. stem ἰδ-) — see; aor. opt. 3 sg., purpose after ὡς: ’might see’
glossary.ἴδωμαι: ὁράω (aor. stem ἰδ-) — see; aor. subj. 1 sg. mid., hortatory: ’let me see’
glossary.ἵκανε: ἱκάνω — come to, reach; impf. 3 sg.: ’came upon’
glossary.ὀδυσσῆ: Ὀδυσσεύς — Odysseus; acc. sg., elided epic Ὀδυσσῆ’ (= Ὀδυσσῆα)
glossary.ὀλίγη: ὀλίγος — little, small; fem. nom. sg.
glossary.ὀπάσειαν: ὀπάζω — grant, bestow, add as a gift; aor. opt. 3 pl.: ’may they grant’
glossary.ὀρεσίτροφος: ὀρεσίτροφος — mountain-nurtured, mountain-bred; masc. nom. sg.
glossary.ὁμοφρονέοντε: ὁμοφρονέω — be of one mind; pres. part. masc. nom. dual, epic uncontracted (= Attic ὁμοφρονοῦντε)
glossary.ὁμοφροσύνην: ὁμοφροσύνη — like-mindedness, concord; fem. acc. sg.
glossary.ὅδε: ὅδε, ἥδε, τόδε — this (here); demonstrative pron., masc. nom. sg.
glossary.ὑβρισταί: ὑβριστής — insolent, violent person; masc. nom. pl.
glossary.ὑπεδύσετο: ὑποδύομαι — slip out from under, emerge from beneath (+ gen.); aor. 3 sg. mid., epic -σετο form
glossary.ὑόμενος: ὕω — rain; pass. be rained upon; pres. part. masc. nom. sg.: ’rained on’
glossary.ὕλης: ὕλη — wood, forest, thicket; fem. gen. sg.
glossary.ὠγυγίης: Ὠγύγιος — Ogygian, of Ogygia (Calypso’s island; sense of the name unknown); fem. gen. sg.
glossary.ὤμοιιν: ὦμος — shoulder; masc. dual gen., epic (= Attic ὤμοιν): ’from the shoulders’
glossary.ῥάκος: ῥάκος — rag, ragged cloth; neut. acc. sg.
glossary.ῥοῇσιν: ῥοή — stream, flow; fem. dat. pl., epic -ῇσιν (= Attic ῥοαῖς)
glossary.ῥύσαιτο: ῥύομαι (ἐρύομαι) — draw, protect, shield; aor. opt. 3 sg. mid., purpose after ὡς: ’might shield’
glossary.αἰγείρων: αἴγειρος — black poplar; fem. gen. pl.
glossary.βάλλειν: βάλλω — throw, put, cast; pres. inf., standing as an instruction (’throw (your hands) about’)
glossary.βέλτερον: βέλτερος — better, preferable (epic comparative of ἀγαθός, = Attic βελτίων); neut. nom. sg., predicate: ’(it is) better’
glossary.βιὸς: βιός — bow; masc. nom. sg. (oxytone, distinct from βίος ’life’)
glossary.δέατ: δέατο (defective epic aor., origin uncertain) — seemed, appeared (= Attic ἐδόκει); 3 sg. mid., unaugmented, elided (δέατ’ = δέατο), + inf.
glossary.δέδαεν: δάω — teach (learn in the aor. pass.); reduplicated aor. 3 sg. act., epic (= Attic ἐδίδαξε), + double acc.: ’taught (the craft)’
glossary.δήεις: δήω (defective) — find; pres. with future sense, 2 sg., epic (= Attic εὑρήσεις): ’you will find’
glossary.διελθέμεν: διέρχομαι — go through; aor. inf., epic -έμεν (= Attic διελθεῖν), standing as an instruction: ’go through’
glossary.δμωαὶ: δμῳή — female servant, maid; fem. nom. pl. (cf. Attic δμωΐς)
glossary.εἰδησέμεν: οἶδα — know; fut. inf. (εἰδήσω), epic -έμεν (= Attic εἰδήσειν): ’will come to know, will learn’
glossary.εἰρύαται: ἐρύω — draw, haul; perf. mid./pass. 3 pl., epic -αται (for -νται): ’are drawn up’ (of ships)
glossary.εἰσίθμη: εἰσίθμη — entrance, passage in; fem. nom. sg.
glossary.εἰσιδέειν: εἰσοράω — look at, behold; aor. inf. (stem εἰσιδ-), epic uncontracted (= Attic εἰσιδεῖν): ’to look upon’
glossary.εἵατ: ἧμαι — sit; pres. 3 pl., epic εἵαται (= Attic κάθηνται), elided (εἵατ’ = εἵαται): ’sit’
glossary.εἶπον: εἶπον — say, tell; aor. 3 pl. (also 1 sg.; = ἔειπον): ’they told’
glossary.εὐξαμένῃ: εὔχομαι — pray, vow; aor. part. mid. fem. dat. sg.: ’to her who prayed’
glossary.εὐρέας: εὐρύς — broad, wide; masc. acc. pl., epic uncontracted (= Attic εὐρεῖς)
glossary.ζεῦξεν: ζεύγνυμι — yoke, harness; aor. 3 sg., unaugmented (= Attic ἔζευξεν)
glossary.θαῦμα: θαῦμα — wonder, marvel; neut. nom. sg., in apposition: ’a wonder to see’
glossary.θρόνος: θρόνος — seat, chair, throne; masc. nom. sg.
glossary.κάλλεϊ: κάλλος — beauty; neut. dat. sg., epic κάλλεϊ (= Attic κάλλει)
glossary.κάρητος: κάρη — head; neut. gen. sg., epic κάρητος (= Attic κεφαλῆς)
glossary.κίονι: κίων — pillar, column; masc. dat. sg.
glossary.καθεζόμενος: καθέζομαι — sit down, sit; pres. part. masc. nom. sg.: ’sitting down’
glossary.κακώτερος: κακός — bad, low, base; epic comparative κακώτερος (= Attic κακίων), masc. nom. sg.: ’a baser fellow’
glossary.καλός: καλός — beautiful, fair, fine; masc. nom. sg., predicate/attributive
glossary.καλὸς: καλός — beautiful, fair, fine; masc. nom. sg., attributive (also of a harbour)
glossary.κατέχευε: καταχέω — pour down over; aor. 3 sg., epic (= Attic κατέχεεν), augmented, + dat.: ’shed upon’
glossary.καταβάς: καταβαίνω — go down, come down; aor. part. masc. nom. sg.: ’having come down’ (οὐρανόθεν ’from heaven’)
glossary.κατωρυχέεσσ: κατωρυχής — dug in, sunk in the ground; masc. dat. pl., epic -έεσσι, elided (κατωρυχέεσσ’ = κατωρυχέεσσι), with λάεσσι
glossary.καὐτή: αὐτός — self; fem. nom. sg. with crasis (καὐτή = καὶ αὐτή): ’even herself’
glossary.κεκλημένος: καλέω — call, name; perf. pass. part. masc. nom. sg.: ’called’ (not κλίνω, cf. κεκλιμένη)
glossary.κεκλιμένη: κλίνω — lean, recline; perf. mid./pass. part. fem. nom. sg.: ’leaning’ (not καλέω, cf. κεκλημένος)
glossary.κεκύθωσι: κεύθω — cover, hide, enclose; reduplicated aor. subj. 3 pl. (aor. κέκυθον), with ὁπότ’ ἄν: ’shall have enclosed’
glossary.κλῦτέ: κλύω — hear, listen; aor. imper. 2 pl., + gen.: ’hear me!’
glossary.κομίσσατο: κομίζω — take care of, carry off; mid. take in, pick up; aor. mid. 3 sg., epic -σσ-, unaugmented (= Attic ἐκομίσατο): ’took in’
glossary.κρήνη: κρήνη — spring, fountain; fem. nom. sg.
glossary.κρατερώνυχας: κρατερώνυξ — strong-hoofed; masc. acc. pl. (of mules)
glossary.κόμας: κόμη — hair, locks; fem. acc. pl.
glossary.λάεσσι: λᾶας — stone; masc. dat. pl., epic -εσσι (= Attic λίθοις)
glossary.λίπον: λείπω — leave, leave behind; aor. 3 pl., unaugmented (= Attic ἔλιπον)
glossary.λεπτὴ: λεπτός — narrow, thin, fine; fem. nom. sg.
glossary.λευκώλενοι: λευκώλενος — white-armed; fem. voc. pl. (of the maids)
glossary.λοέσσατο: λούω — wash, bathe; aor. mid. 3 sg., epic -έσσ- (= Attic ἐλούσατο), unaugmented: ’washed (himself)’
glossary.μάστιγι: μάστιξ — whip, lash; fem. dat. sg., instrumental
glossary.μίμνειν: μίμνω (= μένω) — stay, remain; pres. inf., epic (= Attic μένειν)
glossary.μίσγηται: μίσγω (epic for μίγνυμι) — mix, mingle; mid. consort with; pres. subj. 3 sg. mid., in a general relative clause, + dat.: ’who consorts with’
glossary.μείζονά: μέγας — great, big; comparative μείζων, masc. acc. sg.: ’bigger, taller’
glossary.μελαινάων: μέλας — black, dark; fem. gen. pl., epic -άων (= Attic -ῶν)
glossary.μεῖναι: μένω — stay, wait; aor. inf., standing as an instruction: ’wait’
glossary.μωμεύῃ: μωμεύω — find fault with, mock, blame; pres. subj. 3 sg., after μή: ’lest (someone) mock’
glossary.νίζετο: νίζω — wash (the body, mid.); impf. 3 sg. mid., unaugmented: ’was washing (his skin)’
glossary.ναιετάων: ναιετάω — dwell, live; pres. part. masc. nom. sg., epic -άων (= Attic -ῶν)
glossary.ναυσικάᾳ: Ναυσικάα — Nausicaa, daughter of Alcinous; dat. sg., with ἕπεται: ’(follows) Nausicaa’
glossary.νεμεσῶ: νεμεσάω — feel righteous indignation at, blame; pres. 1 sg., + dat.
glossary.νεῶν: ναῦς — ship; fem. gen. pl. (= epic νηῶν)
glossary.νόστοιο: νόστος — return home; masc. gen. sg., epic -οιο (= Attic -ου), + gen. with τυγχάνω · also gen. governed by λανθάνω ’forget’ (νόστοιο λάθηται ’should forget his return’)
glossary.οἰνοποτάζει: οἰνοποτάζω — drink wine, sit over wine; pres. 3 sg.
glossary.πάσσονα: παχύς — thick, stout; epic comparative πάσσων (= Attic παχύτερος), masc. acc. sg.: ’stouter’
glossary.παραμειψάμενος: παραμείβομαι — pass by, go past; aor. part. mid. masc. nom. sg., + acc.: ’having passed (it) by’
glossary.πατροκασίγνητον: πατροκασίγνητος — father’s brother, paternal uncle; masc. acc. sg.
glossary.πείσματα: πεῖσμα — ship’s cable, mooring rope; neut. acc. pl.
glossary.πεζοὶ: πεζός — on foot; masc. nom. pl., substantival: ’those on foot’
glossary.περιχεύεται: περιχέω — pour around, overlay; pres. mid. 3 sg., + acc. and dat.: ’overlays (gold) on (silver)’
glossary.πλίσσοντο: πλίσσομαι — stride, step out; impf. 3 pl. mid., unaugmented: ’strode out’ (πόδεσσιν ’with their feet’)
glossary.πλαγχθέντα: πλάζω — drive astray; pass. wander; aor. pass. part. masc. acc. sg.: ’driven astray’
glossary.πολυάρητος: πολυάρητος — much prayed to (or much prayed for); masc. nom. sg., agreeing with θεός
glossary.πομπῆς: πομπή — sending, escort, conveyance; fem. gen. sg., + gen. with τυγχάνω · also gen. governed by περί: ’about a conveyance’ · also gen. governed by εἵνεκα: ’on account of an escort’ · also gen. governed by ἐκ: ’from an escort’
glossary.ποσιδήιον: Ποσιδήιος — of Poseidon; neut. Ποσιδήιον as a noun: ’precinct/temple of Poseidon’; neut. acc. sg.
glossary.ποτικέκλιται: ποτικλίνω (= προσκλίνω) — lean against; perf. pass. 3 sg., epic ποτι-: ’leans against’
glossary.πτόλιος: πτόλις (epic for πόλις) — city; fem. gen. sg. (= Attic πόλεως)
glossary.πόλινδ: πόλις — city; fem. acc. sg. with -δε suffix, elided (πόλινδ’ = πόλινδε): ’to the city’
glossary.πόλιος: πόλις — city; fem. gen. sg., epic (= Attic πόλεως)
glossary.πόσις: πόσις — husband, spouse; masc. nom. sg. (distinct from πόσις ’drink’)
glossary.πύργος: πύργος — tower, city wall; masc. nom. sg.
glossary.στίλβων: στίλβω — gleam, glisten; pres. part. masc. nom. sg.: ’glistening’
glossary.τέμενος: τέμενος — sacred precinct, plot of land set apart; neut. nom. sg.
glossary.τεθαλυῖά: θάλλω — bloom, flourish; perf. part. fem. nom. sg. (masc. τεθηλώς): ’flourishing, luxuriant’
glossary.τελείει: τελέω (epic τελείω) — bring to completion, accomplish; pres. 3 sg., epic (= Attic τελεῖ)
glossary.τηλεδαπῶν: τηλεδαπός — from a far land, distant; masc. gen. pl.
glossary.τοιόσδε: τοιόσδε, -ήδε, -όνδε — such (as this); masc. nom. sg.
glossary.τούσδε: ὅδε, ἥδε, τόδε — this; demonstrative pron., masc. acc. pl.
glossary.τρώχων: τρωχάω (LSJ also τρώχω) — run, trot; impf. 3 pl., unaugmented (= Attic ἔτρεχον); -ων would be contracted from -άον if from τρωχάω; lemma uncertain
glossary.τύχῃς: τυγχάνω — hit upon, obtain; aor. subj. 2 sg., + gen.: ’you may obtain’
glossary.φαίηκας: Φαίηξ — a Phaeacian; masc. acc. pl.
glossary.φαίνετ: φαίνω — show; mid. appear; impf. 3 sg. mid., elided (φαίνετ’ = φαίνετο): ’was appearing’
glossary.φαεινῇ: φαεινός — shining, bright; fem. dat. sg.
glossary.φαιήκεσσ: Φαίηξ — a Phaeacian; masc. dat. pl., epic -εσσι, elided (Φαιήκεσσ’ = Φαιήκεσσι)
glossary.φρονέῃσ: φρονέω — think, be minded; pres. subj. 3 sg., epic -ῃσι (= Attic -ῇ), elided (φρονέῃσ’ = φρονέῃσι)
glossary.φῆμιν: φῆμις (Ionic-epic φήμη) — report, talk of people, rumour; fem. acc. sg.
glossary.χάρισι: χάρις — grace, charm; fem. dat. pl.
glossary.χαρίεντα: χαρίεις — graceful, lovely; neut. acc. pl.
glossary.χνόον: χνόος — foam, scum (of the sea); masc. acc. sg., epic uncontracted (= Attic χνοῦς)
glossary.ἀγαλλόμενοι: ἀγάλλομαι — exult, take pride in; pres. part. mid. masc. nom. pl., + dat.: ’taking pride in’
glossary.ἀγροὺς: ἀγρός — field, countryside; masc. acc. pl.
glossary.ἀδευκέα: ἀδευκής — bitter, harsh, cruel; fem. acc. sg., uncontracted (= Attic ἀδευκῆ)
glossary.ἀεικέλιος: ἀεικέλιος — unseemly, unsightly; masc. nom. sg., predicate
glossary.ἀλέγουσι: ἀλέγω — care for, heed, see to; pres. 3 pl., + acc.
glossary.ἀλεείνω: ἀλεείνω — avoid, shun; pres. 1 sg., epic (cf. ἀλέομαι), + acc.
glossary.ἀλωή: ἀλωή — orchard, vineyard, cultivated plot; fem. nom. sg.
glossary.ἀμφάδιον: ἀμφάδιος — open, public; masc. acc. sg., with γάμον
glossary.ἀμφίπολοί: ἀμφίπολος — handmaid, attendant; fem. nom. pl. (accent from the following enclitic τε)
glossary.ἀμφίς: ἀμφίς — on both sides, around; adv., or postpositive prep. + acc.: ’round about’
glossary.ἀμφιέλισσαι: ἀμφιέλισσα — curved on both sides (or rowed both ways); sense uncertain; fem. nom. pl., epithet of ships
glossary.ἀντιβολήσας: ἀντιβολέω — meet, encounter; aor. part. masc. nom. sg.: ’who meets (us)’
glossary.ἀντιθέοισι: ἀντίθεος — godlike; masc. dat. pl., epic -οισι (= Attic -οις)
glossary.ἀποξύνουσιν: ἀποξύνω — sharpen to a point, trim; pres. 3 pl.
glossary.ἀρίγνωτ: ἀρίγνωτος — easily known, conspicuous; neut. nom. pl., elided (ἀρίγνωτ’ = ἀρίγνωτα), predicate
glossary.ἀραρυῖα: ἀραρίσκω — fit together, join; perf. part. fem. nom. sg. (masc. ἀρηρώς): ’fitted, built’
glossary.ἀτιμάζει: ἀτιμάζω — dishonour, slight, scorn; pres. 3 sg.
glossary.ἀφῖχθαι: ἀφικνέομαι — arrive, reach; perf. inf.: ’to have arrived’
glossary.ἄκουσον: ἀκούω — hear, listen; aor. imper. 2 sg., + gen.: ’hear (me)’
glossary.ἄλειψεν: ἀλείφω — anoint, rub with oil; aor. 3 sg., unaugmented (= Attic ἤλειψεν): ’anointed (himself)’
glossary.ἄλσος: ἄλσος — sacred grove; neut. acc. sg.
glossary.ἄμπεχεν: ἀμπέχω (= ἀμφέχω) — enclose, cover; impf. 3 sg., epic unaugmented (= Attic ἠμπεῖχεν)
glossary.ἄνθει: ἄνθος — flower, blossom; neut. dat. sg.
glossary.ἄστυδε: ἄστυ — town, city; neut. acc. sg. with -δε suffix: ’to the town’
glossary.ἅδοι: ἁνδάνω — please, be pleasing to; aor. opt. 3 sg. (aor. ἅδον), + dat.: ’might please’
glossary.ἐλεεινόν: ἐλεεινός — pitiable, pitied; masc. acc. sg., in the sense ’(one) met with pity’
glossary.ἐμήν: ἐμός — my, mine; fem. acc. sg.
glossary.ἐναντίη: ἐναντίος — opposite, face to face; fem. nom. sg., predicative: ’face to face, openly’
glossary.ἐπέβαλλεν: ἐπιβάλλω — throw upon, lay on; impf. 3 sg., augmented: ’was laying on (the lash)’
glossary.ἐπίστιόν: ἐπίστιον — berth, slip for a ship (sense from context, uncertain); neut. nom. sg. (accent from the following enclitic ἐστιν)
glossary.ἐπιβήομεν: ἐπιβαίνω — step on, reach; aor. subj. 1 pl. with diectasis, epic (= Attic ἐπιβῶμεν), + gen.: ’we set foot in’
glossary.ἐρέεσθαι: ἐρέομαι — ask, inquire; pres. inf., epic (= Attic ἐρέσθαι): ’to ask’
glossary.ἐρέουσιν: ἐρέω — say, speak; fut. 3 pl., epic uncontracted (= Attic ἐροῦσιν): ’they will say’
glossary.ἐσθλοί: ἐσθλός — good, noble, brave; masc. nom. pl.
glossary.ἐφήμενος: ἐφῆμαι (ἐπί + ἧμαι) — sit upon, sit; pres. part. masc. nom. sg.: ’sitting (on it)’
glossary.ἑποίατο: ἕπομαι — follow; pres. opt. 3 pl. mid., epic -οίατο (= Attic ἕποιντο), in a purpose clause after ὅπως: ’might follow’
glossary.ἔθεσαν: τίθημι — put, place, set; aor. 3 pl.: ’they set’ (with πὰρ in tmesis: ’set before’)
glossary.ἔλθωμεν: ἔρχομαι — go, come; aor. subj. 1 pl.: ’we may come’
glossary.ἔλπῃ: ἔλπομαι — hope, expect, think; pres. subj. 2 sg. mid. (contracted, = -ηαι), + acc. and inf.: ’you think (us) to have arrived’
glossary.ἔρραιε: ῥαίω — shatter, wreck; impf. 3 sg., augmented (ρ doubled): ’was shattering, wrecked’
glossary.ἔσμηχεν: σμήχω — rub off, wipe away; impf. 3 sg., augmented: ’was rubbing off’
glossary.ἕξει: ἔχω — have, hold; fut. 3 sg. (rough breathing): ’will have, will keep’
glossary.ἕπεται: ἕπομαι — follow; pres. 3 sg. mid., + dat.: ’follows’
glossary.ἕσσαθ: ἕννυμι — clothe; mid. put on; aor. mid. 3 sg., elided (ἕσσαθ’ = ἕσσατο), with ἀμφί in tmesis: ’put on’
glossary.ἡγεμονεύσω: ἡγεμονεύω — lead the way, guide; fut. 1 sg.: ’I will lead’
glossary.ἡνιόχευεν: ἡνιοχεύω — hold the reins, drive; impf. 3 sg.: ’was driving’
glossary.ἥφαιστος: Ἥφαιστος — Hephaestus, god of the forge; nom. sg.
glossary.ἧκε: ἵημι — send, let go, let fall; aor. 3 sg. (with κὰδ in tmesis: ’let down’)
glossary.ἧσται: ἧμαι — sit; pres. 3 sg. (= Attic κάθηται): ’sits’
glossary.ἱκώμεθα: ἱκνέομαι — come to, reach; aor. subj. 1 pl. mid.: ’we may reach’
glossary.ἱμάσθλην: ἱμάσθλη — whip, lash; fem. acc. sg.
glossary.ἱστοὶ: ἱστός — mast (also loom); masc. nom. pl.
glossary.ἴδηαι: ὁράω (aor. stem ἰδ-) — see; aor. subj. 2 sg. mid., epic (= Attic ἴδῃ): ’you may see’
glossary.ἴδρις: ἴδρις — knowing, skilled; masc. nom. sg.
glossary.ὀδυσεύς: Ὀδυσσεύς — Odysseus; nom. sg., single-σ metrical variant
glossary.ὀνείδεα: ὄνειδος — reproach, taunt, blame; neut. nom. pl., epic uncontracted (= Attic ὀνείδη)
glossary.ὁμοίας: ὅμοιος — like, similar; fem. acc. pl., + dat.: ’like’
glossary.ὄλυμπον: Ὄλυμπος — Olympus, home of the gods; masc. acc. sg.
glossary.ὄρσεο: ὄρνυμι — rouse; mid. rise, bestir oneself; aor. imper. 2 sg. mid., epic (= Attic ὄρσο): ’get up!’
glossary.ὑακινθίνῳ: ὑακίνθινος — of hyacinth; neut. dat. sg.
glossary.ὑπερφίαλοι: ὑπερφίαλος — overweening, arrogant; masc. nom. pl.
glossary.ὑψηλός: ὑψηλός — high, lofty; masc. nom. sg.
glossary.ὦκ: ὦκα — quickly, swiftly; adv., elided (ὦκ’ = ὦκα)
glossary.ῥαιομένου: ῥαίω — shatter, wreck; pres. pass. part. masc. gen. sg.: ’(while I was) being shattered’
glossary.ῥυτοῖσιν: ῥυτός — drawn, hauled; masc. dat. pl., epic -οισιν (= Attic -οις), of stones
glossary.αἰγείροιο: αἴγειρος — black poplar; fem. gen. sg., epic -οιο (= Attic -ου)
glossary.βάλ: βάλλω — throw, strike; aor. 3 sg., unaugmented, elided (βάλ’ = ἔβαλε): ’struck’
glossary.βασίλευεν: βασιλεύω — be king, rule (+ dat.); impf. 3 sg., unaugmented (= ἐβασίλευεν)
glossary.βεβλήατο: βάλλω — throw, cast; plpf. 3 pl. mid./pass., epic (= Attic ἐβέβληντο): ’had been thrown, laid’
glossary.βωμῶν: βωμός — raised base, pedestal (also altar); masc. gen. pl.
glossary.γανόωσαι: γανάω — shine, gleam, be bright; pres. part. fem. nom. pl., epic uncontracted (= Attic γανῶσαι)
glossary.γιγάντεσσιν: γίγας — giant; masc. dat. pl., epic -εσσιν (= Attic -ασι)
glossary.γυναῖκες: γυνή — woman; fem. nom. pl., in apposition to δμωαί: ’women’
glossary.δέσποιναν: δέσποινα — mistress, lady; fem. acc. sg.
glossary.δαίτην: δαίς (by-form δαίτη) — feast, banquet; fem. acc. sg. (= δαῖτα), cognate object of δαινυμένους
glossary.δαιτυμόνεσσι: δαιτυμών — guest at a feast, banqueter; masc. dat. pl., epic -εσσι (= Attic -οσι)
glossary.δαῖε: δαίω — kindle, set alight; impf. 3 sg., unaugmented (= ἔδαιε): ’kindled’
glossary.δειδέχαται: δέχομαι — receive, welcome, greet; perf. 3 pl. mid., epic reduplicated (= δεδέχαται), pres. sense: ’greet’
glossary.διοτρεφέας: διοτρεφής — nurtured by Zeus (of kings); masc. acc. pl., epic uncontracted (= Attic -εῖς)
glossary.δύσεσθαι: δύω — enter, go into; fut. inf. mid., after ἔμελλε: ’to enter’
glossary.δῆμος: δῆμος — people, community; masc. nom. sg.
glossary.δῦνε: δύνω, δύω — enter, go into; impf. 3 sg., unaugmented (= ἔδυνε): ’entered’
glossary.δῶκ: δίδωμι — give; aor. 3 sg., unaugmented, elided (δῶκ’ = ἔδωκε)
glossary.εἰσορόωντες: εἰσοράω — look at, gaze on; pres. part. masc. nom. pl., epic uncontracted (= Attic εἰσορῶντες)
glossary.εἴα: ἐάω — allow, permit; impf. 3 sg., augmented: ’allowed’
glossary.εὐρυμέδοντος: Εὐρυμέδων — Eurymedon, king of the Giants; masc. gen. sg.
glossary.εὐρυμέδουσα: Εὐρυμέδουσα — Eurymedusa, Nausicaa’s old nurse; fem. nom. sg.
glossary.ζεφυρίη: ζεφύριος — of the west wind; fem. nom. sg. used as a noun: ’the west wind’ (epic -η = Attic -α)
glossary.θέρευς: θέρος — summer; neut. gen. sg., epic (= Attic θέρους)
glossary.θαλαμηπόλος: θαλαμηπόλος — chamber-servant, maid of the bedchamber; fem. nom. sg., in apposition
glossary.θαρσαλέος: θαρσαλέος — bold, confident; masc. nom. sg.
glossary.θειλόπεδον: θειλόπεδον — sunny drying-ground (for grapes); neut. nom. sg., first element ’sun-warmed’ (sense uncertain)
glossary.θοῇσιν: θοός — swift, quick; fem. dat. pl., epic -ῇσιν (= Attic -αῖς)
glossary.θριγκὸς: θριγκός — coping, cornice of a wall; masc. nom. sg.
glossary.θρόνοι: θρόνος — seat, chair; masc. nom. pl.
glossary.κάλπιν: κάλπις — water-jar, pitcher; fem. acc. sg.
glossary.καιρουσσέων: καιρόεις — close-woven (of cloth); fem. gen. pl., contracted from -οεσσέων, epic -έων (= Attic -ῶν); exact sense disputed
glossary.καρπόν: καρπός — fruit, grain; masc. acc. sg., object of ἀλετρεύουσι: ’grain’ · also ’fruit’ (λωτοῖο … μελιηδέα καρπόν ’the honey-sweet fruit of the lotus’)
glossary.κερτομέοι: κερτομέω — taunt, mock, jeer at; pres. opt. 3 sg., epic uncontracted (= Attic κερτομοίη)
glossary.κλυτά: κλυτός — famous, renowned; neut. acc. pl.
glossary.κορώνη: κορώνη — curved door-handle or ring (lit. ’crow’); fem. nom. sg.; exact sense uncertain
glossary.κοσμηταὶ: κοσμητός — well-ordered, neatly arranged; fem. nom. pl.
glossary.κυάνοιο: κύανος — dark-blue enamel or glass paste; masc. gen. sg., epic -οιο (= Attic -ου)
glossary.λεπτοὶ: λεπτός — fine, delicate, thin; masc. nom. pl.
glossary.λευρῷ: λευρός — level, flat, open; masc. dat. sg.
glossary.λιπόντα: λείπω — leave; aor. part. masc. acc. sg.: ’having left’
glossary.μήλοπα: μήλοψ — apple-coloured, yellowish (of grain); masc. acc. sg.; sense uncertain
glossary.μακεδνῆς: μακεδνός — tall, slender; fem. gen. sg. (of the poplar)
glossary.μαραθῶνα: Μαραθών — Marathon, a place in Attica; acc. sg.
glossary.μεγάθυμον: μεγάθυμος — great-hearted, high-spirited; masc. acc. sg.
glossary.μεγαθύμων: μεγάθυμος — great-hearted, high-spirited; masc. gen. pl.
glossary.μηλέαι: μηλέα — apple tree; fem. nom. pl.
glossary.μυχὸν: μυχός — innermost part, recess; masc. acc. sg.
glossary.μύλῃς: μύλη — handmill, mill; fem. dat. pl., archaic -ῃς (= Attic μύλαις)
glossary.ναυσίθοον: Ναυσίθοος — Nausithous, father of Alcinous; masc. acc. sg.
glossary.ναυσικλυτοὶ: ναυσικλυτός — famed for ships; masc. nom. pl.
glossary.νεήνιδι: νεῆνις — young, youthful; fem. dat. sg., with παρθενικῇ
glossary.νείατον: νείατος — farthest, last, lowest; masc. acc. sg., epic (= Attic νέατος)
glossary.νείκεα: νεῖκος — quarrel, strife; neut. acc. pl., epic uncontracted (= Attic νείκη)
glossary.νυμφίον: νυμφίος — newly wed man, bridegroom; masc. acc. sg., predicative: ’as a bridegroom’
glossary.οὐδοῖο: οὐδός — threshold; masc. gen. sg., epic -οιο (= Attic -οῦ)
glossary.πάροιθε: πάροιθε — in front, before; adv. of place
glossary.πέπλοι: πέπλος — cloth, coverlet, robe; masc. nom. pl.
glossary.πίνοντες: πίνω — drink; pres. part. masc. nom. pl.
glossary.παντοῖαι: παντοῖος — of every kind; fem. nom. pl.
glossary.παρθενικῇ: παρθενική — maiden, girl; fem. dat. sg., with ἐικυῖα
