glossary.παισὶν: παῖς — child, son; masc. dat. pl.: ’to children’
glossary.πείσεται: πάσχω — suffer, experience; fut. 3 sg. mid. (πείσομαι)
glossary.πεμπέμεναι: πέμπω — send, escort, convey; pres. inf., epic -έμεναι (= Attic πέμπειν); after ἐκέλευον, with acc. τὸν ξεῖνον as object: ’to send’
glossary.περιμηχανόωνται: περιμηχανάομαι — contrive all round, devise; pres. 3 pl., epic uncontracted (= Attic -ῶνται)
glossary.πλέονας: πλείων (comparative of πολύς) — more, greater in number; masc. acc. pl., epic πλέονας (= Attic πλείονας)
glossary.πλησίον: πλησίος — near, neighbouring; neut. acc. sg. as adv. πλησίον: ’near, beside’
glossary.πομπὴν: πομπή — sending, escort, conveyance; fem. acc. sg.
glossary.ποντόνοε: Ποντόνοος — Pontonous, herald of Alcinous; masc. voc. sg.
glossary.ποντόνοος: Ποντόνοος — Pontonous, herald of Alcinous; masc. nom. sg.
glossary.πυμάτῳ: πύματος — last, final; masc. dat. sg., agreeing with the relative: ’to whom as last’
glossary.πόνου: πόνος — toil, labour, hardship; masc. gen. sg., after ἄνευθε
glossary.σπένδεσκον: σπένδω — pour a libation; impf. iterative 3 pl., epic -σκον, unaugmented: ’used to pour’
glossary.σπένδοντας: σπένδω — pour a libation; pres. part. masc. acc. pl.: ’pouring’
glossary.σπείσομεν: σπένδω — pour a libation; aor. subj. 1 pl., short vowel (= Attic σπείσωμεν): ’we may pour’
glossary.στυγερῇ: στυγερός — hateful, loathsome; fem. dat. sg.
glossary.τειρόμενον: τείρω — wear out, distress; pres. part. pass. masc. acc. sg.: ’worn down’
glossary.τερπικεραύνῳ: τερπικέραυνος — delighting in the thunderbolt; masc. dat. sg., epithet of Zeus
glossary.τεῦξε: τεύχω — make, fashion; aor. 3 sg., unaugmented (= ἔτευξε)
glossary.φαίνονται: φαίνω — show; mid. appear, show oneself; pres. 3 pl. mid.: ’appear’
glossary.φαεινοῦ: φαεινός — shining, bright; masc. gen. sg.
glossary.φιλέεσκεν: φιλέω — love, be fond of; impf. iterative 3 sg., epic -εσκεν, uncontracted and unaugmented: ’used to love’
glossary.φῦλα: φῦλον — tribe, race; neut. nom. pl.
glossary.χαμαὶ: χαμαί — on the ground, to the ground; adv.
glossary.χύτο: χέω — pour; aor. 3 sg. mid., unaugmented, passive sense (= Attic ἐχύθη): ’was poured’
glossary.ἀήρ: ἀήρ — mist, thick air; fem. nom. sg.
glossary.ἀγακλειτὰς: ἀγακλειτός — very renowned, glorious (= ἀγακλυτός); fem. acc. pl.
glossary.ἀγαπήνορα: ἀγαπήνωρ — man-cherishing, loving manliness (exact sense not known); masc. acc. sg., epithet of Laodamas
glossary.ἀλκίνο: Ἀλκίνοος — Alcinous, king of the Phaeacians; masc. voc. sg., elided (Ἀλκίνο’ = Ἀλκίνοε)
glossary.ἀνίης: ἀνίη — grief, distress; fem. gen. sg., Ionic η for α, after ἄνευθε
glossary.ἀπεκόσμεον: ἀποκοσμέω — clear away, put in order; impf. 3 pl., epic uncontracted (= Attic ἀπεκόσμουν)
glossary.ἀρήτης: Ἀρήτη — Arete, queen of the Phaeacians; fem. gen. sg., Ionic η for α, after ἀμφί
glossary.ἀργεϊφόντῃ: ἀργεϊφόντης — Argeïphontes, epithet of Hermes, of unknown or disputed meaning; masc. dat. sg.
glossary.ἄγρια: ἄγριος — wild, savage; neut. nom. pl.
glossary.ἄκουσ: ἀκούω — hear, listen to; aor. 3 sg., unaugmented and elided (ἄκουσ’ = ἄκουσε)
glossary.ἄλγεσιν: ἄλγος — pain, suffering; neut. dat. pl.
glossary.ἄνευθε: ἄνευθε(ν) — apart from, without; prep. + gen., epic (= Attic ἄνευ) · also adv., no case governed: ’apart, at a distance’ (αἱ δ’ ἄνευθε ’they lie apart’)
glossary.ἅσσα: ὅστις — whoever, whatever; neut. acc. pl. ἅσσα, epic (= Attic ἅτινα): ’whatever’
glossary.ἐβήσετο: βαίνω — go, step; aor. 3 sg. mid., epic ἐβήσετο (= Attic ἔβη): ’stepped’
glossary.ἐκίρνα: κίρνημι — mix (wine with water; = κεράννυμι); impf. 3 sg., epic (= Attic ἐκεράννυ)
glossary.ἐναργεῖς: ἐναργής — visible, manifest, in bodily presence; masc. nom. pl.
glossary.ἐνιπλησθῆναι: ἐμπίμπλημι — fill full; aor. inf. pass., epic ἐνι- (= Attic ἐμπλησθῆναι): ’to be filled’
glossary.ἐπαρξάμενος: ἐπάρχομαι — begin a libation, pour the first drops; aor. part. mid. masc. nom. sg.: ’having poured first drops’
glossary.ἐπιβήμεναι: ἐπιβαίνω — step upon, set foot on (+ gen.); aor. inf., epic -μεναι (= Attic ἐπιβῆναι)
glossary.ἐπιβήσετε: ἐπιβαίνω — step upon; causal set (someone) upon (+ gen.); fut. 2 pl. act. (or short-vowel aor. subj. after ὥς κε), transitive: ’you will set (me) on’
glossary.ἐπικρῆσαι: ἐπικεράννυμι — mix (wine with water); aor. inf., epic ἐπικρῆσαι (= Attic ἐπικεράσαι)
glossary.ἐπιτρέψειεν: ἐπιτρέπω — hand over, entrust; aor. opt. 3 sg., wish: ’may he hand over’
glossary.ἐυσκόπῳ: ἐΰσκοπος — sharp-sighted, keen-eyed (epithet of Hermes); masc. dat. sg.
glossary.ἐχένηος: Ἐχένηος — Echeneus, an elder of the Phaeacians; masc. nom. sg.
glossary.ἔντεα: ἔντεα — gear, implements, equipment; neut. acc. pl.
glossary.ἔοικα: ἔοικα — be like (+ dat.), be fitting; perf. 1 sg. with pres. sense: ’I am like’
glossary.ἔπαθον: πάσχω — suffer, experience; aor. 1 sg.: ’I suffered’
glossary.ἔπιόν: πίνω — drink; aor. 3 pl. (accent from the following enclitic θ’)
glossary.ἔρδωμεν: ῥέζω (epic ἔρδω) — do, perform, offer (sacrifice); pres. subj. 1 pl.: ’we offer’
glossary.ἠέρ: ἀήρ — mist, thick air; fem. acc. sg., epic ἠέρα, elided (ἠέρ’ = ἠέρα)
glossary.ἡγήτορας: ἡγήτωρ — leader, chief; masc. acc. pl.
glossary.ἥσθην: ἧμαι — sit, be seated; impf. 3 dual: ’the two sat’
glossary.ἧσθαι: ἧμαι — sit, be seated; pres. inf.: ’to sit’ (subject of ἔοικε, with an accusative subject of its own)
glossary.ἰδόντα: ὁράω (εἶδον) — see; aor. part. masc. acc. sg.: ’having seen’
glossary.ἰσχανόωνται: ἰσχανάομαι — hold oneself back, wait, be checked; pres. 3 pl., epic uncontracted (= Attic -ῶνται)
glossary.ἰσωσαίμην: ἰσόω — make equal; mid. count oneself equal; aor. opt. 1 sg. mid., potential with κεν: ’I might rank myself equal’
glossary.ἰότητι: ἰότης — will, wish, favour; fem. dat. sg.: ’by the will of’
glossary.ἱκέτῃσιν: ἱκέτης — suppliant; masc. dat. pl., epic -ῃσιν (= Attic -αις)
glossary.ἵκετ: ἱκνέομαι — come, arrive at, reach; aor. 3 sg., unaugmented and elided (ἵκετ’ = ἵκετο) · also augmented, with the long ι that the metre needs (ἵκετ’ ἐμὸν δῶ ’came to my house’)
glossary.ὀιζὺν: ὀιζύς — misery, woe, hardship; fem. acc. sg.
glossary.ὀπηδεῖ: ὀπηδέω — accompany, attend (+ dat.); pres. 3 sg.: ’keeps company with’
glossary.ὀτρύνεσθαι: ὀτρύνω — urge on; mid. bestir oneself, hasten; pres. inf. mid. used as imperative: ’bestir yourselves’
glossary.ὀτρύνετε: ὀτρύνω — urge on, speed; pres. imper. 2 pl.: ’speed on’
glossary.ὀχέοντας: ὀχέω — carry, bear, endure; pres. part. masc. acc. pl., epic uncontracted (= Attic ὀχοῦντας)
glossary.ὁδίτης: ὁδίτης — wayfarer, traveller; masc. nom. sg.
glossary.ὁρόωντες: ὁράω — see, look at; pres. part. masc. nom. pl., epic uncontracted (= Attic ὁρῶντες)
glossary.ὄλβια: ὄλβιος — blessed, prosperous; neut. acc. pl.: ’blessings’
glossary.ὑπελείπετο: ὑπολείπω — leave behind; pass. be left behind; impf. 3 sg. pass.: ’was left behind’
glossary.ὦρσεν: ὄρνυμι — rouse, raise up; aor. 3 sg. act., augmented, with movable ν (= ὦρσε)
glossary.ῥέξομεν: ῥέζω — do, perform, offer (sacrifice); fut. 1 pl., epic: ’we will offer’
glossary.αἰσχυνόμενός: αἰσχύνομαι — feel shame, be ashamed; pres. part. masc. nom. sg.: ’feeling shame’ (accented before enclitic τε)
glossary.αἴθ: αἴθε — would that; epic wish particle + opt., elided (αἴθ’ = αἴθε; = εἰ γάρ, αἲ γάρ)
glossary.βαλὸν: βάλλω — throw, hurl, dash; aor. part. neut. nom. sg. (masc. βαλών): ’having dashed’, agreeing with a neuter subject
glossary.βιήσατο: βιάζομαι — overpower, force, press hard; aor. mid. 3 sg., epic (= Attic ἐβιάσατο), unaugmented; with κε ’would have overpowered’
glossary.γήθησεν: γηθέω — rejoice; aor. 3 sg., ν-movable (= γήθησε): ’rejoiced’
glossary.γαιήιον: Γαιήιος — of Gaia, earth-born; adj., masc. acc. sg., epithet of Tityos: ’son of Earth’
glossary.δείλετό: δείλομαι — turn toward evening, decline (of the sun); 3 sg. mid., impf. or aor. (tense uncertain), unaugmented, accented before enclitic τε
glossary.δεδμημένος: δαμάζω (δάμνημι) — overpower, subdue; perf. pass. part. masc. nom. sg.: ’overcome’ (by sleep)
glossary.δεκάτῃ: δέκατος — tenth; fem. dat. sg., agreeing with νυκτί: ’on the tenth (night)’ · also fem. dat. sg. with ἡμέρῃ understood: ’on the tenth (day)’
glossary.δεύεσκον: δεύω — wet, drench; impf. 1 sg., iterative -εσκ-, unaugmented: ’I used to drench’
glossary.διέτμαγον: διατμήγω — cut through, cleave; aor. 1 sg., epic strong aor. (stem τμαγ-), augmented in the compound: ’I cut across, swam through’
glossary.δοίην: δίδωμι — give; aor. opt. 1 sg.: ’I would give’
glossary.δολόεσσα: δολόεις — crafty, guileful; adj., fem. nom. sg., epic -όεσσα
glossary.δόσαν: δίδωμι — give; aor. 3 pl., unaugmented, epic (= Attic ἔδοσαν)
glossary.δύσζηλοι: δύσζηλος — jealous, censorious, quick to find fault; masc. nom. pl.
glossary.εἰδήσεις: οἶδα — know; fut. 2 sg., epic εἰδήσω (= Attic εἴσῃ): ’you will know, see for yourself’
glossary.εἰμὲν: εἰμί — be; pres. 1 pl., epic (= Attic ἐσμέν)
glossary.εὐβοίης: Εὔβοια — Euboea, the long island off Attica; fem. gen. sg. (Ionic η), gen. of comparison after a comparative
glossary.εὐνή: εὐνή — bed, bedding; fem. nom. sg.
glossary.εὗδον: εὕδω — sleep; impf. 1 sg., unaugmented (Attic ηὗδον, ἐκάθευδον): ’I slept’
glossary.θάμνοισι: θάμνος — bush, thicket; masc. dat. pl., epic -οισι
glossary.θεῇσι: θεά — goddess; fem. dat. pl., epic -ῃσι (= Attic θεαῖς), + ἐικυῖα ’like goddesses’
glossary.θυμηγερέων: θυμηγερέων (θυμός + ἀγείρω) — gathering one’s spirit, sense uncertain; found only as a pres. part. masc. nom. sg., epic uncontracted -έων (= Attic -ῶν): ’gathering my spirits’
glossary.κέων: κείω — lie down, go to bed; pres. part. masc. nom. sg., desiderative in force (ὄρσο κέων ’up, go to bed’)
glossary.καλέεσθαι: καλέω — call, name; pres. pass. inf., epic uncontracted (= Attic καλεῖσθαι): ’to be called’
glossary.κατέδραθον: καταδαρθάνω — fall asleep; aor. 1 sg., epic (= Attic κατέδαρθον): ’I fell asleep’ · also aor. 3 pl. (same form), with dual subject: ’the two fell asleep’
glossary.κατέλεξα: καταλέγω — recount, tell in order; aor. 1 sg.: ’I told, recounted’
glossary.κεχολῶσθαι: χολόω — anger, enrage; perf. mid. inf. (κεχόλωμαι ’be angry’): ’to be angry, be in a rage’
glossary.κοιμηθῆναι: κοιμάω — put to sleep; aor. pass. inf.: ’to lie down to sleep, go to bed’
glossary.λέξεαι: λέγω (mid. λέχομαι) — lay oneself down, lie down; fut. mid. 2 sg., epic uncontracted (= Attic λέξῃ): ’you will lie down’
glossary.λαβοῦσα: λαμβάνω — take, seize; aor. part. fem. nom. sg.: ’having taken (me in)’
glossary.λοῦσ: λούω (epic λοέω) — wash, bathe; elided, either aor. 3 sg. λοῦσε (= Attic ἔλουσε), unaugmented: ’she bathed (me)’, or aor. 1 sg. λοῦσα: ’I bathed’; the context decides
glossary.μένοις: μένω — stay, remain; pres. opt. 2 sg.: ’you should stay’
glossary.μίσγεται: μίσγω — mix, mingle; pres. mid./pass. 3 sg. + dat.: ’consorts with, has dealings with’
glossary.νείκεε: νεικέω — quarrel with, chide, blame; pres. imper. 2 sg., epic uncontracted (= Attic νείκει), with μή: ’do not blame’
glossary.νεὸς: ναῦς — ship; fem. gen. sg., epic-Ionic (= Attic νεώς)
glossary.νηχόμενος: νήχομαι — swim; pres. part. masc. nom. sg.: ’swimming’
glossary.νοήματος: νόημα — thought, purpose, sense; neut. gen. sg., gen. with ἁμαρτάνω (’fail of a good thought’)
glossary.νῆχον: νήχω — swim; impf. 1 sg., unaugmented (= Attic ἔνηχον): ’I swam’
glossary.ξυνέσεσθαι: σύνειμι (ξύνειμι) — be with, meet with, encounter (+ dat.); fut. inf., epic ξυν- (= Attic συν-)
glossary.οὐρανίωνες: Οὐρανίων — child of Uranus (Heaven) or dweller in heaven, sense disputed; masc. nom. pl., epic: θεοὶ Οὐρανίωνες ’the gods, the children of Heaven’
glossary.πέλασαν: πελάζω — bring near, bring to; aor. 3 pl., unaugmented, epic (= Attic ἐπέλασαν)
glossary.πέτρῃς: πέτρη — rock, crag; fem. dat. pl., epic short -ῃς (= Attic πέτραις)
glossary.παιζούσας: παίζω — play, sport; pres. part. fem. acc. pl.: ’playing’
glossary.παριστάμεναι: παρίστημι — stand beside; pres. mid. part. fem. nom. pl.: ’standing by’
glossary.πεποίηται: ποιέω — make, prepare; perf. mid./pass. 3 sg.: ’has been made, is ready’
glossary.πηδῷ: πηδόν — oar-blade, oar; neut. dat. sg., instrumental: ’with the oar’
glossary.πλέον: πλέω — sail; impf. 1 sg. (same form 3 pl.), uncontracted, unaugmented (= Attic ἔπλεον) · also πλείων — more; neut. acc. sg. (= πλεῖον)
glossary.πολλῇ: πολύς — much, many; fem. dat. sg.: ’great’
glossary.τέλεσσαν: τελέω — accomplish, finish; aor. 3 pl., epic σσ, unaugmented (= Attic ἐτέλεσαν)
glossary.τεκμαίρομαι: τεκμαίρομαι — fix, appoint, ordain; pres. 1 sg.: ’I fix’
glossary.τελευτήσειεν: τελευτάω — bring to pass, fulfil; aor. opt. 3 sg., in a wish after αἴθε: ’may he fulfil’
glossary.τεῆς: τεός — your (sg.); adj., fem. gen. sg., epic (= σός)
glossary.τιτυὸν: Τιτυός — Tityos, a giant, son of Earth; masc. acc. sg.
glossary.τοὔνεκ: τοὔνεκα — for that reason, on that account (τοῦ ἕνεκα); adv., elided (τοὔνεκ’)
glossary.φερόμην: φέρω — carry; impf. pass. 1 sg., unaugmented (= Attic ἐφερόμην): ’I was carried, I drifted’
glossary.χέρσου: χέρσος — dry land, shore; fem. gen. sg., with ἐπί: ’on the shore’
glossary.ἀγγελίης: ἀγγελίη — message, tidings, bidding; fem. gen. sg. (Ionic η)
glossary.ἀγκὰς: ἀγκάς — in the arms, in an embrace; adv.
glossary.ἀθέσφατον: ἀθέσφατος — immense, prodigious (sense of the word debated); adj., fem. acc. sg., agreeing with θάλασσαν
glossary.ἀληθείην: ἀλήθεια — truth; fem. acc. sg. (Ionic ἀληθείη)
glossary.ἀμείνω: ἀμείνων — better (comparative of ἀγαθός); neut. nom. pl., contracted from ἀμείνονα
glossary.ἀμφιελίσσης: ἀμφιέλισσα — curved on both sides, well-rounded (of a ship; sense debated); fem. gen. sg.
glossary.ἀμφιπόλους: ἀμφίπολος — handmaid, attendant; fem. acc. pl.
glossary.ἀμύμονα: ἀμύμων — blameless, excellent (traditional sense; exact meaning uncertain); adj., fem. acc. sg. · also masc. acc. sg.: ἀμύμονα Λαοδάμαντα ’blameless Laodamas’
glossary.ἀναρρίπτειν: ἀναρρίπτω — toss up, throw up; pres. inf., epexegetic: ’to toss up’ (the sea with the oar)
glossary.ἀναχασσάμενος: ἀναχάζομαι — draw back, retire; aor. part. mid. masc. nom. sg., epic σσ: ’having drawn back’
glossary.ἀνῆκεν: ἀνίημι — let go, release; aor. 3 sg., augmented: ’let go, released’ · also ’urge on, incite’ (+ acc. and inf.): ἀοιδὸν ἀνῆκεν ἀειδέμεναι ’moved the minstrel to sing’
glossary.ἀπήνυσαν: ἀπανύω — accomplish, complete; aor. 3 pl., augmented in the compound: ’they finished (the journey)’
glossary.ἀπαμείβετο: ἀπαμείβομαι — answer, reply; impf. 3 sg. mid., unaugmented (= Attic ἀπημείβετο)
glossary.ἀτερπέι: ἀτερπής — joyless, cheerless; adj., masc. dat. sg.
glossary.ἀφραδέουσιν: ἀφραδέω — be thoughtless, act foolishly; pres. 3 pl., epic uncontracted (= Attic ἀφραδοῦσιν)
glossary.ἄμβροτα: ἄμβροτος — immortal, divine, undying; adj., neut. acc. pl., epic (= ἀθάνατος)
glossary.ἄρισται: ἀγαθός — good; superlative ἄριστος ’best’; fem. nom. pl. ἄρισται, predicate: ’best, foremost’
glossary.ἐγκονέουσαι: ἐγκονέω — bustle, hasten, be busy; pres. part. fem. nom. pl., epic uncontracted (= Attic ἐγκονοῦσαι): ’bustling’
glossary.ἐκβὰς: ἐκβαίνω — step out, come out, disembark; aor. part. masc. nom. sg.: ’having come out’
glossary.ἐλόωσι: ἐλαύνω — drive, row; pres. 3 pl., epic uncontracted (= Attic ἐλῶσι), with future sense: ’they will drive, row’
glossary.ἐμαὶ: ἐμός — my, mine; fem. nom. pl.
glossary.ἐννῆμαρ: ἐννῆμαρ — for nine days; adv. (ἐννέα + ἦμαρ)
glossary.ἐπιπλόμενον: ἐπιπέλομαι — come round, revolve (of a year); epic aor. part. mid. neut. nom. sg., agreeing with ἔτος
glossary.ἐπισκύσσαιτο: ἐπισκύζομαι — be angry at, take offence at (+ dat.); aor. opt. mid. 3 sg., in a fear clause after μή
glossary.ἐποτρύνουσα: ἐποτρύνω — urge on, exhort; pres. part. fem. nom. sg.: ’urging on’
glossary.ἐποψόμενον: ἐφοράω — look upon, visit; fut. part. mid. masc. acc. sg. (stem ἐποψ-), of purpose: ’to see, to visit’
glossary.ἐπῆλθον: ἐπέρχομαι — come to, reach; aor. 1 sg. (same form 3 pl.), augmented: ’I came upon, reached’
glossary.ἐπῶρσε: ἐπόρνυμι — stir up, rouse against; aor. 3 sg., epic (ἐπ- + ὦρσε): ’stirred up’
glossary.ἐρξέμεν: ἔρδω (= ῥέζω) — do, act, perform; fut. inf., epic -έμεν (= ἔρξειν): ’to do’
glossary.ἐρύξει: ἐρύκω — hold back, detain, restrain; fut. 3 sg.: ’will hold back’
glossary.ἐτράπετ: τρέπω — turn; aor. 3 sg. mid., elided (ἐτράπετ’ = ἐτράπετο): ’turned, changed’
glossary.ἐφέστιον: ἐφέστιος — at the hearth, one at another’s hearth (guest or suppliant); adj., masc. acc. sg., predicative
glossary.ἐφίλει: φιλέω — love, treat kindly; impf. 3 sg., augmented: ’was fond of, cherished’
glossary.ἐφορμήσας: ἐφορμάω — set in motion against, rouse against; aor. part. masc. nom. sg.: ’having roused (the winds) against’
glossary.ἑκαστέρω: ἑκάς — far off; comparative adv. ἑκαστέρω: ’farther’, + gen. of comparison
glossary.ἔθελον: ἐθέλω — wish, be willing; impf. 1 sg. (same form 3 pl.), unaugmented (= Attic ἤθελον)
glossary.ἔλποιο: ἔλπομαι — hope, expect; pres. opt. 2 sg., with ἄν: ’you would expect’
glossary.ἔμπεδον: ἔμπεδος — steady, firm, unbroken; adj., neut. acc. sg. used adverbially: ’steadily, without a break’
glossary.ἔτρεφεν: τρέφω — nourish, rear, cherish; impf. 3 sg., ν-movable: ’was nurturing, cared for’
glossary.ἔφασκε: φημί — say, promise; impf. 3 sg., iterative -σκ-: ’kept saying, kept promising’
glossary.ἕσσεν: ἕννυμι — clothe; aor. 3 sg., epic σσ, ν-movable: ’clothed (me)’
glossary.ἠφυσάμην: ἀφύσσω — draw up, scoop up, heap up; aor. mid. 1 sg., augmented: ’I heaped up for myself’
glossary.ἤλυθ: ἔρχομαι — come, go; aor. 3 sg., elided (ἤλυθ’ = ἤλυθε), epic (= Attic ἦλθε)
glossary.ἤμβροτεν: ἁμαρτάνω — miss, fail, err (+ gen.); aor. 3 sg., epic ἤμβροτε (= Attic ἥμαρτε), ν-movable: ’missed, failed in’
glossary.ἦγεν: ἄγω — lead, bring; impf. 3 sg., ν-movable: ’brought, was leading’
glossary.ἰδόντι: ὁράω — see; aor. part. masc. dat. sg. (εἶδον), agreeing with a dative pronoun: ’(to you) on seeing’
glossary.ἱκέτευσ: ἱκετεύω — supplicate, beseech; aor. 1 sg., elided (ἱκέτευσ’ = ἱκέτευσα): ’I besought’
glossary.ἱκέτευσας: ἱκετεύω — supplicate, beseech; aor. 2 sg.: ’you besought’
glossary.ἱκοίμην: ἱκνέομαι — come, arrive, reach; aor. opt. mid. 1 sg.: ’I might reach’
glossary.ἴδοντο: ὁράω — see; aor. mid. 3 pl., epic, unaugmented (= Attic εἶδον): ’they saw’
glossary.ὀγδόατόν: ὄγδοος — eighth; epic ὀγδόατος, neut. nom. sg., agreeing with ἔτος, accented before an enclitic
glossary.ὀιζυῖ: ὀιζύς — misery, woe, hardship; fem. dat. sg.
glossary.ὄρσο: ὄρνυμι — rouse, stir; aor. imper. mid. 2 sg., epic (= ὄρσεο): ’rise up!’
glossary.ὑμετέρης: ὑμέτερος — your (pl.); adj., fem. gen. sg.
glossary.ὑμετέρῃ: ὑμέτερος — your (pl.); adj., fem. dat. sg.
glossary.ὠγυγίη: Ὠγυγίη — Ogygia, Calypso’s island; fem. nom. sg., used as an adjective: ’Ogygian’ (with νῆσος)
glossary.ὤρινεν: ὀρίνω — stir up, rouse; impf. 3 sg. (or aor.), augmented, ν-movable: ’stirred up’
glossary.ὤτρυνον: ὀτρύνω — urge on, spur, exhort; impf. 3 pl., augmented: ’they urged on’
glossary.ῥαδάμανθυν: Ῥαδάμανθυς — Rhadamanthys, son of Zeus and judge of the dead; masc. acc. sg., epic -υν
glossary.αἴθουσαί: αἴθουσα — portico, colonnade of a hall; fem. nom. pl.
glossary.βάν: βαίνω — step, go, set out; aor. 3 pl., epic (= Attic ἔβησαν)
glossary.βήτην: βαίνω — step, go; aor. 3 dual, unaugmented (= ἐβήτην): ’the two went’, said of several
glossary.βαρὺ: βαρύς — heavy, deep; neut. acc. sg. used adverbially: ’heavily’
glossary.γοάασκεν: γοάω — groan, wail; iterative impf. 3 sg. in -σκε-, epic uncontracted: ’would groan’
glossary.δέρον: δέρω — flay, skin; impf. 3 pl., unaugmented (= ἔδερον)
glossary.δαιτυμόνων: δαιτυμών — feaster, banqueter; masc. gen. pl.
glossary.δαναοῖσι: Δαναοί — the Danaans, the Greeks; masc. dat. pl., epic -οισι (= Attic -οῖς)
glossary.δεινός: δεινός — dread, awe-inspiring, formidable; masc. nom. sg., predicate adj.
glossary.δερματίνοισι: δερμάτινος — of leather, leathern; masc. dat. pl., epic -οισι (= Attic -οις)
glossary.δεῦτ: δεῦτε — come here, hither; adv. used as a call to several, elided (δεῦτ’ = δεῦτε)
glossary.δημόδοκον: Δημόδοκος — Demodocus, the Phaeacian minstrel; masc. acc. sg.
glossary.δηρίσαντο: δηριάομαι — contend, quarrel; aor. 3 pl. mid.
glossary.δηριόωντο: δηριάομαι — contend, quarrel; impf. 3 pl., epic uncontracted (= δηριῶντο)
glossary.δυοκαίδεκα: δυοκαίδεκα — twelve; numeral, indeclinable (= Attic δώδεκα)
glossary.εἴρυσσε: ἐρύω — draw, drag, pull; aor. 3 sg., epic doubled-σ, augmented (= Attic εἴρυσε): ’drew’
glossary.εὐνῆς: εὐνή — bed, couch; fem. gen. sg.
glossary.θαλείῃ: θαλεῖα — abundant, rich, blooming (of a feast; cf. θάλλω ’thrive’); fem. dat. sg., epic -ῃ (= Attic -ᾳ)
glossary.κάνεον: κάνεον — basket, wicker breadbasket; neut. acc. sg., uncontracted (Attic κανοῦν)
glossary.καλέσασθε: καλέω — call, summon; aor. imper. 2 pl. mid.: ’summon!’
glossary.καλήν: καλός — beautiful, fair, fine; fem. acc. sg.
glossary.καλυψάμενος: καλύπτω — cover, hide; aor. part. mid. masc. nom. sg.: ’having covered himself’
glossary.κλέα: κλέος — fame, glory, glorious deeds; neut. acc. pl., uncontracted (κλέα ἀνδρῶν ’glories of men’)
glossary.κληῖσιν: κληΐς — thole-pin, the peg or strap that holds an oar (also ’bar, bolt’); fem. dat. pl., epic -σιν
glossary.κούροισιν: κοῦρος — boy, youth, young man; masc. dat. pl., epic -οισιν (= Attic κόροις)
glossary.κούρω: κοῦρος — youth, young man; masc. dual, nom./acc. (= Attic κόρω): ’the two youths’
glossary.κρέμασεν: κρεμάννυμι — hang up, suspend; aor. 3 sg., unaugmented (= ἐκρέμασεν)
glossary.κρινάσθων: κρίνω — choose out, pick, select; aor. imper. 3 pl. mid.: ’let them choose (for themselves)’ (= Attic κρινάσθωσαν)
glossary.κρινθέντε: κρίνω — choose out, select; aor. part. pass. dual, masc. nom.: ’the two having been chosen’
glossary.κρᾶτα: κάρα — head; neut. acc. sg. κρᾶτα (stem κρατ-), poetic
glossary.κυλίνδετο: κυλίνδω — roll; impf. 3 sg. mid./pass.: ’was rolling’
glossary.κὰκ: κατά (apocope κὰκ before κ-) — down; prep. + gen., ’down from’ (κὰκ κεφαλῆς) · also preverb in tmesis (κὰκ … εἴρυσσε = κατεῖρυσε ’drew down’)
glossary.λάινον: λάϊνος — of stone, stone; masc. acc. sg.
glossary.λήξειεν: λήγω — cease, leave off; aor. opt. 3 sg., in a repeated past clause after ὅτε: ’whenever he ceased’
glossary.λίγειαν: λιγύς — clear-sounding, piercing, shrill; fem. acc. sg., epic accent (= λιγεῖαν)
glossary.λίθοισι: λίθος — stone; masc. dat. pl., epic -οισι (= Attic -οις)
glossary.λαέρταο: Λαέρτης — Laertes, father of Odysseus; masc. gen. sg., epic -αο (= Attic -ου)
glossary.μένει: μένω — stay, remain, wait; pres. 3 sg.
glossary.μέσσῳ: μέσος — middle, in the middle; masc. dat. sg., epic doubled-σ (= Attic μέσῳ): ’in the midst of’
glossary.μακρότερον: μακρός — long, tall; comparative μακρότερος, masc. acc. sg.: ’taller’
glossary.μετῴχετο: μετοίχομαι — go after, go about among; impf. 3 sg.
glossary.μοῦσ: Μοῦσα — Muse; fem. nom. sg., elided (μοῦσ’ = μοῦσα)
glossary.νεῖκος: νεῖκος — quarrel, strife; neut. acc. sg.
glossary.οἴμης: οἴμη — lay, song, strain; fem. gen. sg.
glossary.πάντεσσι: πᾶς — all, every; masc. dat. pl., epic -εσσι (= Attic πᾶσι)
glossary.πήματος: πῆμα — woe, suffering, calamity; neut. gen. sg.
glossary.παρέξω: παρέχω — furnish, provide; fut. 1 sg.: ’I will provide’
glossary.πασσαλόφι: πάσσαλος — peg; masc. gen. sg. with the epic suffix -φι (= πασσάλου)
glossary.πηλεΐδεω: Πηλεΐδης — son of Peleus (Achilles); masc. gen. sg., epic -εω (= Attic -ου)
glossary.πλῆντο: πίμπλημι — fill; aor. 3 pl. mid./pass., unaugmented (= ἐπλήντο): ’were filled’
glossary.πολλούς: πολύς — much, many; masc. acc. pl.
glossary.πρωτόπλοον: πρωτόπλοος — first-voyaging, making a first voyage; fem. acc. sg. (two-ending adj.)
glossary.πρόσωπα: πρόσωπον — face; neut. acc. pl. (plural for one face)
glossary.πτολίπορθος: πτολίπορθος — city-sacking, sacker of cities; masc. nom. sg., epithet of Odysseus
glossary.πυθοῖ: Πυθώ — Pytho, the older name of Delphi, seat of Apollo’s oracle; fem. dat. sg. Πυθοῖ
glossary.πύθησθε: πυνθάνομαι — learn, hear, inquire; aor. subj. 2 pl. mid., + gen. of the person: ’you may learn (of)’
glossary.σκηπτοῦχοι: σκηπτοῦχος — sceptre-bearing, sceptred; masc. nom. pl., also as a noun: ’the sceptre-bearers’
glossary.σπείσασκε: σπένδω — pour a libation; iterative aor. 3 sg. in -σκε-: ’would pour’
glossary.στενάχοντος: στενάχω — groan, sigh; pres. part. masc. gen. sg. (object of ἀκούω, ’heard him groaning’)
glossary.στιβαρῇσι: στιβαρός — stout, sturdy, strong; fem. dat. pl., epic -ῃσι (= Attic -αῖς)
glossary.τέρποντ: τέρπω — delight; impf. 3 pl. mid., elided (τέρποντ’ = τέρποντο): ’they took delight (in)’, + dat.
glossary.τέτυκτο: τεύχω — make, build, prepare; plpf. 3 sg. pass., unaugmented (= ἐτέτυκτο): ’had been made’
glossary.τετύκοντό: τεύχω — make, prepare; epic reduplicated aor. 3 pl. mid. (with the accent of a following enclitic τε): ’they prepared’
glossary.τρωσί: Τρώς — a Trojan; masc. dat. pl. (Τρῶες, Τρωσί): ’Trojans’
glossary.φιλέωμεν: φιλέω — love, treat kindly, entertain; pres. subj. 1 pl., epic uncontracted (= Attic φιλῶμεν), in a purpose clause
glossary.φόρμιγγα: φόρμιγξ — lyre, the singer’s stringed instrument; fem. acc. sg.
glossary.χρείων: χρείων — prophesying, pronouncing an oracle; pres. part. masc. nom. sg. (root and form uncertain, connected with χράω)
glossary.χρησόμενος: χράομαι — consult (an oracle), use; fut. part. mid. masc. nom. sg., of purpose: ’about to consult’
glossary.ἀγορήνδ: ἀγορή — assembly; fem. acc. sg. with the directional suffix -δε, elided (ἀγορήνδ’ = ἀγορήνδε): ’to the assembly’
glossary.ἀγοραί: ἀγορή — assembly, meeting-place; fem. nom. pl.
glossary.ἀγρομένων: ἀγείρω — gather; aor. part. mid., syncopated, masc. gen. pl.: ’of those gathering’
glossary.ἀείδων: ἀείδω — sing; pres. part. masc. nom. sg.
glossary.ἀειδέμεναι: ἀείδω — sing; pres. inf., epic -έμεναι (= Attic ᾄδειν)
glossary.ἀνώγοι: ἄνωγα — bid, command, urge; perf. with present sense, opt. 3 sg., epic
glossary.ἀοιδός: ἀοιδός — minstrel, singer; masc. nom. sg.
glossary.ἀργιόδοντας: ἀργιόδους — white-toothed, white-tusked (of swine); masc. acc. pl., stem ἀργιοδοντ-
glossary.ἀρνείσθω: ἀρνέομαι — refuse, deny; pres. imper. 3 sg.: ’let him refuse’
glossary.ἀχιλῆος: Ἀχιλλεύς — Achilles; masc. gen. sg., single-λ epic (= Attic Ἀχιλλέως)
glossary.ἄγχ: ἄγχι — near, close by; adv., elided (ἄγχ’ = ἄγχι), also with a gen.: ’near him’
glossary.ἄμερσε: ἀμέρδω — deprive, bereave (+ gen. of what is lost); aor. 3 sg., unaugmented (= ἤμερσε)
glossary.ἄρχοιτο: ἄρχομαι — begin; pres. opt. 3 sg. mid., in a repeated past clause after ὅτ’: ’whenever he began’
glossary.ἐθηήσαντο: θεάομαι — gaze at, marvel at; aor. 3 pl. mid., epic (= Attic ἐθεάσαντο)
glossary.ἐκέλευσ: κελεύω — bid, order; aor. 3 sg., elided (ἐκέλευσ’ = ἐκέλευσε)
glossary.ἐκπάγλοις: ἔκπαγλος — terrible, dreadful, violent; masc./neut. dat. pl., agreeing with a neuter noun
glossary.ἐκτελέσειεν: ἐκτελέω — bring to completion, accomplish; aor. opt. 3 sg., in a purpose clause after ὥς κεν: ’might accomplish’
glossary.ἐλάνθανε: λανθάνω — escape the notice of (+ acc.); impf. 3 sg.: ’escaped the notice of’
glossary.ἐπέφραδε: ἐπιφράζω — point out, show, tell; epic reduplicated aor. 3 sg. (= ἐπέφρασε): ’pointed out’
glossary.ἐπειρήσαντ: πειράω — try, make trial of (+ gen.); aor. 3 pl. mid., elided, Ionic η (ἐπειρήσαντ’ = ἐπειρήσαντο; Attic ἐπειράσαντο)
glossary.ἐπεφράσατ: ἐπιφράζομαι — notice, take note of, perceive; aor. 3 sg. mid., elided (ἐπεφράσατ’ = ἐπεφράσατο)
glossary.ἐπιπλαγχθείς: ἐπιπλάζομαι — be driven astray, wander over; aor. part. pass. masc. nom. sg.: ’having been driven astray’
glossary.ἐπιτέλλομαι: ἐπιτέλλω — enjoin, charge, command (+ dat.); pres. 1 sg. mid.: ’I enjoin’
glossary.ἐποτρυνώμεθα: ἐποτρύνω — urge on, speed on; pres. subj. 1 pl. mid., hortatory: ’let us speed’
glossary.ἐποτρύνῃσιν: ἐποτρύνω — urge on, rouse; pres. subj. 3 sg., epic -ῃσι(ν) (= Attic -ῃ): ’may urge on’
glossary.ἐρείσας: ἐρείδω — prop, lean, set firmly; aor. part. act. masc. nom. sg.: ’having propped’
glossary.ἐρύσσομεν: ἐρύω — draw, drag, haul; aor. subj. 1 pl., epic doubled-σ, short vowel, hortatory: ’let us drag’
glossary.ἐφίλησε: φιλέω — love, be fond of; aor. 3 sg.
glossary.ἑκάστου: ἕκαστος — each, every; masc. gen. sg.
glossary.ἑλέσθαι: αἱρέω — take, take up; aor. mid. inf.: ’to take (for oneself)’
glossary.ἑσπερίων: ἑσπέριος — of the evening, western; masc. gen. pl.
glossary.ἔκβητ: ἐκβαίνω — step out, disembark; aor. imper. 2 pl., elided (ἔκβητ’ = ἔκβητε)
glossary.ἔμπληντο: ἐμπίμπλημι — fill full; aor. 3 pl. mid./pass. (= ἐνεπλήντο): ’were filled’
glossary.ἕλεσκε: αἱρέω — take, seize; iterative aor. 3 sg. in -σκε-, unaugmented: ’would take’
glossary.ἕπον: ἕπω — be busy about, tend, dress (meat); impf. 3 pl., in tmesis with ἀμφί (= ἀμφέπον)
glossary.ἕρκεα: ἕρκος — fence, enclosure, courtyard; neut. nom. pl., uncontracted (= Attic ἕρκη)
glossary.ἠοίων: ἠοῖος — of the dawn, eastern; masc. gen. pl.
glossary.ἡγεμόνευ: ἡγεμονεύω — lead the way, lead; impf. 3 sg., elided (ἡγεμόνευ’ = ἡγεμόνευε)
glossary.ἡδεῖαν: ἡδύς — sweet, pleasant; fem. acc. sg.
glossary.ἡμέτερόνδ: ἡμέτερος — our; with the directional suffix -δε, elided (ἡμέτερόνδ’ = ἡμέτερόνδε): ’to our (house)’
glossary.ὀμορξάμενος: ὀμόργνυμι — wipe away, wipe off; aor. part. mid. masc. nom. sg.: ’having wiped away’
glossary.ὀτρύνει: ὀτρύνω — urge on, rouse, press; pres. 3 sg.
glossary.ὀτρύνειαν: ὀτρύνω — urge on, rouse; pres. opt. 3 pl., epic -ειαν (= Attic -οιεν), in a repeated past clause after ὅτ’
glossary.ὑπέρβη: ὑπερβαίνω — step over, cross; aor. 3 sg., unaugmented (= ὑπερέβη)
glossary.ὕας: ὗς — pig, boar; masc. acc. pl. ὕας (= Attic ὗς)
glossary.ὤτρυνε: ὀτρύνω — urge on, rouse; aor. 3 sg., with the temporal augment ο → ω
glossary.αἰδοῖ: αἰδώς — reverence, modesty, courtesy; fem. dat. sg., of manner: ’with modesty’
glossary.βασιλῆά: βασιλεύς — king, chieftain; masc. acc. sg., epic -ῆα (= Attic βασιλέα)
glossary.βροτολοιγῷ: βροτολοιγός — man-destroying, bane of mortals; masc. dat. sg., epithet of Ares
glossary.βόμβησεν: βομβέω — hum, whirr, buzz; aor. 3 sg., unaugmented (= ἐβόμβησεν)
glossary.δίσκον: δίσκος — discus, a thrown disc of stone; masc. acc. sg.
glossary.δίσκῳ: δίσκος — discus, a thrown disc of stone; masc. dat. sg., of respect: ’in the discus’ · also dat. of means: ’with a discus’
glossary.δαήμονι: δαήμων — knowing, skilled (in + gen.); masc. dat. sg.
glossary.δαιτὸς: δαίς — feast, meal; gen. sg., after κορέννυμι: ’sated with the feast’
glossary.δεδάηκας: δάω (aor. pass. ἐδάην) — teach; in perf. and aor. ’learn, know’; perf. 2 sg., pres. sense: ’you have learned, you know’
glossary.δεδάηκε: δάω (aor. pass. ἐδάην) — teach; in perf. and aor. ’learn, know’; perf. 3 sg., pres. sense: ’he has learned, he knows’
glossary.δημοδόκου: Δημόδοκος — Demodocus, the Phaeacian minstrel; masc. gen. sg.
glossary.διδοῦσιν: δίδωμι — give; pres. 3 pl. (= Attic διδόασι)
glossary.δολιχήρετμοι: δολιχήρετμος — long-oared; masc. nom. pl., epithet of the Phaeacians
glossary.δρόμος: δρόμος — running, race, racecourse; masc. nom. sg.
glossary.εἰπών: εἶπον — say, speak; aor. part. masc. nom. sg.: ’having said’, ’by speaking’
glossary.εἰσορόωσιν: εἰσοράω — look at, gaze upon; pres. 3 pl., epic uncontracted (= Attic εἰσορῶσι)
glossary.εὐρύαλος: Εὐρύαλος — Euryalus, a Phaeacian noble; masc. nom. sg.
glossary.θέειν: θέω — run; pres. inf., epic uncontracted (= Attic θεῖν)
glossary.θαμίζων: θαμίζω — come often, frequent, go to and fro (+ dat.); pres. part. masc. nom. sg.
glossary.θαυμανέοντες: θαυμάζω (epic θαυμαίνω) — wonder at, marvel at; pres. part. masc. nom. pl., epic (= Attic θαυμάζοντες)
glossary.θυμοδακὴς: θυμοδάκης — heart-biting, stinging to the spirit; masc. nom. sg.
glossary.θυμοῦ: θυμός — heart, spirit, soul; masc. gen. sg.
glossary.θόων: Θόων — Thoon, a Phaeacian youth; masc. nom. sg.
glossary.κήδεά: κῆδος — care, trouble, sorrow; neut. nom. pl., epic uncontracted (= Attic κήδη)
glossary.κακοῖσι: κακός — bad, evil; neut. dat. pl., epic -οισι (= Attic -οῖς), used as a noun: ’ills, troubles’
glossary.κακός: κακός — bad, base, poor; masc. nom. sg., predicate: ’bad, poor’
glossary.κακότητι: κακότης — badness, misery, distress; fem. dat. sg.
glossary.κακώτερον: κακός — bad; comparative κακώτερος (= κακίων), neut. acc. sg.: ’worse’
glossary.κατείρυσται: κατερύω — draw down, haul down (a ship to the sea); perf. pass. 3 sg.: ’has been drawn down’
glossary.κεκορήμεθα: κορέννυμι — sate, satisfy; perf. mid./pass. 1 pl., epic (= κεκορέσμεθα), + gen.: ’we are sated with’
glossary.κελεύετε: κελεύω — urge, bid, command; pres. 2 pl.
glossary.κερδέων: κέρδος — gain, profit; neut. gen. pl., epic uncontracted (= Attic κερδῶν)
glossary.κερτομέοντες: κερτομέω — taunt, mock, rail at; pres. part. masc. nom. pl., epic uncontracted (= Attic κερτομοῦντες)
glossary.κλυτόνηος: Κλυτόνηος — Clytoneus, a Phaeacian youth, son of Alcinous; masc. nom. sg.
glossary.κνήμας: κνήμη — shin, lower leg; fem. acc. pl.
glossary.κονίοντες: κονίω — raise dust, cover with dust; pres. part. masc. nom. pl.: ’raising the dust’
glossary.λαοδάμα: Λαοδάμας — Laodamas, son of Alcinous; masc. voc. sg.
glossary.λαοδάμας: Λαοδάμας — Laodamas, son of Alcinous; masc. nom. sg.
glossary.λαοὺς: λαός — people, folk, crowd; masc. acc. pl. (epic; Attic λεώς)
glossary.λεύσσουσιν: λεύσσω — look, gaze at; pres. 3 pl.
glossary.λισσόμενος: λίσσομαι — beg, entreat, supplicate; pres. part. masc. nom. sg.
glossary.λᾶος: λᾶας — stone; masc. gen. sg. (nom. λᾶας)
glossary.μέσσον: μέσος — middle, in the middle; neut. acc. sg., epic -σσ- (= Attic μέσον), used as a noun: ’the middle’
glossary.μείζονα: μείζων — greater, larger; comparative of μέγας; masc. acc. sg.
glossary.μειλιχίῃ: μειλίχιος — gentle, winning, soothing; fem. dat. sg., epic -ίῃ (= Attic -ίᾳ)
glossary.μνήμων: μνήμων — mindful, remembering (+ gen.); masc. nom. sg.
glossary.μορφὴν: μορφή — form, shape, comeliness; fem. acc. sg.
glossary.μυθεῖαι: μυθέομαι — speak, say, tell; pres. 2 sg., epic contracted (= μυθέεαι, Attic μυθῇ)
glossary.μυρίοι: μυρίος — countless, numberless; masc. nom. pl. (later ’ten thousand’)
glossary.ναυβολίδης: Ναυβολίδης — son of Naubolus; masc. nom. sg., patronymic
glossary.ναυσίκλυτοι: ναυσικλυτός — famed for ships, ship-renowned; masc. nom. pl.
glossary.ναυτάων: ναύτης — sailor; masc. gen. pl., epic -άων (= Attic -ῶν)
glossary.ναυτεύς: Ναυτεύς — Nauteus (’Shipman’), a Phaeacian youth; masc. nom. sg.
glossary.νείκεσέ: νεικέω — quarrel with, rebuke, revile; aor. 3 sg., unaugmented (= ἐνείκεσε), accented before enclitic τε
glossary.νύσσης: νύσσα — post marking the start or turn of a race; fem. gen. sg.
glossary.νῆις: νῆις — ignorant, unskilled (+ gen.); masc. nom. sg., adj. of two endings

glossary.ἐπήρατα: ἐπήρατος — lovely, desirable; neut. acc. pl.
glossary.ἐπελήκεον: ἐπιληκέω — beat time, stamp or clap in time (sense inferred, not certain); impf. 3 pl., epic (= Attic ἐπιλήκουν)
glossary.ἐπενήνοθεν: ἐπενήνοθε — lies upon, covers (of a bloom or adornment); defective epic perf. with pres. sense, 3 sg., ν-movable, + acc.; root uncertain
glossary.ἐπιεικτὰ: ἐπιεικτός — yielding, tolerable, to be put up with; neut. acc. pl. (with οὐκ: ’intolerable’)
glossary.ἐριούνης: ἐριούνης — epithet of Hermes, conventionally ’helper’ or ’luck-bringer’; masc. nom. sg.; the sense is disputed
glossary.ἐχέθυμος: ἐχέθυμος — holding one’s spirit in check, self-controlled; fem. nom. sg. (ἔχω + θυμός)
glossary.ἑάων: ἐΰς — good; neut. gen. pl. ἑάων, an epic fixed form (= Attic ἀγαθῶν), substantivized: ’of good things’
glossary.ἑκάεργος: ἑκάεργος — far-working, far-shooter, epithet of Apollo (the first element is ἑκάς ’far’; the second is disputed); masc. nom. sg.
glossary.ἑκατηβόλ: ἑκατηβόλος — far-shooting, epithet of Apollo; masc. voc. sg., elided ἑκατηβόλ’ (= ἑκατηβόλε)
glossary.ἑρμῆν: Ἑρμῆς — Hermes, messenger of the gods; masc. acc. sg.
glossary.ἑστεῶτες: ἵστημι — set, stand; perf. part. ἑστεώς ’standing’, masc. nom. pl., epic (= Attic ἑστῶτες)
glossary.ἔθ: ἔτι — still, yet; adv., elided ἔθ’ before a rough breathing (with negative: ’no longer’)
glossary.ἔριζεν: ἐρίζω — contend, vie, rival; impf. 3 sg.
glossary.ἔστη: ἵστημι — set, stand; aor. 3 sg. intrans.: ’stood, took his stand’
glossary.ἔχοιεν: ἔχω — have, hold; pres. opt. 3 pl., in a wish: ’may they hold’
glossary.ἔχυντο: χέω — pour; mid. stream, be spread; aor. 3 pl. mid., root aorist, epic (= Attic ἐχύθησαν): ’streamed around’
glossary.ἕσσαν: ἕννυμι — clothe; aor. 3 pl. ἕσσαν, epic (Attic ἠμφίεσαν): ’they clothed (her) in’, with acc. of the garment
glossary.ἕτερος: ἕτερος — the one, the other (of two); masc. nom. sg. (ὁ ἕτερος … ὁ δέ ’the one … the other’)
glossary.ἠπεδανὸς: ἠπεδανός — weak, feeble, infirm; masc. nom. sg.
glossary.ἥφαιστ: Ἥφαιστος — Hephaestus, god of the forge; masc. voc. sg., elided ἥφαιστ’ (= Ἥφαιστε)
glossary.ἰδνωθεὶς: ἰδνόω — bend, bow; pass. bend oneself; aor. pass. part. masc. nom. sg.: ’having bent (back)’
glossary.ἰθὺν: ἰθύς — straight line, straight course; fem. acc. sg., with ἀνά: ’in a straight line’
glossary.ἴμεναι: εἶμι — go; pres. inf., epic (= Attic ἰέναι): ’to go’
glossary.ὀρχήσασθαι: ὀρχέομαι — dance; aor. inf. mid.: ’to dance’
glossary.ὀφέλλει: ὀφέλλω — owe, be liable for; pres. 3 sg., epic (= Attic ὀφείλει)
glossary.ὄφελλον: ὀφέλλω — owe, ought; ὄφελλον + inf. an unfulfillable wish, impf. 3 pl. (1 sg. same form), unaugmented, epic (= Attic ὤφελον): ’would that they had (not)’
glossary.ὄψεσθ: ὁράω — see; fut. 2 pl. mid., elided ὄψεσθ’ (= ὄψεσθε): ’you will see’
glossary.ὑπίσχομαι: ὑπισχνέομαι — promise, undertake; pres. 1 sg. mid., epic (= Attic ὑπισχνοῦμαι)
glossary.ὑπαλύξας: ὑπαλύσκω — slip away from, escape; aor. part. masc. nom. sg.: ’having escaped’
glossary.ὑποστρέψας: ὑποστρέφω — turn back, return; aor. part. masc. nom. sg.: ’having turned back’
glossary.ὑψόσ: ὑψόσε — up on high, aloft; adv., elided ὑψόσ’
glossary.ὠκύν: ὠκύς — swift, quick; masc. acc. sg.
glossary.ὠκύτατόν: ὠκύς — swift; superlative ὠκύτατος, masc. acc. sg., accented before enclitic περ: ’swiftest’
glossary.ὠρχείσθην: ὀρχέομαι — dance; impf. 3 dual mid., augmented: ’the two danced’
glossary.ὦρτ: ὄρνυμι — rouse; mid. rise, arise; aor. 3 sg. mid., root aorist, elided ὦρτ’ (= ὦρτο), in tmesis ἐν … ὦρτο: ’arose among’
glossary.ᾕρει: αἱρέω — take, seize; impf. 3 sg., augmented: ’seized’
glossary.ῥίπτασκε: ῥίπτω — throw, hurl; iterative impf. 3 sg. in -σκε(ν), unaugmented: ’would throw’
glossary.ῥηιδίως: ῥᾳδίως — easily; adv., epic ῥηιδίως (= Attic ῥᾳδίως)
glossary.αὐτόδιον: αὐτόδιον — on the spot, right then and there; adv.: ’at once, without delay’
glossary.βάνθ: βαίνω — go, step; aor. part. masc. acc. sg., root aorist, elided (βάνθ’ = βάντα): ’having stepped (into)’
glossary.βέβακται: βαίνω — go, step; perf. 3 sg. mid./pass., of a word: ’has gone forth, has been let slip’
glossary.γάστρην: γαστήρ — belly, paunch (of a cauldron); fem. acc. sg., Ionic (= Attic γαστέρα)
glossary.δέδαε: δάω — teach; reduplicated aor. 3 sg., epic (= Attic ἐδίδαξε): ’taught’
glossary.δαῖον: δαίω — kindle, set alight; impf. 3 pl., unaugmented: ’they kindled’
glossary.δεξάμενοι: δέχομαι — receive, take; aor. part. mid. masc. nom. pl.: ’having received’
glossary.δηλήσεται: δηλέομαι — harm, injure; aor. subj. 3 sg. mid., short vowel (= Attic δηλήσηται), in a fear clause after μή: ’lest he harm’
glossary.δῶμεν: δίδωμι — give; aor. subj. 1 pl., hortatory: ’let us give’
glossary.εὐχετοῴμην: εὐχετάομαι — pray to, vow to; pres. opt. 1 sg. mid., uncontracted epic (= Attic εὐχετῴμην), with κεν, potential: ’I would pray’
glossary.εὕδῃσθα: εὕδω — sleep; pres. subj. 2 sg., epic -ῃσθα (= Attic εὕδῃς), after ὁππότ’ ἂν: ’whenever you sleep’
glossary.ζωάγρι: ζωάγρια — payment for saving a life, life-ransom; neut. acc. pl., elided (ζωάγρι’ = ζωάγρια)
glossary.θάμιζεν: θαμίζω — come often, be in the habit; impf. 3 sg., unaugmented (= ἐθάμιζεν): ’was wont, did often’
glossary.θέρμετε: θέρμω — heat, warm; pres. imper. 2 pl. (= Attic θερμαίνετε): ’heat!’
glossary.θέρμετο: θέρμω — heat, warm; impf. 3 sg. pass. (= Attic ἐθερμαίνετο): ’was growing hot’
glossary.θρόνοισι: θρόνος — seat, chair; masc. dat. pl., epic -οισι(ν) (= Attic -οις)
glossary.θὲς: τίθημι — put, place; aor. imper. 2 sg.: ’put!’
glossary.κίρκη: Κίρκη — Circe, the enchantress goddess; fem. nom. sg.
glossary.κείμενα: κεῖμαι — lie, be laid; pres. part. mid. neut. nom./acc. pl.: ’lying (there)’
glossary.κερόωντό: κεράννυμι — mix (wine with water); impf. 3 pl. mid., epic κεράομαι (= Attic ἐκεράννυντο): ’they mixed (for themselves)’
glossary.κηλέῳ: κήλεος — burning, blazing; adj., neut. dat. sg., epithet of fire: ’blazing’
glossary.κολεὸν: κολεόν — sheath, scabbard; neut. nom. sg. (Attic κουλεόν)
glossary.κομιδή: κομιδή — care, tending, attention; fem. nom. sg.
glossary.κομιζόμενός: κομίζω — tend, take care of; mid. look after oneself; pres. part. mid. masc. nom. sg., accented before enclitic γε: ’caring for himself’
glossary.κρέας: κρέας — flesh, meat; neut. acc. sg.: ’a portion of meat’
glossary.κραίνουσι: κραίνω — accomplish, rule; pres. 3 pl.: ’they rule’
glossary.κώπη: κώπη — handle, hilt (of a sword; also oar); fem. nom. sg.
glossary.λοέτρ: λοετρόν — bath, bathing water; neut. acc. pl., elided, epic uncontracted (λοέτρ’ = λοετρά, Attic λουτρά): ’baths’
glossary.λοετροχόον: λοετροχόος — pouring bath-water, for bath-water; adj., masc. acc. sg. (Attic λουτροχόος): ’for heating the bath’
glossary.λούσασθαι: λούω — wash, bathe; aor. inf. mid.: ’to bathe (oneself)’
glossary.μέτα: μετά — among, amid; prep. + acc., placed after its noun with anastrophe (Attic μετὰ ἄνδρας)
glossary.μνήσῃ: μιμνήσκομαι — remember, be mindful of (+ gen.); aor. subj. 2 sg. mid. (= Attic μνησθῇς), after ἵνα: ’you may remember’
glossary.νεοπρίστου: νεόπριστος — newly sawn; adj., masc. gen. sg. (of ivory)
glossary.νώτου: νῶτον — back, chine (of an animal); gen. sg., partitive after a verb of cutting: ’from the chine’
glossary.ξίφεός: ξίφος — sword; neut. gen. sg., epic ξίφεος (= Attic ξίφους), accented before enclitic γε
glossary.ξεινήιον: ξεινήιον — guest-gift; neut. acc. sg., epic (= Attic ξένιον)
glossary.οἰνοποτῆρας: οἰνοποτήρ — wine-drinker, drinker at feasts; masc. acc. pl.
glossary.οἰσέμεναι: φέρω (fut. οἴσω) — bring, carry; fut. inf. act. in -έμεναι (= Attic οἴσειν): ’to carry’
glossary.οἴμας: οἴμη — song, lay, strain; fem. acc. pl., poetic
glossary.πάσχεις: πάσχω — suffer, experience; pres. 2 sg.: ’you suffer’
glossary.παγχάλκεον: πάγχαλκος — all of bronze; adj., neut. acc. sg., epic παγχάλκεος (= Attic παγχάλκους)
glossary.παρῆεν: πάρειμι — be present, be at hand; impf. 3 sg., epic (= Attic παρῆν)
glossary.πατρίδι: πατρίς — of one’s fathers, native; adj., fem. dat. sg., agreeing with γαίῃ: ’native (land)’
glossary.πλεῖον: πλείων — more, greater; comparative of πολύς; neut. nom. sg. (Attic πλέον): ’more (of it)’
glossary.ποθὴ: ποθή — longing, want, need (+ gen.); fem. nom. sg.
glossary.πρώτῃ: πρῶτος — first; adj., fem. dat. sg., agreeing with μοι: ’(to me) first’
glossary.πῶμα: πῶμα — lid, cover; neut. acc. sg. (distinct from πόμα ’drink’)
glossary.σπένδῃ: σπένδω — pour a libation; pres. subj. 2 sg., after ὄφρα: ’you may pour’
glossary.στῆσαι: ἵστημι — set, stand up; aor. inf. act., transitive: ’to set up’
glossary.τάλαντον: τάλαντον — talent, a weight of gold; neut. acc. sg.
glossary.τέρπηται: τέρπω — delight; mid. take one’s pleasure; pres. subj. 3 sg. mid., after ὄφρα: ’may he take his pleasure’
glossary.τετιμένον: τιμάω — honour; perf. part. pass. masc. acc. sg., epic (= Attic τετιμημένον): ’honoured’
glossary.τιμήεντος: τιμήεις — precious, valued; adj., masc. gen. sg., epic (= Attic τίμιος): ’precious (gold)’
glossary.τρίποδ: τρίπους — tripod, three-footed cauldron-stand; masc. acc. sg., elided (τρίποδ’ = τρίποδα)
glossary.τρίποδα: τρίπους — tripod, three-footed cauldron-stand; masc. acc. sg.
glossary.τρίποδος: τρίπους — tripod, three-footed cauldron-stand; masc. gen. sg.
glossary.τρισκαιδέκατος: τρισκαιδέκατος — thirteenth; ordinal, masc. nom. sg.
glossary.φάγῃσιν: ἐσθίω (aor. ἔφαγον) — eat; aor. subj. 3 sg., epic -ῃσι(ν) (= Attic φάγῃ), after ὄφρα: ’that he may eat’
glossary.φέροιεν: φέρω — carry, bear; pres. opt. 3 pl., wish: ’may they carry (it) off’
glossary.φέρωμεν: φέρω — bring, carry; pres. subj. 1 pl., hortatory: ’let us bring’
glossary.φίλησε: φιλέω — love, treat as dear; aor. 3 sg., unaugmented (= ἐφίλησε): ’loved’
glossary.φῦλον: φῦλον — tribe, race, kind; neut. acc. sg.
glossary.χαλκὸν: χαλκός — bronze; masc. acc. sg. · also a bronze vessel, cauldron: ’the bronze (cauldron)’
glossary.χηλὸν: χηλός — chest, coffer; fem. acc. sg.
glossary.χρύσεον: χρύσεος — golden; adj., neut. acc. sg., uncontracted (= Attic χρυσοῦν)
glossary.ἀμφιδεδίνηται: ἀμφιδινέω — whirl, run around; perf. 3 sg. mid./pass.: ’has been set round, encircles’
glossary.ἀναρπάξασαι: ἀναρπάζω — snatch up, carry off; aor. part. fem. nom. pl.: ’having snatched up’
glossary.ἀοιδῶν: ἀοιδός — minstrel, singer; masc. gen. pl.
glossary.ἀολλέα: ἀολλής — all together, in a body; adj., neut. acc. pl., uncontracted epic (= Attic ἀολλῆ)
glossary.ἀποπροταμών: ἀποπροτάμνω — cut off (a portion); aor. part. masc. nom. sg. (Attic ἀποτεμών): ’having cut off’
glossary.ἀρέσσομαι: ἀρέσκω — appease, make amends to; fut. 1 sg. mid., doubled σ (= Attic ἀρέσομαι): ’I will make amends’
glossary.ἀργιόδοντος: ἀργιόδους — white-toothed; adj., masc./fem. gen. sg., epithet of a boar or pig
glossary.ἀργυρέη: ἀργύρεος — of silver; adj., fem. nom. sg., Ionic η (= Attic ἀργυρᾶ)
glossary.ἀρεσσάμενος: ἀρέσκω — appease, make amends to; aor. part. mid. masc. nom. sg., doubled σ: ’having made amends’
glossary.ἀρεσσάσθω: ἀρέσκω — appease, make amends to; aor. imper. 3 sg. mid., doubled σ: ’let him make amends’
glossary.ἀριπρεπέ: ἀριπρεπής — outstanding; fem. acc. sg., elided (ἀριπρεπέ’ = ἀριπρεπέα, Attic ἀριπρεπῆ)
glossary.ἀριπρεπέες: ἀριπρεπής — outstanding; masc. nom. pl., uncontracted (= Attic ἀριπρεπεῖς)
glossary.ἀσάμινθον: ἀσάμινθος — bath, bathing-tub; fem. acc. sg.
glossary.ἄλοχόν: ἄλοχος — wife, spouse; fem. acc. sg., accented before enclitic τε
glossary.ἄμφεπε: ἀμφέπω — busy oneself about, tend, play about; impf. 3 sg., unaugmented (= ἤμφεπε): ’was busy about’
glossary.ἄορ: ἄορ — sword (poetic, = ξίφος); neut. acc. sg.
glossary.ἐβιώσαο: βιόομαι — bring to life, save the life of; aor. 2 sg. mid., epic -αο (= Attic ἐβιώσω): ’you gave me life’
glossary.ἐδίδαξε: διδάσκω — teach; aor. 3 sg., augmented, with double acc.: ’taught (them the songs)’
glossary.ἐλέλειπτο: λείπω — leave; plpf. 3 sg. pass.: ’had been left (over)’
glossary.ἐνείκατε: φέρω (aor. ἤνεγκα) — bring; aor. imper. 2 pl., epic ἐνείκατε (= Attic ἐνέγκατε): ’bring!’
glossary.ἐξέφερεν: ἐκφέρω — carry out; impf. 3 sg., augmented (= Attic ἐξέφερε): ’was bringing out’
glossary.ἐπήρτυε: ἐπαρτύω — fit on, put in order; impf. 3 sg.: ’was fitting on’
glossary.ἐπιεικές: ἐπιεικής — fitting, suitable, proper; neut. nom. sg., predicate: ’as is fitting’
glossary.ἐπιχθονίοισιν: ἐπιχθόνιος — on the earth, earthly; adj., masc. dat. pl., epic -οισιν (= Attic -οις)
glossary.ἐρίγδουπος: ἐρίγδουπος — loud-crashing, traditionally loud-thundering (ἐρι- intensive; exact sense uncertain), epithet of Zeus; masc. nom. sg.
glossary.ἐυπλυνὲς: ἐϋπλυνής — well-washed; adj., neut. acc. sg., agreeing with φᾶρος
glossary.ἑλοῦσαι: αἱρέω — take, seize; aor. part. fem. nom. pl. (aor. stem ἑλ-): ’having taken’
glossary.ἔδωκαν: δίδωμι — give; aor. 3 pl. augmented (κ-aorist): ’they gave’
glossary.ἔμμοροί: ἔμμορος — having a share in (+ gen.); adj., masc. nom. pl., accented before enclitic εἰσι
glossary.ἔμπεδος: ἔμπεδος — steady, firm, unfailing; adj. of two endings, fem. nom. sg., predicate
glossary.ἔνεικαν: φέρω — bring; aor. 3 pl., epic (= Attic ἤνεγκαν): ’they brought’
glossary.ἔνεμον: νέμω — distribute, dole out; impf. 3 pl.: ’they distributed’
glossary.ἔχεαν: χέω — pour; aor. 3 pl., ε-stem aorist with -α endings (ἔχεα): ’they poured in’
glossary.ἠυκόμοιο: ἠΰκομος — fine-haired, with beautiful hair; adj., fem. gen. sg., epic -οιο (= Attic -ου), epithet of goddesses
glossary.ἥρης: Ἥρη — Hera, wife of Zeus; fem. gen. sg., Ionic (= Attic Ἥρας)
glossary.ἥρῳ: ἥρως — hero, noble warrior (title of honour); masc. dat. sg.
glossary.ἰήνατε: ἰαίνω — warm, heat; aor. imper. 2 pl.: ’warm!’
glossary.ἰδών: ὁράω (aor. εἶδον) — see; aor. part. masc. nom. sg.: ’having seen’
glossary.ἴηλεν: ἰάλλω — send, cast; aor. 3 sg. (ἴηλε with movable ν): ’cast, tied (a knot)’
glossary.ἴηλον: ἰάλλω — send, cast; aor. imper. 2 sg., epic: ’cast, tie (a knot)’
glossary.ἴῃ: εἶμι — go; pres. subj. 3 sg., after ὄφρα: ’may go’
glossary.ὀπάσσω: ὀπάζω — grant, give as a gift; fut. 1 sg., doubled σ (= Attic ὀπάσω): ’I will give’
glossary.ὀφέλλεις: ὀφέλλω — owe (epic for ὀφείλω, not the homograph ὀφέλλω ’increase’); pres. 2 sg. (= Attic ὀφείλεις): ’you owe’
glossary.ὁρῶσα: ὁράω — see, look; pres. part. fem. nom. sg.: ’looking at’
glossary.ὑψηλοῖσι: ὑψηλός — high, lofty; adj., masc. dat. pl., epic -οισι (= Attic -οῖς)
glossary.ὑός: ὗς — pig, boar; masc./fem. gen. sg. ὑός
glossary.ὕμνον: ὕμνος — song, lay; masc. acc. sg.
glossary.αἰδοίοιο: αἰδοῖος — revered, worthy of respect; masc. gen. sg., epic -οιο (= Attic -ου)
glossary.αἰνίζομ: αἰνίζομαι — praise, commend; pres. 1 sg. mid., elided (αἰνίζομ’ = αἰνίζομαι)
glossary.αἰνότατον: αἰνός — dread, grim, terrible; superl. αἰνότατος, masc. acc. sg.: ’most dread’
glossary.αἷμά: αἷμα — blood, kinship by blood; neut. acc. sg., accented before an enclitic
glossary.αὐταὶ: αὐτός — self; intensive pron., fem. nom. pl.: ’themselves’
glossary.βήμεναι: βαίνω — go, step; aor. inf., epic -μεναι (= Attic βῆναι)
glossary.βαλόντες: βάλλω — throw, cast; aor. part. masc. nom. pl.: ’having thrown’
glossary.δηιφόβοιο: Δηίφοβος — Deiphobus, a son of Priam; masc. gen. sg., epic -οιο (= Attic -ου)
glossary.δημόδοκ: Δημόδοκος — Demodocus, the blind minstrel of the Phaeacians; voc. sg., elided (Δημόδοκ’ = Δημόδοκε)
glossary.δημόδοκος: Δημόδοκος — Demodocus, the minstrel of the Phaeacians; masc. nom. sg.
glossary.διέπραθον: διαπέρθω — sack, destroy utterly; aor. 3 pl., augmented, with the aorist ἔπραθον (of πέρθω) after the preverb
glossary.διαπλῆξαι: διαπλήσσω — strike through, cleave asunder; aor. inf.
glossary.δορπέομέν: δορπέω — take the evening meal, dine; pres. 1 pl., epic uncontracted (= Attic δορποῦμεν), accented before an enclitic
glossary.δουράτεον: δουράτεος — wooden, of timber; masc. acc. sg., epic (= Attic δούρειον)
glossary.δουρατέου: δουράτεος — wooden, of timber; masc. gen. sg., epic (= Attic δουρείου)
glossary.δούρεσσι: δόρυ — spear, shaft; neut. dat. pl., epic -εσσι (= Attic δόρασι): ’with spears’
glossary.εἰδῇ: οἶδα — know; perf. subj. 3 sg., in a general relative clause with κεν: ’who knows’
glossary.εἰμεν: εἰμί — be; pres. 1 pl., epic (= Attic ἐσμέν): ’we are’
glossary.εἰπόντος: εἶπον — say; aor. part. masc. gen. sg., agreeing with a noun: ’as he said’
glossary.εἰσανάγουσι: εἰσανάγω — lead in, bring up into; pres. 3 pl.
glossary.εἴρερον: εἴρερος — servitude, slavery; masc. acc. sg., of the state entered: ’into bondage’
glossary.εἴρωμαι: εἴρομαι — ask, inquire; pres. subj. 1 sg. mid., epic (= Attic ἔρωμαι), with κε in an indefinite clause
glossary.εἶβεν: εἴβω — let fall, shed (poetic by-form of λείβω); impf. 3 sg., epic εἶβεν (= ἔλειβεν)
glossary.θελκτήριον: θελκτήριον — charm, thing that soothes or propitiates; neut. nom. sg.
glossary.θνήσκοντα: θνῄσκω — die; pres. part. masc. acc. sg.: ’dying’
glossary.κήδιστοι: κήδιστος — closest-tied, nearest by kinship (superl. of κήδιος, from κῆδος ’care, tie by marriage’); masc. nom. pl.
glossary.κασιγνήτοιο: κασίγνητος — brother; masc. gen. sg., epic -οιο (= Attic -ου), gen. of comparison after χερείων
glossary.κασιγνήτου: κασίγνητος — brother; masc. gen. sg., governed by ἀντί: ’in place of a brother’
glossary.καταλέξῃς: καταλέγω — recount in full and in order; aor. subj. 2 sg., in a condition with αἴ κεν
glossary.κεκαλυμμέναι: καλύπτω — cover, veil; perf. mid./pass. part. fem. nom. pl.: ’hidden’
glossary.κεκαλυμμένοι: καλύπτω — cover, hide; perf. mid./pass. part. masc. nom. pl.: ’hidden’
glossary.κεραϊζέμεν: κεραΐζω — ravage, sack, plunder; pres. inf., epic -έμεν (= Attic κεραΐζειν)
glossary.κερδαλέοισιν: κερδαλέος — cunning, crafty (lit. gainful); neut. dat. pl., epic -οισιν (= Attic -οις)
glossary.κεχαρισμένα: χαρίζομαι — oblige, gratify; perf. part. pass. neut. acc. pl., used as an adj.: ’agreeable, kindly’
glossary.κεῦθε: κεύθω — hide, conceal; pres. imper. 2 sg.: ’hide!’
glossary.κλαίεις: κλαίω — weep, lament; pres. 2 sg.: ’you weep’
glossary.κλαίῃσι: κλαίω — weep; pres. subj. 3 sg., epic -σι (= Attic κλαίῃ), in a simile
glossary.κλισίῃσι: κλισίη — hut, tent, shelter; fem. dat. pl., epic -ῃσι (= Attic κλισίαις)
glossary.κυβερνητῆρες: κυβερνητήρ — steersman, helmsman; masc. nom. pl.
glossary.κόπτοντες: κόπτω — strike, beat; pres. part. masc. nom. pl.: ’striking’
glossary.λίγα: λιγύς — clear, shrill; neut. acc. pl. used adverbially: ’shrilly’
glossary.μετάβηθι: μεταβαίνω — pass over, move on (to another matter); aor. imper. 2 sg.
glossary.μετάφρενον: μετάφρενον — the back (between the shoulders); neut. acc. sg.
glossary.ναιετοώσας: ναιετάω — dwell, be inhabited; pres. part. fem. acc. pl., epic uncontracted (= Attic ναιετώσας): ’inhabited’
glossary.ναυσιθόου: Ναυσίθοος — Nausithous, father of Alcinous; masc. gen. sg., epic -οου (= Attic -οῦ)
glossary.νεφέλῃ: νεφέλη — cloud; fem. dat. sg., of means: ’in cloud’
glossary.νηλεὲς: νηλεής — pitiless, ruthless; neut. acc. sg., uncontracted (= Attic νηλές); cf. dat. νηλέι
glossary.νικῆσαι: νικάω — conquer, prevail; aor. inf.: ’to win, to conquer’
glossary.νοήμασι: νόημα — thought, design; neut. dat. pl., of means: ’with thoughts’
glossary.ξεινοδόκοι: ξεινοδόκος — host, one who receives guests; masc. nom. pl., epic ξειν- (= Attic ξενοδόκοι)
glossary.ξεῖνός: ξεῖνος — stranger, guest-friend (epic = Attic ξένος); masc. nom. sg., accented before an enclitic
glossary.πέμπωσι: πέμπω — send, escort; pres. subj. 3 pl., in a purpose clause after ὄφρα
glossary.πέσῃσιν: πίπτω — fall, be slain; aor. subj. 3 sg., epic -σιν, in a general relative clause
glossary.παρεὼν: πάρειμι — be present, be at hand; pres. part. masc. nom. sg., epic uncontracted (= Attic παρών)
glossary.παύσατ: παύω — stop, cause to cease; aor. mid. 3 sg., elided (παύσατ’ = παύσατο), intrans. ’ceased’ (+ gen.)
glossary.πηδάλι: πηδάλιον — steering-oar, rudder; neut. nom. pl., elided (πηδάλι’ = πηδάλια)
glossary.πημανθῆναι: πημαίνω — bring harm to, harm; aor. pass. inf.: ’to be harmed’
glossary.πηὸς: πηός — kinsman by marriage, relative; masc. nom. sg.
glossary.πομποὶ: πομπός — escort, conveyor; masc. nom. pl.
glossary.πομπὴ: πομπή — sending, escort, conveyance home; fem. nom. sg.
glossary.ποτὲ: ποτέ — once, at some time, some day; adv.
glossary.πόλιάς: πόλις — city; fem. acc. pl., epic πόλιας (= Attic πόλεις), accented before an enclitic
glossary.πόλιας: πόλις — city; fem. acc. pl., epic πόλιας (= Attic πόλεις)
glossary.σχεθέτω: ἔχω (aor. ἔσχεθον) — hold, check, hold back; aor. imper. 3 sg., epic σχεθ- (= Attic σχέτω): ’let him hold back, stop’
glossary.τάχισθ: ταχύς — swift; superl. τάχιστα, neut. pl. used adverbially, elided and aspirated (τάχισθ’ before a rough breathing): ’most swiftly’
glossary.τέκωσι: τίκτω — bear, beget; aor. subj. 3 pl., in a temporal clause with κε
glossary.τήκετο: τήκω — melt, waste away; mid./pass. impf. 3 sg.: ’melted, dissolved (in tears)’
glossary.τίθενται: τίθημι — put, place; mid. ’lay upon, give (a name)’; pres. 3 pl., ἐπί … τίθενται in tmesis
glossary.τεκέεσσιν: τέκος — child; neut. dat. pl., epic -εσσιν (= Attic τέκνοις)
glossary.τελευτήσεσθαι: τελευτάω — accomplish, bring to an end; fut. mid. inf. with passive sense: ’to be fulfilled, to come to pass’
glossary.τεὴν: τεός — your, thy (epic = Attic σός); fem. acc. sg.
glossary.τεῦξαν: τεύχω — make, fashion; aor. 3 pl., epic (= Attic ἔτευξαν), unaugmented
glossary.τιτυσκόμεναι: τιτύσκομαι — aim at, make for, direct; pres. part. mid. fem. nom. pl.
glossary.τολμήσαντα: τολμάω — dare, endure; aor. part. masc. acc. sg.: ’having dared’
glossary.τρίχα: τρίχα — in three ways, threefold; adv.
glossary.φάσθαι: φημί — say, speak; pres. inf. mid., epic φάσθαι (= Attic φάναι)
glossary.φαῖνε: φαίνω — show, reveal, bring to light; impf. 3 sg., unaugmented (= ἔφαινε)
glossary.φθινύθουσι: φθινύθω — waste away, wither; pres. 3 pl.
glossary.φιλέοντες: φιλέω — love, treat kindly; pres. part. masc. nom. pl., epic uncontracted (= Attic φιλοῦντες)
glossary.χαλεποί: χαλεπός — harsh, hard to deal with; masc. nom. pl.
glossary.χαριζόμενος: χαρίζομαι — gratify, please (+ dat.); pres. part. masc. nom. sg.: ’pleasing, indulging’
glossary.χυμένη: χέω — pour; aor. mid. part. fem. nom. sg., epic syncopated χυμένη (= χεαμένη): ’poured out, flung down’
glossary.χώρας: χώρη — land, place, region; fem. acc. pl. (the lemma is Ionic χώρη, Attic χώρα)
glossary.ἀγάσασθαι: ἀγάομαι — be resentful of (+ dat.); aor. inf. mid. (also written ἀγάσσασθαι)
glossary.ἀγόρευ: ἀγορεύω — speak, say; impf. 3 sg., elided (ἀγόρευ’ = ἀγόρευε), unaugmented
glossary.ἀείδει: ἀείδω — sing; pres. 3 sg., epic uncontracted (= Attic ᾄδει)
glossary.ἀείδεις: ἀείδω — sing; pres. 2 sg., epic uncontracted (= Attic ᾄδεις)
glossary.ἀκρόπολιν: ἀκρόπολις — citadel, high city; fem. acc. sg.
glossary.ἀμφιβέβηκεν: ἀμφιβαίνω — go about, encompass, envelop; perf. 3 sg. with present force (+ acc.): ’has enveloped’
glossary.ἀμφικαλύψειν: ἀμφικαλύπτω — enfold, cover all round; fut. inf.: ’to enfold’
glossary.ἀμφικαλύψῃ: ἀμφικαλύπτω — enfold, cover all round; aor. subj. 3 sg., in a temporal clause with ἐπήν
glossary.ἀμφιπεσοῦσα: ἀμφιπίπτω — fall around, throw oneself upon; aor. part. fem. nom. sg.: ’having flung herself upon’
glossary.ἀμύνων: ἀμύνω — ward off, defend; pres. part. masc. nom. sg., ’keeping off (a harm) from (dat.)’
glossary.ἀνθρώποις: ἄνθρωπος — human being; masc. dat. pl.
glossary.ἀνιοῦσαν: ἄνειμι — go up, come back; pres. part. fem. acc. sg. (from εἶμι): ’returning’
glossary.ἀντὶ: ἀντί — instead of, in place of; prep. + gen.
glossary.ἀνώνυμός: ἀνώνυμος — nameless; masc./fem. nom. sg., accented before an enclitic
glossary.ἀπέπλειον: ἀποπλέω — sail away; impf. 3 pl., epic uncontracted (= Attic ἀπέπλεον)
glossary.ἀπέφθιτο: ἀποφθίνω — perish, die; aor. 3 sg. mid.: ’had perished’
glossary.ἀπήμονές: ἀπήμων — unharmed, harmless, safe; masc. nom. pl., accented before an enclitic
glossary.ἀπεπλάγχθης: ἀποπλάζω — drive off course; aor. pass. 2 sg.: ’you were driven astray’
glossary.ἀσπαίροντα: ἀσπαίρω — gasp, quiver, struggle; pres. part. masc. acc. sg.
glossary.ἀτέλεστ: ἀτέλεστος — unfulfilled, unaccomplished; neut. nom. pl., elided (ἀτέλεστ’ = ἀτέλεστα)
glossary.ἄεισον: ἀείδω — sing; aor. imper. 2 sg., epic uncontracted (= Attic ᾆσον)
glossary.ἄκριτα: ἄκριτος — endless, undistinguished, confused; neut. acc. pl. used as a cognate object or adverbially
glossary.ἄστεϊ: ἄστυ — town, city; neut. dat. sg., epic ἄστεϊ (= Attic ἄστει)
glossary.ἄχεϊ: ἄχος — grief, distress; neut. dat. sg., epic ἄχεϊ (= Attic ἄχει)
glossary.ἅς: ὅς, ἥ, ὅ — who, which; relative pron., fem. acc. pl., with τινας ’whichever’; not the possessive
glossary.ἐάαν: ἐάω — allow, let be; pres. inf., epic uncontracted (= Attic ἐᾶν)
glossary.ἐκπρολιπόντες: ἐκπρολείπω — leave, quit; aor. part. masc. nom. pl.: ’having left’
glossary.ἐκχύμενοι: ἐκχέω — pour out; aor. mid. part. masc. nom. pl., syncopated: ’pouring out’
glossary.ἐλεεινοτάτῳ: ἐλεεινός — pitiable, wretched; superl. ἐλεεινότατος, neut. dat. sg.: ’most pitiable’
glossary.ἐλεεινὸν: ἐλεεινός — pitiable, wretched; neut. acc. sg.
glossary.ἐμπλήσας: ἐμπίμπλημι — fill (+ gen. of what fills); aor. part. masc. nom. sg.: ’having filled’
glossary.ἐμόγησαν: μογέω — toil, suffer hardship; aor. 3 pl.
glossary.ἐξαλάπαξαν: ἐξαλαπάζω — sack, utterly destroy; aor. 3 pl.
glossary.ἐπειὸς: Ἐπειός — Epeius, builder of the wooden horse; masc. nom. sg.
glossary.ἐπιψαύῃ: ἐπιψαύω — touch, lay hold of (+ gen.; here with the instrumental dative πραπίδεσσι ’with his wits’); pres. subj. 3 sg., in a general relative clause
glossary.ἐποίησεν: ποιέω — make, build; aor. 3 sg., augmented
glossary.ἐρύσαντας: ἐρύω — draw, drag; aor. part. masc. acc. pl.: ’having dragged’
glossary.ἐσσομένοισιν: εἰμί — be; fut. part. mid. ἐσσόμενος, masc./neut. dat. pl., epic -οισιν: ’those yet to be’
glossary.ἐστ: εἰμί — be; pres. 3 sg., elided (ἐστ’ = ἐστί)
glossary.ἐυεργέα: ἐϋεργής — well-made, well-wrought; fem. acc. sg., uncontracted (= ἐϋεργῆ)
glossary.ἐυσσέλμων: ἐΰσσελμος — well-benched, with good rowing-benches; fem. gen. pl.
glossary.ἑστήκει: ἵστημι — set, stand; plpf. 3 sg. (perf. ἕστηκα): ’had stood, was standing’
glossary.ἑῆς: ἑός, ἑή, ἑόν — his own, her own (possessive, = ὅς); fem. gen. sg.; not the relative
glossary.ἔξοχα: ἔξοχος — outstanding, preeminent; neut. pl. used as adv.: ’above all, outstandingly’
glossary.ἔπαθόν: πάσχω — suffer, undergo; aor. 3 pl., accented before an enclitic (ἔπαθον)
glossary.ἔρξαν: ῥέζω — do, perform; aor. 3 pl., epic ἔρξαν (= Attic ἔδρασαν)
glossary.ἠέρι: ἀήρ — mist, haze; masc. dat. sg., epic ἠέρι, of means: ’in mist’
glossary.ἤειδεν: ἀείδω — sing; impf. 3 sg., epic uncontracted, augmented (= Attic ᾖδεν)
glossary.ἧμιν: ἐγώ — I, we; dat. pl., epic ἧμιν (= Attic ἡμῖν): ’to us’
glossary.ἰλίου: Ἴλιος — Ilios, Troy; fem. gen. sg.
glossary.ἰλιόθι: Ἴλιος — Ilios, Troy; ἰλιόθι, locative adv. with suffix -θι: ’at Ilios’
glossary.ἱππόθεν: ἵππος — horse; ἱππόθεν, adv. with suffix -θεν: ’from the horse’
glossary.ἵκεο: ἱκνέομαι — come, reach; aor. 2 sg. mid., epic ἵκεο (= Attic ἵκου), unaugmented
glossary.ὀδύρεαι: ὀδύρομαι — lament, bewail; pres. 2 sg. mid., epic uncontracted (= Attic ὀδύρῃ)
glossary.ὀιζυροῖο: ὀιζυρός — miserable, woeful; masc. gen. sg., epic -οιο (= Attic -οῦ)
glossary.ὀιζύν: ὀιζύς — misery, woe, hardship; fem. acc. sg.
glossary.ὁρμηθεὶς: ὁρμάω — set in motion, urge on; aor. pass. part. masc. nom. sg.: ’set in motion, impelled’
glossary.ὤπασε: ὀπάζω — give, bestow (+ dat.); aor. 3 sg., augmented
glossary.ὤρορε: ὄρνυμι — rouse, stir up; aor. 2 3 sg., reduplicated, used without an object; the exact sense is uncertain
glossary.ᾖσι: εἰμί — be; pres. subj. 3 sg., epic ᾖσι (= Attic ᾖ), in a purpose clause after ἵνα
glossary.ῥαισέμεναι: ῥαίω — shatter, smash; fut. inf., epic -έμεναι (= Attic ῥαίσειν)
glossary.αἰαίη: Αἰαίη — Aeaean, of Aeaea (Circe’s island); fem. nom. sg. adj., epithet of Circe
glossary.αἰνομόροισιν: αἰνόμορος — dread-fated, of grim lot (αἰνός ’dread’ + μόρος ’lot’); masc. dat. pl., epic -οισιν (= Attic -οις)
glossary.αὐτόθ: αὐτόθι — right there, on the spot; adv., elided (αὐτόθ’ = αὐτόθι)
glossary.αὐτὰς: αὐτός — self; intensive pron., fem. acc. pl.: ’the (ships) themselves’
glossary.βουλυτόνδε: βουλυτός — time of unyoking the oxen, evening; with directional -δε: ’towards evening’
glossary.γεγώνευν: γεγωνέω — shout, call out to; impf. 3 pl., epic uncontracted, unaugmented (= Attic ἐγεγώνουν)
glossary.γλαφυρῇσιν: γλαφυρός — hollow; fem. dat. pl., epic -ῃσιν (= Attic -αις)
glossary.γλυκερώτερον: γλυκερός — sweet; comparative γλυκερώτερος, neut. acc. sg.: ’sweeter’
glossary.γλύκιον: γλυκύς — sweet; epic comparative γλύκιον, neut. nom. sg. (= Attic γλυκύτερον): ’sweeter’
glossary.δαμάσαντες: δαμάζω — subdue, overpower; aor. part. masc. nom. pl.: ’having overpowered’
glossary.δασσάμεθ: δατέομαι — divide, share out; aor. mid. 1 pl., epic -σσ-, unaugmented, elided (δασσάμεθ’ = δασσάμεθα): ’we shared out’
glossary.δείσαντες: δείδω — fear, dread; aor. part. masc. nom. pl.: ’having feared’
glossary.διέσχισεν: διασχίζω — split apart, cleave through; aor. 3 sg.: ’split’
glossary.διερῷ: διερός — sense uncertain: perhaps ’living, lively’ (so ’nimble’), or ’wet’; masc. dat. sg., agreeing with ποδί
glossary.δουλίχιόν: Δουλίχιον — Dulichium, an island near Ithaca; neut. nom. sg.
glossary.δόλοισιν: δόλος — trick, wile, cunning; masc. dat. pl., epic -οισιν (= Attic -οις), dat. of means: ’by tricks’
glossary.δῃωθέντες: δηϊόω — cut down, slay; aor. pass. part. masc. nom. pl.: ’cut down’
glossary.δῆσα: δέω — bind, tie; aor. 1 sg., unaugmented (= ἔδησα): ’I bound’
glossary.εἰνοσίφυλλον: εἰνοσίφυλλος — leaf-shaking, with quivering foliage; neut. nom. sg., agreeing with ὄρος
glossary.εἴδετ: οἶδα — know; perf. subj. 2 pl., epic short-vowel (= Attic εἰδῆτε), elided: ’that you may know’
glossary.εἴδεται: εἴδομαι — seem, appear (with inf.); pres. mid. 3 sg.: ’seems’
glossary.εἴμ: εἰμί — be; pres. 1 sg., elided (εἴμ’ = εἰμί): ’I am’
glossary.εἴρεσθ: εἴρομαι — ask; pres. inf., elided (εἴρεσθ’ = εἴρεσθαι): ’to ask’
glossary.εἴσβαινον: εἰσβαίνω — go aboard, embark; impf. 3 pl., unaugmented (= εἰσέβαινον)
glossary.εἶδαρ: εἶδαρ — food, fare; neut. acc. sg., object of ἔδουσιν
glossary.εἶεν: εἰμί — be; pres. opt. 3 pl., in an indirect question: ’(who) they might be’
glossary.ζάκυνθος: Ζάκυνθος — Zacynthus, an island near Ithaca; fem. nom. sg.
glossary.ζυγὰ: ζυγόν — yoke; a ship’s cross-bench; neut. acc. pl., after ὑπό: ’under the benches’
glossary.θάνατόν: θάνατος — death; masc. acc. sg., enclitic accent before τε: ’death’
glossary.θάνον: θνῄσκω — die; aor. 3 pl., unaugmented (= ἔθανον): ’they died’
glossary.θοῇς: θοός — swift; fem. dat. pl., epic -ῇς (= Attic -αῖς)
glossary.κάθεμεν: καθίημι — let down, lower; aor. 1 pl., epic, unaugmented (= καθεῖμεν; Attic also καθήκαμεν): ’we let down’
glossary.κήρυχ: κῆρυξ — herald; masc. acc. sg., elided (κήρυχ’ = κήρυκα)
glossary.κίκονες: Κίκονες — the Cicones, a Thracian people; masc. nom. pl.
glossary.κίοι: κίω — go, move; pres. opt. 3 sg., in a negative purpose clause after ὡς: ’should go’
glossary.κατερήτυεν: κατερητύω — hold back, detain; impf. 3 sg., epic (= Attic κατηρήτυε)
glossary.κείμεθ: κεῖμαι — lie; impf. 1 pl., unaugmented, elided (κείμεθ’ = κείμεθα): ’we lay’
glossary.κελόμην: κέλομαι — urge, bid, command; impf. 1 sg., unaugmented (= ἐκελόμην): ’I urged’
glossary.κικόνεσσι: Κίκονες — the Cicones, a Thracian people; masc. dat. pl., epic -εσσι (= Attic -οσι): ’to the Cicones’
glossary.κικόνων: Κίκονες — the Cicones, a Thracian people; masc. gen. pl.: ’of the Cicones’
glossary.κλαίοντας: κλαίω — weep, wail; pres. part. masc. acc. pl.: ’weeping’
glossary.κλῖναν: κλίνω — bend, turn; aor. 3 pl., unaugmented (= ἔκλιναν): ’they turned to flight, routed’
glossary.κουροτρόφος: κουροτρόφος — nurse of young men; fem. nom. sg. (adj. of two endings): ’good at rearing youths’
glossary.κρητῆρος: κρατήρ — mixing bowl; masc. gen. sg., epic κρητήρ (= Attic κρατήρ)
glossary.κυβερνῆταί: κυβερνήτης — helmsman, steersman; masc. nom. pl., enclitic accent before τ’
glossary.κυθήρων: Κύθηρα — Cythera, an island off Laconia; neut. pl., gen. of separation with παραπλάζω: ’away from Cythera’
glossary.λάθηται: λανθάνω (mid. λήθομαι) — forget (+ gen.); aor. subj. mid. 3 sg.: ’should forget’
glossary.λαίλαπι: λαῖλαψ — squall, whirlwind; fem. dat. sg.
glossary.λαβόντες: λαμβάνω — take, seize; aor. part. masc. nom. pl.: ’having taken’
glossary.λαερτιάδης: Λαερτιάδης — son of Laertes (patronymic of Odysseus); masc. nom. sg.
glossary.λαθέσθαι: λανθάνω (mid. λήθομαι) — forget (+ gen.); aor. mid. inf.: ’to forget’
glossary.λωτοφάγοι: Λωτοφάγοι — the Lotus-eaters (λωτός + φαγεῖν); masc. nom. pl.
glossary.λωτοφάγοισι: Λωτοφάγοι — the Lotus-eaters; masc. dat. pl., epic -οισι (= Attic -οις)
glossary.λωτοφάγοισιν: Λωτοφάγοι — the Lotus-eaters; masc. dat. pl., epic -οισιν (= Attic -οις)
glossary.λωτοφάγων: Λωτοφάγοι — the Lotus-eaters; masc. gen. pl.: ’of the Lotus-eaters’
glossary.λωτοῖο: λωτός — lotus, the lotus plant and its fruit; masc. gen. sg., epic -οιο (= Attic -οῦ), partitive with φάγοι, πάσασθαι
glossary.λωτὸν: λωτός — lotus, the lotus plant and its fruit; masc. acc. sg.
glossary.μάλειαν: Μαλέα — Malea, the southern cape of Laconia; fem. acc. sg., Ionic Μάλεια
glossary.μάρνασθαι: μάρναμαι — fight, battle; pres. inf.: ’to fight’
glossary.μάχην: μάχη — battle, fight; fem. acc. sg., cognate acc. with ἐμάχοντο: ’fought a fight’
glossary.μέλω: μέλω — be a care to, be of concern to (+ dat.); pres. 1 sg.: ’I am a care’
glossary.μήδονθ: μήδομαι — plan, devise; impf. mid. 3 pl., elided and aspirated (μήδονθ’ = μήδοντο)
glossary.μίγεν: μείγνυμι — mix; aor. pass. 3 pl., unaugmented (= ἐμίγησαν), + dat.: ’they mingled with’
glossary.μενέμεν: μένω — stay, remain; pres. inf., epic -έμεν (= Attic μένειν)
glossary.μετενίσσετο: μετανίσσομαι — go across, move on; impf. 3 sg.: ’was moving on (towards)’
glossary.νήριτον: Νήριτον — Neriton, a mountain on Ithaca; neut. nom. sg., in apposition to ὄρος
glossary.ναίοντες: ναίω — dwell, inhabit; pres. part. masc. nom. pl.: ’dwelling’
glossary.ναιετάουσι: ναιετάω — dwell, inhabit; pres. 3 pl., epic uncontracted (= Attic ναιετῶσι); of a place, ’are inhabited’
glossary.ναιετάω: ναιετάω — dwell in, inhabit; pres. 1 sg., epic uncontracted (= Attic ναιετῶ), + acc.
glossary.οἰνοχόος: οἰνοχόος — wine-pourer, cupbearer; masc. nom. sg.
glossary.οἰχόμενοι: οἴχομαι — go, be gone, go off; pres. part. masc. nom. pl.: ’going off’
glossary.πάθοιμεν: πάσχω — suffer, experience; aor. opt. 1 pl., in a purpose clause after ἵνα: ’that we might suffer’
glossary.πάσασθαι: πατέομαι — taste, eat (+ gen.); aor. mid. inf.: ’to eat of’
glossary.πέλασσεν: πελάζω — bring near; aor. 3 sg., epic -σσ-, unaugmented (= ἐπέλασεν), + dat.: ’brought (me) to’
glossary.πίνετο: πίνω — drink; impf. pass. 3 sg., unaugmented (= ἐπίνετο): ’was drunk’
glossary.πανυπερτάτη: πανύπερτατος — uppermost; sense uncertain: ’highest’ or ’farthest out’; fem. nom. sg. superlative
glossary.παρέπλαγξεν: παραπλάζω — drive astray, carry past; aor. 3 sg.: ’drove astray’
glossary.περιγνάμπτοντα: περιγνάμπτω — bend around, round (a cape); pres. part. masc. acc. sg.: ’as I was rounding’
glossary.πεύθεσθαι: πυνθάνομαι — learn, inquire; pres. inf., epic πεύθομαι (= Attic πυνθάνεσθαι): ’to find out’
glossary.πλέονάς: πολύς — much, many; comparative πλέων, masc. acc. pl. πλέονας: ’more numerous’, accented before enclitic περ
glossary.πλήθωσι: πλήθω — be full, fill; pres. subj. 3 pl., + gen.: ’may be full of’
glossary.ποδὶ: πούς — foot; masc. dat. sg., dat. of manner (διερῷ ποδί ’on a nimble foot’)
glossary.πολυκηδέ: πολυκηδής — full of woe, much-troubled; masc. acc. sg., uncontracted and elided (πολυκηδέ’ = πολυκηδέα; Attic πολυκηδῆ)
glossary.προΐειν: προΐημι — send forth; impf. 1 sg., epic (= Attic προΐην): ’I sent forward’
glossary.προερέσσαμεν: προερέσσω — row forward; aor. 1 pl., epic -σσ-, unaugmented: ’we rowed on’
glossary.πρῶτόν: πρῶτος — first; neut. acc. sg. used adverbially: ’first’, accented before enclitic τοι
glossary.σάμη: Σάμη — Same, an island (later Cephallenia); fem. nom. sg.
glossary.σίτοιό: σῖτος — bread, grain, food; masc. gen. sg., epic -οιο (= Attic -ου), partitive with ἐπασσάμεθ’; accented before enclitic τ’
glossary.σπερχομένους: σπέρχομαι — hasten, be in a hurry; pres. part. masc. acc. pl.: ’hastening’
glossary.στησάμενοι: ἵστημι — set up, place; aor. mid. part. masc. nom. pl.: ’having set up’ (also ’having taken a stand’, drawn up in line)
glossary.στονόεντα: στονόεις — full of groaning, grievous; neut. acc. pl., epic -όεντα
glossary.συνεχὲς: συνεχής — continuous, unbroken; neut. acc. sg. used adverbially: ’without a break’
glossary.τετραχθὰ: τετραχθά — in four pieces; adv. (correlative with τριχθά)
glossary.τρίτατον: τρίτατος — third; epic superlative-form of τρίτος, masc. acc. sg.: ’as a third’
glossary.τρηχεῖ: τρηχύς — rough, rugged; fem. nom. sg., elided (τρηχεῖ’ = τρηχεῖα; Attic τραχεῖα)
glossary.φάγοι: ἐσθίω — eat; aor. (ἔφαγον) opt. 3 sg., in an indefinite relative clause: ’whoever should eat’
glossary.φαγὼν: ἐσθίω — eat; aor. (ἔφαγον) part. masc. nom. sg.: ’having eaten’
glossary.φευγέμεν: φεύγω — flee; pres. inf., epic -έμεν (= Attic φεύγειν)
glossary.φορέῃσι: φορέω — carry about, bear; pres. subj. 3 sg., epic -ῃσι (= Attic φορῇ)
glossary.φυγὼν: φεύγω — flee, escape; aor. part. masc. nom. sg.: ’having escaped’
glossary.φύγομεν: φεύγω — flee, escape; aor. 1 pl., unaugmented (= ἐφύγομεν): ’we escaped’
glossary.χαλκήρεσιν: χαλκήρης — fitted with bronze; fem. dat. pl., epic -εσιν (= Attic -εσι)
glossary.χαριέστερον: χαρίεις — graceful, pleasing; comparative χαριέστερος, neut. acc. sg.: ’more pleasing’
glossary.χθαμαλὴ: χθαμαλός — low-lying, low; fem. nom. sg.
glossary.ἀέξετο: ἀέξω — make grow, increase; impf. pass. 3 sg., unaugmented (= ἠέξετο): ’was growing’
glossary.ἀκαχήμενοι: ἀχέω (also ἀκαχίζω) — grieve, distress; perf. mid. part. masc. nom. pl., epic reduplicated: ’grieved’
glossary.ἀκουάζωνται: ἀκουάζομαι — listen to (+ gen.); pres. subj. mid. 3 pl.: ’may listen’
glossary.ἀλεξόμενοι: ἀλέξω — ward off, defend; pres. mid. part. masc. nom. pl.: ’defending ourselves’
glossary.ἀλλοδαπῇ: ἀλλοδαπός — of another land, foreign; fem. dat. sg.
glossary.ἀλόχους: ἄλοχος — wife, bedfellow; fem. acc. pl.
glossary.ἀνέμοισιν: ἄνεμος — wind; masc. dat. pl., epic -οισιν (= Attic -οις)
glossary.ἀπέωσε: ἀπωθέω — push away, drive off; aor. 3 sg. (aorist stem ἐωσ-): ’thrust away’
glossary.ἀπαγγεῖλαι: ἀπαγγέλλω — bring word back, report; aor. inf.
glossary.ἀτεμβόμενος: ἀτέμβω — cheat, deprive; pass. part. masc. nom. sg., + gen.: ’cheated (of)’
glossary.ἀφ: ἀπό — from, away from; prep. + gen., elided and aspirated before a rough breathing (ἀφ’ = ἀπό)
glossary.ἀφυσσάμεθ: ἀφύσσω — draw (liquid); aor. mid. 1 pl., epic -σσ-, unaugmented, elided (ἀφυσσάμεθ’ = ἀφυσσάμεθα): ’we drew’
glossary.ἀφύσσων: ἀφύσσω — draw (liquid), ladle out; pres. part. masc. nom. sg.: ’drawing’
glossary.ἀῦσαι: ἀΰω — shout, call aloud; aor. inf.: ’to call out’
glossary.ἄνθεα: ἄνθος — flower, blossom; neut. nom. pl., uncontracted (= Attic ἄνθη)
glossary.ἄνθινον: ἄνθινος — flowery, made of flowers; neut. acc. sg.
glossary.ἄσμενοι: ἄσμενος — glad, well pleased; masc. nom. pl.
glossary.ἐγχείῃ: ἐγχέω — pour in; pres. subj. 3 sg., epic lengthened (= ἐγχέῃ): ’may pour’
glossary.ἐγχείῃσιν: ἐγχείη — spear; fem. dat. pl., epic -ῃσιν (= Attic -αις), instrumental
glossary.ἐνίσπω: ἐνέπω — tell, relate; aor. subj. 1 sg. (ἐνίσπον), hortatory after εἰ δ’ ἄγε: ’let me tell’
glossary.ἐπέβημεν: ἐπιβαίνω — step on, set foot on (+ gen.); aor. 1 pl.: ’we set foot on’
glossary.ἐπασσάμεθ: πατέομαι — taste, eat (+ gen.); aor. mid. 1 pl., epic -σσ-, elided (ἐπασσάμεθ’ = ἐπασσάμεθα): ’we tasted’
glossary.ἐπετράπετο: ἐπιτρέπω — turn over; mid. turn to, be moved to (+ inf.); aor. mid. 3 sg.: ’was inclined’
glossary.ἐπικάρσιαι: ἐπικάρσιος — sense uncertain: ’slantwise, aslant’ or ’head first’ (from κάρ-, ’head’); fem. nom. pl., agreeing with αἱ, the ships
glossary.ἐπιστάμενοι: ἐπίσταμαι — know how to (+ inf.); pres. part. masc. nom. pl.: ’skilled in’
glossary.ἐρίηρας: ἐρίηρος — traditionally ’trusty’, exact sense uncertain (of companions); masc. acc. pl.
glossary.ἐρεπτόμενοι: ἐρέπτομαι — feed on, munch; pres. part. mid. masc. nom. pl., + acc.
glossary.ἐρύσαντες: ἐρύω — draw, haul; aor. part. masc. nom. pl.: ’having hauled up’
glossary.ἐρύσσας: ἐρύω — draw, drag; aor. part. masc. nom. sg., epic -σσ-: ’having dragged’
glossary.ἐσσυμένως: ἐσσυμένως — hastily, eagerly; adv. from the participle of σεύομαι ’rush’
glossary.ἐυφροσύνη: εὐφροσύνη — cheer, merriment; fem. nom. sg., epic ἐυ- (= Attic εὐ-)
glossary.ἐφέηκεν: ἐφίημι — send upon, impose on; aor. 3 sg., epic (= Attic ἐφῆκεν): ’laid upon’
glossary.ἐφέροντ: φέρω — carry, bear; impf. pass. 3 pl., elided (ἐφέροντ’ = ἐφέροντο): ’were borne along’
glossary.ἑκάστης: ἕκαστος — each; fem. gen. sg., agreeing with νηός
glossary.ἔπειθον: πείθω — persuade; impf. 3 pl. (the ending also serves 1 sg.): ’they tried to persuade’
glossary.ἔπραθον: πέρθω — sack, destroy; aor. 1 sg. (ἔπραθον, the aor. 2 stem πραθ-): ’I sacked’
glossary.ἔσφαζον: σφάζω — slaughter; impf. 3 pl.: ’they were slaughtering’
glossary.ἔω: εἰμί — be; pres. subj. 1 sg., epic (= Attic ὦ), with ἄν: ’I may be’
glossary.ἠέλιόν: ἥλιος (epic ἠέλιος) — sun; masc. acc. sg., accented before enclitic τε
glossary.ἠέριοι: ἠέριος — sense uncertain: ’early’ (from ἠώς or ἦρι) or ’misty’ (from ἠήρ); masc. nom. pl.
glossary.ἠνώγεα: ἄνωγα — command, bid; plupf. 1 sg. of a perfect with present sense, used as impf.: ’I urged’
glossary.ἡμετέροις: ἡμέτερος — our, ours; masc. dat. pl.
glossary.ἤπειρον: ἤπειρος — mainland, dry land; fem. acc. sg.
glossary.ἰλιόθεν: Ἴλιος — Ilium, Troy; adv. with ablatival -θεν: ’from Ilium’
glossary.ἰσμάρῳ: Ἴσμαρος — Ismarus, a city of the Cicones; masc. dat. sg., in apposition to Κικόνεσσι: ’to Ismarus’
glossary.ἰόντας: εἶμι — go; pres. part. masc. acc. pl.: ’going’
glossary.ἴθυνον: ἰθύνω — steer straight, guide; impf. 3 pl.: ’they steered’
glossary.ἴσης: ἴσος — equal, fair; fem. gen. sg. (μοίρης understood): ’(an) equal (share)’, gen. with ἀτεμβόμενος
glossary.ὀλέσαντες: ὄλλυμι — destroy, lose; aor. part. masc. nom. pl.: ’having lost’
glossary.ὀλοοῖς: ὀλοός — destructive, deadly; masc. dat. pl.
glossary.ὀπάσσας: ὀπάζω — send along as attendant, add; aor. part. masc. nom. sg., epic -σσ-: ’having added’
glossary.ὑλήεσσα: ὑλήεις — wooded; fem. nom. sg., epic -ήεσσα
glossary.ὑστάτιον: ὕστατος — last; epic by-form ὑστάτιος, neut. acc. sg. used adverbially: ’last’
glossary.ὠκειάων: ὠκύς — swift; fem. gen. pl., epic -άων (= Attic -ῶν), agreeing with νηῶν
glossary.ὤλεσα: ὄλλυμι — destroy, lose; aor. 1 sg.: ’I destroyed’
glossary.ὤλονθ: ὄλλυμι — destroy; mid. perish; aor. mid. 3 pl., elided and aspirated (ὤλονθ’ = ὤλοντο): ’they perished’
glossary.ῥόος: ῥόος — current, stream; masc. nom. sg., epic (= Attic ῥοῦς)
